questions.question: Which Indian city is hosting the Kimberley Process Intersessional Meeting 2026 from May 11 to May 14, 2026?
questions.explanation: Mumbai is hosting the Kimberley Process Intersessional Meeting 2026 from May 11 to May 14, 2026, under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry. India assumed the Chair of the Kimberley Process on January 1, 2026, focusing on the theme of credibility, compliance, and consumer confidence in the natural diamond sector. The meeting includes representatives from 86 countries and the European Union. The Kimberley Process Certification Scheme was established to prevent conflict diamonds from entering legitimate global markets. India’s role as a major global hub for diamond cutting and polishing further strengthens its importance in the international diamond trade and regulatory framework.

questions.question: Which country developed an AI-driven electrochemical process to convert nitrate-polluted wastewater into sustainable agricultural ammonia?
questions.explanation: China developed an advanced Artificial Intelligence-driven electrochemical process to transform nitrate-polluted wastewater into sustainable agricultural ammonia. The innovation uses machine learning to identify the most effective Dual-Atom Catalyst (DAC) for nitrate electroreduction. This technology operates at room temperature with renewable electricity and achieves nearly three times the efficiency of earlier methods. The process is environmentally significant because it helps reduce water pollution, limits eutrophication in aquatic ecosystems, and lowers carbon emissions associated with traditional ammonia production. It also serves as an eco-friendly alternative to the conventional Haber-Bosch process, which requires fossil fuels, high temperatures, and extreme pressure.

questions.question: Which city in Gujarat will host the 2026 Asian Weightlifting Championships from May 11 to 17, 2026?
questions.explanation: Gandhinagar, the capital city of Gujarat, has been selected as the host venue for the 2026 Asian Weightlifting Championships. The event is scheduled to take place from May 11 to 17, 2026, and it marks a significant milestone as India will organise the championship after a gap of 44 years. Around 180 athletes from 28 countries are expected to participate in the tournament. The championship is also important because it serves as a qualifying event for major international competitions like the Commonwealth Games and the Asian Games, highlighting India’s growing role in hosting international sporting events.

questions.question: How many Panchayats across 17 States and Union Territories were selected for the National Panchayat Awards 2025?
questions.explanation: The Ministry of Panchayati Raj announced the National Panchayat Awards 2025, recognising 42 Panchayats from 17 States and Union Territories for their outstanding contributions to rural development and local governance. These awards are presented under the Incentivization of Panchayats component of the Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan (RGSA). The awards encourage Panchayati Raj Institutions to improve governance, social welfare, women's empowerment, child welfare, water conservation, and livelihood opportunities. Cash incentives ranging from ₹50 lakh to ₹5 crore are provided to winning Panchayats. Karnataka secured the highest number of awards, followed by Andhra Pradesh and Odisha.

questions.question: Which airport in Mumbai achieved the Zero Waste to Landfill (ZWL) Platinum – Class I Rating for diverting over 99% of its waste from landfills?
options: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport
questions.explanation: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (CSMIA) in Mumbai achieved the prestigious Zero Waste to Landfill (ZWL) Platinum – Class I Rating on May 12, 2026. The recognition was awarded by the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) for successfully diverting more than 99 percent of airport waste away from landfills. This achievement highlights the airport’s strong commitment to sustainable waste management and environmental conservation. CSMIA is also one of India’s busiest airports, handling over 50 million passengers annually. The airport is operated by Mumbai International Airport Limited, where Adani Airport Holdings Limited holds the majority stake.

questions.question: Who assumed charge as the Chairman & Managing Director (CMD) of Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) on 09 May 2026?
questions.explanation: Dr. Ashok Kumar Panda assumed charge as the Chairman & Managing Director (CMD) of Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) on 09 May 2026. Before his elevation, he served as Director (Finance) and also handled the additional responsibility of Director (Commercial) in the company. Dr. Panda began his career with SAIL in 1992 as a Management Trainee (Technical), showcasing a long and experienced association with the organisation. SAIL is a Maharatna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Steel and plays a major role in India’s steel production and industrial development.

questions.question: In which city was the National Conference on Laboratory Animal Welfare organised by the Committee for Control and Supervision of Experiments on Animals (CCSEA) on May 11, 2026?
questions.explanation: The National Conference on Laboratory Animal Welfare was organised in New Delhi by the Committee for Control and Supervision of Experiments on Animals (CCSEA) on May 11, 2026. The conference focused on promoting ethical research practices and ensuring animal welfare in scientific experiments. It was conducted under the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying with the theme “Policies and Best Practices of Research on Animals and their Welfare.” The event highlighted humane treatment of animals during vaccine development and drug discovery trials while also encouraging institutions to align with international animal welfare standards and responsible scientific research practices.

questions.question: What is the revised annual release date for the Provisional Estimates of Annual GDP and Q4 GDP announced by the NSO?
questions.explanation: The National Statistics Office (NSO) revised the annual release schedule for the Provisional Estimates of Annual GDP and Fourth Quarter GDP to June 7 each year. Earlier, the data was released on the last working day of May. The revision was made after consultations with the Advisory Committee on National Accounts Statistics (ACNAS). The new schedule allows the inclusion of important corporate financial data and finalised Central Government account figures such as taxes, subsidies, and capital expenditure. The NSO, functioning under the Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation, is responsible for compiling national accounts and major macroeconomic indicators in India.

questions.question: Who took oath as the Chief Minister of Puducherry for a fifth term in May 2026?
questions.explanation: N Rangasamy, leader of the All India NR Congress (AINRC), was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Puducherry for the fifth time on May 13, 2026. The oath of office was administered by Lieutenant Governor K Kailashnathan. The AINRC-led NDA alliance formed the government after securing the support of 18 MLAs, crossing the majority mark in the Puducherry Legislative Assembly. Along with him, Malladi Krishna Rao and A Namassivayam were inducted as ministers. N Rangasamy also won assembly elections from both Thattanchavady and Mangalam constituencies with significant victory margins.

questions.question: Which platform partnered with SAI to launch CWG 2030 engagement initiatives in 2026?
questions.explanation: MyBharat, officially known as Mera Yuva Bharat, is a technology-driven platform launched on October 31, 2023, for youth development in India. It partnered with the Sports Authority of India (SAI) to launch nationwide digital engagement initiatives ahead of the Commonwealth Games 2030 in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. These initiatives included a Torch Design Contest, CWG Reel Challenge, and CWG 2030 Quiz. The platform aims to encourage youth participation in sports, creativity, and nation-building activities through digital outreach and engagement programmes across the country.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Chairman of the BRISEC Chamber of Commerce & Industry in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Dr Harvansh Chawla was appointed as the Chairman of the BRISEC Chamber of Commerce & Industry (CCI) on May 11, 2026. Before taking up this position, he stepped down as the Chairman of the BRICS CCI. The BRISEC Chamber focuses on promoting cross-border trade, investment, and economic collaboration among emerging and established markets. It also works to expand policy dialogue beyond the traditional BRICS framework into broader global economic corridors. The organisation is officially recognised by NITI Aayog and regularly organises forums, trade delegations, and policy interactions to strengthen international business cooperation.

questions.question: What GDP growth forecast did Moody's set for India for 2026 and 2027?
questions.explanation: Moody's Investors Service revised India's GDP growth forecast to 6% for both 2026 and 2027 due to rising energy costs and geopolitical tensions affecting the economy. The downgrade reflects concerns over subdued private consumption, weaker industrial activity, and reduced capital formation. India’s dependence on imported energy, especially crude oil and LPG passing through the Strait of Hormuz, increases vulnerability to global disruptions. Higher fuel and fertiliser costs may also strain government finances and reduce capital spending. Moody’s is one of the world’s leading credit rating agencies and closely monitors global economic and financial conditions.

questions.question: In which state was the Bhimmandali Eco Heritage Site inaugurated in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The Bhimmandali Eco Heritage Site was inaugurated in Sambalpur, Odisha, by Union Minister Dharmendra Pradhan on May 10, 2026. Located within the Naktideul Forest Range, the site is historically significant for its ancient rock paintings and stone inscriptions dating back more than 20,000 years. It served as a human shelter from the Old Stone Age to the Neolithic period. The site also has mythological importance linked to Bhima from the Mahabharata and features a cave dedicated to Lord Shiva and Parvati as Gupteswar. Odisha, formed on April 1, 1936, celebrates its foundation day annually as Utkal Divas.

questions.question: Which state launched the Meri Rasoi Yojna in May 2026 to distribute free nutritional food kits to poor families?
questions.explanation: Punjab launched the Meri Rasoi Yojna on May 09, 2026, under the leadership of Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann. The scheme aims to provide free nutritional kitchen kits every three months to nearly 40 lakh economically weaker families in the state. The kits include essential items such as mustard oil, pulses, sugar, salt, and turmeric to support household food security. Alongside this, the state also initiated the Mawan Dheeyan Satkar Yojna to provide monthly financial assistance to eligible women. Punjab is popularly known as the “Land of Five Rivers” and has a unicameral legislature with 117 assembly constituencies.

questions.question: Which organisation, functioning under the Ministry of Science & Technology, facilitated the transfer of 13 indigenous technologies developed by the Central Building Research Institute to industries and start-ups on National Technology Day 2026?
questions.explanation: The Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) is an autonomous body operating under the Ministry of Science & Technology. It facilitated the transfer of 13 indigenous technologies developed by the Central Building Research Institute (CBRI) during the National Technology Day event held on May 12, 2026. These technologies were related to fire safety, sustainable construction, infrastructure protection, energy efficiency, and advanced building materials. Headquartered in New Delhi and established in 1942, the organisation plays a major role in advancing scientific research, innovation, and industrial development in India through its network of laboratories and institutes.

questions.question: What is the revised import duty rate on gold and silver announced by the Centre in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The Centre revised the customs duty on precious metals on May 13, 2026, to safeguard macroeconomic stability and conserve foreign exchange reserves. Under the revised structure, the import duty on gold and silver was increased significantly from 6% to 15%, while platinum duty was raised to 15.4%. The policy aims to reduce non-essential imports and ease pressure on India’s Current Account Deficit (CAD). The decision was also influenced by global crude oil volatility and supply-side disruptions affecting international trade and shipping. The Ministry of Finance manages such economic and taxation policies to maintain financial stability in the country.

questions.question: Where is the headquarters of the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) located?
questions.explanation: The Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) is headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra. It is a premier research and development organisation under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY). C-DAC is widely known for developing India’s first indigenous supercomputer, PARAM 8000, in 1991. The organisation plays a significant role in advanced computing, electronics, and information technology research in India. In the IP Catalyst initiative launched in 2026, C-DAC Pune was entrusted with the implementation of the programme aimed at promoting patent commercialisation and supporting innovation-driven technology development across the country.

questions.question: Which state cabinet approved the draft Uniform Civil Code (UCC) Bill in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The Assam cabinet approved the draft Uniform Civil Code (UCC) Bill in May 2026, with plans to introduce it in the state legislative assembly on May 26, 2026. The proposed law aims to regulate civil matters such as marriage, divorce, live-in relationships, and compulsory marriage registration through a common legal framework. Tribal communities in Assam are exempted from the bill to preserve their traditional customs and cultural practices. The bill aligns structurally with UCC models of states like Gujarat, Uttarakhand, and Goa. Article 44 of the Indian Constitution mentions the Uniform Civil Code as a Directive Principle of State Policy.

questions.question: Who was sworn in for a seventh term as the President of Uganda in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Yoweri Museveni was officially sworn in for a historic seventh term as the President of Uganda on May 12, 2026. The oath-taking ceremony took place at the Kololo Independence Grounds in Kampala, the capital city of Uganda. Museveni secured a decisive electoral victory with more than 71 percent of the votes, while opposition leader Bobi Wine received around 25 percent. Museveni is regarded as one of Africa’s longest-serving leaders, and his latest victory extends his continuous tenure in office to nearly four decades. Uganda continues to play an important role in East African politics and regional affairs.

questions.question: What was India's annual WPI inflation rate in April 2026?
questions.explanation: India’s annual inflation rate based on the Wholesale Price Index (WPI) stood at 8.3% in April 2026 on a provisional basis. The increase was mainly driven by higher prices of mineral oils, crude petroleum, natural gas, basic metals, and manufactured products. Fuel and power recorded a particularly sharp rise due to higher mineral oil prices, while primary articles also witnessed strong inflationary pressure. The WPI is released every month by the Office of the Economic Adviser under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. Manufactured products carry the highest weightage in the WPI basket, making them a key factor in overall inflation trends.

questions.question: On which date is the International Day of Families observed globally every year?
questions.explanation: The International Day of Families is observed globally every year on May 15 to recognise the importance of families in society and their role in social development. The 2026 theme, “Families, Inequalities and Child Wellbeing,” highlighted how social and economic inequalities affect family life and children’s futures. The observance encourages governments and institutions to adopt policies supporting family welfare, education, health, employment, and social inclusion. The United Nations General Assembly proclaimed the day in 1993, and the first global observance took place in 1994. It serves as an important platform for promoting awareness about issues affecting families worldwide.

questions.question: Which company launched India's first compliant stablecoin cross-border payments platform in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Xflow launched India’s first compliant stablecoin-based cross-border payments infrastructure on May 14, 2026. The platform allows Indian businesses to accept international payments in stablecoins such as USDC and USDT and convert them into Indian Rupees through authorised banking channels. The system ensures regulatory compliance by conducting stablecoin transactions and off-ramping processes outside India, while only fiat currency enters the country through AD Category I banks. The platform mainly supports MSMEs, SaaS companies, and service exporters facing challenges in global payments. Xflow was co-founded by Anand Balaji and Ashwin Bhatnagar and is backed by investors such as Lightspeed, General Catalyst, and Stripe.

questions.question: Which bank launched a new credit card portfolio with variants such as AU Ananta, AU Laksya, AU Tejas, and AU Prathama in May 2026?
questions.explanation: AU Small Finance Bank launched a new credit card portfolio on May 14, 2026, introducing four variants tailored to different customer segments and lifestyle needs. The portfolio includes AU Ananta for affluent users, AU Laksya for digitally active professionals and Gen Z customers, AU Tejas for young salaried individuals, and AU Prathama for first-time credit users. These cards provide benefits such as reward points, cashback offers, airport lounge access, EMI facilities, and fuel surcharge waivers. AU Small Finance Bank is recognised as India’s largest Small Finance Bank and is also notable for receiving in-principle approval to transition into a Universal Bank.

questions.question: How many states were felicitated by NeGD for DigiLocker integration initiatives in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The National e-Governance Division (NeGD) felicitated five states for their successful integration of DigiLocker with citizen services during the National Consultative Workshop on Strengthening Cybersecurity Frameworks for State Data held on May 11, 2026. The recognised states included Karnataka, Gujarat, Keralam, Nagaland, and Rajasthan for their achievements in digital governance and service integration. DigiLocker, launched under the Digital India programme in 2015, enables citizens to securely access and store digital documents online. NeGD, functioning under the Digital India Corporation, plays an important role in promoting e-governance and digital public infrastructure across India.

questions.question: Until when has India prohibited sugar exports under the amended trade policy announced in May 2026?
questions.explanation: India prohibited the export of raw, white, and refined sugar until September 30, 2026, through an amendment to the trade policy announced by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. The decision was taken to ensure adequate domestic supply and stabilise sugar prices in the local market. The prohibition applies to specific ITC (HS) codes under Chapter 17 of the trade classification system. Certain exemptions continue for quota-based exports to the European Union and the United States, shipments under the Advance Authorisation Scheme, and consignments related to international food security commitments. If not extended further, the export status will revert to “Restricted” after September 2026.

questions.question: Which Indian Naval Ship completed the IOS SAGAR initiative port call at Chattogram, Bangladesh?
questions.explanation: INS Sunayna successfully completed its maritime port call at Chattogram, Bangladesh, under the Indian Ocean Ship (IOS) SAGAR initiative. The deployment was carried out under the Ministry of Defence and included joint naval activities with the Bangladesh Navy, such as a Passage Exercise (PASSEX) and coordinated maritime manoeuvres with BNS Protoy. The ship also carried personnel from 16 partner nations during the mission, highlighting regional maritime cooperation. After concluding its Bangladesh visit, the vessel proceeded toward Colombo, Sri Lanka, as part of its operational route. The initiative strengthens India’s maritime partnerships and regional security collaboration in the Indian Ocean region.

questions.question: Which institution commissioned India's first Integrated CCUS Field Laboratory Facility in May 2026?
questions.explanation: IIT Bombay commissioned India’s first Integrated Carbon Capture, Utilisation, and Storage (CCUS) Field Laboratory Facility under Bharat Innovates 2026 on May 11, 2026. The indigenously developed pilot facility has the capacity to process up to 3 tonnes of carbon dioxide per day using advanced aqueous-based catalytic CO₂ capture technology. The system can capture carbon dioxide from ambient air and industrial emissions using non-potable water sources such as seawater and industrial effluents. The project also includes geological sequestration in the Deccan Traps to permanently store CO₂. IIT Bombay, established in 1958, is an Institute of National Importance located in Powai, Mumbai.

questions.question: Which company partnered with the Adani Group on May 16, 2026, to establish its first data centre in India?
questions.explanation: Uber partnered with the Adani Group to establish its first data centre in India as part of a strategic technology and infrastructure collaboration. The agreement was finalised after a meeting between Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi and Gautam Adani in Ahmedabad. The facility is expected to become operational by the end of 2026 and will support Uber’s technological expansion in India. The project aligns with Adani Group’s broader vision of investing $100 billion in renewable-energy-powered and AI-ready data centres by 2035. The infrastructure is being developed through Adani Connex, which is building a large-scale five-gigawatt data centre platform across India.

questions.question: What is the name of the strategic initiative aimed at establishing manufacturing and integration partnerships across 7 continents and 77 countries for the Kaal Bhairava combat aircraft?
questions.explanation: Operation 777 is a strategic initiative launched in connection with the Kaal Bhairava autonomous combat aircraft programme developed by Flying Wedge Defence & Aerospace (FWDA). The initiative focuses on creating manufacturing and integration partnerships across 7 continents and 77 countries, strengthening India’s global defence manufacturing presence. Under this initiative, FWDA established its first overseas manufacturing facility in Portugal in collaboration with SKETCHPIXEL LDA. The Kaal Bhairava platform is a Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) autonomous combat aircraft equipped with advanced features such as AI-driven target recognition, encrypted communication systems, and swarm coordination capabilities, representing a significant milestone in India’s indigenous defence technology development.

questions.question: In which Indian state was the ‘Lion’ Species Spotlight Programme inaugurated at Sasan Gir in 2026?
questions.explanation: The ‘Lion’ Species Spotlight Programme was inaugurated at Sasan Gir in Gujarat by Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav as a precursor to the IBCA Summit 2026. The programme highlighted the success of Asiatic lion conservation efforts in the Greater Gir Landscape, where the lion population reached an estimated 891 individuals in 2025, reflecting a 32% increase since the 2020 census. The initiative aligns with Project Lion, launched in 2020 for long-term conservation and habitat restoration. Gujarat remains the only natural habitat of Asiatic lions in the world, making the state globally significant for wildlife conservation and biodiversity protection.

questions.question: Which Financial Technology company announced the launch of the Artificial Intelligence-native lending infrastructure suite named Atlas?
questions.explanation: FinBox announced the launch of Atlas, an Artificial Intelligence-native lending infrastructure suite designed to transform the digital lending ecosystem. The platform significantly reduces loan processing time from nearly three weeks to just 24 hours by automating traditional lending operations. Atlas replaces manual workflows with AI-driven agents capable of handling borrower onboarding, document verification, and operational decision-making throughout the credit lifecycle. This innovation aims to improve efficiency, speed, and accuracy in digital lending services. The launch reflects the growing role of Artificial Intelligence in the fintech sector, where automation and data-driven systems are increasingly being used to streamline financial services and customer experiences.

questions.question: Which state signed an agreement with the Digital Bharat Nidhi (DBN) and the Department of Telecommunications for implementing the Amended BharatNet Programme?
questions.explanation: Andhra Pradesh signed an agreement with the Digital Bharat Nidhi (DBN), the Department of Telecommunications, BSNL, APBIL, and APSFL for implementing the Amended BharatNet Programme. The Central Government approved financial support of ₹2,432 crore for the project. The initiative aims to strengthen digital infrastructure by covering 13,426 Gram Panchayats and providing on-demand connectivity to thousands of villages. It also plans to facilitate more than 5 lakh rural home fibre connections. BharatNet is a flagship programme intended to expand broadband connectivity to rural India, while DBN, formerly known as USOF, funds major telecom and digital inclusion projects across the country.

questions.question: In which city was the third edition of the Kalam & Kavach strategic defence conference inaugurated on May 14, 2026?
questions.explanation: The third edition of the Kalam & Kavach strategic defence conference was inaugurated at the Manekshaw Centre in New Delhi by Raksha Rajya Mantri Shri Sanjay Seth. The conference focused on the vision of Jointness, Aatmanirbharta, and Innovation (JAI), while promoting indigenisation and international collaboration in defence technologies. Discussions covered AI-enabled warfare, autonomous systems, hypersonic technologies, quantum-enabled C4ISR capabilities, and emerging space threats. The event also highlighted the role of iDEX, MSMEs, and defence industrial corridors in strengthening India’s defence ecosystem. The initiative supports India’s long-term strategic objective of achieving Viksit Bharat@2047 through advanced indigenous defence capabilities.

questions.question: In which city was the MoU signed on 20 April 2026 to develop India’s first Mega Greenfield Shipyard?
questions.explanation: India’s first Mega Greenfield Shipyard will be developed at Thoothukudi in Tamil Nadu under a tripartite agreement involving HD Korea Shipbuilding & Offshore Engineering, NSHIP-TN, and Sagarmala Finance Corporation Limited. The project was established under the India-ROK ‘VOYAGES’ framework during the South Korean President’s state visit. The shipyard is expected to have an annual capacity of 2.5 Million Gross Tonnage and generate around 15,000 direct jobs. This initiative supports the Maritime Amrit Kaal Vision 2047, which aims to make India one of the top five global shipbuilding nations by significantly increasing domestic shipbuilding capacity and maritime infrastructure development.

questions.question: Which airport received Union Cabinet approval for modernisation under a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model?
questions.explanation: The Union Cabinet approved the modernisation of Nagpur International Airport through a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model by extending the lease period of the Airports Authority of India land granted to MIHAN India Limited. The project operations will be managed by GMR Nagpur International Airport Limited (GNIAL) for a concession period of 30 years. The modernisation aims to expand the airport’s capacity to handle up to 30 million passengers annually while strengthening cargo logistics in the Vidarbha region. The airport, officially known as Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar International Airport, is also a major component of the Multi-modal International Cargo Hub and Airport at Nagpur (MIHAN) project.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the next Chief Minister of Kerala by the Congress-led United Democratic Front (UDF) on May 14, 2026?
questions.explanation: VD Satheesan was appointed as the next Chief Minister of Kerala after the Congress-led United Democratic Front (UDF) achieved a decisive victory in the 2026 Kerala Assembly elections. The alliance secured 102 out of 140 seats, while the Indian National Congress emerged as the single largest party with 63 seats. VD Satheesan also won his sixth consecutive term as an MLA from the Paravur constituency. This result marked the end of the second consecutive term of the Left Democratic Front (LDF) government led by Pinarayi Vijayan. Kerala’s capital is Thiruvananthapuram, and the state was formed on November 1, 1956.

questions.question: Which Indian state implemented a rotational work-from-home policy for specific government employees on May 14, 2026, to conserve fuel and reduce expenditure?
questions.explanation: Tripura introduced a rotational work-from-home policy for Group C and Group D government employees to reduce fuel consumption and state expenditure. Under this arrangement, only 50 percent of employees attend offices physically each day, while the remaining staff work remotely on a weekly rotational basis. Employees working from home are required to stay electronically connected and must report immediately during emergencies. Essential and emergency services were exempted from the directive to ensure uninterrupted public services. Tripura, with its capital at Agartala, became a full-fledged state on January 21, 1972, under the North-Eastern Areas (Reorganisation) Act, 1971.

questions.question: Which state became the first in India to complete all priority areas under both Phase I and Phase II of the Compliance Reduction and Deregulation initiative in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Tripura became the first Indian state to complete all 51 priority areas under the national Compliance Reduction and Deregulation initiative launched in January 2026. The initiative, led by the Cabinet Secretariat, focuses on simplifying governance, reducing regulatory burdens, and improving ease of doing business. Tripura introduced several digital governance reforms, including a centralised e-Gazette system, an upgraded SWAGAAT single-window approval platform, and an auto-appeal mechanism under the Right to Services framework. The state also implemented sectoral reforms such as self-certification for land-use approvals and inspection exemptions for industries, while partnering with National Law University Tripura and IIM Calcutta for legal review and impact assessment.

questions.question: Who formally assumed charge as India’s High Commissioner to the United Kingdom on May 15, 2026?
questions.explanation: P Kumaran, a senior 1992-batch Indian Foreign Service (IFS) officer, formally took charge as India’s High Commissioner to the United Kingdom on May 15, 2026. Before this appointment, he served as Secretary (East) in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA). He succeeded Vikram Doraiswami, who was appointed as India’s Ambassador to China during a senior diplomatic reshuffle. P Kumaran has also held important diplomatic positions earlier, including serving as India’s Ambassador to Qatar and High Commissioner to Singapore. The role of High Commissioner is specifically used between Commonwealth nations such as India and the United Kingdom.

questions.question: What was the guiding theme of the National Conclave on Minorities Welfare convened by the Ministry of Minority Affairs in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The National Conclave on Minorities Welfare organized by the Ministry of Minority Affairs (MoMA) in May 2026, was conducted under the theme “Bhagidari Se Bhagyoday,” which means “Prosperity through Participation.” The conclave focused on improving minority welfare through participative governance and the integration of artificial intelligence in public service delivery. Discussions included the use of AI-powered conversational bots for grievance redressal and welfare scheme implementation, as well as AI applications for Hajj 2027 management. Several technology partners, such as Generation India, EkStep Foundation, Gnani, and Sarvam, showcased innovative AI-enabled governance solutions to improve citizen-centric services and inclusive development initiatives.

questions.question: In which Union Territory was the Mahey Tokpo-Raldho irrigation canal inaugurated on May 15, 2026?
questions.explanation: The Mahey Tokpo-Raldho irrigation canal was inaugurated in the Union Territory of Ladakh by Lieutenant Governor Vinai Kumar Saxena on May 15, 2026. The canal, located in the high-altitude Changthang district at over 14,000 feet, was constructed to address persistent water shortages in the region. Stretching 2.10 km and supplied by Yaya Lake, the project is designed to support irrigation across nearly 100 acres of agricultural land in the Mahey region. Alongside the inauguration, a plantation drive involving 15,000 trees was also organised to promote slope stabilisation and soil conservation in the ecologically sensitive Himalayan region.

questions.question: In which national park was India’s first satellite-tagged Ganges softshell turtle released?
questions.explanation: India’s first satellite-tagged Ganges softshell turtle was released in Kaziranga National Park and Tiger Reserve as part of a major wildlife conservation initiative. The project was launched on Endangered Species Day to monitor the movement, habitat use, breeding sites, and seasonal migration patterns of the endangered freshwater turtle species. The Ganges softshell turtle, scientifically known as Nilssonia gangetica, is listed as endangered on the IUCN Red List despite being widely distributed across India. The initiative was jointly carried out by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Assam Forest Department, Kaziranga authorities, and supported by the National Geographic Society to strengthen conservation planning in the Brahmaputra river basin.

questions.question: Which Indian state celebrated 51 years of statehood on May 16, 2026?
questions.explanation: Sikkim celebrated its 51st Statehood Day on May 16, 2026, marking more than five decades since it officially became a state of India in 1975. Before joining India, Sikkim functioned as an independent Himalayan kingdom ruled by the Chogyal monarchy under the Namgyal dynasty. Growing political demands for democratic governance and public participation led to a historic referendum in 1975, where the majority supported integration with India. Following this, the monarchy was abolished, and the 36th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1975, formally made Sikkim the 22nd state of India. The state is also known for its rich cultural diversity and strong Buddhist heritage.

questions.question: Which state was selected to receive 1,243 EV chargers under the PM E-Drive scheme in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Karnataka was selected to receive 1,243 electric vehicle (EV) chargers under the central PM E-Drive scheme on May 12, 2026. The project, approved with a financial outlay of ₹123.26 crore, aims to strengthen the state’s electric mobility infrastructure and reduce range anxiety among EV users. The PM E-Drive scheme, administered by the Ministry of Heavy Industries, promotes clean and sustainable transportation across India. Karnataka has been a pioneer in the EV sector, becoming the first Indian state to introduce a dedicated Electric Vehicle and Energy Storage Policy in 2017. The state also leads the country in EV startups and public charging infrastructure development.

questions.question: Which bank became the first Taiwanese bank to establish a branch in GIFT City, Gujarat, in May 2026?
questions.explanation: CTBC Bank became the first Taiwanese bank to establish a branch in GIFT City, Gujarat, on May 13, 2026. This marked a significant milestone as it was also the first Taiwanese bank to set up operations anywhere in India. The branch was opened to strengthen cross-border financing, trade, and investment activities between India, Taiwan, and other Asian markets. CTBC Bank has maintained a financial presence in India for around 30 years through branches in New Delhi and Kattupakkam (Chennai). Headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, the bank was established in 1966 and currently operates under the leadership of CEO Tanmoy Adhikari in India.

questions.question: In which state was the Grih Pravesh of 5 lakh completed PMAY-G houses initiated on May 15, 2026?
questions.explanation: The Grih Pravesh ceremony for 5 lakh completed houses under the Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G) was launched in Maharashtra by Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan on May 15, 2026. The event took place in Satara and also marked the handover of keys for the 3-croreth rural house completed under the scheme. PMAY-G, launched in 2016 under the Ministry of Rural Development, aims to provide “Housing for All” in rural India. Maharashtra also received substantial central financial assistance and approval for PMGSY-IV road projects to improve rural connectivity and infrastructure across several habitations.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Managing Director of Jio Platforms in April 2026 for a five-year term?
questions.explanation: Akash Ambani was appointed as the Managing Director of Jio Platforms on April 9, 2026, for a five-year term. The appointment came at a significant time as the company prepared for its upcoming Initial Public Offering (IPO), with plans to file draft papers by May or June 2026. Akash Ambani has been associated with Reliance Jio Infocomm Limited (RJIL) since October 2014 as a board member and has played an important role in the company’s expansion. Reliance Jio, launched in 2016, rapidly transformed India’s telecom sector by achieving 100 million subscribers in less than six months after its launch.

questions.question: In which city did the Indian Navy inaugurate its premier Naval Sailing Node on 17 May 2026?
questions.explanation: The Indian Navy inaugurated its premier Naval Sailing Node at the Upper Lake, also known as Bhojtal, in Bhopal on 17 May 2026. The inauguration ceremony was presided over by Admiral Dinesh K Tripathi, the Chief of the Naval Staff. The state-of-the-art facility was established to support advanced training activities for the Indian Navy Sailing Team, rowing, canoeing, and kayaking teams, along with NCC cadets. The initiative aligns with India’s National Sports Policy by promoting world-class sports training and encouraging youth participation in defence services. Bhojtal, where the facility is located, is historically significant and recognised internationally as part of the Ramsar-listed Bhoj Wetland.

questions.question: Which institution inaugurated a dedicated Incubation Centre for Startups in Weather and Climate and hosted WISE-2026 in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM) Pune inaugurated a dedicated Incubation Center for Startups in Weather and Climate on May 15, 2026, and also hosted the Weather and Climate Innovation Meet for Startups and Entrepreneurs (WISE-2026). The initiative was launched under the Ministry of Earth Sciences to encourage innovation and private sector participation in meteorological and climate services. The incubation centre operates as a major component of the National Enterprise for Atmospheric Technology (NEAT) initiative. The event witnessed participation from hundreds of attendees, including startup founders and experts from institutions such as IMD, NCMRWF, NCPOR, ICRISAT, IISER Pune, and several IITs to advance climate-tech innovation in India.

questions.question: On which date does the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) observe its Incorporation Day?
questions.explanation: The Government e-Marketplace (GeM) observes its Incorporation Day on May 17 every year. GeM was incorporated on May 17, 2017, as a Section 8 non-profit company under the Companies Act, 2013, to create and manage India’s national public procurement portal. Operating under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, the platform promotes transparent and efficient digital procurement for government departments and public sector organisations. Over the years, GeM has significantly supported Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs), women entrepreneurs, SC/ST businesses, and startups by providing large-scale procurement opportunities, thereby strengthening local supply chains and supporting the vision of Aatmanirbhar Bharat.

questions.question: Which Indian company signed an MoU with ASML to develop a semiconductor manufacturing facility in Dholera, Gujarat?
questions.explanation: Tata Electronics signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with ASML on May 17, 2026, to establish a semiconductor manufacturing facility in Dholera, Gujarat. The agreement was witnessed by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten during a bilateral engagement. The project aims to strengthen India’s domestic semiconductor ecosystem and boost technological capabilities in chip manufacturing. ASML, a Netherlands-based company and global leader in photolithography technology, will provide strategic support for setting up and scaling semiconductor operations. Tata Electronics, a wholly owned venture of Tata Sons established in 2020, focuses on semiconductor and precision component manufacturing in India.

questions.question: Which state organised the special "Youth and Sports Week" from May 18 to 23, 2026?
questions.explanation: Telangana organised a special “Youth and Sports Week” from May 18 to 23, 2026, to encourage youth empowerment, physical fitness, sports participation, and employment opportunities across the state. The programme was conducted under the larger 99-day public service initiative called “Praja Palana Pragathi Pranalika.” Activities during the week included marathons, career guidance sessions, youth parliament programmes, sports events, environmental cleaning drives, and employment facilitation initiatives. Events were held at district and grassroots levels, including major programmes at the L.B. Stadium in Hyderabad. The initiative aimed to actively involve students, youth organisations, athletes, and local communities in building a healthier and more empowered society.

questions.question: What was the name of the operation under which the NCB carried out India’s first-ever seizure of the psychotropic drug Captagon?
questions.explanation: The Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) conducted India’s first-ever seizure of the psychotropic drug Captagon under Operation RAGEPILL. Announced on May 16, 2026, the operation led to the recovery of 227.7 kg of Captagon tablets and powder valued at approximately ₹182 crore in the illegal market. The drugs were seized from locations in New Delhi and Mundra, Gujarat, where they were concealed in machinery and imported cargo from Syria. Captagon, commonly known as the “Jihadi Drug,” contains substances such as Fenetylline and Amphetamine. The operation exposed an international trafficking network attempting to use India as a transit hub for smuggling narcotics to Gulf countries, especially Saudi Arabia.

questions.question: In which countries did the WHO declare the Ebola outbreak a public health emergency of international concern in May 2026?
options: Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda
questions.answer: Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda
questions.explanation: The World Health Organisation (WHO) declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, 2026. The outbreak began in the mining region of Mongwalu in the Ituri province of the DRC and later spread to the capitals Kinshasa and Kampala. The disease involved the rare Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus, which currently has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. WHO recommended emergency management measures, cross-border screening, and temporary travel restrictions for exposed individuals to contain the spread of the deadly virus across the affected region.

questions.question: Between which two cities did CSIR-NGRI discover a 200 km-long underground palaeo-channel in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Scientists from the CSIR-National Geophysical Research Institute (NGRI) discovered a massive underground palaeo-channel stretching between Prayagraj and Kanpur in the Ganga-Yamuna Doab region. The channel, buried 10 to 15 metres below the surface and extending nearly 200 km, represents an ancient independent river system distinct from the Ganga and Yamuna rivers. The discovery was made using advanced Heliborne transient electromagnetic technology (H-TEM) along with confirmatory drilling. Researchers identified highly porous clay and sand layers within the channel, making it suitable for groundwater recharge projects. The initiative involved collaboration between CSIR-NGRI, the National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG), and the Central Ground Water Board (CGWB).

questions.question: How many total medals did India win at the Asian Boxing U15 Championships held in Tashkent in 2026?
questions.explanation: India delivered an impressive performance at the Asian Boxing U15 Championships held in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, by winning a total of 27 medals. The medal tally included 9 gold medals across different categories, highlighting the country’s growing strength in youth boxing. The Indian U-15 girls’ team dominated the tournament by securing 7 gold medals and topping the overall standings. Notable performers included Anzee and Angel, who won gold medals in their respective weight categories. In the boys’ division, Yash Kumar and Mohd Yasser also secured gold medals. The championship showcased India’s strong potential in international amateur boxing competitions.

questions.question: Which Indian state observed the International AIDS Candlelight Memorial on May 17, 2026?
questions.explanation: Nagaland observed the International AIDS Candlelight Memorial on May 17, 2026, at the College of Nursing in Kohima. The memorial was organised under the theme “Light the Legacy: Remember. Advance. Act.” and aimed to honour individuals who lost their lives to HIV/AIDS-related illnesses while also supporting people currently living with HIV. The event emphasised the importance of reducing social stigma, improving healthcare accessibility, and encouraging collective action by governments and civil society organisations. Special focus was placed on the role of youth in spreading awareness, promoting safe practices, and encouraging social inclusion in the fight against HIV/AIDS.

questions.question: Which state became the first in India to implement an Alcohol-in-Beverage (AIB) based excise duty structure in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Karnataka became the first Indian state to adopt a globally recognised Alcohol-in-Beverage (AIB) based excise duty structure on May 11, 2026. The reform marked a major shift in liquor taxation by allowing producers to independently fix prices based on alcohol content and market conditions instead of government-controlled pricing. The policy also streamlined Indian Made Liquor categories into eight distinct slabs through amendments to the Karnataka Excise Rules, 1968. Introduced following commitments in the 2026–27 state budget, the initiative aims to provide consumers with more competitive pricing while maintaining parity with neighboring states such as Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Maharashtra, and Kerala.

questions.question: Which state launched the "Jan Bhagidari – Sabse Door, Sabse Pehle" campaign in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The "Jan Bhagidari – Sabse Door, Sabse Pehle" campaign was launched by the Chhattisgarh government to improve the delivery of welfare schemes in remote tribal villages. Conducted from May 18 to May 25, 2026, the initiative targeted more than 8,000 tribal villages across the state. Implemented by the Tribal Development Department, the campaign focused on benefits related to health, nutrition, education, social security, and drinking water. It also included public grievance hearings and health camps for screening diseases such as sickle cell anaemia and tuberculosis. The campaign supported national tribal welfare initiatives like PM-JANMAN and the Dharti Aaba mission.

questions.question: In which city were the Million Minds Tech Park and GREMI City Campus inaugurated in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The Million Minds Tech Park and GREMI City Campus were inaugurated in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, by Union Home Minister Amit Shah on May 17, 2026. The project is considered a major step toward strengthening Gujarat’s position as a leading hub for emerging technologies and Global Capability Centres (GCCs). The tech park’s first phase involves a large investment and is designed to accommodate thousands of professionals, while the GREMI City Campus focuses on modernising leadership and urban planning in the real estate sector. These initiatives are expected to generate significant employment opportunities and boost economic growth in the region.

questions.question: In which city did the National Test House establish an advanced Shoe Testing Laboratory in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The National Test House (NTH) established a modern Shoe Testing Laboratory in Ghaziabad on May 17, 2026, to strengthen India’s footwear quality and manufacturing ecosystem. Located at the NTH Northern Region center, the laboratory provides easier access for footwear industries in nearby manufacturing hubs such as Delhi-NCR, Kanpur, and Agra. The facility is equipped with advanced instruments like the Bally Water Penetration Tester and Bata Belt Flex Tester to assess durability, slip resistance, material strength, and chemical safety according to Indian Standards. This initiative supports the Make in India mission and aims to improve export readiness and self-reliance in the footwear sector.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the new Prime Minister of Iraq in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Ali Falih Kadhim al-Zaidi was approved by the Iraqi Parliament as the new Prime Minister on May 16, 2026. He emerged as a consensus candidate to end a prolonged five-month political deadlock in Iraq. Despite having no prior political experience, he was chosen to lead the government during a period of economic and political challenges. His appointment came along with the approval of a partial cabinet, where only 14 out of 23 ministerial positions were filled. The remaining posts stayed vacant because of internal disagreements and external pressures influencing Iraq’s political system.

questions.question: What percentage of AIGCC member investors adopted Net Zero portfolio targets according to the 2026 report?
questions.explanation: The Asia Investor Group on Climate Change (AIGCC) reported in 2026 that 74% of its member investors had adopted Net Zero portfolio targets. The study evaluated 240 investors managing assets worth $123 trillion, highlighting growing awareness of climate-related financial risks among institutional investors in Asia. Despite strong adoption of Net Zero goals, the report also identified significant implementation gaps, as only a limited number of investors published detailed transition pathways and fossil fuel policies. The findings underline the increasing importance of sustainable investment strategies, energy storage, and climate risk disclosure in global financial markets while emphasising the need for stronger execution of climate commitments.

questions.question: Which company integrated its AI coding assistant Codex into the ChatGPT mobile app in May 2026?
questions.explanation: OpenAI introduced its AI coding assistant, Codex, into the ChatGPT mobile application for both iOS and Android platforms in May 2026. This integration enables developers to remotely manage coding tasks using smartphones, including reviewing outputs, approving commands, switching AI models, and monitoring real-time updates such as screenshots, terminal outputs, and test results. The system securely keeps files and credentials on the connected host machine while offering seamless synchronisation. OpenAI also expanded support with remote SSH connectivity and enterprise-level features like programmatic access tokens and HIPAA-compliant local support for healthcare-related workspaces.

questions.question: In which city was Rajasthan's first semiconductor packaging facility inaugurated in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan's first semiconductor packaging facility and Electronics Manufacturing Cluster (EMC) were inaugurated in Bhiwadi on May 15, 2026. The project was developed by Sahasra Semiconductors Pvt. Ltd. and became India's first SME-led semiconductor unit to begin commercial chip production. Supported under the SPECS scheme, the facility received significant investments and aims to expand its annual packaging capacity from 60 million to 600 million units within three years. The cluster has also attracted major investments from multiple companies, creating thousands of employment opportunities and strengthening India’s domestic electronics and semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem.

questions.question: On which date is the International Day for Women in Maritime observed by the United Nations and the IMO?
questions.explanation: The International Day for Women in Maritime is observed every year on May 18 to recognise and promote the contributions of women in the global maritime sector. In 2026, the United Nations and the International Maritime Organisation (IMO) marked the occasion with a special event in London under the theme “From Policy to Practice: Advancing Gender Equality for Maritime Excellence.” The observance aims to encourage greater participation, recruitment, and sustained employment of women in maritime professions. It also supports the broader objective of achieving gender equality under the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 (SDG 5).

questions.question: Who assumed charge as the new CEO of the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Saurabh Vijay officially assumed charge as the Chief Executive Officer of the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) on May 18, 2026. He is a 1998-batch Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer from the Maharashtra cadre and has extensive experience serving in various roles within the Government of India. UIDAI functions under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology and is responsible for issuing Aadhaar, the 12-digit unique identification number for residents of India. His appointment is considered significant for strengthening the administration and implementation of India’s digital identity and governance systems.

questions.question: Which state launched India's first integrated monitoring portal for NSQ and NDPS drugs in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Karnataka launched India’s first integrated digital monitoring portal for tracking Not of Standard Quality (NSQ) medicines and regulating Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) on May 15, 2026. Developed by the state’s Food Safety and Drug Administration Department, the system strengthens pharmaceutical surveillance and drug safety mechanisms. The portal enables immediate e-signing of NSQ reports, automatic blocking of defective drug batches, and strict monitoring of NDPS medicine sales through prescription verification. The initiative aims to prevent the misuse of controlled substances and ensure higher standards in medicine distribution. It also reflects Karnataka’s focus on technology-driven governance and public health protection.

questions.question: In which city was the Metro Monday initiative launched in May 2026 to promote fuel conservation and public transport?
questions.explanation: The Metro Monday initiative was launched in New Delhi on May 19, 2026, by Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta. The campaign was introduced under the broader “Mera Bharat, Mera Yogdan” initiative to encourage fuel conservation and increase the use of public transportation amid concerns related to the West Asia conflict. Several administrative measures accompanied the initiative, including work-from-home arrangements for government employees, revised office timings, and a freeze on official foreign visits. Citizens were also encouraged to observe a weekly No Vehicle Day. The initiative highlights Delhi’s focus on sustainable urban mobility, energy conservation, and reducing traffic congestion and pollution.

questions.question: Which company signed an MoU with Jindal Global Business School to train youth in the logistics industry under the Skill India Mission?
questions.explanation: Skyways Air Services Ltd., through its training arm MyLogistics Gurukul, signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Jindal Global Business School on May 18, 2026. The collaboration aims to strengthen skill development in the logistics and supply chain sector under the Government of India’s Skill India Mission. The initiative provides students with practical exposure through internships, visits to freight and warehousing hubs, and certified industry-focused training modules. It also integrates real-world logistics challenges into academic learning. Skyways, established in 1984, is recognised as one of India’s leading air freight forwarders and has maintained a strong position in the global logistics industry.

questions.question: Which bank partnered with Visa to launch a USD-denominated debit card for NRIs through its GIFT City branch?
questions.explanation: ICICI Bank launched a USD-denominated debit card for Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) in partnership with Visa through its GIFT City branch. Built on the Visa Infinite platform, the card is linked to a USD Global Savings Account maintained at the GIFT City International Banking Unit. The initiative aims to reduce international transaction costs by eliminating traditional currency markup fees and GST charges usually applied to Indian debit cards. It also offers zero forex markup on direct USD transactions, providing significant annual savings for frequent international users. The service is especially targeted at NRIs, overseas professionals, and families supporting international education expenses.

questions.question: Which country successfully tested the RS-28 Sarmat intercontinental ballistic missile in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Russia successfully conducted a test flight of the RS-28 Sarmat heavy intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) on May 18, 2026. The missile was developed by the Makeyev Rocket Centre and is intended to replace the older RS-20 Voevoda missile systems from the Soviet era. The RS-28 Sarmat is a liquid-fueled missile with advanced capabilities, including hypersonic warhead deployment and suborbital flight trajectories that significantly extend its operational range. Designed for strategic deterrence, the missile can target hardened locations over extremely long distances and is considered one of the most advanced components of Russia’s strategic missile forces.

questions.question: Which bank launched the Business Multiplier Credit Card for entrepreneurs and small business owners in May 2026?
questions.explanation: IDFC FIRST Bank launched the Business Multiplier Credit Card on May 19, 2026, to support early-stage entrepreneurs, founders, and small business owners. The secured credit card is issued against a fixed deposit, removing the need for traditional credit history, profitability records, or high credit scores. It provides a 100% credit limit against the linked deposit, along with lower interest rates and zero forex markup charges for international transactions. The product is designed to improve financial access for startups and growing businesses while offering flexibility to scale credit limits through additional fixed deposits without undergoing fresh underwriting procedures.

questions.question: Which university secured ₹1.16 crore in grants from ICMR and ANRF for agriculture and healthcare research in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Chandigarh University secured government research grants worth ₹1.16 crore from the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) and the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) in May 2026. The funding supports two important research projects related to agriculture and healthcare. One project focuses on improving mustard and Brassica crop yields through beneficial soil microbes to reduce dependence on chemical fertilisers. The second project aims at early detection of diabetic kidney disease using advanced metagenomic and bioinformatic analysis of gut microbiota. These initiatives highlight the growing importance of interdisciplinary scientific research in addressing agricultural sustainability and public health challenges in India.

questions.question: Which company entered into a strategic collaboration with France-based Exail for the Indian Navy’s Unmanned Mine Counter-Measure Suite in May 2026?
questions.explanation: L&T partnered with France-based Exail on May 18, 2026, to provide an advanced Unmanned Mine Counter-Measure (MCM) Suite for the Indian Navy. Under the collaboration, L&T serves as the prime contractor while Exail contributes advanced technological systems. The project is linked to India’s proposed procurement of 12 Mine Counter Measure Vessels aimed at enhancing maritime security capabilities. The autonomous system is designed to detect, classify, identify, and neutralise underwater mine threats while allowing operations from a safe stand-off distance. This partnership reflects India’s growing focus on modern naval defence systems and indigenous participation in advanced military technology programmes.

questions.question: Which country conferred the Royal Order of the Polar Star on Prime Minister Narendra Modi in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Prime Minister Narendra Modi received the Royal Order of the Polar Star during his visit to Sweden on May 18, 2026. The honour is regarded as the highest distinction that Sweden can confer upon a Head of Government. Instituted in 1748, the award recognises exceptional contributions and efforts that benefit Sweden and its interests. This recognition became the 31st international honour received by PM Modi, reflecting India’s growing diplomatic engagement and global partnerships. During the two-day visit, PM Modi was welcomed by Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson, highlighting the strengthening bilateral relationship between India and Sweden across multiple sectors.

questions.question: In which city did India host the BRICS Justice Ministers’ Meeting on Alternative Dispute Resolution in May 2026?
questions.explanation: India hosted the BRICS Senior Officials’ Meeting and Justice Ministers’ Meeting on Alternative Dispute Resolution in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, from May 19 to 22, 2026. Organised under India’s BRICS Chairship by the Ministry of Law and Justice, the meetings focused on strengthening institutional mediation, arbitration reforms, and digital dispute-resolution mechanisms. The initiative aimed to reduce court case backlogs and improve cross-border legal cooperation among BRICS nations. Participating ministers also worked toward adopting a joint declaration promoting capacity building in mediation and arbitration. The event highlighted India’s growing role in international legal cooperation and alternative dispute resolution frameworks.

questions.question: Who became the first woman officer in Indian Air Force history to earn the Category-A Qualified Flying Instructor rating in 2026?
questions.explanation: Squadron Leader Saanya became the first woman officer in the history of the Indian Air Force to achieve the prestigious Category-A Qualified Flying Instructor (QFI) rating on May 18, 2026. The qualification represents the highest instructional grading in military aviation and certifies pilots to train new aviators, operational pilots, and junior instructors. To earn this elite status, candidates must complete a demanding 22-week course at the Flying Instructors School in Tambaram near Chennai, involving extensive flying practice and ground training. Saanya’s achievement marks another important milestone in the growing role of women in India’s armed forces and aviation sector.

questions.question: What percentage stake did Prudential Plc acquire in Bharti Life Insurance for ₹3,500 crore?
questions.explanation: Prudential Plc, a UK-based global insurance company, acquired a 75% controlling stake in Bharti Life Insurance through a transaction valued at ₹3,500 crore. The deal gives Prudential majority ownership and operational control in India’s growing life insurance market. As part of the restructuring, Bharti Enterprises reduced its shareholding from 85% to 25%, while 360 ONE Asset Management exited completely by selling its 15% stake. The acquisition also requires Prudential to reduce its existing stake in ICICI Prudential Life Insurance to comply with Indian regulatory norms. The move highlights increasing foreign investment and competition in India’s financial and insurance sectors.

questions.question: Which high-speed rail corridor was featured in the first visual design of India’s maiden bullet train unveiled in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The Ministry of Railways unveiled the first visual design of India’s inaugural bullet train for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail (MAHSR) corridor on May 18, 2026. The 508-kilometre project is India’s first bullet train initiative and is being developed using Japanese Shinkansen technology. Once operational, the corridor is expected to reduce travel time between Mumbai and Ahmedabad from over seven hours to nearly two hours. The project includes advanced infrastructure such as undersea tunnels beneath Thane Creek and high-speed train sets being developed under the Make in India initiative. The rail corridor is considered a major milestone in India’s modernization of transportation infrastructure.

questions.question: Which state cabinet approved the ₹3,000 monthly ‘Annapurna’ scheme and free bus travel for women in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The West Bengal Cabinet approved several major welfare and administrative measures on May 18, 2026, under the leadership of Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari. One of the key initiatives was the launch of the ₹3,000 monthly ‘Annapurna’ financial aid scheme for women, replacing the earlier Lakshmir Bhandar scheme. The government also introduced free travel for women on all state-run buses to encourage financial independence and workforce participation. Additionally, religion-based stipends for imams, muezzins, and priests were discontinued, with funds redirected toward merit-based scholarships. These reforms reflected a broader focus on welfare expansion, social equity, and governance restructuring.

questions.question: Which country approved $428 million defence support packages for India’s Apache fleet and M777 howitzers in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The United States approved defence sustainment packages worth $428.2 million for India on May 18, 2026. The agreements included support for India’s AH-64E Apache attack helicopters and M777A2 Ultra-Light Howitzers through the Foreign Military Sales (FMS) programme. The packages cover engineering assistance, logistics, technical training, spare parts, and repair services to maintain operational readiness of the Indian Armed Forces. Major defence companies such as Boeing, Lockheed Martin, and BAE Systems are involved in the support framework. The move highlights the growing strategic defence partnership between India and the United States, especially in advanced military technology and operational cooperation.

questions.question: In which district was the Nimapara Patha Utsav 2026 inaugurated by Odisha Deputy CM Pravati Parida?
questions.explanation: The Nimapara Patha Utsav 2026 was inaugurated in the Puri district of Odisha on May 17, 2026, by Deputy Chief Minister Pravati Parida. The cultural street festival aimed to encourage youth participation in regional development through the “Utkarsha Nimapara 2.0” initiative. The event featured public awareness campaigns using traditional folk art forms such as Pala and Dasakathia, along with street plays and solo performances. It also introduced upcoming marathons, sports and cultural competitions, and a digital platform for volunteer registration. The initiative highlighted Odisha’s emphasis on combining cultural heritage with community engagement and socio-economic development.

questions.question: What is the maximum stake approved for Emirates NBD Bank to acquire in RBL Bank?
questions.explanation: The Ministry of Finance approved Emirates NBD Bank’s proposal to acquire up to a 74% stake in RBL Bank in May 2026. Emirates NBD, one of the leading banking groups in the UAE, planned the acquisition through a major equity investment valued at over ₹26,000 crore. Under the approved structure, the bank is required to maintain at least a 51% holding while being permitted to increase it up to 74%. Following the transaction, RBL Bank will operate as a foreign bank subsidiary under Emirates NBD. The approval reflects increasing foreign investment interest in India’s banking sector and ongoing regulatory oversight by institutions such as the RBI and CCI.

questions.question: In which city was India’s first AI-powered “phygital” bank branch inaugurated in May 2026?
questions.explanation: India’s first AI-powered “phygital” bank branch was inaugurated in Guwahati, Assam, on May 16, 2026. Opened by Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma, the innovative branch of Slice Small Finance Bank combines physical banking services with advanced digital infrastructure. The facility uses AI-enabled self-service kiosks, paperless onboarding systems, and automated banking processes to enhance customer convenience and efficiency. One of its key features allows users to access working capital directly through UPI without a separate loan application. The initiative is designed to support digital transformation and improve financial accessibility for small business owners and women entrepreneurs.

questions.question: Which Indian city became the first to deploy solar-powered “Algae Trees” to combat urban air pollution?
questions.explanation: Bhopal became the first city in India to deploy solar-powered “Algae Trees” as part of an innovative initiative to tackle urban air pollution. Installed under the Bhopal Smart City project, these biotechnology-based systems use living microalgae cultures to absorb carbon dioxide, reduce harmful PM 2.5 particles, and release oxygen into the atmosphere. Each unit operates as an outdoor photo-bioreactor powered by integrated solar panels, enabling sustainable and off-grid functionality. The project demonstrates the growing use of green technology and renewable energy solutions in urban environmental management while promoting cleaner air and climate-friendly infrastructure in densely populated city areas.

questions.question: Who became the youngest Indian-origin mayor in UK history after being appointed Mayor of Elstree and Borehamwood?
questions.explanation: Tushar Kumar, a 23-year-old Labour Party councillor, was appointed as the Mayor of Elstree and Borehamwood in the United Kingdom, becoming the youngest Indian-origin individual to hold a mayoral office in British history. The appointment was confirmed during the Mayor Making Ceremony held in Hertfordshire. Previously serving as Deputy Mayor, Kumar succeeded outgoing Mayor Dan Ozarow. During his tenure, he plans to focus on youth empowerment and community participation while supporting local welfare initiatives. A graduate of King’s College London, he has also gained experience as a policy advisor and research analyst, highlighting his early achievements in public service and leadership.

questions.question: Across how many cities does the Draft National Water Metro Policy propose the rollout of water-based urban mobility networks?
questions.explanation: The Draft National Water Metro Policy, 2026, proposes the rollout of sustainable water-based urban mobility systems across 18 major Indian cities. The initiative, reviewed under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways, aims to promote eco-friendly and cost-effective transportation using inland waterways. The project will be implemented in phases, beginning with cities such as Guwahati, Srinagar, Patna, and Varanasi. Inspired by the success of the Kochi Water Metro, the policy emphasises electric and hybrid ferries, multimodal integration, and reduced infrastructure costs compared to conventional metro systems. The initiative is expected to improve urban mobility while supporting green transportation and sustainable development goals.

questions.question: Which country joined India’s Shukrayaan Mission to Venus through an agreement with ISRO in 2026?
questions.explanation: Sweden joined India’s Shukrayaan Mission to Venus through a Memorandum of Understanding signed between ISRO and the Swedish National Space Agency in May 2026. The collaboration was finalised during Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s visit to Sweden and focuses on expanding cooperation in planetary exploration. Sweden’s participation includes the development of the Venusian Neutrals Analyser (VNA) by the Swedish Institute of Space Physics. The instrument will study solar wind interactions, atmospheric escape processes, and plasma behaviour around Venus. Shukrayaan is India’s first dedicated mission to Venus and aims to investigate the planet’s atmosphere, volcanic surface, weather systems, and past potential for liquid water.

questions.question: Which state signed MoUs for developing 25,400 MW nuclear power projects with investments worth ₹6.5 lakh crore?
questions.explanation: Maharashtra signed major Memorandums of Understanding with four leading companies to develop 25,400 MW of nuclear power capacity with a total planned investment of ₹6.5 lakh crore. The projects involve companies such as NTPC Limited, Adani Power, Reliance Industries Limited, and Lalitpur Power Generation Company. These initiatives include the development of advanced nuclear technologies such as Bharat Small Reactors and Small Modular Reactors. Large-scale projects are planned in Ratnagiri district and other regions, with expectations of generating significant employment opportunities. The move reflects Maharashtra’s commitment to expanding clean energy infrastructure and strengthening India’s long-term energy security through nuclear power development.

questions.question: In which Indian state did Shyam Metalics announce a ₹10,000 crore industrial investment plan in 2026?
questions.explanation: Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited announced a major investment plan worth ₹10,000 crore in West Bengal for multiple industrial projects over the next three years. A large portion of the investment is being directed toward the Jamuria facility in Paschim Bardhaman district for manufacturing hot rolled coils, speciality steel, and carbon steel products. The company is also expanding operations in Kharagpur after acquiring Ramsarup Industries through the NCLT process. The expansion includes plans for a railway coach manufacturing unit and a speciality steel plant. The investment reflects West Bengal’s growing importance as a destination for industrial development and steel manufacturing in India.

questions.question: Which country signed five major science and innovation agreements with India in May 2026?
questions.explanation: India and Norway strengthened their strategic partnership in science and innovation through five major bilateral agreements signed in Oslo on May 18, 2026. The agreements involved India’s CSIR and DSIR collaborating with leading Norwegian institutions in areas such as clean energy, offshore wind technology, geosciences, sustainability, and public health research. The partnerships also focused on student mobility, scientific exchanges, and advanced infrastructure solutions. Key organisations involved included SINTEF, NTNU, and FME NorthWind. These agreements reflect growing cooperation between India and Norway in green technology, climate research, renewable energy, and sustainable industrial development.

questions.question: Which tennis player completed the Career Golden Masters by winning the Italian Open in 2026?
questions.explanation: Jannik Sinner achieved a historic milestone by completing the Career Golden Masters after winning the Italian Open on May 20, 2026. By securing all nine ATP Masters 1000 titles, he became only the second male player in tennis history to accomplish this feat, joining Novak Djokovic. Sinner achieved the milestone at the age of 24, making him the youngest player ever to complete the Career Golden Masters. During the 2026 season, he dominated the ATP circuit with an impressive win record and multiple Masters titles. His achievement further strengthened his position as World No. 1 and highlighted his growing legacy in modern tennis history.

questions.question: Which bank partnered with Mahindra & Mahindra to launch India’s first sustainability-linked dealer financing program in the automotive sector?
questions.explanation: Mahindra & Mahindra collaborated with DBS Bank India to introduce the Indian automotive sector’s first sustainability-linked dealer financing initiative. The program offers favourable financing rates to vehicle dealers based on their environmental performance and sustainability practices. Assessment criteria include greenhouse gas emissions, water conservation, renewable energy usage, waste management, rainwater harvesting, and EV charging infrastructure. The initiative also encourages higher sales of electric SUVs. This partnership aligns with India’s broader climate commitments and net-zero goals for 2070. It also supports Mahindra’s Green Dealership Program and reflects the growing role of sustainable finance in promoting environmentally responsible business operations in India.

questions.question: Which state launched the ‘Kasa Kay?’ campaign under the ‘Majhe Gaav, Arogya Sampanna Gaav’ initiative in 2026?
questions.explanation: Maharashtra launched the ‘Kasa Kay?’ public awareness campaign on May 19, 2026, as part of the ‘Majhe Gaav, Arogya Sampanna Gaav’ initiative to improve healthcare awareness in rural regions. The campaign focuses on preventive healthcare, disease control, sanitation, nutrition, and access to clean drinking water.
