Villages demonstrating strong health performance will receive the title of “Arogya Sampanna Gaav.” The initiative was inaugurated in Mumbai by the Chief Minister and included the release of an official health song, promotional materials, and informational booklets. The program reflects Maharashtra’s efforts to strengthen rural healthcare systems and encourage healthier community practices across villages.

questions.question: Which automobile company became the Exclusive Sponsor of the Tennis Premier League through a three-year partnership in 2026?
questions.explanation: Kia India signed a landmark three-year agreement to become the Exclusive Sponsor of the Tennis Premier League (TPL) in May 2026. Under the partnership, Kia will serve as the front-of-jersey sponsor for all eight franchise teams and integrate its presence across the TPL ecosystem, including the league’s digital platforms. The collaboration also focuses on promoting grassroots tennis and nurturing emerging talent in India. The Tennis Premier League operates under the All India Tennis Association and features prominent personalities such as Leander Paes and Sania Mirza as brand ambassadors. The sponsorship highlights the growing connection between sports development and corporate partnerships in India.

questions.question: Which city will host South India’s largest industrial exhibition from May 28 to 30, 2026?
questions.explanation: Chennai was selected as the host city for South India’s largest co-located industrial sourcing platform scheduled from May 28 to 30, 2026. The event will take place at the Chennai Trade Centre in Nandambakkam and is organised by Smart Expos & Fairs (India) Pvt. Ltd. It includes major exhibitions such as COMPACK 2026, LOGMAT 2026, and COSS 2026, focusing on packaging, warehouse automation, industrial safety, and logistics. The exhibition is expected to attract leading brands and industries from sectors including automotive, electronics, electric vehicles, aerospace, and pharmaceuticals. The event highlights Chennai’s growing role as a major industrial and business hub in India.

questions.question: Which fintech company received NPCI certification for UPI, IMPS, and IBMB integrations in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Viyona Fintech, a Hyderabad-based fintech infrastructure company, secured NPCI certification for its payment technology framework covering UPI Acquirer, UPI Issuer, IMPS, and Interoperable Banking Mobile Banking (IBMB) integrations. This certification enables the company to support merchant QR acceptance, customer-side UPI issuance, and real-time fund transfer services. The infrastructure is particularly aimed at improving interoperable mobile banking and strengthening rural banking solutions. NPCI, which operates major retail payment systems like UPI and IMPS, plays a critical role in India’s rapidly growing digital payments ecosystem and financial inclusion initiatives.

questions.question: In which city did Union Health Minister JP Nadda address the 79th World Health Assembly in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Union Health Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda addressed the plenary session of the 79th World Health Assembly in Geneva, Switzerland, on May 19, 2026. The session focused on the theme “Reshaping Global Health: A Shared Responsibility.” During the event, India highlighted its achievements in healthcare infrastructure, digital health innovation, and global vaccine support initiatives. Key initiatives discussed included Ayushman Bharat, Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission, and Vaccine Maitri. Geneva is also the headquarters of the World Health Organisation (WHO), which serves as the leading international body for global public health and policymaking among its 194 member states.

questions.question: What percentage stake did TVS Venu Group acquire in Jana Small Finance Bank in May 2026?
questions.explanation: TVS Venu Group acquired a 9.9% stake in Jana Small Finance Bank for ₹193.3 crore as part of its strategy to strengthen its presence in the financial services sector. The transaction included both primary warrant subscriptions and secondary share purchases from Jana Holdings. Additionally, TVS Motor Company directly secured a 4.9% holding in the bank. Jana Small Finance Bank, headquartered in Bengaluru, began operating as a Small Finance Bank in 2018. This investment also aligns with the broader expansion plans of the TVS Group in banking, lending, and asset management services.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the new Executive Director (ED) of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Gunveer Singh was appointed as the new Executive Director of the Reserve Bank of India on May 18, 2026. Before this promotion, he served as the Chief General Manager-in-Charge within the RBI. In his new role, he will oversee the Department of Payment and Settlement Systems, which manages India’s payment infrastructure and settlement ecosystem. The appointment highlights RBI’s continued focus on strengthening digital payment systems and financial stability. Alongside his appointment, several senior officers, including Monisha Chakraborty, Suman Ray, Sudhakar Malli, and Ravi Shanker, were also empanelled for future Executive Director positions within the central bank.

questions.question: In which Indian state did the multilateral military exercise PRAGATI 2026 commence in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The multilateral military exercise PRAGATI 2026 began at the Umroi Military Station located in Meghalaya on May 20, 2026. PRAGATI stands for Partnership of Regional Armies for Growth and Transformation in the Indian Ocean Region. The two-week exercise focuses on counter-terrorism operations in semi-mountainous and jungle terrain. A total of 12 friendly foreign nations, including Bhutan, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Vietnam, and Indonesia, are participating alongside India. The exercise also highlights the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative by showcasing indigenous defence technologies and equipment, while promoting joint planning, intelligence sharing, and tactical cooperation among participating armies.

questions.question: Where was Prime Minister Narendra Modi awarded the FAO Agricola Medal 2026?
questions.explanation: The Agricola Medal 2026 was conferred on Prime Minister Narendra Modi by the Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO) of the United Nations in recognition of his contributions to food security, sustainable agriculture, and rural development. The award ceremony took place at the FAO headquarters, which is located in Rome, Italy, and was presented by FAO Director-General Dr Qu Dongyu. The visit was notable as it marked the first time in 30 years that an Indian Head of Government visited the FAO headquarters. The FAO plays a global role in addressing hunger and agricultural development and is headquartered in Rome.

questions.question: Which country is hosting the 68th Session of the Asian Productivity Organisation (APO) Governing Body at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, from May 20 to 22, 2026?
questions.explanation: India is hosting the 68th Session of the Asian Productivity Organisation (APO) Governing Body in New Delhi with participation from more than 60 senior delegates representing 20 APO member economies. The event focuses on discussions related to the APO Vision 2030 framework, budget planning for 2027–28, and leadership elections for the organisation. India assumed the APO Chairmanship during the 67th session in 2025 through DPIIT Secretary Amardeep Singh Bhatia. Established in 1961, the APO is a regional intergovernmental organisation dedicated to improving productivity and promoting sustainable economic development across Asia-Pacific member economies.

questions.question: Which organisation successfully completed the final development trials of the indigenous ULPGM-V3 precision-guided missile in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) successfully completed the final development trials of the ULPGM-V3 missile in both air-to-ground and air-to-air modes. The trials were conducted at the DRDO test range in Kurnool using an integrated Ground Control System. The ULPGM-V3 is designed for anti-tank warfare and can also target drones, helicopters, and other aerial threats. Research Centre Imarat (RCI) acted as the nodal laboratory with support from DRDL, TBRL, and HEMRL. The missile system was integrated with UAV platforms developed by NewSpace Research and Technologies, while production is being managed by Bharat Dynamics Limited and Adani Defence & Aerospace.

questions.question: Which state hosted the ₹5,400 crore ReNew Energy Global plc solar manufacturing project launched in Anakapalli district in April 2026?
questions.explanation: Andhra Pradesh became the host state for the major ₹5,400 crore solar manufacturing project initiated by ReNew Energy Global plc in Anakapalli district. The project involves setting up a 6 GW solar ingot and wafer manufacturing facility aimed at strengthening India’s renewable energy supply chain and supporting clean energy goals. Introduced under the Andhra Pradesh Integrated Clean Energy Policy 2024, the initiative is expected to be completed within 24 months and generate more than 2,100 direct and indirect jobs. ReNew Energy Global plc has also committed a total investment of ₹82,000 crore in the state, highlighting Andhra Pradesh’s growing role in renewable energy development.

questions.question: Which company partnered with Google to launch a U.S.-based AI TPU and data centre joint venture in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Blackstone partnered with Google to establish a new joint venture focused on providing Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) and data centre operations as a compute-as-a-service platform in the United States. Blackstone committed an initial equity investment of $5 billion through its managed funds, while Google contributed its advanced TPU hardware, software, and technical expertise. The venture aims to bring the first 500 MW of computing capacity online by 2027 to support growing demand for AI training and inference. The collaboration highlights the increasing importance of AI infrastructure, high-performance computing, and cloud-based services in the global technology sector.

questions.question: Which institution is headed by Manindra Agrawal, who was elected as a Fellow of the Royal Society in 2026?
questions.explanation: Manindra Agrawal was elected as a Fellow of the Royal Society in 2026 for his outstanding contributions to theoretical computer science. He is widely known for co-developing the AKS primality test, a landmark achievement in mathematics and computer science. The algorithm provided the first deterministic polynomial-time method for testing whether a number is prime, with important applications in cryptography and internet security. Agrawal has received several prestigious awards for his research and was serving as the Director of IIT Kanpur when he received this honour.

questions.question: Which country assumed the Chair of the Regional Cooperative Agreement (RCA) for 2026 during the 48th Meeting of National Representatives held?
questions.explanation: India formally assumed the Chair of the Regional Cooperative Agreement (RCA) for 2026 during the 48th Meeting of National Representatives held in Navi Mumbai from May 19–22, 2026. Hosted by the Department of Atomic Energy, the meeting brought together delegates from Asia-Pacific nations, representatives from AFRA, and officials from the IAEA and RCARO. Discussions focused on the peaceful applications of nuclear science in healthcare, agriculture, food technology, water management, and environmental sustainability. India’s leadership under the theme “India By Your Side” reflects its commitment to regional cooperation and the promotion of nuclear technologies for socio-economic development.

questions.question: In which Indian state was the ₹5,400 crore ReNew solar manufacturing project launched, laying the foundation stone on April 23, 2026?
questions.explanation: On April 23, 2026, Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu laid the foundation stone for ReNew Energy Global plc’s ₹5,400 crore solar manufacturing facility in Anakapalli district, which is located in Andhra Pradesh. The project includes a 6 GW solar ingot and wafer manufacturing unit and falls under the Andhra Pradesh Integrated Clean Energy Policy 2024. It is expected to be commissioned within 24 months, creating over 2,100 direct and indirect jobs. Additionally, ReNew Energy has committed a total cumulative investment of ₹82,000 crore in Andhra Pradesh.

questions.question: Where was Prime Minister Narendra Modi conferred with the FAO Agricola Medal 2026?
questions.explanation: Prime Minister Narendra Modi received the prestigious FAO Agricola Medal 2026 on May 20, 2026, at the headquarters of the Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO) of the United Nations in Rome, Italy. The award was presented by FAO Director-General Dr Qu Dongyu in recognition of India's achievements in food security, sustainable agriculture, and rural development. The honour also acknowledged initiatives such as climate-resilient crop development, micro-irrigation through the ‘Per Drop More Crop’ program, and the use of digital technologies in agriculture. The event marked a historic occasion, as it was the first visit by an Indian Head of Government to FAO Headquarters in three decades.

questions.question: What is Liberty Mutual Insurance's current shareholding in Liberty General Insurance Limited (LGI) as of May 2026?
questions.explanation: Liberty Mutual Insurance increased its stake in Liberty General Insurance Limited (LGI) to 74% on May 18, 2026, up from 55.40% held since September 2025. The move followed changes in India's foreign direct investment (FDI) regulations, which allowed greater foreign participation in the insurance sector. Liberty Mutual, one of the world's leading insurers, aims to use the additional capital to strengthen its retail and commercial insurance businesses in India and improve insurance penetration. The development highlights growing international investment in India's insurance industry and reflects confidence in the sector's long-term growth potential.

questions.question: Who were the Indian-origin scientists conferred the Order of Mapungubwe by President Cyril Ramaphosa on May 21, 2026?
options: Salim Abdool Karim and Keertan Dheda
Raghunath Mashelkar and C. N. R. Rao
questions.answer: Salim Abdool Karim and Keertan Dheda
questions.explanation: South Africa’s highest civilian honour, the Order of Mapungubwe, was conferred on Professors Salim Abdool Karim and Keertan Dheda on May 21, 2026, in Pretoria. They were recognised for their exceptional contributions to medical science, public health epidemiology, and groundbreaking research in HIV/AIDS and tuberculosis (TB). Their work has significantly influenced national health policies and improved public health outcomes. The award is granted to South African citizens whose excellence and achievements benefit both the nation and the global community. Karim received the Order of Mapungubwe in Gold, the highest category within the honour.

questions.question: What is the title of the debut book released by former Federal Bank MD and CEO Shyam Srinivasan in May 2026?
questions.explanation: "Better Never Stops" is the debut book authored by Shyam Srinivasan, the former Managing Director and CEO of Federal Bank. Released on May 18, 2026, the book combines elements of a memoir and a leadership guide, drawing from his three decades of experience in the banking industry. It highlights themes such as resilience, continuous improvement, adaptability, and professional growth. Srinivasan is widely recognised for transforming Federal Bank from a regional institution into a nationally recognised private sector bank while driving significant expansion in digital and retail banking. The book offers valuable insights into leadership and organisational transformation.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the chief coach of India's national compound archery team in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Dave Cousins, a former American world champion archer, was appointed as the chief coach of India’s national compound archery team by the Archery Association of India (AAI) on May 21, 2026. He will serve as the full-time coach until the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and receive a monthly salary of USD 12,000. Cousins was expected to join the Indian team before the World Cup Stage 3 event in Antalya, Turkey. His appointment is particularly significant as compound archery is set to make its Olympic debut at the 2028 Los Angeles Games through a mixed team event, creating new opportunities for Indian archers on the global stage.

questions.question: Which state cabinet approved direct IndiGo international flight operations on the Gaya–Bangkok route in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The Bihar Cabinet approved direct international flight operations on the Gaya–Bangkok route and selected IndiGo to operate the service for a period of 12 months. The initiative aims to improve international connectivity and facilitate travel for Buddhist pilgrims from Thailand visiting Bodh Gaya, one of the most important Buddhist pilgrimage sites in the world. Along with this decision, the cabinet also approved the Young Professionals Selection Policy-2026 and extended the recommendations of the Fifth State Finance Commission for FY 2026–27. The move is expected to strengthen tourism, cultural exchanges, and economic activity in the region.

questions.question: Who was unanimously re-elected as the Chairman of the Commonwealth Chess Association (CCA) for a four-year term in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Bharat Singh Chauhan was unanimously re-elected as the Chairman of the Commonwealth Chess Association (CCA) for a four-year term on May 17, 2026. The election took place during the Annual General Body Meeting held in Wasakaduwa, Sri Lanka. Under his leadership, the association approved the launch of the Commonwealth School Chess Championship, with the inaugural edition scheduled to be hosted by Malaysia in October 2026. Chauhan is a prominent chess administrator who also serves as Chairman of the FIDE Advisory Board and Deputy President of the Asian Chess Federation, contributing significantly to the growth and development of chess across the region and the Commonwealth.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Chairperson of the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Science and Technology, Environment, Forests and Climate Change in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Medha Vishram Kulkarni, a BJP member of the Rajya Sabha, was nominated as the Chairperson of the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Science and Technology, Environment, Forests and Climate Change on May 18, 2026. The appointment was made by Rajya Sabha Chairman C.P. Radhakrishnan. The committee plays an important role in examining government policies, reviewing proposed legislation, and assessing budgetary allocations related to scientific and environmental sectors. Parliamentary Standing Committees are essential mechanisms for detailed legislative scrutiny and oversight, helping Parliament evaluate the functioning and performance of various government departments and ministries.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Secretary (Security) in the Cabinet Secretariat in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Rajiv Singh, a 1993-batch IPS officer of the Tripura cadre, was appointed as the Secretary (Security) in the Cabinet Secretariat on May 22, 2026, following approval by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC). Prior to this appointment, he served as the Director General of Police (DGP) of Manipur, where he led the police force during a challenging period marked by ethnic unrest. As Secretary (Security), he becomes the administrative head of the Special Protection Group (SPG), which is responsible for providing proximate security to the Prime Minister of India and eligible family members. questions.question: Which state launched the ShramMitra application to provide a digital employment platform for workers and employers in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Haryana launched the ShramMitra application on May 20, 2026, with the objective of creating a digital platform that connects workers and employers more efficiently. Developed by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, the app functions as an Electronic Employment Exchange and aims to gradually replace the traditional labour chowk system. It supports Hindi, English, and Punjabi languages and already includes data on around 75,000 registered workers from 135 labour chowks. The platform facilitates employment opportunities for skilled workers such as masons, electricians, plumbers, carpenters, painters, welders, and various self-employed professionals, promoting greater transparency and accessibility in the labour market.

questions.question: Which state government partnered with Google in May 2026 to develop an AI-powered governance framework and an AI Centre of Excellence?
questions.explanation: The Madhya Pradesh government partnered with Google on May 20, 2026, to establish an AI-powered governance ecosystem and an AI Centre of Excellence (AI CoE). The initiative aims to enhance public service delivery through advanced technologies such as real-time crowd monitoring, predictive safety analytics, digital twin models, and multilingual AI assistants. The partnership also focuses on innovation, startup incubation, and large-scale AI skill development. Additionally, Google Play plans to train 10,000 app developers, while AI-based solutions will be introduced in education, agriculture, and healthcare. The collaboration reflects the growing adoption of artificial intelligence for governance and socio-economic development.

questions.question: Which state mandated the use of Electric Vehicles (EVs) for official duties and promoted virtual meetings in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Odisha introduced a policy on May 22, 2026, requiring the use of Electric Vehicles (EVs) for official government duties and encouraging virtual meetings to improve administrative efficiency. The initiative aims to reduce travel-related costs, enhance sustainability, and support environmentally friendly governance practices. The Finance Department of Odisha was tasked with preparing the implementation framework for the policy. The move aligns with broader efforts to promote clean transportation and digital governance. Odisha has often been recognized for progressive administrative reforms and is also known for landmarks such as the Konark Sun Temple and its role in hosting major international sporting events.

questions.question: Where was the First International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) Summit originally scheduled to be held on June 1, 2026?
questions.explanation: The First International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) Summit was originally scheduled to take place in New Delhi on June 1, 2026. The event was planned alongside the Fourth India-Africa Forum Summit (IAFS IV) but was later rescheduled due to the postponement of the India-Africa Forum Summit following an Ebola outbreak in parts of Africa. The IBCA is an initiative launched by India to promote the conservation of seven major big cat species, including the tiger, lion, leopard, snow leopard, puma, jaguar, and cheetah. The summit is expected to strengthen international cooperation among range countries and conservation stakeholders for big cat protection and habitat preservation.

questions.question: Which company successfully conducted the test-firings of the Suryastra Universal Rocket Launcher in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Nibe Limited, a Pune-based defence manufacturing company, successfully carried out the test-firings of the Suryastra Universal Rocket Launcher at the Interim Test Range (ITR) in Chandipur, Odisha, on May 18 and 19, 2026. Developed in collaboration with Israel’s Elbit Systems using Precise & Universal Launching System (PULS) technology, the system is planned for indigenous production in India. The launcher features rocket variants with ranges of 150 km and 300 km and demonstrated high accuracy during testing. Designed as a rapid-response precision weapon system, Suryastra aims to bridge the operational gap between conventional artillery systems and heavy ballistic missiles.

questions.question: Which organisation signed an MoU with MDI Gurgaon in May 2026 to collaborate on Executive Education Programs?
questions.explanation: Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Management Development Institute (MDI), Gurgaon, on May 20, 2026, to strengthen executive education and leadership development. The collaboration aims to create future-ready leaders through specialised leadership programs, strategy-focused learning interventions, overseas learning opportunities, and joint research initiatives. The partnership also emphasises action learning and customised case studies to generate measurable business outcomes. Implemented through SAIL’s Management Training Institute (MTI), the initiative operates under the Ministry of Steel and reflects SAIL’s commitment to enhancing managerial capabilities and organisational excellence within the public sector enterprise.

questions.question: What GDP growth rate has ICRA projected for India in FY27 after revising its forecast in May 2026?
questions.explanation: ICRA revised India's GDP growth forecast for FY27 to 6.2% on May 19, 2026, reducing it from its earlier estimate of 6.5%. The revision was influenced by concerns over rising crude oil prices, which were projected to average $95 per barrel during FY27 due to geopolitical tensions in West Asia and persistent supply constraints. The agency also highlighted challenges such as slowing global economic growth, weaker merchandise exports, and shipping disruptions. Despite the downward revision, the forecast reflects continued economic expansion, although at a more moderate pace than previously expected. The assessment provides important insights into India's growth outlook and macroeconomic conditions.

questions.question: Which insurance company launched the health indemnity solution 'My Health Care Plan Edge+' (MHCP EDGE+) in May 2026?

The plan offers sum insured options ranging from ₹5 lakh to ₹5 crore and includes innovative features such as the Smart Tenure facility, Age Shield Rider, and unlimited reinstatement of the sum insured for multiple claims. Additional benefits include global medical coverage, protection for non-payable hospital expenses, and lifetime renewability. The product aims to enhance financial security against healthcare costs while offering greater flexibility and long-term value to policyholders.

questions.question: When is World Turtle Day observed every year?
questions.explanation: World Turtle Day is observed annually on May 23 to raise awareness about the conservation of turtles and tortoises and the protection of their habitats. Established in 2000 by the American Tortoise Rescue, the day highlights the ecological importance of these ancient reptiles, some of which have existed for more than 200 million years. The observance encourages people to support conservation efforts through education, advocacy, habitat preservation, and responsible environmental practices. It also draws attention to threats such as habitat loss, pollution, climate change, and illegal wildlife trade, which continue to endanger turtle and tortoise populations across the world.

questions.question: At which city were multiple integrated sports infrastructure facilities inaugurated at the SAI National Centre of Excellence (NCoE) in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Union Minister Dr Mansukh Mandaviya inaugurated several integrated sports infrastructure facilities at the SAI National Centre of Excellence (NCoE) in Gandhinagar on May 24, 2026. The newly inaugurated facilities included a Para Athlete Hostel, Centralised Dining Hall, Strength and Conditioning Hall, Meditation Park, and a Multipurpose Training Hall for Kabaddi. The centre serves as India's designated Nodal Centre for Para Sports and supports disciplines such as Para Athletics, Para Badminton, Para Swimming, Para Powerlifting, Para Table Tennis, and Para Fencing. The initiative aims to strengthen athlete training infrastructure and enhance India's performance in national and international sporting events.

questions.question: Who was sworn in as the Chairman of the US Federal Reserve Board of Governors on May 23, 2026?
questions.explanation: Kevin Warsh was sworn in as the Chairman of the US Federal Reserve Board of Governors on May 23, 2026, succeeding Jerome Powell. He was nominated by President Donald Trump to lead the United States central bank during a period marked by elevated inflation levels. The Federal Reserve plays a critical role in managing monetary policy, maintaining financial stability, and influencing economic growth through tools such as interest rate adjustments and open market operations. As Chairman, Warsh is expected to guide policy decisions affecting inflation, employment, and the broader financial system, with significant implications for both the US and global economies.

questions.question: Which country signed a bilateral accession protocol with India to support its membership in the World Trade Organisation (WTO) in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Ethiopia signed a bilateral accession protocol with India on May 22, 2026, in Geneva, Switzerland, as part of its process to join the World Trade Organisation (WTO). The agreement reflects the strengthening relationship between the two countries, with India being Ethiopia’s second-largest trading partner. Bilateral ties were elevated to a Strategic Partnership in December 2025, highlighting growing cooperation in trade, investment, and development. Ethiopia’s accession to the WTO is expected to support its integration into the global trading system, improve market access, and encourage economic reforms. The development also reinforces India’s engagement with African nations through economic and diplomatic partnerships.

questions.question: Which state initiated the roll-out of the PM Vishwakarma Scheme in May 2026?
questions.explanation: West Bengal initiated the implementation of the PM Vishwakarma Scheme on May 22, 2026, by establishing a State Monitoring Committee and District Implementation Committees. The scheme aims to support traditional artisans and craftspeople through skill development, financial assistance, modern tools, and improved market access. More than 7.79 lakh artisans and craftspeople are enrolled under the scheme in the state. As part of broader MSME support initiatives, a Transformer Testing Facility was also inaugurated in Kolkata to provide affordable testing services for enterprises. The rollout is expected to strengthen traditional occupations, improve livelihoods, and enhance the MSME ecosystem across the state.

questions.question: Where was the Maroon Beret Ceremonial Parade held in May 2026 for the induction of new Garud Special Forces operatives?
questions.explanation: The Maroon Beret Ceremonial Parade was conducted on May 23, 2026, at Air Force Station Chandinagar, home to the Garud Regimental Training Centre (GRTC). The event marked the successful completion of rigorous training by new members of the Garud Special Forces, the elite special operations unit of the Indian Air Force. During the ceremony, trainees were awarded the Maroon Beret, Garud Proficiency Badge, and Special Forces Tabs, symbolising their induction into the force. The parade was reviewed by Air Vice Marshal Rahul Gupta, and outstanding performers were recognised for their achievements during training.

questions.question: On which date is Africa Day celebrated every year?
questions.explanation: Africa Day is celebrated annually on May 25 to commemorate the founding of the Organisation of African Unity (OAU) in 1963, which later evolved into the African Union (AU). The observance highlights the continent’s progress in unity, integration, development, and cooperation among African nations. In 2026, the African Union marked the 63rd anniversary of this historic occasion with celebrations held in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The event featured cultural programs, innovation initiatives, participation from member states, regional organisations, and international partners. Africa Day serves as an opportunity to reflect on Africa’s achievements and its vision for sustainable development under Agenda 2063.

questions.question: To which country did FIFA relocate Iran's training base for the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
questions.explanation: FIFA approved the relocation of Iran's training base for the 2026 FIFA World Cup from Tucson, Arizona, in the United States to Tijuana, Mexico, on May 25, 2026. The change was made to simplify visa procedures and improve travel logistics for players and support staff. Tijuana's location near the US border allows convenient access to match venues in California while providing operational flexibility for the team. The 2026 FIFA World Cup will be jointly hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico and will feature an expanded format with 48 teams. Iran, known as Team Melli, will continue to play all its group-stage matches in the United States.

questions.question: Which country elevated its bilateral relationship with India to a Strategic Partnership in May 2026?
questions.explanation: India and Cyprus elevated their bilateral ties to a Strategic Partnership during the visit of Cypriot President Nikos Christodoulides to New Delhi on May 22, 2026. The partnership includes a roadmap for defence cooperation from 2026 to 2031 and the creation of new dialogue mechanisms covering cyber security, consular affairs, and connectivity. Both countries also agreed to strengthen collaboration in areas such as counter-terrorism, higher education, innovation, diplomatic training, and cultural exchanges. The development reflects growing cooperation between India and Cyprus and supports broader economic and strategic engagement, including initiatives linked to the India–Middle East–Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC).

Named the Energy, Food Security and Economic Resilience Facility, the initiative aims to strengthen energy security, food security, and economic resilience while supporting long-term infrastructure development and green transition efforts. The facility provides budgetary assistance, liquidity support, and financing for essential imports and critical expenditures. AIIB is a multilateral development bank headquartered in Beijing, China, with India as its second-largest shareholder. The initiative reflects AIIB's role in addressing global economic disruptions and promoting sustainable development.

questions.question: Which state launched its first dedicated support centre for Paediatric Bone Marrow Transplant (BMT) patients in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Karnataka's first dedicated support centre for Paediatric Bone Marrow Transplant (BMT) patients was inaugurated on May 23, 2026, in Manipal by Access Life. Named the "Home Away from Home" (HAH) centre, the facility provides a hygienic and controlled recovery environment for children undergoing bone marrow transplant procedures. Developed in partnership with the Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE), the centre supports families of young patients receiving treatment at Kasturba Hospital. The initiative is backed by the Chellaram Foundation and aims to offer essential non-medical support, accommodation, and care during the recovery period, improving the overall treatment experience for paediatric patients and their families.

questions.question: Where was India's first indigenous 300-km range rocket system Suryastra, flagged off in May 2026?
questions.explanation: India's first indigenous 300-km range rocket system, Suryastra, was flagged off by Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh in Shirdi, Maharashtra, on May 24, 2026. Developed by NIBE Limited, the system represents a significant advancement in India's indigenous defence capabilities and supports the vision of Aatmanirbhar Bharat. During the event, a private-sector defence manufacturing complex was also inaugurated, focusing on advanced artillery, missile technologies, space systems, and autonomous defence platforms. Additional initiatives included the unveiling of indigenous TNT and RDX plant technologies and the foundation stone laying for a missile complex. The development highlights the growing role of private industry in strengthening India's defence production ecosystem.

questions.question: Which state launched a training drive to revive the traditional Bomkai weave in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Odisha launched a specialised documentation and training initiative on May 23, 2026, to revive the traditional Bomkai weave in Ganjam district. The project, titled 'Revival of Languishing Products (Cotton Bomkai Saree)', is being implemented by the state's Handlooms, Textiles and Handicrafts Department in coordination with the State Agency for Development of Handloom Clusters. A five-day orientation programme was organised in Bomkai village to document traditional designs and colour patterns. Bomkai weave is a GI-tagged craft of Odisha, renowned for its intricate Jala work, nature-inspired motifs, contrasting borders, and richly designed pallu, making it an important part of the state's textile heritage.

questions.question: Which force completed its first all-women Mount Everest expedition in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP) successfully completed its first-ever all-women international Mount Everest expedition on May 21, 2026. The 14-member team, comprising 11 women climbers and 3 technical support members, reached the summit of Mount Everest via the South Col Route from Nepal. The expedition was flagged off from New Delhi on April 19, 2026, and also promoted environmental conservation through the Clean Himalaya—Save Glacier campaign. This achievement marked the fifth successful Everest summit by ITBP and highlighted the growing role of women in high-altitude mountaineering and national service. The expedition also aligned with the Union Home Ministry’s vision of dedicated ITBP Everest missions.

questions.question: Who won the 2025 UN Military Gender Advocate of the Year Award?
questions.explanation: Major Abhilasha Barak was named the recipient of the 2025 United Nations Military Gender Advocate of the Year Award for her outstanding service in Lebanon as part of the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL). Serving as the Commander of the Female Engagement Team, she contributed significantly to community outreach programs for women and adolescent girls and promoted gender sensitisation training among peacekeepers. The award recognises exceptional efforts to advance gender equality in peacekeeping operations. Major Abhilasha Barak is also notable for being the first woman combat helicopter pilot in the Indian Army and the third Indian peacekeeper to receive this prestigious international honour.

questions.question: On which date is World Football Day observed?
questions.explanation: World Football Day is observed annually on May 25 following a resolution adopted by the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA). The date commemorates the 100th anniversary of the first international football tournament with global representation, which began on May 25, 1924, during the Paris Summer Olympics. The observance recognises football's unique ability to bring people together across cultures, nations, and communities. It also highlights the sport's role in promoting inclusion, friendship, peace, and international cooperation. The day serves as a celebration of football's global popularity and its positive social and cultural impact around the world.

questions.question: Who authored the book 'The Library Man of India: The Story of PN Panicker'?
questions.explanation: The book 'The Library Man of India: The Story of PN Panicker' was authored by PP Sathyan and released by Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan on May 22, 2026, at the Uprashtrapati Bhavan in New Delhi. The book highlights the life and contributions of PN Panicker, who is widely regarded as the Father of the Library Movement in Kerala. Through his efforts, a vast network of libraries was established across the state, promoting literacy, social awareness, and intellectual growth. His work played a major role in Kerala’s cultural renaissance and helped transform society through the power of education and access to books.

questions.question: Who was reappointed as the Managing Director and CEO of ICICI Bank in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) approved the reappointment of Sandeep Bakhshi as the Managing Director and CEO of ICICI Bank on May 23, 2026. His extended tenure will begin on October 4, 2026, and continue until October 3, 2028. Sandeep Bakhshi has been leading ICICI Bank since 2018 and has played a significant role in strengthening the bank’s operational performance, digital banking initiatives, and financial stability. ICICI Bank is one of India’s leading private sector banks and is classified by the RBI as a Domestic Systemically Important Bank (D-SIB), highlighting its importance to the country's financial system.

questions.question: In which state was the Agni-1 ballistic missile successfully test-fired in May 2026?
questions.explanation: India successfully conducted the test-launch of the Agni-1 short-range ballistic missile from Chandipur in Odisha on May 22, 2026. The launch was carried out under the Strategic Forces Command and validated all operational and technical parameters of the missile system. Agni-1 is an important component of India's strategic deterrence framework and was developed under the Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme (IGMDP). The missile uses a single-stage solid propellant engine and plays a key role in strengthening national security. The successful test demonstrated the reliability and operational readiness of India's indigenous missile capabilities and strategic defence infrastructure.

questions.question: Which country launched the Shenzhou-23 mission, marking its first attempt to keep an astronaut in orbit for a full one-year duration?

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Chairman of the Marine Products Export Development Authority (MPEDA) on May 26, 2026?

Jawahar, a 2007-batch IAS officer belonging to the AGMUT cadre, was appointed as the Chairman of the Marine Products Export Development Authority (MPEDA) and assumed charge on May 26, 2026. His appointment brings significant administrative experience to the organisation, as he has previously served in key roles including Chief Electoral Officer of Puducherry and Commissioner/Secretary in charge of Industries & Commerce and Education. MPEDA, functioning under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry and headquartered in Kochi, is responsible for promoting India’s marine product exports. The appointment aims to strengthen institutional leadership in the fisheries export sector.

questions.question: Which country held a bilateral meeting with India on May 25, 2026, aiming to upgrade ties to a “next-level partnership” and target $50 billion trade by 2030?
questions.explanation: India and Canada held a high-level bilateral meeting on May 25, 2026, between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney to strengthen their economic and strategic partnership. Both countries set an ambitious target of achieving $50 billion in bilateral trade by 2030 and agreed to finalise a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA). The partnership also focuses on advanced technologies such as AI, quantum computing, and semiconductors, along with cooperation in critical minerals, nuclear energy, and renewable energy. Canada’s participation in global initiatives like the ISA and GBA further highlights the deepening cooperation between the two nations.

questions.question: Where was Kerala’s first private medical museum, the Museum of Medical Archives, inaugurated?
questions.explanation: The Museum of Medical Archives, recognised as Kerala’s first private medical museum, was inaugurated in Ulloor, Thiruvananthapuram, on May 26, 2026. It was established by A Sivaraman, a former artist-modeller from the Government Medical College in Thiruvananthapuram. The museum showcases handcrafted anatomical models, microbiology archives, and educational exhibits that visually represent complex medical concepts such as embryology, circulation, and cellular processes. Its primary aim is to convert textbook-based diagrams into accessible three-dimensional learning tools for students, children, and the general public. The museum also highlights the long history of medical education in Kerala and the evolution of scientific teaching aids.

questions.question: Where was the Governance Summit 2026 organised by MeitY and ISB held?
questions.explanation: The Governance Summit 2026, themed "Inclusive AI for Viksit Bharat," was organised on May 23, 2026, at the Mohali campus of the Indian School of Business (ISB). Jointly hosted by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and the Bharti Institute of Public Policy at ISB, the summit focused on the use of Artificial Intelligence for digital commerce, online safety, healthcare access, job creation, and public service delivery. A key highlight was a roundtable discussion on leveraging AI at the Gram Panchayat level to improve governance. The event aligned with the broader Viksit Bharat vision of transforming India into a developed nation by 2047.

questions.question: Which country launched the Jangbogo-N Project to develop its first nuclear-powered submarine by the late 2030s?
questions.explanation: South Korea officially launched the Jangbogo-N Project on May 26, 2026, marking a major step in its naval modernisation program. The project aims to develop the country’s first nuclear-powered submarine, with the initial launch planned for the mid-2030s and full operational induction expected by the late 2030s. The submarine will be built using domestic shipbuilding and reactor technologies and will utilize low-enriched uranium under 20%, ensuring compliance with international nuclear safety standards. The initiative follows guidelines set by the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) and aligns with global non-proliferation norms while strengthening South Korea’s maritime defence capabilities.

questions.question: Which location hosted Adani Green Energy Ltd’s commissioning of the world’s largest Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) outside China?
questions.explanation: Adani Green Energy Ltd (AGEL) commissioned a 3.37 GWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) in Khavda, Gujarat, marking the largest such facility outside China. The project achieved global recognition due to its massive scale and rapid execution within just 10 months of construction. The system enhances renewable energy reliability by storing large amounts of electricity and supplying power during demand peaks. It can power around 1 million homes for a full day and support millions of LED bulbs for extended hours. Khavda is also a major renewable energy hub where AGEL is developing one of the world’s largest clean energy plants.

questions.question: Which country participated in the 5th Sub Working Group (Land) meeting with India in May 2026?
questions.explanation: India and Russia held the 5th Sub Working Group (Land) meeting on May 24, 2026, under the framework of the India-Russia Inter-Governmental Commission on Military and Military Technical Cooperation. The discussions focused on strengthening operational synergy, enhancing bilateral military capabilities, and expanding cooperation in areas such as joint production of weapons, military hardware, space exploration, energy security, and fertiliser supply chains. During the visit, the Russian delegation also toured the Shatrujeet Brigade of the Indian Army. The meeting reflected the long-standing strategic partnership between India and Russia and their commitment to deepening defence and military cooperation across multiple sectors.

questions.question: Which athlete set a new national record in men’s pole vault by clearing 5.45m at the 29th National Senior Athletics Federation Competition in Ranchi?
questions.explanation: Dev Kumar Meena delivered a record-breaking performance in the men’s pole vault event at the 29th National Senior Athletics Federation Competition held in Ranchi on May 24, 2026. He cleared a height of 5.45 metres to win the gold medal, equalling Kuldeep Kumar’s jump but finishing ahead on countback. This performance surpassed the previous national record of 5.41 metres. Both athletes also achieved the Commonwealth Games qualification mark of 5.25 metres. The achievement highlights Dev Kumar Meena’s excellence in field athletics and marks a significant improvement in India’s national pole vault standards at a competitive level.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the first woman Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) of West Bengal by the Election Commission of India on May 25, 2026?
questions.explanation: Neelam Meena, a 1998-batch IAS officer, was appointed as the Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) of West Bengal by the Election Commission of India on May 25, 2026. This appointment marks a significant administrative milestone as she became the first woman to hold the CEO post in the state since its creation. She succeeded Manoj Kumar Agarwal, who moved on to serve as Chief Secretary of West Bengal. The CEO functions under the supervision of the Election Commission of India and is responsible for overseeing election-related processes at the state level under the framework of the Representation of the People Act, 1950.

questions.question: Which bank partnered with the Delhi e-Governance Society (DeGS) to integrate the ‘e-Pay’ procurement system into the Delhi Government eProcurement Portal?
questions.explanation: The State Bank of India (SBI) signed an MoU with the Delhi e-Governance Society (DeGS) on May 26, 2026, to integrate the ‘e-Pay’ system into the Delhi Government eProcurement Portal. This collaboration aims to modernise procurement by automating payment processes and enabling transparent, paperless transactions. SBI’s role includes providing secure digital payment infrastructure and Management Information System (MIS) integration, ensuring real-time verification of Earnest Money Deposits (EMD) for bidders. The initiative eliminates manual payment methods like demand drafts and strengthens efficiency, transparency, and accountability in government procurement, aligning with broader goals of improving Ease of Doing Business in digital governance.

questions.question: Which state government launched the ₹1 Lakh reward scheme for forest fire control under the Forest Fire Control and Management 2026 strategy?
questions.explanation: The Uttarakhand government introduced the Forest Fire Control and Management 2026 strategy on May 28, 2026, to strengthen wildfire prevention and response systems. As part of this initiative, cash rewards of up to ₹1 lakh, along with ₹75,000 and ₹51,000, are offered to individuals and teams for exceptional efforts in controlling and preventing forest fires. The scheme also includes community-driven measures such as incentives for Forest Fire Protection Committees, pine needle collection payments, and extensive deployment of fire watchers and monitoring infrastructure. Additionally, technologies like IVRS helplines and mobile applications have been introduced to improve real-time coordination in fire management across the state’s high-risk forest regions.

questions.question: In which district was the new natural gas reserve discovered by Oil India Limited in May 2026?
questions.explanation: Oil India Limited (OIL), a Maharatna PSU under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, discovered a new natural gas reserve in the Dandewala Field located in Jaisalmer district, Rajasthan. The discovery was made from the shallower Sanu Formation within the gas field and is estimated to produce around 25,000 standard cubic metres of gas per day. The gas is noted for its high quality due to low carbon dioxide content, making it economically and environmentally significant. This development strengthens India’s domestic energy production and aligns with the broader objective of Atmanirbhar Bharat by enhancing self-reliance in hydrocarbons and reducing dependence on imports.

questions.question: Which state government formed a special task force to curb Godavari River pollution in preparation for the Godavari Pushkarams?
questions.explanation: The Andhra Pradesh government announced the formation of a dedicated inter-district task force to address pollution in the Godavari River ahead of the upcoming Godavari Pushkarams. The initiative is implemented under the Andhra Pradesh Pollution Control Board (APPCB) with a significant budget allocation of ₹100 crore for immediate corrective measures. The plan includes strict environmental regulations such as a year-long ban on single-use plastics across six districts and mandatory quarterly pollution audits for industries, which are categorised into Red, Yellow, and Green based on compliance levels. The project also sets a six-month timeline for visible improvements in river water quality, highlighting the state’s focus on sustainable river conservation and ecological restoration.

questions.question: Which states have been approved for establishing Space Manufacturing Clusters?
questions.explanation: The Department of Space has approved the establishment of Space Manufacturing Clusters in Gujarat and Tamil Nadu to strengthen India’s space ecosystem. Gujarat’s cluster is located at Khoraj near Ahmedabad and focuses on end-to-end spacecraft, payload systems, and space-based applications. Tamil Nadu’s cluster is set up at Thoothukudi and focuses on manufacturing, testing, and integration of launch vehicle systems, strategically positioned near the upcoming Small Launch Vehicle complex at Kulasekharapatnam. The initiative is anchored by IN-SPACe, which oversees procurement, commissioning, and temporary operation of infrastructure before handing it over to state governments. This move aims to promote decentralised space manufacturing and encourage multiple states to participate in India’s growing space sector.

questions.question: Which organisation is developing India’s first commercial geothermal power project at Puga Valley in Ladakh?
questions.explanation: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) is responsible for developing India’s first commercial geothermal power project at Puga Valley in Ladakh. The project was approved through a 5-year MoU extension and aims to establish a 1 MWe pilot geothermal plant targeted for commissioning in FY 2026–27. Located at an altitude of over 14,000 feet, the site has significant geothermal potential with subsurface temperatures reaching around 240°C. The project involves multiple phases including deep drilling and exploration in nearby regions. ONGC, a Maharatna PSU headquartered in New Delhi, is leading this initiative in collaboration with the Ladakh administration and local development authorities.

questions.question: Which AI platforms were launched by the Indian Army on May 25, 2026, to enhance real-time decision-making and logistics management?
questions.explanation: The Indian Army launched two indigenous AI platforms named Kautilya and Q-FORCE on May 25, 2026, to strengthen data-driven decision-making and improve operational efficiency. Kautilya is designed for structured data generation, advanced analytics, and Natural Language Processing (NLP) interfaces, enabling faster interpretation of battlefield and administrative data. Q-FORCE focuses on logistics optimisation, inventory control, and sustainment support across diverse terrains, ensuring efficient resource management in operations. These initiatives are part of the Army’s broader roadmap, where 2026 is designated as the Year of Networking and Data Centricity, with full AI integration targeted by 2027 to modernise military operations.

questions.question: Which footballer officially reached billionaire status on May 24, 2026, becoming only the second player in history to do so after Cristiano Ronaldo?
questions.explanation: Lionel Messi reached billionaire status on May 24, 2026, marking a major financial milestone in his football career. He became only the second footballer ever to achieve this status after Cristiano Ronaldo. His total career earnings exceed $700 million from salaries and bonuses accumulated since 2007, and his net worth has been verified by the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. Messi also continues to be a global football icon, currently captaining Inter Miami in Major League Soccer. His influence extends beyond football, with honours such as a street renamed in his name and record achievements including multiple Ballon d’Or awards and a FIFA World Cup victory with Argentina in 2022.

questions.question: Which company signed a strategic agreement with the Department of Posts for nationwide last-mile parcel delivery services?
questions.explanation: Flipkart India Private Limited signed a strategic agreement with the Department of Posts (DoP) on May 22, 2026, to strengthen nationwide last-mile parcel delivery services. Under this partnership, Flipkart will leverage India Post’s extensive delivery network, which includes over 1.6 lakh post offices, enabling efficient logistics coverage across urban, semi-urban, rural, and remote regions. The agreement supports delivery of both prepaid and Cash on Delivery (COD) parcels, along with OTP-based secure authentication and real-time shipment tracking. This collaboration aims to enhance India’s e-commerce logistics ecosystem while optimising the reach and infrastructure of the Department of Posts.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Director of the National Health Authority – Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) on May 26, 2026?
questions.explanation: Piyush Singla, a 2012 batch Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer from the AGMUT cadre, was appointed as the Director of the National Health Authority (NHA) for the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM). His appointment was made under the Central Staffing Scheme of the Department of Health & Family Welfare and was recommended by the Ministry of Home Affairs for central deputation. The tenure is co-terminus with the duration of the ABDM project and is subject to admissible staffing norms. The ABDM, launched in 2021, aims to create a digital health ecosystem in India through ABHA IDs and improved health record integration under the National Health Authority.

questions.question: What is the revised equity stake of LIC in Central Bank of India after the increase reported in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) increased its equity shareholding in the Central Bank of India to 6.06% through a market purchase on May 22, 2026. Earlier, LIC held a 3.16% stake, and the transaction involved acquiring an additional 2.901% equity in the public sector bank. This move reflects LIC’s continued investment strategy in government-owned financial institutions. LIC, headquartered in Mumbai and established under the LIC Act of 1956, is India’s largest state-owned insurance and investment entity. Central Bank of India, also headquartered in Mumbai and founded in 1911, is one of the oldest public sector banks and was nationalised in 1969 along with other major commercial banks.

questions.question: In which state was the Yoga Mahotsav organised at the Western Group of Temples in Khajuraho to mark the 25-day countdown to IDY 2026?
questions.explanation: The Yoga Mahotsav was organised at the Western Group of Temples in Khajuraho on May 27, 2026, marking the 25-day countdown to the 12th International Day of Yoga (IDY). The event took place in Madhya Pradesh and was conducted by the Morarji Desai National Institute of Yoga (MDNIY) under the Ministry of Ayush. It forms part of a nationwide 100-day countdown campaign aimed at promoting yoga participation across India in collaboration with 100 institutions at 100 locations. The initiative also includes the “Yoga 365 Days” program, which provides free training and encourages mass participation in the Common Yoga Protocol, highlighting India’s effort to integrate heritage sites with wellness initiatives.

questions.question: Which space agency unveiled a $20 billion 3-phase plan to establish a permanent human outpost on the Moon?
questions.explanation: NASA unveiled a $20 billion strategic roadmap on May 27, 2026, aimed at establishing a permanent human presence on the Moon through a structured three-phase plan. The initiative includes technology testing and Lunar Terrain Vehicle deployment in Phase 1 (2026–2028), infrastructure development such as a lunar power grid in Phase 2 (2029–2032), and long-term sustained lunar operations from Phase 3 onwards. The plan also includes multiple missions like Moon Base-I, Moon Base-II, and Moon Base-III, involving international partners such as ESA and the Korean Space Agency. NASA, established in 1958 and headquartered in Washington, D.C., continues its Artemis program to return humans to the lunar surface and advance deep space exploration.

questions.question: Which company signed an MoU with Munitions India Limited for the integration of advanced warheads into unmanned combat systems?
questions.explanation: Johnnette Technologies signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Munitions India Limited (MIL) on May 27, 2026, aimed at integrating advanced warheads into unmanned combat systems. The collaboration focuses on JM-series loitering munitions and the development of future Unmanned Combat Aerial Vehicle (UCAV) programs. The agreement supports the creation of a fully indigenous supply chain for precision-strike munitions under the Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative, reducing reliance on foreign defence components. Johnnette Technologies specialises in unmanned combat aerial systems and is led by founder and CEO Lt Cdr John Livingstone (Retd.), contributing to India’s growing defence innovation ecosystem.

options: The first 24 hours after a traumatic injury
The first 6 hours after an accident
The first hour after a traumatic injury during which prompt medical intervention significantly improves survival
The first 30 minutes after an accident requiring surgical intervention
questions.answer: The first hour after a traumatic injury during which prompt medical intervention significantly improves survival

questions.question: Which company partnered with Datamatics to implement Agentic AI-powered automation for medical underwriting operations?
questions.explanation: SBI Life Insurance entered into a partnership with Datamatics on May 27, 2026, to modernise its medical underwriting process using Agentic AI-powered automation. The initiative involves the deployment of the TruAI Underwriting solution, which is designed to process complex insurance cases by analysing medical histories, laboratory reports, and risk declarations. It generates consolidated digital case summaries and supports decision-making based on established underwriting rules and historical data. The system also includes self-learning capabilities that improve accuracy over time. SBI Life Insurance, a joint venture between State Bank of India and BNP Paribas Cardif, aims to reduce operational costs and improve consistency in underwriting through this advanced AI integration.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Part-time Chairman of Federal Bank approved by the RBI in May 2026?
questions.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) approved the appointment of Elias George as the Part-time Chairman of Federal Bank on May 25, 2026, for a tenure of three years. Prior to this elevation, he served as an Independent Director on the bank’s board from September 5, 2023, reflecting his continued association with the institution. His professional background includes serving as the CEO of the Kochi Metro Rail project and as Chairman of the Unified Metropolitan Transport Authority. A retired Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer, he brings extensive administrative and infrastructure experience. Federal Bank, headquartered in Aluva, Kochi, is one of India’s established scheduled commercial banks with a long legacy in the banking sector.

questions.question: Which city has been announced to host the main national celebration of the International Day of Yoga (IDY) 2026?
questions.explanation: Kolkata has been announced by the Ministry of Ayush on 27 May 2026 as the host city for the main national celebration of the International Day of Yoga (IDY) 2026, scheduled for 21 June 2026. The event carries the theme “Yoga for Healthy Ageing,” highlighting the role of yoga in promoting wellness across all age groups. The announcement was made during the Yoga Mahotsav held at Khajuraho as part of the 25-day countdown to IDY. Key initiatives supporting the celebration include the Yoga Sangam and Yoga Park portals, along with a nationwide Yoga 365 campaign that trained over two lakh participants. The Morarji Desai National Institute of Yoga (MDNIY) will coordinate the mass Common Yoga Protocol demonstration.

questions.question: Who became the first woman from Bengaluru to achieve the Woman International Master (WIM) title in 2026?
questions.explanation: Swara Lakshmi Nair, a 19-year-old chess player from Bengaluru, achieved a historic milestone by becoming the city’s first woman to earn the Woman International Master (WIM) title on May 24, 2026. She secured the title during the Sardinia World Chess Festival Open A after an important eighth-round victory against Switzerland’s Gut Rafael. Her journey toward the title included earning her first WIM norm in May 2025, demonstrating consistent progress at the international level. The WIM title, awarded by the International Chess Federation (FIDE), is a lifelong recognition and ranks just below the Woman Grandmaster title. This achievement marks a significant advancement in her chess career and highlights her growing presence in international chess circuits.

questions.question: Who was appointed as India’s Chef de Mission for the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow?
questions.explanation: The Indian Olympic Association (IOA) appointed Rohit Rajpal as India’s Chef de Mission for the Commonwealth Games 2026, scheduled to be held in Glasgow from July 23 to August 2, 2026. Rohit Rajpal, who is also the Davis Cup captain and Vice-President of the All India Tennis Association (AITA), will lead the Indian contingent during the event. Alongside him, Ravi Bengani was named Deputy Chef de Mission, while Vandana Rao and Rahul Swami were appointed as General Team Managers. The leadership delegation also includes IOA President P T Usha and CEO Raghuram Iyer. The appointment aims to ensure efficient coordination and management of India’s athletes in a scaled-down edition of the Games.
