The contract was awarded to Adani Harbour International FZCO, a subsidiary of APSEZ, along with Argentina-based Meridian Group. The project is located in the San Matias Gulf of Rio Negro Province and is expected to begin commercial operations in September 2027. The initiative is significant for strengthening energy cooperation between India and Argentina, with plans to support LNG exports of up to 10 million tonnes annually to India starting in 2027.

questions.question: How many countries, including India, were granted access to Claude Mythos under Anthropic's Project Glasswing initiative as of June 2026?
questions.explanation: India became one of 15 countries granted access to Claude Mythos, an advanced cybersecurity-focused AI model developed under Anthropic's Project Glasswing initiative. Launched in April 2026, Project Glasswing aims to strengthen the security of critical digital infrastructure across sectors such as banking, communications, and public services. The initiative includes 150 organisations worldwide and partners with major technology companies and institutions. Claude Mythos is specifically designed to analyse large software codebases and detect long-hidden security vulnerabilities. Due to its powerful cybersecurity capabilities, access to the model is restricted to authorised participants to prevent misuse by malicious actors.

questions.question: Which city is hosting the 2nd Commonwealth Parliamentary Association (CPA) India Region Zone II Conference inaugurated on June 8, 2026?
questions.explanation: The 2nd Commonwealth Parliamentary Association (CPA) India Region Zone II Conference is being held in Chandigarh and inaugurated by Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla on June 8, 2026. The conference is hosted at the Haryana Legislative Assembly, located in the Capitol Complex designed by renowned architect Le Corbusier. The event focuses on the theme of the role of an aware society and legislators in achieving the goals of Viksit Bharat 2047. It brings together representatives from the legislatures of Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Haryana, and Delhi to strengthen regional legislative cooperation and discuss future governance challenges.

questions.question: Which state launched the Yogandhra 2026 statewide campaign to promote yoga and healthy living ahead of International Yoga Day?
questions.explanation: Andhra Pradesh launched the Yogandhra 2026 campaign on June 7, 2026, as a statewide initiative to encourage yoga, fitness, and healthy living among citizens. The campaign is designed as a 14-day programme that concludes on June 21, 2026, coinciding with the International Day of Yoga. A major highlight of the initiative is its ambitious target of engaging 1 crore people through yoga sessions, awareness drives, and community activities. The grand finale is scheduled to take place in Amaravati. The programme reflects the state's commitment to promoting preventive healthcare and increasing public participation in wellness-oriented activities.

questions.question: Which country defeated Bangladesh 3-1 to win its record-extending sixth SAFF Women’s Championship title in June 2026?
questions.explanation: India won its record-extending sixth SAFF Women’s Championship title by defeating Bangladesh 3-1 in the final held at the Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium in Margao, Goa, on June 9, 2026. The victory marked India's first championship triumph since 2019 and helped the team reclaim the title after Bangladesh won the 2022 and 2024 editions. India delivered a dominant performance throughout the tournament, scoring 18 goals in four matches while conceding only one. Goals in the final were scored by Pyari Xaxa, Sanfida Nongrum, and Lynda Kom. The achievement further strengthened India's position as the most successful team in SAFF Women’s Championship history.

questions.question: Which state launched a pilot project in June 2026 to automate neonatal health monitoring using AI-powered smartphone video technology?
questions.explanation: Andhra Pradesh launched an innovative pilot project on June 7, 2026, to improve neonatal healthcare through AI-powered smartphone video technology. Developed by Wadhwani AI under the 'Shishu Maapan' application, the system estimates newborn weight and body measurements without physical contact. The technology can record important health parameters such as height, weight, head circumference, chest circumference, and arm measurements. Integrated into the mobile application already used by Accredited Social Health Activists (ASHAs), the pilot project focuses on creating a database of 1,000 newborns across Urban Health Centres (UHCs) and Primary Health Centres (PHCs) in the Mangalagiri constituency, enhancing early child health monitoring and intervention.

questions.question: Which country received the first commercial consignment of 1.5 Metric Tonnes of fresh Amrapali mangoes exported from Jharkhand on June 7, 2026?
questions.explanation: The first commercial consignment of 1.5 Metric Tonnes of fresh Amrapali mangoes from Jharkhand was exported to London, United Kingdom, on June 7, 2026. The mangoes were sourced from Beura Farmer Producer Company Ltd., an all-women Farmer Producer Company located in Bano Block of Simdega district. The export was facilitated by APEDA under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry and handled by M/s JGB Agrofresh Pvt. Ltd. This export highlights the growing international demand for Indian mangoes and showcases Jharkhand's potential in agricultural exports and horticultural development.

questions.question: What Total Fertility Rate (TFR) was recorded by the Andaman and Nicobar Islands in NFHS-6, making it the lowest in India?
questions.explanation: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands recorded a Total Fertility Rate (TFR) of 0.9 in the National Family Health Survey-6 (NFHS-6), making it the lowest TFR in India and the only region with a fertility rate below 1. This figure is significantly lower than the replacement level of 2.1 required to maintain a stable population. The TFR has steadily declined from 1.4 in NFHS-4 (2015-16) to 1.3 in NFHS-5 (2019-20) and further to 0.9 in NFHS-6. The data also reflects demographic changes such as a shrinking child population and a growing elderly population in the Union Territory.

questions.question: Which hospital successfully conducted India’s first Pulsed Field Ablation (PFA) procedure for the treatment of Atrial Fibrillation on June 8, 2026?
questions.explanation: Narayana Health City, Bengaluru, achieved a significant medical milestone by successfully performing India’s first Pulsed Field Ablation (PFA) procedure for treating Atrial Fibrillation (AFib) on June 8, 2026. PFA is an advanced cardiac treatment that uses ultra-fast electrical pulses to selectively target abnormal heart tissue while preserving nearby critical structures. The procedure was completed in just 35 minutes, considerably faster than conventional thermal ablation methods that can take several hours. The technology offers a safer, minimally invasive approach to cardiac rhythm management and is integrated with a comprehensive AFib treatment programme to improve patient outcomes and accessibility.

The victory earned India the gold medal and reinforced its strong presence in Asian junior hockey. Ashish Tani Purti played a crucial role in the tournament, finishing as the top scorer with 13 goals and earning the Player of the Match award in the final. Ayush Rajak was named the tournament's Best Goalkeeper, while Ketan Kushwaha captained the championship-winning Indian team. The achievement highlights the strength of India's emerging hockey talent.

questions.question: Which Indian state exported the first consignment of GI-tagged Tezpur Litchi to Dubai with the facilitation of APEDA in June, 2026?
questions.explanation: APEDA facilitated the first export of GI-tagged Tezpur Litchi from Assam to Dubai on June 7, 2026, marking an important achievement for India's agricultural export sector. Tezpur Litchi is known for its distinctive quality and includes varieties such as Bombaya, Bilati, Elaichi, Piyaji, and Sahi. The initiative was undertaken to expand international market access for farmers and strengthen agricultural exports from the North Eastern region. As a result of the export, farmers received nearly 10% higher prices compared to domestic markets. The move also supports the integration of North Eastern farmers into global value chains and promotes regional economic development.

questions.question: In which city was the new Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC) launched jointly by Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh on June 8, 2026?
questions.explanation: The new Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC) was launched in Lucknow to strengthen weather forecasting and meteorological services across Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and adjoining regions. The centre is part of broader efforts under Mission Mausam to improve high-frequency and impact-based weather forecasting. The initiative supports the expansion of weather-monitoring infrastructure, including Doppler Weather Radars, Automatic Weather Stations, Automatic Rain Gauges, and lightning sensors. The enhanced network is expected to improve predictions of extreme weather events such as cyclones, thunderstorms, flash floods, and landslides. The centre also contributes to better aviation meteorological services and disaster preparedness across northern India.

questions.question: Which state government signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MoA) with CSIR-Central Road Research Institute in June 2026 to implement the CAQM framework for urban road dust mitigation and sustainable infrastructure?
questions.explanation: Haryana signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MoA) with CSIR-Central Road Research Institute (CSIR-CRRI) on June 8, 2026, to implement the CAQM framework aimed at reducing urban road dust and promoting sustainable infrastructure development. The initiative focuses on the National Capital Region (NCR), where road dust is a major contributor to particulate air pollution. The project includes developing road space standards, adopting greening measures, integrating Road Asset Management Systems (RAMS), and using innovative technologies for sustainable road construction. The collaboration involves CSIR-CRRI, the School of Planning and Architecture (SPA), New Delhi, under the guidance of the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM).

questions.question: Who was nominated by President Lee Jae-myung as the new Prime Minister of South Korea on June 09, 2026, and is set to become the country's second female Prime Minister upon confirmation?
questions.explanation: Han Seong-sook was nominated by South Korean President Lee Jae-myung as the new Prime Minister on June 09, 2026. She currently serves as the Minister of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises (SMEs) and is the first female Prime Minister nominee of the Lee administration. If approved by the National Assembly, she will become only the second woman to hold the office of Prime Minister in South Korea's history. Before entering government service, Han was the CEO of Naver, a major internet company, and has been entrusted with advancing the country's Artificial Intelligence (AI) and technology-driven growth initiatives.

questions.question: In which location was Manipur's first Exclusive Special Court of the National Investigation Agency (NIA) inaugurated?
questions.explanation: Manipur's first Exclusive Special Court dedicated to the National Investigation Agency (NIA) was inaugurated in Thoubal district. Located at the Thoubal District Court Complex in Khangabok, the court has been established to strengthen the state's justice delivery system and ensure faster handling of cases investigated by the NIA. The inauguration was carried out by Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh. The creation of a dedicated NIA court is expected to improve judicial efficiency in dealing with terrorism-related and other serious national security cases. It also enhances access to specialised legal proceedings within the state, reducing procedural delays and supporting effective law enforcement.

questions.question: Which location in Uttar Pradesh has been selected for the establishment of the first 250 MW solar power project with a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) on defence land?
questions.explanation: Sitapur in Uttar Pradesh has been chosen for the development of a 250 MW solar power project on vacant defence land. Approved by the Ministry of Defence on June 9, 2026, the project will cover around 850 acres and will include a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), making it the first large-scale renewable energy project of its kind on defence land in India. NTPC Limited will develop the project through a competitive bidding process. The initiative aims to enhance energy security for defence establishments, promote the use of renewable energy, and reduce dependence on conventional grid power, contributing to sustainable infrastructure development.

questions.question: Which state launched the Singappen Special Force on June 09, 2026, to enhance the protection of women and children?
questions.explanation: Tamil Nadu launched the Singappen Special Force as a dedicated initiative to improve the safety and security of women and children across the state. The force was inaugurated by Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay at Rajarathinam Stadium in Chennai in the presence of Director General of Police Mahesh Kumar Aggarwal. The specialised unit is tasked with monitoring and patrolling public places, identifying vulnerable locations, preventing harassment, and increasing police visibility. The initiative aims to create a safer environment through proactive policing and community participation, ultimately fostering a women and child-friendly society while strengthening public confidence in law enforcement.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Managing Director of Indraprastha Gas Ltd (IGL), succeeding Kamal Kishore Chatiwal?
questions.explanation: Kumar Shanker has been appointed as the Managing Director of Indraprastha Gas Ltd (IGL), one of India's leading city gas distribution companies. Prior to this appointment, he served as the Managing Director of Maharashtra Natural Gas Ltd (MNGL), a joint venture involving GAIL, Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL), and the Maharashtra government. He played a significant role in implementing the Unified Tariff for India's National Gas Grid System, a major reform in the natural gas sector. IGL, headquartered in New Delhi, is a joint venture of GAIL and BPCL and is recognised as the largest city-gas distributor in North India.

questions.question: What GDP growth rate has Fitch Ratings forecast for India in FY27 after revising its earlier estimate downward on June 09, 2026?
questions.explanation: Fitch Ratings revised India's GDP growth forecast for FY27 to 6.4%, down from its earlier estimate of 6.7%. The revision was attributed to factors such as geopolitical tensions and rising global energy costs, which could affect economic activity and investment. Fitch also projected that growth would improve to 6.7% in FY28 as energy-related pressures ease before stabilising at 6.4% in FY29. Despite the downgrade, India is expected to remain one of the fastest-growing major economies. The report also highlighted higher crude oil price estimates, inflation concerns, and expectations of a policy rate increase by the Reserve Bank of India.

questions.question: Which Indian state signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) in June 2026 to promote climate-resilient and sustainable development?
questions.explanation: Himachal Pradesh signed an MoU with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) on June 5, 2026, to advance climate-resilient and sustainable development initiatives. The collaboration focuses on implementing circular economy practices, improving waste management systems, adopting electric mobility solutions for waste collection, and carrying out landscape restoration and ecosystem-based adaptation projects. The state also launched the Safai Mitra Scheme under Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu to support the socio-economic welfare and safety of informal waste management workers. Himachal Pradesh, formed in 1971, is known for its ecological significance and rich natural heritage.

questions.question: In which year is NASA's Artemis III mission scheduled to launch as a critical test flight for future lunar exploration?
questions.explanation: Artemis III is a major mission under NASA’s Artemis program and is scheduled for launch in 2027. The mission will serve as a crucial technology demonstration, testing spacecraft rendezvous, docking operations, crew transfer procedures, navigation systems, and integration with lunar landers developed by Blue Origin and SpaceX. The four-member crew includes astronauts from NASA and the European Space Agency, highlighting international cooperation in space exploration. Artemis III is expected to pave the way for future lunar missions, including Artemis IV, and support NASA’s long-term objective of establishing a sustainable human presence on the Moon while preparing for eventual crewed missions to Mars.

questions.question: How many companies were approved under Round-III of the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Textiles on June 10, 2026?
questions.explanation: The Ministry of Textiles approved 96 companies under Round-III of the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Textiles on June 10, 2026. This includes 22 newly approved applicants in the latest phase. The selected companies have committed a total investment of ₹12,822.67 crore, while the new applicants alone are expected to invest ₹2,339.14 crore. The scheme focuses on promoting Man-Made Fibre (MMF) apparel, MMF fabrics, and technical textiles to strengthen India’s textile manufacturing capabilities. It is also expected to generate significant employment opportunities and contribute substantially to production, exports, and overall growth in the textile sector.

questions.question: Which state police launched Operation Milap, under which 1,470 missing persons were traced in one month?
questions.explanation: Operation Milap was a special statewide initiative launched by the Gujarat Police on 7 May 2026 to trace missing persons and reunite them with their families. Through a combination of technology, field investigations, digital intelligence, and interstate coordination, the operation successfully traced 1,470 individuals within a month. The initiative focused particularly on vulnerable groups such as women and children, while also reviewing long-pending missing person cases. Surat City Police recorded the highest number of recoveries. The campaign highlighted citizen-centric policing, strengthened public trust in law enforcement, and demonstrated the effective use of modern investigative techniques in ensuring public safety and family reunification.

questions.question: Who was ranked among India's Top 50 CEOs, MDs, and Founders for 2026 by the Great Manager Institute?
questions.explanation: Sameer Kanodia was recognised in India’s Top 50 CEOs, MDs, and Founders list for 2026 by the Great Manager Institute (GMI). This marked the second consecutive year he received this prestigious leadership honour. The recognition is awarded to leaders who demonstrate exceptional ability in inspiring, empowering, and developing teams while achieving strong business outcomes. Sameer Kanodia serves as the Vice Chairman and CEO of both Lumina Datamatics and TNQTech. His leadership has been acknowledged for fostering organisational growth, promoting employee development, and delivering sustained business success through effective management practices and strategic vision.

questions.question: Which port will have the world's second longest breakwater being constructed by Afcons Infrastructure under a ₹5,301 crore contract?
questions.explanation: Vadhvan Port, located in Maharashtra, is set to host the world's second longest breakwater with a total length of 10.14 km. Afcons Infrastructure Ltd secured a ₹5,301 crore contract for the project from Vadhvan Port Project Limited. The port is being developed as a key component of India's maritime expansion strategy and is expected to become the country's largest public port. With a planned handling capacity of 23.2 million TEUs, Vadhvan Port is also projected to be among the largest container ports globally. The project is expected to strengthen India's trade infrastructure and enhance its position as a major global maritime hub.

questions.question: Which state government launched ‘Project Ganga’ to provide high-speed internet connectivity to rural families and promote digital entrepreneurship?
questions.explanation: Project Ganga is a rural digital connectivity initiative launched by the Uttar Pradesh government to expand high-speed internet access in underserved rural areas. The project aims to connect approximately 20 lakh families, train around 8,000 digital entrepreneurs, and generate more than one lakh direct and indirect employment opportunities. It focuses on strengthening digital education, telemedicine, e-governance, and technology-based entrepreneurship. The initiative is being implemented in phases, beginning with 21 districts, and seeks to bridge the digital divide by ensuring reliable internet services and creating new livelihood opportunities across rural communities.

questions.question: Which state unveiled the Science, Technology and Innovation Policy 2026 to promote a research-oriented economy and strengthen emerging technology sectors?
questions.explanation: Uttarakhand unveiled the Science, Technology and Innovation Policy 2026 with the objective of transforming the state into a major hub for science, technology, and information technology. The policy emphasises integrating modern research with traditional knowledge and focuses on emerging fields such as Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain, Robotics, Drones, Space Technology, and Nanotechnology. It also proposes the establishment of Science Cities, Planetariums, Atal Tinkering Labs, and advanced Teaching-Learning Centres. The Uttarakhand State Council for Science and Technology will serve as the nodal agency, while digital initiatives like the STI Observatory will support researchers through improved access to scientific resources and information.

questions.question: Which company partnered with Meta to develop India's first AI-enabled hyperscale data centre in Jamnagar, Gujarat?
questions.explanation: Reliance Industries partnered with Meta Platforms to establish a 168 MW AI-enabled hyperscale data centre in Jamnagar, Gujarat. The facility is designed to support Meta’s growing global artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and data processing requirements. It is expected to be Meta’s first built-to-suit data centre in India and one of the largest AI infrastructure investments in the country. The project emphasises sustainability through renewable energy-powered operations and seawater-based cooling systems. Reliance Industries will manage the entire infrastructure lifecycle, including design, development, utility management, network connectivity, operations, maintenance, and renewable power supply.

questions.question: Which country will receive liquefied natural gas (LNG) from Malaysia’s Petronas under the 20-year supply agreement signed with JERA?
questions.explanation: Malaysia’s national oil and gas company, Petronas, signed a long-term agreement with JERA, one of the world’s largest LNG buyers, to supply liquefied natural gas for 20 years. Under the deal, Petronas will provide 2 million tons of LNG annually, with deliveries beginning in 2028. The agreement aims to strengthen Japan’s energy security and ensure a stable supply of natural gas. In addition to energy cooperation, both countries agreed to enhance bilateral trade using local currencies and collaborate in areas such as critical minerals, artificial intelligence, semiconductors, defence, and fertiliser feedstock supply chains.

questions.question: Who launched the Land Port Management System (LPMS) ‘VINIMAY’ in New Delhi as part of India’s Smart Border initiative?
questions.explanation: Amit Shah, the Union Home Minister, launched the Land Port Management System (LPMS) ‘VINIMAY’ in New Delhi on 9 June 2026. The digital platform is designed to modernise border management by integrating cargo handling, passenger movement, vehicle processing, and inter-agency coordination into a single system. LPMS aims to reduce paperwork by around 90%, improve trade efficiency, strengthen security, and enable real-time information sharing among multiple government agencies. The initiative forms a key component of India’s Smart Border strategy, which focuses on technology-driven operations, enhanced surveillance, smoother cross-border trade, and improved connectivity at land ports.

questions.question: Where was the Land Port Management System (LPMS) named 'VINIMAY' inaugurated in June, 2026?
questions.explanation: The Land Port Management System (LPMS), known as 'VINIMAY', was inaugurated in New Delhi by Union Home Minister Amit Shah on June 9, 2026. The system is designed to modernise land port operations through a Single Electronic Window, significantly reducing manual paperwork and improving efficiency. It incorporates advanced technologies such as Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) and real-time data sharing among multiple government agencies. VINIMAY supports India's Smart Borders Strategy by enhancing border management, facilitating trade, reducing processing delays, and strengthening the country’s security and economic infrastructure through digital transformation.

questions.question: Which region will gain all-weather connectivity with Jammu & Kashmir through the Zojila Tunnel Project?
questions.explanation: The Zojila Tunnel Project is a landmark infrastructure development aimed at ensuring year-round connectivity between Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh. The tunnel, stretching approximately 14 km between Baltal and Minamarg on NH-1, will overcome the seasonal disruptions caused by heavy snowfall at Zojila Pass. The project is expected to reduce travel time between Sonamarg and Minamarg from two hours to about 30 minutes. Equipped with modern safety systems, including fire detection, ventilation, and CCTV surveillance, the tunnel will improve transportation, strengthen regional connectivity, and support economic and strategic development in the region.

questions.question: Which company secured the Letter of Award from the Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port Authority for the integrated development of a container terminal in Kolkata in June, 2026?
questions.explanation: JSW Infrastructure secured the Letter of Award from the Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port Authority for the development of the Outer Container Terminal at Netaji Subhas Dock in Kolkata. The project will be implemented under the Design, Build, Finance, Operate and Transfer (DBFOT) model through a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) framework with a concession period of 30 years. The project is expected to enhance container handling capacity significantly, increasing the Kolkata Dock System's overall capacity while also boosting JSW Infrastructure’s total container handling capabilities across its port network.

questions.question: Which state launched the Priyadarshini scheme to provide free bus travel for women from June 15, 2026?
questions.explanation: Kerala approved the Priyadarshini scheme to offer free bus travel for women across all age groups and income categories. The benefit is initially available on ordinary services operated by the Kerala State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC). The scheme forms part of the government's Indira Guarantee welfare initiatives aimed at enhancing mobility and reducing transportation expenses for women. The estimated monthly expenditure exceeds ₹60 crore, while the annual financial commitment is projected to be nearly ₹800 crore. Future expansion of the scheme to additional transport categories will depend on improvements in KSRTC’s financial condition and revenue generation.

questions.question: Which state is set to receive a proposed investment of ₹1 lakh crore facilitated by the Indian Chamber of Commerce (ICC)?
questions.explanation: The Indian Chamber of Commerce (ICC) proposed an investment of ₹1 lakh crore in West Bengal to boost regional economic growth and industrial development. The investment is expected to be facilitated through ICC member companies and aims to attract large-scale projects across key sectors. The initiative emphasises collaboration between the Central Government, the West Bengal state government, and industry stakeholders to unlock the state's economic potential. Founded in 1925 by Ghanshyam Das Birla and headquartered in Kolkata, the ICC is one of India's oldest industry associations and plays a significant role in promoting business and economic development.

questions.question: What is the targeted share of electricity in global final energy demand by 2035 under the proposed "35x35" global electrification target?
questions.explanation: The "35x35" global electrification target proposed by the COP31 co-presidency of Turkey and Australia aims to increase electricity’s share of global final energy demand from the current 20% to 35% by 2035. The initiative is supported by analyses from the International Energy Agency (IEA) and the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) and is intended to help countries align with the goals of the Paris Agreement. Greater electrification is considered essential for reducing greenhouse gas emissions, accelerating the transition to clean energy, improving energy efficiency, and supporting long-term global climate objectives.

questions.question: In which Union Territory was the Guinness World Record for the tallest underwater human stack achieved in May 2026?
questions.explanation: A diving team achieved a Guinness World Record in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands by creating the tallest human stack underwater. The structure reached a height of 22.3 metres (73.16 feet) and was officially recognised as the world's tallest underwater human stack. The feat was performed at Swaraj Dweep, formerly known as Havelock Island, a popular destination in the archipelago. Admiral D.K. Joshi (Retd.), the Lieutenant Governor of the Union Territory, also participated in the successful attempt. The achievement highlights the region's prominence in adventure tourism, diving activities, and unique marine attractions.

questions.question: Which company introduced BlueVerse Currency as a new commercial model for outcome-based AI pricing in June 2026?
questions.explanation: LTM, a subsidiary of the Larsen & Toubro Group, launched BlueVerse Currency to transform how enterprises adopt and scale artificial intelligence solutions. The model shifts from traditional effort-based billing to outcome-based pricing, aligning costs with measurable business results. BlueVerse Currency integrates expert services, software accelerators, AI agents, delivery platforms, and computing resources within a unified commercial framework. It also supports a mix of fixed and variable pricing structures along with subscription-based managed services. Powered by the BlueVerse ecosystem, the initiative is designed to accelerate business transformation and enable agentic enterprises through advanced process automation and AI-driven operations.

questions.question: Which state decided to withdraw the two-child restriction for eligibility in government service in June 2026?
questions.explanation: The Madhya Pradesh government decided to remove the two-child restriction that had previously disqualified individuals with more than two living children from government service recruitment. The decision also involved amendments to service and conduct rules that treated having more than two children as a ground for ineligibility or misconduct. Originally introduced in 2001 as a population-control measure, the policy applied to individuals with more than two children born on or after January 26, 2001. The move aligns Madhya Pradesh with other states such as Rajasthan and Chhattisgarh, which had already withdrawn similar restrictions in earlier years.

questions.question: In which state was the 20-kW FM transmitter inaugurated in Ramgarh to strengthen border communication infrastructure?
questions.explanation: The 20-kW FM transmitter was inaugurated in Ramgarh, Rajasthan, with the objective of enhancing communication connectivity across India's border regions. The transmitter is strategically important as it is designed to provide coverage along the border belt extending from Kashmir to Rajasthan. The initiative supports improved information dissemination, communication access, and infrastructure development in sensitive border areas. The announcement was made alongside updates on the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme, under which railway stations in cities such as Jaisalmer, Alwar, Kota, and Ajmer are being upgraded. The project reflects the government's broader focus on strengthening border infrastructure and regional development.

questions.question: Which institution developed the portable arsenic detection device 'ArsenSafe' for rapid testing of drinking water contamination?
questions.explanation: ArsenSafe is a portable hand-held device developed by researchers at IIT Bhubaneswar to detect arsenic contamination in drinking water quickly and efficiently. The innovation was created by the Sensors and Spectroscopy Research Group within the School of Electrical and Computer Sciences (SECS) under the leadership of Sayan Dey. Developed through a startup incubated at the institute's Research and Entrepreneurship Park, the device combines nanotechnology and machine learning to assess water quality. Its ability to operate without laboratory infrastructure or specialised chemicals makes it highly useful for field testing by public health agencies, environmental organisations, and NGOs working in affected regions.

questions.question: Who was nominated by the Central Government as a Director on the Central Boards of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and State Bank of India (SBI) on June 11, 2026?
questions.explanation: Sanjay Lohiya was nominated by the Central Government as a Director on the Central Boards of both the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and the State Bank of India (SBI) on June 11, 2026. A 1994-batch IAS officer of the Assam-Meghalaya cadre, he serves as the Secretary of the Department of Financial Services (DFS) under the Ministry of Finance and assumed charge on June 1, 2026. His nomination followed the retirement of Nagaraju Maddirala. The appointment became effective immediately and will remain in force until further orders, strengthening coordination between the government and key financial institutions.

questions.question: Which international organisation jointly launched the Blue Valley Cluster in Guwahati with the Government of Assam in June 2026?
questions.explanation: The Blue Valley Cluster was jointly launched by the Government of Assam and the European Union to strengthen sustainable value chains and innovation ecosystems in the North-East region of India. The initiative focuses on sectors such as flavours, fragrances, AYUSH products, agarwood, and organic foods. A Memorandum of Understanding was also signed between the Assam Industrial Development Corporation Limited (AIDC) and the Federation of European Businesses in India (FEBI) to promote investment, business collaboration, and knowledge exchange. The project aims to connect farmers, self-help groups, and startups with global markets while encouraging industrial cooperation in advanced technology sectors.

questions.question: Where was the 11th Governing Council Meeting of NITI Aayog held on June 11, 2026?
questions.explanation: The 11th Governing Council Meeting of NITI Aayog was held on June 11, 2026, at the Rashtrapati Bhavan Cultural Centre in New Delhi. Chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the meeting focused on the theme "Inclusive Human Development for Viksit Bharat @2047." Discussions centred on strengthening human capital, promoting employment and entrepreneurship, improving health and well-being, and ensuring equity for all citizens. The meeting also reviewed recommendations from the National Conference of Chief Secretaries and emphasised key development areas such as education, skilling, and sports. New Delhi is also the headquarters of NITI Aayog, India's apex public policy think tank.

questions.question: Which Indian Standard was released by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) in 2026 to provide a framework for managing Community Seed Banks (CSBs)?
questions.explanation: The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) released IS 20201:2026 to establish a structured framework for the management of Community Seed Banks (CSBs) and the conservation of indigenous crop varieties. The standard provides guidelines for seed collection, viability testing, storage, and documentation. It particularly focuses on preserving traditional seeds that possess valuable characteristics such as drought tolerance, disease resistance, and enhanced nutritional value. Developed with contributions from key agricultural and biodiversity institutions, the standard supports national efforts to safeguard plant genetic resources, strengthen food security, and promote sustainable agricultural practices while aligning with existing biodiversity and farmers’ rights legislation.

questions.question: In which city was the 114th International Labour Conference (ILC) held on June 9, 2026?
questions.explanation: The 114th International Labour Conference (ILC) was held in Geneva, Switzerland, on June 9, 2026. The conference brought together representatives from different countries to discuss labour-related issues and policies. India, led by Union Minister of State Shobha Karandlaje, participated actively and highlighted priorities such as inclusive growth, gender equality, and social dialogue. Geneva is an important global centre for international diplomacy and labour affairs. It is also the headquarters of the International Labour Organisation (ILO), which was established in 1919 and is known for promoting workers' rights, social justice, and cooperation among governments, employers, and workers worldwide.

questions.question: What was the provisional All India CPI (Combined) inflation rate reported for May 2026?
questions.explanation: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) for May 2026 reported a provisional national inflation rate of 3.93%, reflecting the overall change in retail prices across the country. Released by the National Statistical Office (NSO) under the Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation, the CPI is a key indicator used to measure inflation and monitor price movements in a fixed basket of goods and services. The data is collected from a wide network of urban markets and villages across India. Inflation trends influence monetary policy decisions, household purchasing power, and overall economic planning, making CPI one of the most important economic indicators in the country.

questions.question: What global rank did Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority (JNPA) achieve in the Container Port Performance Index (CPPI) 2025?
questions.explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority (JNPA) secured the 22nd position globally in the Container Port Performance Index (CPPI) 2025, released by the World Bank and S&P Global Market Intelligence. This achievement marked an improvement of one rank from the previous year and helped JNPA retain its status as India's highest-performing container port. The CPPI evaluates ports based on operational efficiency, turnaround time, and overall performance. The report also highlighted the impact of global shipping disruptions and congestion on freight movement. JNPA's strong ranking reflects its continued efforts to improve port operations and enhance India's maritime trade infrastructure.

questions.question: Which company received official certification as a Biller Operating Unit (BOU) under the Bharat Bill Payment System (BBPS) in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Viyona Fintech India received certification as a Biller Operating Unit (BOU) under the Bharat Bill Payment System (BBPS) from NPCI Bharat BillPay Limited (NBBL). This certification authorises the company to facilitate bill payment collection for various sectors, including utilities, education, insurance, and financial services. As a BOU, Viyona Fintech can help expand the reach of the Bharat BillPay network by integrating regional and underserved areas into the interoperable payment ecosystem. The development supports the growth of digital payment infrastructure in India and contributes to greater financial inclusion and convenience for consumers and service providers.

questions.question: In which state will the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) host the Global Wind Day 2026 Conference?
questions.explanation: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) is organising the Global Wind Day 2026 Conference in Goa on June 15, 2026. The conference focuses on the theme “Wind Energy: From Ambition to Acceleration” and aims to support India's renewable energy goals. India is currently the world's fourth-largest wind power market and has set ambitious targets to achieve 100 GW of wind energy capacity by 2030 and 155 GW by 2035. The event will also highlight opportunities in wind turbine manufacturing and exports, helping strengthen India's position as a major global player in clean energy and sustainable development.

questions.question: At which institution were Advanced Quantum and Artificial Intelligence labs announced by Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Advanced Quantum and Artificial Intelligence laboratories were announced at MNIT Jaipur on June 11, 2026, as part of India's efforts to strengthen capabilities in emerging technologies. The initiative includes a Quantum Computing Lab focused on indigenous development of Quantum Key Distribution (QKD), quantum simulation, and quantum sensing technologies. The project aims to enhance national security and support advancements in post-quantum cryptography. In addition, AI and Makers Labs were established to promote research, innovation, and hands-on learning in areas such as artificial intelligence, embedded systems, sensors, and electronics. The initiative aligns with India's broader goals of technological self-reliance and semiconductor ecosystem development.

questions.question: Which institution unveiled ANCHOR, the world's most detailed 3D atlas of the human brainstem, in June 2026?
questions.explanation: ANCHOR, which stands for Atlas of Neurochemical Characterisation of the Human Brainstem with 3D Reconstruction, was unveiled by IIT Madras on June 12, 2026. Developed by the Sudha Gopalakrishnan Brain Centre (SGBC), the atlas represents a major advancement in neuroscience research. It incorporates more than 200 brainstem nuclei and fiber tracts and combines MRI, histology, and chemo-architectural data into a single multimodal framework. Covering various stages of the human lifespan, the project aims to improve the understanding of neurological disorders and assist clinicians in identifying affected cell populations, thereby supporting more accurate diagnosis and future medical research.

questions.question: Which two states signed a tripartite MoU with the Government of India on June 11, 2026, for oil and gas exploration along their shared border?
questions.explanation: The Government of India, Assam, and Nagaland signed a tripartite Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on June 11, 2026, to facilitate oil and gas exploration in areas along the Assam-Nagaland border. The agreement includes a 50-50 revenue-sharing mechanism for resources extracted from the disputed region and covers more than 1,000 square kilometres. The initiative aims to significantly increase oil production from the current levels of 1,000–1,500 barrels per day to over 10,000–15,000 barrels per day. The project is expected to enhance energy production, generate substantial revenue, and promote cooperation between the two neighbouring states in resource development.

questions.question: What GDP growth rate did the World Bank forecast for India in 2026, making it the world's fastest-growing major economy?
questions.explanation: The World Bank projected India's GDP growth at 6.6% for 2026, maintaining its position as the fastest-growing major economy in the world. This forecast follows a strong economic expansion of 7% in 2025 and reflects confidence in India's long-term growth potential. While global economic growth is expected to slow due to geopolitical tensions and international conflicts, India is projected to outperform other major economies such as China, the United States, the Euro Zone, and Japan. The forecast highlights India's resilience, expanding domestic demand, ongoing reforms, and growing role in the global economy, making it a key driver of future economic growth worldwide.

questions.question: Which country elevated its bilateral relationship with India to a "Special Global Strategic Partnership" in February 2026?
questions.explanation: India and France elevated their bilateral ties to a "Special Global Strategic Partnership" during President Emmanuel Macron's visit to India in February 2026. The partnership builds upon a long-standing relationship that began with the establishment of a Strategic Partnership in 1998, making France the first Western nation to do so with India. The upgraded framework includes the Horizon 2047 roadmap, a 25-year cooperation plan covering areas such as space technology, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, critical technologies, and Indo-Pacific security. Collaboration between ISRO and France's space agency CNES, along with growing commercial space partnerships, further strengthens the strategic importance of this relationship.

questions.question: Who assumed charge as India’s High Commissioner to Bangladesh in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Dinesh Trivedi assumed charge as India’s High Commissioner to Bangladesh after arriving in Dhaka on June 12, 2026. He succeeded Pranay Verma in this important diplomatic position and had received his Letters of Credence from President Droupadi Murmu shortly before taking up the assignment. Dinesh Trivedi has had a distinguished political and parliamentary career, serving as the Union Minister for Railways and Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare. He also represented the Barrackpore constituency in the Lok Sabha and served in the Rajya Sabha. His appointment reflects India's commitment to strengthening diplomatic and strategic relations with Bangladesh.

questions.question: What is the name of India’s first indigenous distilled video AI model launched under the IndiaAI Mission in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Varya is India’s first indigenous distilled video AI model, launched by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) with support from the IndiaAI Mission. Developed by Avataar.ai, the model uses an advanced distillation technique that significantly reduces video generation cycles from 50 steps to just 4 steps, improving efficiency and lowering costs. It supports both Text-to-Video and Image-to-Video generation and is designed to create culturally relevant content reflecting Indian festivals, clothing, food, and regional diversity. The technology is expected to benefit sectors such as education, e-commerce, and MSMEs by enabling affordable and scalable digital content creation.

questions.question: Which country partnered with India to launch a UPI-NPI cross-border peer-to-peer remittance linkage in June 2026?
questions.explanation: India and Nepal operationalized a peer-to-peer (P2P) cross-border remittance mechanism on June 6, 2026, enabling real-time digital money transfers between the two countries. The initiative connects India's Unified Payments Interface (UPI) with Nepal's National Payments Interface (NPI), allowing users to make instant and secure transactions through mobile banking applications and digital wallets. The integration was implemented by NPCI International Payments Limited (NIPL) and Nepal Clearing House Limited (NCHL). This development strengthens digital financial connectivity, facilitates cross-border commerce, benefits travellers by reducing the need for currency exchange, and supports broader financial inclusion and economic cooperation between India and Nepal.

questions.question: Which company launched a new delivery centre in GIFT City, Gandhinagar, on June 13, 2026?
questions.explanation: Hexaware Technologies inaugurated a new delivery centre in GIFT City, Gandhinagar, as part of its expansion strategy to strengthen its presence in India's growing technology ecosystem. The facility is located in the Pragya-II building within the GIFT City campus and is expected to generate around 1,000 highly skilled jobs over the next three years. The centre will focus on advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, data analytics, automation, and digital transformation services. It will serve global clients across sectors including banking, financial services, insurance, healthcare, and manufacturing, contributing to Gujarat's emergence as a hub for innovation and technology-driven investments.

questions.question: Which digital wallet application was the most downloaded worldwide in 2025?
questions.explanation: PhonePe emerged as the most downloaded digital wallet application in the world in 2025, reflecting India's growing dominance in the digital payments ecosystem. India recorded more than 440 million digital wallet app downloads during the year, accounting for nearly one-fourth of global downloads. The country's rapid adoption of digital payment platforms has been driven by the success of the Unified Payments Interface (UPI), which processed 228.5 billion transactions worth ₹299.7 trillion in 2025. Along with Google Pay, PhonePe handled over 80% of UPI transactions, highlighting its significant role in promoting cashless payments, financial inclusion, and digital commerce across India.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Chairperson of the Expert Committee on Agrobiodiversity reconstituted by the National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Dr P L Gautam was appointed as the Chairperson of the Expert Committee on Agrobiodiversity by the National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) on June 13, 2026. A Padma Shri awardee, he has previously served as the head of both the National Biodiversity Authority and the Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers’ Rights Authority (PPVFRA). The committee was reconstituted under the Biological Diversity Act, 2002, and is tasked with promoting the conservation of agricultural genetic resources and strengthening Access and Benefit-Sharing (ABS) mechanisms. It also provides guidance on international agreements related to plant genetic resources and supports India's biodiversity and sustainable development commitments.

questions.question: In which state did India Post launch its first drone-based mail and parcel transmission service on June 12, 2026?
questions.explanation: India Post launched its first drone-based mail and parcel transmission service in Himachal Pradesh on June 12, 2026, connecting Mandi Head Post Office with Rehardhar Branch Post Office. The initiative significantly reduced delivery time from more than two hours through conventional transport to just seven minutes across a mountainous route of about 12 kilometers. The project aims to improve connectivity in remote and difficult-to-access regions while promoting environmentally sustainable transportation. Led by the Ministry of Communications, the service also provides real-time tracking capabilities. Following its successful launch, India Post plans to expand drone-based delivery operations to 150 additional routes, particularly in Himachal Pradesh and Assam.

questions.question: In which city was the BRICS Agriculture Ministers' Meeting held, where the Indore Declaration was unanimously adopted in June 2026?
questions.explanation: The BRICS Agriculture Ministers' Meeting concluded in Indore on June 13, 2026, with the adoption of the Indore Declaration aimed at strengthening global food security and promoting sustainable agriculture. The meeting brought together BRICS member nations, which collectively account for a significant share of the world's population, agricultural land, and foodgrain production. Key outcomes included the creation of networks focused on agroecology, regenerative agriculture, digital farming, and farmers' rights. The event also emphasised cooperation in artificial intelligence, geospatial technologies, seed systems, and agricultural research. Indore, located in Madhya Pradesh, served as the venue for these important discussions on agricultural collaboration and innovation.

questions.question: Which New Zealand cricketer announced his retirement from all formats of international cricket on June 15, 2026?
questions.explanation: Kane Williamson announced his retirement from all formats of international cricket following the Lord’s Test against England in June 2026, bringing an end to a remarkable 16-year international career. He finished as New Zealand’s highest run-scorer across all formats with 19,346 runs and accumulated 48 centuries and 110 half-centuries. Williamson also holds the national record for the most Test centuries with 33. As captain, he led New Zealand to several historic achievements, including victory in the inaugural ICC World Test Championship in 2021 and appearances in the finals of major ICC tournaments. His consistency, leadership, and sportsmanship made him one of cricket’s most respected figures.

questions.question: Which organisation successfully conducted the flight tests of the Multi-layered Ballistic Missile Defence (BMD) system and the Naval Anti-Ship Missile-Medium Range (NASM-MR) in June 2026?
questions.explanation: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) successfully carried out three consecutive flight-tests of the Multi-layered Ballistic Missile Defence (BMD) system and the Naval Anti-Ship Missile-Medium Range (NASM-MR) on June 10 and 11, 2026. These tests demonstrated India's capability to defend against long-range ballistic missile threats and marked the successful maiden flight-test of the NASM-MR, designed for the Indian Navy. The achievement placed India among a select group of nations capable of engaging Intercontinental Ballistic Missiles (ICBMs). Developed indigenously, these advanced missile systems strengthen India's defence preparedness and showcase significant progress in domestic military technology and strategic capabilities.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the next Chief of the Army Staff (COAS) by the Government of India with effect from June 30, 2026?
questions.explanation: Lieutenant General Dhiraj Seth was appointed as the next Chief of the Army Staff (COAS), succeeding General Upendra Dwivedi upon his retirement on June 30, 2026. Before this appointment, Lt Gen Dhiraj Seth served as the Vice Chief of the Army Staff and had a distinguished military career spanning several decades. Commissioned into the Armoured Corps in December 1986, he is an alumnus of the National Defence Academy, Khadakwasla. He has commanded the prestigious Sudarshan Chakra Corps and received several distinguished military honours, including the Param Vishisht Seva Medal (PVSM), Uttam Yudh Seva Medal (UYSM), and Ati Vishisht Seva Medal (AVSM) for his exemplary service.

questions.question: In which city was the foundation stone laid for the new MSME Technology Centre on June 15, 2026?
questions.explanation: The foundation stone for a new MSME Technology Centre was laid at Khizarsarai in Gaya, Bihar, by Union Minister for MSME Jitan Ram Manjhi and Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary on June 15, 2026. The project involves an investment of ₹170 crore and aims to strengthen industrial development and skill enhancement in the region. The centre will feature advanced facilities such as an Industry 4.0 laboratory, production and training blocks, and hostel accommodations. It is expected to train around 7,000 individuals annually and provide technical support to more than 1,000 MSMEs each year, benefiting the broader Magadh region of Bihar.

questions.question: In which tiger reserve did the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) discover 25 inscriptions and ancient rock art in June 2026?
questions.explanation: The Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) discovered 25 inscriptions and ancient rock art in the Nallamala Tiger Reserve of Andhra Pradesh during a survey conducted in June 2026. These findings span nearly 1,400 years, ranging from the 2nd century CE to the 16th century CE, and provide valuable insights into the region’s historical and cultural evolution. The inscriptions are associated with several major dynasties, including the Satavahanas, Chalukyas, Kakatiyas, and Vijayanagara rulers. The survey also uncovered prehistoric rock paintings near the Krishna River, with some artworks dating back to around 1500 BCE, highlighting the area's rich archaeological heritage.

questions.question: In which city will the Brihanmumbai Custom Brokers' Association (BCBA) host the second edition of the India Logistics Conclave 2026?
questions.explanation: The second edition of the India Logistics Conclave 2026 is scheduled to be held in Mumbai on June 17, 2026, at The Taj Mahal Palace. Organised by the Brihanmumbai Custom Brokers' Association (BCBA), the event is centred on the theme "One Fraternity, One Vision — Logistics Driving India Towards Viksit Bharat." The conclave focuses on key areas such as logistics infrastructure development, digitalisation through AI-driven systems, customs modernisation, geopolitical trade strategies, and Free Trade Agreement utilisation. The event aims to strengthen India's trade ecosystem by positioning customs brokers and freight forwarders as key growth partners while supporting the country's long-term vision of becoming a developed nation by 2047.

questions.question: Who became the first Indian to win the Russia Grand Sand Master Cup 2026 at the II International Festival of Sand Sculpture?
questions.explanation: Sudarsan Pattnaik became the first Indian artist to win the Russia Grand Sand Master Cup 2026 at the II International Festival of Sand Sculpture held in Kaliningrad, Russia. His award-winning creation was a three-meter-tall sand sculpture based on the theme of global warming and climate change. The artwork portrayed two contrasting faces of Earth, highlighting the consequences of environmental degradation and the importance of sustainable living and tree plantation. A renowned sand artist from Puri, Odisha, Pattnaik has represented India at numerous international events and has received several prestigious honours, including the Padma Shri, for his contributions to art and cultural diplomacy.

questions.question: Which state launched a state-wide breakfast scheme for students from pre-primary level up to Class 12 in government institutions on June 15, 2026?
questions.explanation: Telangana launched a state-wide breakfast scheme on June 15, 2026, benefiting students from pre-primary classes up to Class 12 in government schools and junior colleges. The first phase was implemented in 1,302 institutions, including 33 junior colleges, across eight districts through a centralised kitchen model. The scheme is being executed by the Hare Krishna Movement Charitable Trust and Manna Trust. To improve nutrition among students, the menu includes millet-based foods such as millet idli, millet upma, pongal, and ragi jawa, along with other breakfast items. Telangana also became the first state in India to extend a breakfast scheme to students up to Class 12, expanding beyond the coverage seen in most other states.

questions.question: By what percentage did India's merchandise exports increase to reach $45.2 billion in May 2026?
questions.explanation: India's merchandise exports rose by 18% year-on-year to reach $45.2 billion in May 2026, reflecting strong performance in the country's external trade sector. During the same month, merchandise imports increased by 20.62% to $73.41 billion, resulting in a trade deficit of $28.21 billion. For the April–May 2026-27 period, total exports stood at $88.91 billion, registering a growth rate of 16.09% over the corresponding period of the previous year. The data highlights continued momentum in India's export sector despite global economic uncertainties. The Ministry of Commerce and Industry, through the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT), plays a key role in formulating policies that support and promote international trade.

questions.question: Which state launched the Mukhyamantri Shikshak Cashless Chikitsa Yojana providing cashless medical treatment up to ₹5 lakh per annum for teachers and education department employees?
questions.explanation: Uttar Pradesh launched the Mukhyamantri Shikshak Cashless Chikitsa Yojana to provide comprehensive healthcare coverage for teachers, education department employees, and their dependent family members. The scheme offers cashless medical treatment of up to ₹5 lakh annually through empanelled government and private hospitals. Around 3.5 lakh beneficiaries were identified for the initial rollout. The initiative is being implemented by the State Agency for Comprehensive Health and Integrated Services (SACHIS), which serves as the nodal agency for health insurance and cashless treatment programs in the state. A dedicated digital portal has also been developed to streamline beneficiary registration, card generation, and hospital integration for efficient service delivery.

questions.question: What rank did India achieve in the Global Peace Index (GPI) 2026 released by the Institute for Economics and Peace (IEP)?
questions.explanation: India was ranked 127th out of 163 countries in the Global Peace Index (GPI) 2026, published by the Institute for Economics and Peace (IEP). India recorded an overall score of 2.409 and slipped three places compared to the previous year. The ranking reflects factors such as internal security challenges, communal conflicts, and border security concerns. Iceland retained the 1st rank for the 19th consecutive year since 2008, achieving a score of 1.161 and continuing its position as the world's most peaceful nation. The index assesses countries across indicators related to societal safety and security, ongoing conflict, and militarisation, with lower scores indicating higher levels of peace.

questions.question: Which country partnered with India to adopt the Innovation Roadmap 2030 under the Special Global Strategic Partnership on June 15, 2026?
questions.explanation: India and France officially adopted the Innovation Roadmap 2030 on June 15, 2026, to deepen cooperation under their Special Global Strategic Partnership. The roadmap provides a framework for collaboration in critical and emerging technologies, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, digital innovation, research, and startup ecosystems through 2030. Key initiatives include the promotion of Trusted AI, expansion of academic exchanges, and a target for France to welcome 30,000 Indian students by 2030. The partnership also includes the establishment of a Franco-Indian Campus for Aeronautics Training and Careers in Kanpur, enhanced space-sector cooperation, and new research collaborations involving leading Indian institutions such as IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Madras, and IISc Bengaluru.

questions.question: In which states did the National Cadet Corps (NCC) establish new independent State Directorates in June 2026?
questions.explanation: The Headquarters Directorate General NCC approved the establishment of independent State Directorates for Andhra Pradesh and Jharkhand on June 15, 2026. With this expansion, the total number of NCC State Directorates in India increased from 17 to 19. The move aims to provide better administrative coordination, enhanced supervision, and improved support for training infrastructure in the two states. The NCC currently has a strength of more than 20 lakh cadets and operates in over 750 districts across the country. Recognised as the world’s largest uniformed youth organisation, the NCC plays a significant role in youth development, leadership training, and nation-building activities.

questions.question: Which country's voters rejected a referendum proposal to cap the national population at 10 million by 2050 in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Switzerland rejected a referendum proposal that sought to cap the country's population at 10 million by the year 2050. In the referendum held on June 14, 2026, 54.79% of voters opposed the initiative, while 45.21% supported it, with a voter turnout of 58.86%. The proposal, backed by the Swiss People’s Party (SVP), also called for stricter residency and asylum measures and the possible termination of the Freedom of Movement agreement with the European Union if population thresholds were exceeded. At the time, Switzerland's population stood at approximately 9.1 million, with foreign nationals accounting for nearly 28% of residents. The rejection reflected concerns about maintaining economic stability and preserving access to the EU single market.

questions.question: Who became the world's first trillionaire following the stock market debut of SpaceX on Nasdaq in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Elon Musk became the world's first trillionaire on June 12, 2026, after the successful public listing of SpaceX on the Nasdaq stock exchange. The company's shares opened strongly and achieved a valuation exceeding $2 trillion, significantly boosting Musk's personal wealth to approximately $1.05 trillion. A major portion of his fortune came from his holdings in SpaceX, while his stake in Tesla also contributed substantially. This historic achievement marked the first time an individual's net worth crossed the $1 trillion threshold. Musk, who previously became a billionaire in 2012 and a centibillionaire in 2020, continues to lead both SpaceX and Tesla as CEO.

questions.question: What is the name of India's first regulatory-approved radioligand therapy for advanced prostate cancer launched by Novartis on June 15, 2026?
questions.explanation: Pluvicto is India's first regulatory-approved radioligand therapy for advanced prostate cancer, launched by Novartis Healthcare Pvt Ltd. Known scientifically as lutetium-177 vipivotide tetraxetan, the therapy is specifically designed for patients with PSMA-positive metastatic prostate cancer. It combines a targeting molecule with the radioactive isotope Lutetium-177, enabling radiation to be delivered directly to cancer cells while minimising damage to healthy tissues. The treatment works by binding to Prostate-Specific Membrane Antigen (PSMA) proteins found on prostate cancer cells. This innovative therapy represents a significant advancement in precision oncology and targeted cancer treatment in India.

questions.question: Who became the only Indian to be included in the TIME100 Most Influential People in Sports 2026 list?
questions.explanation: Smriti Mandhana earned a place in the prestigious TIME100 Most Influential People in Sports 2026 list, becoming the only Indian featured in the global ranking. Recognised for her exceptional performances and leadership in women’s cricket, she has achieved several historic milestones, including becoming the first Indian woman to score a double century in a domestic one-day match and the first Indian woman to score centuries in all three international formats. Mandhana also jointly holds the record for the most centuries in women’s international cricket with 17 hundreds. Her achievements, consistency, and contributions to Indian cricket have established her as one of the most influential figures in world sports.

questions.question: Which state approved the revision of English spellings for 64 places across 26 districts to better reflect authentic Odia phonetics and preserve linguistic heritage?
questions.explanation: Odisha approved a proposal to revise the English spellings of 64 places across 26 districts to align them more closely with authentic Odia pronunciation and cultural identity. The initiative aims to preserve Odia Asmita by correcting colonial-era distortions in place names. Recommendations were made by a high-level committee headed by eminent Odia litterateur Pratibha Ray. Several well-known locations, including Cuttack, Balasore, and Angul, will receive revised spellings. Following approval, the state government will issue a gazette notification to the Ministry of Home Affairs, enabling updates across official records maintained by agencies such as the Survey of India, Indian Railways, and the Department of Posts.

questions.question: Who was honoured at the Interfaith Leaders Unite summit held at the Parliament House, Melbourne, on June 16, 2026, for contributions to spiritual unity and cross-cultural dialogue?
questions.explanation: Rajrajeshwar Guruji was honoured during the Interfaith Leaders Unite summit held at the Parliament House in Melbourne, Australia. The event brought together global interfaith leaders with the objective of promoting world peace and harmony through dialogue and cooperation. Rajrajeshwar Guruji received recognition for his significant contributions to spiritual unity and his efforts in fostering understanding among diverse cultures and faiths. His work has helped strengthen cross-cultural communication and mutual respect, which are essential for building peaceful societies. The honour highlighted his influence as a spiritual leader dedicated to encouraging harmony and collaboration across different communities and traditions.

questions.question: Which state received Geographical Indication (GI) tags for Bhagaiya Silk, Kuchai Silk, Munda Jewellery, and Bamboo Craft in June, 2026?
questions.explanation: Jharkhand received GI tag recognition for four traditional products—Bhagaiya Silk, Kuchai Silk, Munda Jewellery, and Bamboo Craft. These products represent the state's rich cultural heritage, traditional craftsmanship, and indigenous knowledge systems. Bhagaiya Silk and Kuchai Silk are known for their distinctive silk production techniques, while Munda Jewellery reflects the cultural identity of the Munda tribal community. Jharkhand Bamboo Craft showcases the skills of rural artisans who create handicrafts using locally sourced bamboo. The registration process was coordinated by NABARD's Jharkhand branch with support from Farmer Producer Organisations, Self-Help Groups, and technical institutions, helping preserve and promote these unique regional products.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Brand Ambassador of MBG Card on June 16, 2026, to promote the adoption of digital marketing solutions across India?
questions.explanation: Pankaj Tripathi was appointed as the Brand Ambassador of MBG Card to help expand the adoption of digital marketing solutions throughout India. His role focuses on encouraging entrepreneurs, especially small and medium-scale business owners, to embrace digital networking tools and contactless business card technology. The initiative aims to increase awareness of sustainable and modern marketing practices across both urban and rural regions. Pankaj Tripathi’s strong public image and widespread popularity make him an effective choice for connecting with diverse audiences. He is also known for being appointed as the National Icon by the Election Commission of India and for receiving a National Film Award for his performance in the film Newton.

questions.question: Which state received Geographical Indication (GI) tags for Karbi Anglong Handloom Products, Bihu Pepa, Bamboo Crafts, and Deuri Handloom Products?
questions.explanation: Assam achieved a significant milestone in preserving its cultural heritage by securing GI tags for four traditional products: Karbi Anglong Handloom Products, Assam Bihu Pepa, Assam Bamboo Crafts, and Deuri Handloom Products. These products represent the state's rich traditions in weaving, music, handicrafts, and indigenous craftsmanship. The recognition helps protect these unique products from unauthorised use while promoting authentic regional producers. Supported by NABARD, the GI registration process strengthens market access for artisans and encourages sustainable livelihoods. With these additions, the number of NABARD-supported GI-certified products in Assam increased to 12, further enhancing the state's reputation as a centre of cultural diversity and traditional craftsmanship.

questions.question: Which country partnered with India to launch the ATL Bridge initiative aimed at connecting school innovation labs and young innovators?
questions.explanation: France partnered with India to launch the India-France ATL Bridge, a pioneering initiative designed to connect school innovation ecosystems and encourage collaboration among young innovators from both countries. Announced during the India-France Year of Innovation 2026, the program promotes creativity, entrepreneurship, and technological learning through innovation labs inspired by India's Atal Tinkering Labs model. A significant outcome of the partnership is the establishment of the first School Innovation Lab in France based on the ATL framework. The initiative also supports student exchanges, joint innovation projects, and cross-cultural learning, strengthening bilateral cooperation in education, technology, innovation, and entrepreneurship between the two nations.

questions.question: Which company partnered with e2E Rail on June 16, 2026, to deploy AI-powered drone intelligence for monitoring and maintaining railway infrastructure?
questions.explanation: Skylark Drones entered into a strategic partnership with e2E Rail to enhance railway infrastructure monitoring and maintenance through the use of AI-powered drone intelligence. The collaboration focuses on integrating drones, aerial data collection, and AI-driven analytics to improve the inspection and management of rail assets. By adopting automated surveillance and digital twin models, the partnership aims to modernise railway safety protocols and enable real-time asset tracking. Skylark Drones, headquartered in Bengaluru, is recognised for its expertise in drone data analytics and aerial solutions for infrastructure, mining, and agriculture sectors.

questions.question: Which state ranked first in the digitisation of enumeration forms during the third phase of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls as of June, 2026?
questions.explanation: Mizoram emerged as the top-performing state in the digitisation of enumeration forms during the third phase of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. The state achieved an impressive completion rate of 68.05%, securing the highest position among 16 states and 3 Union Territories. Several districts recorded exceptional performance, with Khawzawl, Champhai, and Serchhip all surpassing 90% completion. The state also achieved 99.90% distribution of enrolment forms and deployed 1,301 Block Level Officers (BLOs) to support the process. This achievement highlights Mizoram’s effective implementation of electoral digitisation initiatives and its commitment to improving election management and voter registration systems.
