questions.question: When is the World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought observed every year worldwide?
questions.explanation: The World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought is observed annually on June 17 to raise awareness about land degradation, desertification, and drought-related challenges. The 2026 theme, “Rangelands: Recognise. Respect. Restore.”, highlighted the importance of protecting and restoring rangelands, which cover more than half of the Earth's land surface. These ecosystems play a vital role in food security, biodiversity conservation, climate resilience, and water management. The observance encourages governments, communities, and organisations to promote sustainable land management practices and take action against environmental degradation, helping to ensure a healthier and more resilient future for people and ecosystems worldwide.

questions.question: Which state approved investment proposals worth ₹76,612 crore across 20 major projects, including lab-grown diamonds, renewable energy, and steel manufacturing?
questions.explanation: Odisha approved investment proposals worth approximately ₹76,612 crore across 20 major projects spanning sectors such as lab-grown diamonds, renewable energy, critical minerals, steel manufacturing, healthcare, and infrastructure. The approved projects are expected to generate more than 50,500 employment opportunities across nine districts. A significant highlight was the state's entry into the lab-grown diamond industry through large-scale manufacturing projects in Khordha district. Odisha also attracted investments in solar manufacturing, permanent magnets, rare earth materials, and steel production, strengthening its position as a leading industrial destination. These initiatives support economic diversification, regional development, clean energy goals, and long-term industrial growth within the state.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of General Insurance Corporation of India (GIC Re) by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Hitesh Rameshchandra Joshi was appointed as the Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of General Insurance Corporation of India (GIC Re) by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet. Prior to his official appointment, he had been serving as the acting CMD since October 2025 following the retirement of N. Ramaswamy. With decades of experience in the insurance and reinsurance industry, Joshi has worked across areas such as enterprise risk management, financial planning, reinsurance operations, corporate governance, and strategic planning. His extensive leadership experience and strong academic background make him well-suited to lead GIC Re, India's national reinsurer and one of Asia's largest reinsurance companies.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the CEO of North America to lead InCred Capital's strategic expansion in the United States?
questions.explanation: Arunava Das was appointed as the CEO of North America by InCred Capital as part of the company's expansion into the United States market. The firm launched its first US office in New York with the objective of connecting international capital to India's growth opportunities. Das will lead the company's strategic initiatives in North America and help strengthen its presence among institutional investors and family offices. InCred Capital already operates across major financial hubs including India, Singapore, Dubai, and London, with New York becoming its fifth major global hub. The expansion reflects the firm's growing international ambitions and focus on India-centric investment solutions.

questions.question: Which country partnered with India to adopt the Rules of Implementation for the Joint Crediting Mechanism (JCM) under Article 6.2 of the Paris Agreement?
questions.explanation: Japan partnered with India to adopt the Rules of Implementation for the Joint Crediting Mechanism (JCM), a bilateral framework designed to support climate mitigation projects and carbon reduction efforts. The mechanism enables cooperation through investment, technology transfer, and capacity building for low-carbon projects. Emission reductions achieved through these projects are quantified and shared as carbon credits between the participating countries. The implementation rules establish a transparent governance structure covering project approval, monitoring, validation, verification, and credit issuance. This collaboration aligns with Article 6.2 of the Paris Agreement and strengthens international efforts toward sustainable development and global climate action.

questions.question: Which university launched the KCC Space Technology & Research Program 2026 and Summer Internship Program in collaboration with experts from ISRO and other leading institutions?
questions.explanation: Chandigarh University launched the KCC Space Technology & Research Program 2026 through its Kalpana Chawla Centre. The national-level initiative focuses on advanced areas such as Quantum Cryptography, Quantum Communications, Artificial Intelligence in satellite systems, Small Satellite Technologies, and semiconductor ecosystem development. The program brings together experts and mentors from organisations including ISRO, NewSpace India Limited, the Indian Institute of Remote Sensing, and the Ministry of Earth Sciences. Running from June 15 to July 11, 2026, the initiative aims to provide students and researchers with practical exposure to emerging space technologies while supporting India's goals in innovation, space research, and semiconductor self-reliance.

questions.question: Which state's traditional musical instrument, Sarinda, received Geographical Indication (GI) tag recognition for its cultural and artistic significance?
questions.explanation: Tripura's traditional musical instrument, Sarinda, was granted a Geographical Indication (GI) tag in recognition of its unique cultural heritage and craftsmanship. Sarinda is a bowed string instrument widely used in the folk music traditions of the state's indigenous tribal communities. Handcrafted from a single block of wood, it produces a distinctive sound and plays an important role in cultural ceremonies, folk performances, and community gatherings. The GI tag helps protect the instrument's identity from imitation while supporting local artisans and preserving traditional knowledge. This recognition also strengthens efforts to promote Tripura's rich cultural legacy and encourages younger generations to continue this valuable musical tradition.

questions.question: When is Autistic Pride Day observed annually to celebrate neurodiversity and promote the inclusion of autistic individuals?
questions.explanation: Autistic Pride Day is observed every year on June 18 to celebrate neurodiversity and recognise the strengths, talents, and contributions of autistic individuals. The observance promotes acceptance, dignity, and inclusion while encouraging society to view autism as a natural variation of human neurology rather than a condition that needs to be cured. The 2026 theme focused on Recognition, Representation, and Reform, highlighting the importance of equal opportunities and respect for neurodiverse communities. Through awareness campaigns, educational programs, and community events, the day helps challenge misconceptions about autism and advocates for a more inclusive society that values neurological diversity.

questions.question: Which city is home to Intellion Park, the campus that became India's largest WELL Core Platinum-certified development?
questions.explanation: Chennai is home to Intellion Park, developed by Tata Realty & Infrastructure Ltd., which achieved the distinction of becoming India's largest campus to receive the WELL Core Platinum certification. The certification, awarded by the International WELL Building Institute (IWBI), recognises excellence in building design and operations that support occupant health and well-being. The evaluation covers factors such as air quality, lighting, thermal comfort, acoustics, and operational standards. In addition to this achievement, the campus is also India's first IFC EDGE Zero Carbon-certified development. The recognition highlights Chennai's growing prominence as a hub for sustainable and environmentally responsible commercial infrastructure.

questions.question: What was the percentage growth recorded in India's cumulative exports during April–May 2026-27 compared to the same period of the previous year?
questions.explanation: India's cumulative exports for April–May 2026-27 reached US$ 162.69 billion, reflecting a growth rate of 14.66% compared to US$ 141.89 billion during the corresponding period of the previous year. This growth was driven by strong performance in both merchandise and services exports. Merchandise exports grew by 16.09%, while services exports increased by 12.99%. Key sectors contributing to export growth included petroleum products, engineering goods, and electronic goods. The positive export performance highlights the resilience of India's trade sector and its expanding presence in global markets, supported by increasing demand from major trading partners and diversified export destinations.

questions.question: Which city hosted the Creative Zone Digital Summit-2026 aimed at empowering creators from rural areas and small communities?
questions.explanation: The Creative Zone Digital Summit-2026 was held in Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh, on June 06, 2026, with the objective of strengthening the digital creator ecosystem. Organised by the Bharat Digital Media Federation in collaboration with the Ratan Tata Innovation Hub and the Andhra Pradesh Innovation Society, the summit focused on the theme “From Rural Roots to Digital Reach.” It encouraged creators from rural and underserved communities to use digital platforms for wider visibility and sustainable growth. The event featured sessions on Artificial Intelligence in content creation, creator monetisation, brand partnerships, intellectual property rights, and digital entrepreneurship, helping participants develop skills needed for success in the digital economy.

questions.question: Which state signed a strategic MoU with the Footwear Design and Development Institute (FDDI) on June 17, 2026, to strengthen its manufacturing ecosystem?
questions.explanation: Punjab entered into a strategic partnership with the Footwear Design and Development Institute (FDDI) to enhance its manufacturing sector, particularly in sports goods, footwear, and leather industries. The agreement focuses on improving industrial infrastructure, providing access to advanced testing facilities, developing skilled manpower through technical training, and encouraging design and innovation. It also aims to create stronger market linkages, enabling local businesses to integrate with national and global supply chains. The initiative is especially beneficial for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs), helping them improve competitiveness, expand exports, attract investments, and generate employment opportunities across the state.

questions.question: Which state witnessed the discovery of a new lynx spider species named Hamataliwa mawlyngot in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Scientists from the Zoological Survey of India and the University of Calcutta discovered a new species of lynx spider named Hamataliwa mawlyngot in Meghalaya. The species was named after Mawlyngot village in the East Khasi Hills, where it was identified. This discovery is significant because it marks the first recorded presence of the genus Hamataliwa in Meghalaya, helping bridge a geographical distribution gap between Southern India, China, and Southeast Asia. The spider is small in size, inhabits tea plantation regions, and functions as an active predator. By feeding on pest populations, it serves as a natural biological control agent and contributes to maintaining ecological balance in agricultural landscapes.

questions.question: In which state was the mega surgical eye camp under Operation DRISHTI conducted at Military Hospital Namkum?
questions.explanation: Operation DRISHTI is a major humanitarian medical initiative undertaken by the Indian Army and Indian Air Force to provide advanced eye care services. The mega surgical eye camp was organised at Military Hospital Namkum in Ranchi, Jharkhand, from June 15 to 19, 2026. Led by Brigadier Dr Sanjay Kumar Mishra, the specialised ophthalmic team aimed to perform more than 200 free advanced eye surgeries. Beneficiaries included ex-servicemen, their dependents, serving personnel, and underprivileged civilians. The programme reflects the armed forces' commitment to combining medical expertise with community service, thereby improving healthcare access and supporting social welfare initiatives.

questions.question: In which state were the domestic PNG supply and CNG infrastructure projects inaugurated in Mangaldai and Tezpur on June 18, 2026?
questions.explanation: Assam witnessed a significant boost in its energy infrastructure with the inauguration of domestic Piped Natural Gas (PNG) supply and CNG projects in Mangaldai and Tezpur by Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on June 18, 2026. The initiative included PNG connections for households, CNG stations to improve fuel accessibility, and industrial gas supply to Patanjali Ayurved Limited. The Tezpur PNG network already serves more than 1,400 households and is expected to expand further. The project supports India's objective of reducing LPG imports, utilising locally produced natural gas more effectively, conserving foreign exchange, and enhancing long-term energy security across Assam.

questions.question: In which city did India host the 28th Meeting of the Committee of Senior Officials (CSO) of the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) on June 15–16, 2026?
questions.explanation: India hosted the 28th Meeting of the Committee of Senior Officials (CSO) of the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) in New Delhi on June 15–16, 2026, during its chairship tenure for the 2025–27 period. The meeting focused on shaping the next IORA Action Plan for 2028–2032 and addressed key regional priorities such as maritime security, the blue economy, disaster risk management, and sustainable development. Discussions also highlighted the growth of women’s participation in India’s maritime sector and the ‘Sagar Mein Samman’ initiative. IORA, established in 1997 and headquartered in Ebene, Mauritius, promotes cooperation among countries bordering the Indian Ocean.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Inspector General (IG) of the National Investigation Agency (NIA) by the Union Ministry of Home Affairs on June 16, 2026?
questions.explanation: Sundarraj Pattilingam, a 2003-batch IPS officer, was appointed as the Inspector General of the National Investigation Agency (NIA) on June 16, 2026. This appointment marked his first central deputation after a distinguished career in the Chhattisgarh cadre. He spent 12 years serving in the Bastar region, including seven years as the head of police, where he played a key role in counter-insurgency operations across districts such as Sukma, Bijapur, Dantewada, Narayanpur, and Kondagaon. An alumnus of Tamil Nadu Agricultural University and trained in counter-insurgency warfare, he brings extensive operational experience to India's premier counter-terrorism agency.

questions.question: Which insurance company launched the Multifactor Index Fund, introducing a Smart Beta investment strategy to the Indian life insurance sector on June 18, 2026?
questions.explanation: PNB MetLife launched the Multifactor Index Fund to bring Smart Beta investing to the Indian life insurance sector. The fund follows a multifactor investment approach by selecting stocks based on quality, value, momentum, and low volatility factors. Integrated into Unit Linked Insurance Plans (ULIPs), it operates as a passively managed index fund designed to provide systematic diversification and lower tracking error. The strategy aims to perform effectively across different market conditions through an “all-weather” approach, balancing risk and return. By focusing on reducing portfolio volatility while pursuing long-term capital appreciation, the fund offers investors a disciplined and data-driven investment solution.

questions.question: Which company became the world's 5th most valuable listed company on June 17, 2026, surpassing Amazon with a market valuation of $2.655 trillion?
questions.explanation: SpaceX achieved a major milestone by becoming the world's fifth most valuable listed company on June 17, 2026. The company surpassed Amazon with a market valuation of $2.655 trillion (₹251.03 lakh crore). This achievement was supported by a strong stock market performance, with shares rising 4.8% in a single day to close at $201.80. The surge was largely driven by the launch of options trading, which saw more than 1 million contracts traded in a single day. In the global valuation rankings, SpaceX secured the fifth position behind Nvidia, Alphabet (Google), Apple, and Microsoft, while moving ahead of Amazon.

Established in 2011 as the training arm of the Election Commission of India, IIIDEM plays a crucial role in strengthening election management and democratic processes. The institute has conducted 1,885 training programmes and reached more than 1.2 lakh participants across 142 countries. During the celebration, a conference on capacity building and strategic planning was organised, highlighting its focus on national and global training initiatives, research, knowledge development, and the promotion of sustainable democracy and effective election management practices.

questions.question: Where was the new forester moth species named Mimeusemia kali discovered in June 2026?
questions.explanation: The newly identified forester moth species, Mimeusemia kali, was discovered in the Kali Tiger Reserve located in Karnataka. The discovery was made by researchers from the Zoological Survey of India in collaboration with the Natural History Museum, London. This finding is particularly significant because it represents the first addition to the genus Mimeusemia in nearly three decades. The species belongs to the Noctuidae family and contributes to India's biodiversity records. Forester moths are important ecological indicators and pollinators, helping maintain ecosystem balance. The Kali Tiger Reserve, situated in the biodiversity-rich Western Ghats, provides a vital habitat for numerous rare and endemic species.

questions.question: Which country is set to inaugurate its first traditional stone-built Hindu temple in September 2026?
questions.explanation: France is set to inaugurate its first traditional stone-built Hindu temple in September 2026, marking a significant milestone for the Indian diaspora and cultural heritage in Europe. The temple has been constructed using natural stones sourced from India, with its components crafted in India and later transported and assembled in France by specialised teams. The project is associated with the BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha, a global Hindu spiritual organisation known for constructing traditional temples worldwide. A 15-day consecration programme is planned for the inauguration. The development highlights the growing cultural presence of the Indian community in France and strengthens people-to-people ties between the two countries.

questions.question: Which city is home to the Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST), where scientists developed a novel electrolyte additive for Aqueous Zinc-Ion Batteries in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Scientists at the Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST) in Mohali developed an innovative electrolyte additive named BDIM to improve the performance and lifespan of Aqueous Zinc-Ion Batteries (AZIBs). The additive helps reduce corrosion, suppress hydrogen evolution reactions, and prevent zinc dendrite growth, which are major challenges in battery technology. Researchers used advanced analytical techniques such as ultramicroelectrodes and fast-scan cyclic voltammetry to study the additive's effectiveness. Led by Dr Ramendra Sundar Dey, the research was published in ACS Electrochemistry. The technology has significant potential for applications in grid-scale energy storage, renewable energy integration, and reliable backup power systems.

questions.question: Which country will host the multinational air combat exercise Pitch Black 2026 in which the Indian Air Force will participate?
questions.explanation: Australia will host Exercise Pitch Black 2026, a major biennial multinational air combat exercise conducted by the Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF). Scheduled from July 20 to August 7, 2026, the exercise will take place in Australia's Northern Territory and involve more than 100 aircraft along with personnel from 20 participating nations, including the host country. The event is designed to enhance air combat integration, interoperability, and operational coordination among allied and partner air forces across the Indo-Pacific region. Participation by the Indian Air Force reflects India's growing defence cooperation with international partners and provides valuable experience in realistic and complex warfare training environments.

questions.question: Which Indian cricketer became the joint-highest wicket-taker in women’s international cricket by equalling Jhulan Goswami’s record of 355 wickets?
questions.explanation: Deepti Sharma achieved a remarkable milestone in women’s cricket by becoming the joint-highest wicket-taker in women’s international cricket with 355 wickets. She reached the landmark during India’s Women’s T20 World Cup 2026 Group A match against the Netherlands at Headingley in Leeds. The record-equalling wicket came when she dismissed Dutch opener Phebe Molkenboer. With this achievement, Deepti matched the tally of former Indian captain Jhulan Goswami and England’s Katherine Sciver-Brunt. The feat highlights Deepti’s consistency and impact as an all-rounder and reflects India’s growing prominence in women’s cricket, with two Indian players featuring among the leading wicket-takers in the history of the game.

questions.question: Which country participated with India in the 4th Cyber Dialogue held in New Delhi on June 16–17, 2026?
questions.explanation: The 4th Cyber Dialogue was conducted between India and the Netherlands in New Delhi to enhance cooperation in cyber security and digital governance. The discussions were held under the India–Netherlands Strategic Partnership Roadmap (2026–2030) and covered important topics such as Artificial Intelligence governance, Digital Public Infrastructure, data protection, cybercrime prevention, and protection of critical information infrastructure. The dialogue also emphasised collaboration between Computer Emergency Response Teams (CERTs) and law enforcement agencies. Through such engagements, both countries aim to strengthen cyber resilience, improve digital security frameworks, and promote cooperation on global cyber issues through multilateral platforms and institutional partnerships.

questions.question: Which city witnessed the launch of the Jan Kalyan Shivir outreach initiative across 42 locations on June 18, 2026?
questions.explanation: The Jan Kalyan Shivir initiative was launched across the National Capital Territory to provide citizens with easier access to various Central and State Government welfare schemes. Inaugurated by Chief Minister Rekha Gupta, the programme was conducted at 42 locations and operated as a three-day outreach campaign from June 18 to June 20, 2026. The initiative aimed to improve public service delivery through direct citizen engagement and assistance. Alongside the welfare camps, a large-scale Yamuna cleaning drive was carried out across 28 ghats to promote environmental conservation. The programme reflects efforts to enhance governance, public welfare, and urban development in the national capital.

questions.question: Which city hosted the launch of UPI at the Galeries Lafayette department store to facilitate digital payments for Indian tourists?
questions.explanation: Nice, a prominent city in France, became the latest international location to adopt India's Unified Payments Interface (UPI) for seamless digital transactions. The launch took place at Galeries Lafayette Nice Massena, a major retail destination, through a collaboration between NPCI International Payments Limited (NIPL) and the French fintech company Lyra Collect. This initiative expands the global reach of India's digital payment ecosystem and follows the earlier rollout of UPI at the Eiffel Tower in Paris in 2024. The move enhances convenience for Indian travellers while strengthening cross-border payment interoperability and showcasing India's leadership in digital financial innovation on the global stage.

questions.question: Which state received a record railway budget allocation of over ₹10,000 crore and exported the 51st locomotive to Guinea in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Bihar received a record annual railway budget allocation exceeding ₹10,000 crore, reflecting the government's focus on strengthening rail infrastructure and connectivity in the state. Several major projects are underway, including the construction of a new station with five platforms at Hardinge Park and the redevelopment of Fatuha station. The launch of the Chhapra–Delhi Express further enhanced connectivity between the Saran region and the national capital. In addition, the Marhowrah locomotive manufacturing plant achieved a significant milestone by exporting its 51st locomotive to Guinea. This accomplishment highlights Bihar's growing role in railway manufacturing and supports the broader objectives of the Make in India initiative.

questions.question: When is World Crocodile Day observed annually to raise awareness about crocodilian conservation and habitat protection?
questions.explanation: World Crocodile Day is observed every year on June 17 to promote awareness about the conservation of crocodilians, including crocodiles, alligators, caimans, and gharials. Established in 2017 by the Crocodile Research Coalition in partnership with the Belize Zoo, the observance highlights the ecological importance of these reptiles and the challenges they face due to habitat loss and other threats. The day also showcases successful conservation efforts around the world, such as the recovery of saltwater crocodile populations in Australia and improvements in the status of the American crocodile in the United States. It encourages research, education, and long-term conservation initiatives for crocodilian species globally.

questions.question: Who was elected as a judge of the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea (ITLOS) for the 2026–2035 term?
questions.explanation: Bimal N. Patel was elected as a judge of the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea (ITLOS) for the 2026–2035 term during the 36th Meeting of States Parties to the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS). He secured 115 votes out of 168 valid votes cast and won one of the seats allocated to the Asian region. His nine-year term will begin on October 1, 2026, succeeding Neeru Chadha. ITLOS, headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, is an independent judicial body responsible for resolving disputes related to maritime boundaries, navigation rights, marine resources, and the interpretation of international maritime law.

questions.question: What was the percentage decline in India’s gold imports in May 2026 after the government increased the import duty on gold?
questions.explanation: India's gold imports recorded a significant decline of 39% month-on-month in May 2026, falling to $3.4 billion after the government raised the import duty on gold from 6% to 15%. The measure was introduced to reduce demand for imported gold and help conserve foreign exchange reserves. As a result, import volumes dropped sharply compared to previous months, while domestic gold prices increased. The policy also influenced investor behaviour, leading to net outflows from gold exchange-traded funds (ETFs) and a reduction in active investor accounts. The development highlights how changes in import duties can directly affect trade patterns, consumer demand, and investment activity.

questions.question: Which country is hosting the multilateral joint military exercise KHAAN QUEST 2026 in which the Indian Army is participating?
questions.explanation: Mongolia is hosting the 2026 edition of Exercise KHAAN QUEST, a multinational military exercise focused on enhancing peacekeeping capabilities and interoperability among participating nations. Conducted at the Five Hills Training Area in Ulaanbaatar, the exercise includes personnel from various countries and features tactical drills such as cordon and search operations, patrolling, counter-IED procedures, checkpoint establishment, and combat first aid. The Indian Army has deployed a contingent of 40 personnel led by a battalion of the JAT Regiment. Originally launched in 2003 as a bilateral exercise between the United States and Mongolia, KHAAN QUEST evolved into a multilateral peacekeeping exercise in 2006 and has since become an important platform for international military cooperation.

questions.question: Which institution signed an MoU with ARIES Nainital to establish a long-term Bharat Climate Observation Network monitoring station at Devasthal in the Himalayan region?
questions.explanation: IITM Pune signed a long-term Memorandum of Understanding with ARIES Nainital to establish a Bharat Climate Observation Network (BCON) monitoring station at Devasthal in the Himalayan region. The collaboration, undertaken under the Mission Mausam initiative of the Ministry of Earth Sciences, aims to create a high-precision climate monitoring framework for more than 50 years. The station will monitor greenhouse gases, atmospheric chemistry, soil moisture, and meteorological parameters while generating high-quality datasets for Earth System Models. Devasthal was chosen because of its pristine high-altitude environment, making it ideal for observing baseline atmospheric conditions and supporting long-term climate research and policy planning.

questions.question: Which city hosted Bharat Buildcon 2026 at the Yashobhoomi Convention Centre on June 20, 2026?
questions.explanation: Bharat Buildcon 2026 was inaugurated at the Yashobhoomi Convention Centre in New Delhi by Union Minister for Housing and Urban Affairs Manohar Lal Khattar. Organised under the theme “One Nation, One Expo,” the four-day exhibition served as a major platform for showcasing innovations and advancements in the construction sector. The event witnessed participation from more than 90 countries and over 100 Indian cities, attracting over 25,000 visitors on its opening day. With exhibits spanning 24 industry segments such as cement, steel, ceramics, and electrical products, the expo highlighted infrastructure development, international trade opportunities, and the role of Free Trade Agreements in promoting economic growth.

questions.question: When is World Sickle Cell Day observed globally to raise awareness about sickle cell disease and promote early diagnosis?
questions.explanation: World Sickle Cell Day is observed every year on June 19 to increase awareness about sickle cell disease, a hereditary blood disorder that affects millions of people worldwide. The observance highlights the importance of early diagnosis, timely treatment, genetic counselling, and improved healthcare access. The 2026 theme, “Closing the Survival Gap: Equity in Sickle Cell Disease,” emphasises reducing disparities in care and outcomes. In India, the disease particularly affects Scheduled Tribes and forest-dwelling communities, making awareness and screening programs especially important. Various diagnostic methods, including CBC, HPLC, haemoglobin electrophoresis, and DNA testing, play a crucial role in identifying and managing the condition effectively.

questions.question: Which state witnessed the induction of the first indigenous Air Cushion Vehicle (ACV) by the Indian Coast Guard on June, 2026?
questions.explanation: The Indian Coast Guard inducted its first indigenous Air Cushion Vehicle (ACV), commonly known as a hovercraft, in Goa as part of efforts to strengthen maritime operational capabilities. Designed and built by Chowgule & Company Private Limited under the Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative, the vessel is the first delivery from an order of six ACVs These amphibious craft can travel over water, land, mud, and other challenging surfaces using a cushion of high-pressure air. The project represents a significant step toward enhancing indigenous defence manufacturing, expanding India’s maritime industrial base, and improving the Coast Guard’s ability to conduct coastal surveillance, search-and-rescue operations, and environmental protection missions.

questions.question: Which country became the first Central Asian member of the New Development Bank (NDB) in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Uzbekistan became the 10th member of the New Development Bank (NDB) and the first country from Central Asia to join the institution. The membership was finalised after the country completed all required ratification procedures. Founded by the BRICS nations in 2015, the NDB supports infrastructure and sustainable development projects in emerging economies. Uzbekistan's inclusion is expected to enhance investment opportunities in sectors such as energy, water management, transportation, and social infrastructure. The bank plans to support projects using national currencies and domestic procurement systems. This development strengthens Uzbekistan’s integration into global financial institutions and highlights the growing international role of the New Development Bank.

questions.question: Which company signed an MoU with the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) to provide discounts for replacing old trucks and buses in Delhi-NCR?
questions.explanation: Tata Motors signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways on June 18, 2026, to support the replacement of old commercial vehicles in the Delhi-NCR region. Under the agreement, eligible buyers can receive discounts on new trucks and buses, encouraging the adoption of cleaner and more efficient vehicles. The initiative is complemented by central and state government incentives, including interest subsidies, fuel vouchers, tax concessions, and registration fee waivers. The programme aims to reduce vehicular pollution, modernise the commercial transport fleet, improve fuel efficiency, and promote sustainable mobility while supporting economic activity in the transportation sector.

questions.question: Which state inaugurated the Northeast’s largest organic spice processing plant at Bhoirymbong in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Meghalaya became home to the Northeast’s largest organic spice processing plant with its inauguration at Bhoirymbong in the Ri Bhoi District. The facility was established by the Eastern Ri Bhoi Organic Farmer Producer Company and has an annual processing capacity of 10,346 metric tonnes of spices. The project is expected to benefit around 5,500 organic farmers by improving value addition, market access, and income opportunities. Alongside the inauguration, foundation stones were laid for several infrastructure and development projects worth over ₹1,200 crore, including initiatives related to logistics, connectivity, ecotourism, sustainable livelihoods, and human capital development, supporting the region’s long-term economic growth.

questions.question: What minimum age has the United Arab Emirates officially set for social media use?
questions.explanation: The United Arab Emirates became the first Arab nation to establish an official minimum age of 15 years for social media usage. Under the new regulation, children below this age are prohibited from creating, operating, or participating in personal social media accounts. The policy also requires social media platforms to implement advanced age-verification mechanisms, including AI-powered technologies and digital identity checks, while rejecting self-declared ages as valid proof. For users aged 15 and 16, enhanced safeguards such as parental supervision tools, screen-time management features, and age-appropriate content filters are mandatory. The initiative aims to improve online safety, protect minors from digital risks, and encourage responsible social media engagement.

questions.question: Which state will host India's first commercial-scale coal-to-ammonium nitrate project at Lakhanpur, Jharsuguda?
questions.explanation: Odisha has been selected as the location for India's first commercial-scale coal-to-ammonium nitrate project, which will be established at Lakhanpur in Jharsuguda district. The project is being developed by Bharat Coal Gasification and Chemicals Limited, a joint venture between BHEL and Coal India Limited. Using indigenous coal gasification technology, the facility will convert coal into synthesis gas and produce 2,000 tonnes of ammonium nitrate per day. With an investment of over ₹25,000 crore, the project aims to reduce dependence on imported chemical products, strengthen domestic manufacturing capabilities, promote technological innovation, and generate substantial employment opportunities while supporting the broader goal of energy and industrial self-reliance.

questions.question: Who received the top honours as Best Male Athlete of the Year and Best Female Athlete of the Year at the Indian Athletics Awards 2025?
options: PT Usha and Anju Bobby George
Parveer Singh and Dr Kuldeep Singh
questions.explanation: The Indian Athletics Awards 2025 recognised outstanding achievements in Indian track and field athletics. Neeraj Chopra was named Best Male Athlete of the Year for his exceptional performances, including becoming the first Indian to cross the 90-metre mark in javelin throw with a throw of 90.23 metres. Parul Chaudhary received the Best Female Athlete of the Year award after a successful season that included gold medals in the women's 3000m steeplechase and 5000m events at the Asian Championships. Their achievements highlighted excellence in Indian athletics and inspired aspiring athletes across the country.

questions.question: Which state is associated with Khurasani Imli, the heritage fruit that recently received a GI Tag?
questions.explanation: Khurasani Imli, a unique fruit obtained from the African Baobab tree (Adansonia digitata), is closely associated with the historic town of Mandu in the Dhar district of Madhya Pradesh. It was awarded a Geographical Indication (GI) Tag to recognise its distinct identity, heritage, and strong connection to the region. Mandu hosts India's largest natural cluster of Baobab trees, and the area's specific soil and climatic conditions contribute to the fruit's unique characteristics. The GI Tag protects the authenticity of the product and preserves its cultural, historical, and ecological significance for future generations.

questions.question: On which date will International Yoga Day 2026 be observed worldwide?
questions.explanation: International Yoga Day is observed every year on June 21. In 2026, people across the world will celebrate this day to promote the physical, mental, and emotional benefits of yoga. The date was chosen because it coincides with the Summer Solstice in the Northern Hemisphere, the longest day of the year, which holds special significance in yogic traditions. The United Nations officially recognised June 21 as the International Day of Yoga following a proposal made by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in 2014. Since its first celebration in 2015, the event has grown into a global movement promoting health, wellness, mindfulness, and healthy living.

questions.question: Which organisation partnered with Schoolnet India Limited to provide a USD 10 million financing package for expanding digital education infrastructure in India?
questions.explanation: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) partnered with Schoolnet India Limited to provide a USD 10 million financing package aimed at strengthening digital education infrastructure across India. The initiative seeks to benefit approximately 4.5 million students by supporting digital learning in 30,000 government schools. Key objectives include establishing computer laboratories in at least 1,000 schools, creating 58,000 digital classrooms, and training over 56,000 teachers in digital pedagogy and equitable teaching practices. The project is notable as ADB’s first private sector financing initiative for a digital education project in India, highlighting its commitment to enhancing human capital development through technology-enabled learning.

questions.question: Which country will provide nine retired SEPECAT Jaguar fighter aircraft to the Indian Air Force for spare parts and maintenance support?
questions.explanation: The Indian Air Force has decided to acquire nine retired SEPECAT Jaguar fighter aircraft from the United Kingdom to support its ageing Jaguar fleet. These aircraft will not be inducted into active service but will be used as a source of spare parts, including engines, avionics systems, airframe structures, and other critical components. Since Jaguar production has ended and India remains the only country operating the aircraft in frontline service, obtaining spare parts has become increasingly difficult. This acquisition will help extend the operational life of existing Jaguar squadrons and support the IAF in maintaining combat readiness until newer fighter aircraft gradually replace the fleet.

questions.question: Which organisation approved the ₹4,000-crore loan for Haryana’s Jal Sanrakshit Haryana Water Security Project?
questions.explanation: The ₹4,000-crore loan for Haryana’s Jal Sanrakshit Haryana Water Security Project was approved by the World Bank to support sustainable water management and irrigation development in the state. The project aims to improve water conservation, modernise canals, enhance groundwater recharge, promote treated wastewater reuse, and increase irrigation efficiency. Haryana faces significant challenges such as groundwater depletion, waterlogging, and rising agricultural water demand. The funding will help rehabilitate hundreds of canals, upgrade irrigation infrastructure, and benefit large areas of agricultural land. The initiative is expected to strengthen long-term water security, improve farm productivity, and support climate-resilient development across Haryana.

questions.question: In which city did Prime Minister Narendra Modi commission INS Agray, INS Dunagiri, and INS Sanshodhak on 21 June 2026?
questions.explanation: Prime Minister Narendra Modi commissioned three indigenously built naval vessels—INS Agray, INS Dunagiri, and INS Sanshodhak—at the Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port in Kolkata, West Bengal, on 21 June 2026. The event marked a significant step in strengthening India’s naval capabilities, maritime security, and indigenous defence manufacturing. INS Dunagiri is an advanced stealth frigate; INS Agray is designed for anti-submarine warfare operations; and INS Sanshodhak is a modern hydrographic survey vessel. The commissioning ceremony highlighted India's growing expertise in naval engineering and supported the vision of Aatmanirbhar Bharat in the defence sector.

questions.question: What was India's rank in the World Economic Forum's Energy Transition Index (ETI) 2026?
questions.explanation: India secured the 70th position in the World Economic Forum's Energy Transition Index (ETI) 2026 with an overall score of 54.9. The country improved by two places compared to the previous year, reflecting progress in energy transition readiness and infrastructure development. India's score increased by 1.9%, supported by growth in low-carbon employment and expansion of renewable energy initiatives. Renewable energy jobs reached 1.3 million, with hydropower contributing the largest share of employment within the sector. The ETI evaluates 120 countries on energy security, equity, and sustainability, providing a comprehensive assessment of global energy transition performance.

questions.question: In which city did India win the FIH Hockey Women’s Nations Cup by defeating New Zealand in the final?
questions.explanation: India won the FIH Hockey Women’s Nations Cup by defeating host nation New Zealand 2-0 in the final held in Auckland on June 21, 2026. The Indian team remained unbeaten throughout the tournament and secured its second Nations Cup title. Goals from Navneet Kaur and Sunelita Toppo helped India claim victory, while goalkeeper Savita Punia delivered a clean sheet in the final. Lalremsiami was named Player of the Match for her outstanding performance. The triumph also earned India promotion to the next season’s FIH Hockey Women’s Pro League, marking a significant achievement for Indian women’s hockey on the international stage.

questions.question: Who became the first person of Indian origin to receive the Wolf Prize in Physics?
questions.explanation: Jainendra K Jain, an Indian-origin theoretical physicist, became the first person of Indian origin to receive the prestigious Wolf Prize in Physics. He was honoured for his groundbreaking discovery of composite fermions, which significantly advanced the understanding of the fractional quantum Hall effect. His work introduced the Jain sequences, providing a unified framework for explaining electronic conductivity in semiconductor systems. The discovery has had a major impact on condensed matter physics and has important applications in the field of quantum computing by helping protect quantum bits from errors. Jain is also an alumnus of IIT Kanpur and a member of several distinguished scientific academies.

questions.question: Who was appointed as India's first Vice-President of the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Vivek Aggarwal was elected and appointed as the Vice-President of the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) on June 19, 2026, becoming the first Indian official to hold this prestigious position. A 1994-batch IAS officer of the Madhya Pradesh cadre and Secretary in the Ministry of Culture, he was chosen by the FATF Plenary from among its members. His tenure as Vice-President is scheduled from July 2026 to June 2027. The appointment highlights India's growing role in global efforts to combat money laundering, terrorist financing, and other financial crimes through international cooperation and policy coordination.

questions.question: Which bank collaborated with BITS Pilani to establish the ₹100 crore Industry Research, Technology & Innovation Park in Hyderabad?
questions.explanation: BITS Pilani partnered with Axis Bank to establish the Axis Bank–BITS Industry Research, Technology & Innovation Park at its Hyderabad campus. The project is being funded through a ₹100 crore Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) grant from Axis Bank and will cover approximately 120,000 square feet. The park aims to promote research and innovation in key sectors such as life sciences, biopharma, healthcare, and medical devices. It will focus on deep-tech innovation and translational research to develop commercially viable solutions. The initiative reflects collaboration between academia and industry to strengthen India's research ecosystem and technological advancement.

questions.question: Which country commenced the five-day Immediate Combat Readiness Exercise on June 22, 2026, to enhance rapid deployment capabilities and wartime preparedness?
questions.explanation: Taiwan launched the five-day Immediate Combat Readiness Exercise on June 22, 2026, with the objective of improving its ability to transition quickly from peacetime to wartime operations. The exercise emphasises realistic combat conditions by using actual troops, terrain, and equipment rather than scripted scenarios. It is designed to strengthen command-and-control coordination, logistical support systems, and overall military preparedness. The drills also follow the deployment of US-made HIMARS rocket systems and serve as a precursor to the Han Kuang exercises, Taiwan’s largest annual military manoeuvres. These efforts aim to enhance defense readiness and response capabilities against potential security challenges.

questions.question: On which date is United Nations Public Service Day observed annually?
questions.explanation: United Nations Public Service Day is observed every year on June 23 to recognise the contributions of public servants and public institutions in improving people's lives. The observance was officially established by the United Nations General Assembly through Resolution 57/277 adopted on December 20, 2002. It promotes excellence, innovation, transparency, accountability, and citizen-centred governance in public administration. The day also highlights the important role played by government officials, educators, healthcare workers, law enforcement personnel, and other public servants in national development and social welfare. It serves as a platform to encourage effective governance and strengthen public trust worldwide.

questions.question: Which country formally notified a $482.2 million sustainment support package for India’s AH-64E Apache attack helicopters and M777A2 ultra-light howitzers in June 2026?
questions.explanation: On June 17, 2026, the United States formally notified a $482.2 million sustainment support package for India's AH-64E Apache attack helicopters and M777A2 ultra-light howitzers. The package includes long-term engineering, technical, logistics, and maintenance support for India's existing military platforms. Apache support is being provided through Boeing Company and Lockheed Martin, while BAE Systems is responsible for M777A2 howitzer support. India operates 28 Apache helicopters acquired through separate deals and previously procured 145 M777A2 howitzers under the Foreign Military Sales program. The support package aims to enhance operational readiness and long-term capability sustainment.

questions.question: Which bank launched the FCNR Max Deposit Scheme offering a fixed annual return of 6.25% on US dollar-denominated FCNR deposits?
questions.explanation: Federal Bank launched the FCNR Max Deposit Scheme to meet the increasing demand for higher-yield foreign currency investments among Non-Resident Indians (NRIs). The scheme offers a fixed annual return of 6.25% on US dollar-denominated Foreign Currency Non-Resident (FCNR) deposits with tenures ranging from three to five years. It includes a mandatory one-year lock-in period, and premature withdrawals after that period attract a penalty. The initiative is aimed at strengthening the bank’s offshore liability franchise. Federal Bank supports global customers through representative offices in Dubai and Abu Dhabi and operates an IFSC Banking Unit at GIFT City.

questions.question: Which country received the first-ever commercial export of 22.6 metric tonnes of dried whole egg powder from Balangir, Odisha, facilitated by APEDA?
questions.explanation: APEDA facilitated the first-ever commercial export of 22.6 metric tonnes of dried whole egg powder from Balangir, Odisha, to Austria on June 20, 2026. The export was carried out by OVO Farm Pvt. Ltd. and marked a significant achievement for Odisha’s agri-processing sector. Dried whole egg powder is produced through the spray-drying of liquid eggs and is widely used in food processing, bakery, confectionery, and pharmaceutical industries. Its long shelf life and ease of transportation make it suitable for international trade. This export highlights India's growing presence in value-added agricultural product exports.

questions.question: Who became the first player in both men's and women's international cricket history to play 200 T20 Internationals during a World Cup match?
questions.explanation: Harmanpreet Kaur achieved a historic milestone by becoming the first cricketer in international cricket, across both men's and women's formats, to play 200 T20 Internationals. The landmark match took place against South Africa during the ICC Women's T20 World Cup in Manchester on June 21, 2026. Harmanpreet made her ODI debut in March 2009 and her T20I debut in June 2009 against England. She is one of India's most accomplished women cricketers, having received the Arjuna Award in 2017, scored the first T20I century by an Indian woman, and set several records in international cricket.

questions.question: Who was assigned the additional charge of Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer (MD & CEO) of UCO Bank on June 21, 2026?
questions.explanation: Rajendra Kumar Saboo was assigned the additional charge of Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer (MD & CEO) of UCO Bank by the Ministry of Finance on June 21, 2026. The appointment order was issued by the Department of Financial Services (DFS). At the time of his appointment, Saboo was serving as the Executive Director of UCO Bank. He assumed the additional responsibility following the completion of the tenure of former MD & CEO Ashwani Kumar on May 31, 2026. The arrangement will remain in effect until August 31, 2026, or until a regular incumbent is appointed to the position.

questions.question: In which country were the Asian Relays Championships 2026 held, where India won the women's 4x100m gold medal?
questions.explanation: The Asian Relays Championships 2026 were held in Shangyu, China, where the Indian athletics team finished with a total of three medals. India's women's 4x100m relay team, comprising Srabani Nanda, Sneha Shanuvalli, Sudeshna Shivankar, and Tamanna, won the gold medal with a season's best time of 43.85 seconds. In addition to the gold, India secured a silver medal in the mixed 4x400m relay and a bronze medal in the mixed 4x100m relay. The 2026 edition was the second Asian Relays Championships, organised under the Asian Athletics Association, and India is scheduled to host the next edition in Chandigarh in 2027.

questions.question: Who has been reappointed as the Solicitor General of India for a fresh three-year term beginning on July 1, 2026?
questions.explanation: Tushar Mehta was reappointed as the Solicitor General of India for another three-year term following approval by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC). The Solicitor General is the second-highest law officer in the country after the Attorney General and plays a vital role in representing the Union Government before the Supreme Court, High Courts, tribunals, and other judicial forums. Mehta, a senior advocate from Gujarat, has handled several significant constitutional, governance, taxation, and national security matters. His reappointment reflects the government's confidence in his legal expertise and leadership in important judicial proceedings.

questions.question: Which country partnered with Canada through a formal acquisition arrangement for the Arctic Over-the-Horizon Radar (A-OTHR) program on June 22, 2026?
questions.explanation: Canada signed a Government-to-Government acquisition arrangement with Australia and BAE Systems Australia to procure Over-the-Horizon Radar (OTHR) technology for its Arctic Over-the-Horizon Radar (A-OTHR) program. Canada committed $2.5 billion for the project, which aims to achieve Initial Operational Capability by December 2029. OTHR technology can detect objects beyond the Earth's curvature by using radar signals refracted through the ionosphere. The initiative supports NORAD modernisation, enhances Arctic surveillance capabilities, and strengthens Canada's ability to monitor airborne and maritime threats. It also promotes knowledge transfer and domestic expertise through industrial and technological agreements.

questions.question: On which date is Olympic Day 2026 celebrated worldwide?
questions.explanation: Olympic Day is celebrated every year on June 23 to commemorate the founding of the International Olympic Committee (IOC) in 1894. The day marks the beginning of the modern Olympic Movement, which was revived by Baron Pierre de Coubertin. Olympic Day promotes sport, physical activity, friendship, and the core Olympic values of excellence, respect, and friendship. Celebrations include Olympic Day Runs, fitness campaigns, educational programs, sports competitions, and cultural activities. The observance encourages people of all ages and abilities to adopt healthy lifestyles and strengthens international understanding through the unifying power of sports.

questions.question: Which organisation launched the Global Methane Action Plan to accelerate methane emissions reduction?
questions.explanation: The United Nations launched the Global Methane Action Plan under the leadership of Secretary-General António Guterres to address the urgent challenge of climate change. The initiative focuses on reducing methane emissions from the fossil fuel industry, agriculture, and waste management sectors, as methane has a much stronger short-term warming effect than carbon dioxide. The plan also promotes better landfill management, methane capture technologies, and circular economy practices. Alongside this initiative, the UN highlighted the environmental impact of rapidly expanding AI infrastructure and encouraged governments, industries, and technology companies to take coordinated action to achieve global climate goals and limit future warming.

questions.question: On which date is the International Day of Women in Diplomacy observed every year?
questions.explanation: The International Day of Women in Diplomacy is observed annually on June 24 to recognise and celebrate the invaluable contributions of women in diplomacy, international relations, peacebuilding, and global leadership. The observance also highlights the importance of gender equality in foreign policy and decision-making while encouraging greater participation of women in diplomatic services. It serves as a platform to acknowledge the achievements of women diplomats, address barriers that limit their representation, and inspire future generations to pursue careers in diplomacy. The day reinforces the role of inclusive leadership in promoting peace, security, and sustainable global development.

questions.question: Which city's Malwi Potato received the Geographical Indication (GI) tag in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Malwi Potato from Indore, Madhya Pradesh, received the Geographical Indication (GI) tag in June 2026, recognising its unique qualities and regional significance. The potato is known for its low sugar and low starch content, making it highly suitable for processing into chips and French fries without turning black or red during frying. It has also been selected as the One District, One Product (ODOP) crop for Indore by the Ministry of Food Processing Industries. Cultivated mainly during the Rabi season, it is grown across around 45,000 hectares, with the Mhow region serving as the primary cultivation and processing hub.

questions.question: Which regulatory body introduced the GARUDA Green Channel framework for Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs)?
options: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)
Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
questions.explanation: SEBI introduced the GARUDA (Green Channel: AIF Rollout Upon Document Acknowledgement) framework to simplify and accelerate the launch of Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) schemes. The new mechanism replaces the traditional pre-clearance process with a document acknowledgement system, reducing approval timelines and improving operational efficiency. It also introduces structured classifications for AIF schemes, eases compliance requirements for certain fund categories, and enables faster capital mobilisation. By promoting transparency, accountability, and ease of doing business, the framework is expected to strengthen India's alternative investment ecosystem, boost investor confidence, and encourage greater private capital investment.

questions.question: In which month is India's first Made-in-India C295 transport aircraft scheduled to be delivered to the Indian Air Force in 2026?
questions.explanation: India's first Made-in-India C295 transport aircraft is scheduled for delivery to the Indian Air Force in September 2026, marking a major milestone in the country's defence manufacturing sector. Built by Tata Advanced Systems Limited in partnership with Airbus, it is the first military aircraft to be manufactured by India's private sector. The C295 is a versatile tactical transport aircraft capable of carrying troops, cargo, and medical evacuation missions while operating from short and unprepared runways. The programme supports the modernisation of the Indian Air Force by replacing the ageing Avro HS-748 fleet and strengthening the vision of self-reliance in defence production.

questions.question: What percentage of reservations has Gujarat announced for former Agniveers in Class-3 recruitments?
questions.explanation: The Gujarat government announced a 20% reservation for former Agniveers in direct recruitment to Class-3 posts across the police, jail, and forest departments. Along with the reservation, former Agniveers will receive age relaxation of up to three years, while candidates from the first batch of the Agnipath Scheme will be eligible for up to five years of age relaxation. They are also exempt from the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) for these recruitments. The initiative aims to support former Agniveers in securing government employment by recognising their military training, discipline, and service experience after completing their four-year tenure under the Agnipath Scheme.

questions.question: What was India's global rank in the QS World Future Skills Index 2027?
questions.explanation: India secured the 13th position in the QS World Future Skills Index 2027, reflecting its growing readiness for an artificial intelligence-driven future. The country earned an overall score of 89.4 out of 100 and was recognised as one of the strongest-performing lower-middle-income economies in preparing for AI-led economic transformation. India performed particularly well in the "Future of Work" pillar, ranking 5th globally, while also demonstrating strengths such as a large digital workforce, an expanding startup ecosystem, increasing AI adoption, and strong demographic advantages. The ranking highlights India's significant potential to drive innovation and long-term economic growth.

questions.question: Which city hosted the BRICS Heads of Space Agencies (HOSA) Meeting 2026 in India?
questions.explanation: Bengaluru hosted the BRICS Heads of Space Agencies (HOSA) Meeting 2026, bringing together senior representatives from all eleven BRICS member nations to strengthen cooperation in space exploration and technology. Hosted by ISRO and the Department of Space, the meeting focused on key issues such as space sustainability, satellite coordination, Earth observation, and the proposed BRICS Space Council. Discussions also covered the expansion of the BRICS Remote Sensing Satellite Constellation to improve disaster management, agriculture monitoring, climate studies, and environmental protection. The event highlighted India's growing leadership in global space diplomacy and its commitment to innovation, collaboration, and sustainable space activities.

questions.question: Who became the first football player in history to score in six different FIFA World Cup tournaments?
questions.explanation: Cristiano Ronaldo created football history by becoming the first player to score in six different FIFA World Cup editions. He achieved this remarkable milestone during Portugal's 5-0 victory over Uzbekistan in the 2026 FIFA World Cup by scoring twice. His World Cup scoring journey spans the 2006, 2010, 2014, 2018, 2022, and 2026 tournaments, showcasing extraordinary consistency, longevity, and excellence over two decades. This achievement further strengthened his legacy as one of the greatest footballers of all time and highlighted his ability to perform at the highest level even at the age of 41.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Global Head of WhatsApp by Meta Platforms Inc. in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Kunal Shah, the founder of Cred, was appointed as the Global Head of WhatsApp by Meta Platforms Inc. on June 23, 2026. He succeeded Will Cathcart, who had led WhatsApp since 2019 and later moved to a new product development role within Meta. Following Shah's appointment, Miten Sampat assumed the role of interim CEO of Cred. Shah is widely recognised for founding Cred in 2018, a Bengaluru-based fintech company that rewards creditworthy users and offers services in payments, lending, insurance, and wealth management. His appointment reflects Meta's focus on strengthening WhatsApp's global growth and innovation.

questions.question: Which two Indian women won the prestigious Whitley Awards, also known as the Green Oscars, in 2026?
options: Parveen Shaikh and Dr Barkha Subba
Purnima Devi Barman and Bittu Sahgal
questions.answer: Parveen Shaikh and Dr Barkha Subba
questions.explanation: Parveen Shaikh and Dr Barkha Subba were honoured with the 2026 Whitley Awards, popularly known as the Green Oscars, for their exceptional contributions to environmental conservation. Parveen Shaikh was recognised for her efforts to protect the endangered Indian Skimmer through community-based conservation initiatives along the Chambal River. Dr Barkha Subba received the award for her work in conserving the Himalayan Salamander by restoring wetlands, monitoring populations, and engaging local communities. Each recipient received £50,000 to support ongoing conservation projects, highlighting India's significant contribution to global biodiversity conservation and sustainable environmental practices.

questions.question: Which state received approval for India's first private-sector Hybrid 2G Ethanol Project?
questions.explanation: Uttar Pradesh became the location for India's first private-sector Hybrid 2G Ethanol Project after receiving financial assistance of ₹150 crore from the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas. Approved under the PM JI-VAN Yojana, the project aims to produce sustainable ethanol using agricultural residues such as sugarcane bagasse. It combines biomass gasification and gas fermentation technologies to convert waste into clean fuel. The initiative supports India's target of achieving 20% ethanol blending in petrol, promotes renewable energy, reduces dependence on fossil fuels, and encourages the productive use of agricultural waste while strengthening the country's biofuel ecosystem.

questions.question: What GDP growth rate has S&P Global Ratings projected for India in FY27?
questions.explanation: S&P Global Ratings has projected India's GDP growth at 6.6% for FY27, indicating a moderation from the estimated 7.7% growth in FY26. The agency attributed the slower growth outlook to continued energy market disruptions, rising fuel prices, and expectations of a below-normal southwest monsoon influenced by El Niño conditions. These factors could increase inflationary pressures and affect economic activity. S&P also expects inflation to rise in FY27, which may prompt the Reserve Bank of India to consider monetary policy adjustments, including a possible 25-basis-point increase in the repo rate to maintain economic stability and control inflation.

questions.question: Which fund house launched India's first target-date Life Cycle Fund series in June 2026?
questions.explanation: Zerodha Fund House launched India's first target-date Life Cycle Fund series, introducing the Life Cycle Fund 2036 and Life Cycle Fund 2041. These funds are designed to help investors achieve long-term financial goals by automatically adjusting asset allocation as the target year approaches. Initially, the portfolio maintains higher exposure to growth-oriented assets such as equities and gradually shifts towards lower-risk investments like government securities. The funds also include exposure to gold and silver, providing diversification. This innovative investment approach aligns with global retirement planning practices and offers a disciplined, long-term wealth creation strategy for investors.

questions.question: On which date is World Vitiligo Day observed every year?
questions.explanation: World Vitiligo Day is observed annually on June 25 to raise awareness about vitiligo, a long-term skin condition that causes loss of skin pigmentation. The observance aims to eliminate myths and social stigma while promoting acceptance, inclusion, and support for people living with the condition. The 2026 theme, "From Stigma to Strength," emphasises empowerment, self-confidence, and greater public understanding. The day also encourages early diagnosis, supports mental well-being, and highlights that vitiligo is not contagious. Through awareness campaigns and educational initiatives, World Vitiligo Day advocates for dignity, equality, and respect for individuals regardless of their appearance.

questions.question: Which country became the world's leading ship recycling nation according to the UNCTAD report for 2025?
questions.explanation: India emerged as the world's leading ship recycling nation in 2025, achieving a 35.4% global market share and reaching the Maritime India Vision 2030 target five years ahead of schedule. The country's ship recycling volume increased significantly from 1.86 million Gross Tons (GT) in 2024 to 2.99 million GT in 2025. This achievement was supported by government initiatives, including financial assistance for modernising recycling yards, implementation of the Recycling of Ships Act, 2019, and compliance with the Hong Kong International Convention. India also plans to further expand its ship recycling capacity through the development of the Alang Ship Recycling Yard in Gujarat.

questions.question: Which bank partnered with Zaggle to launch India's first co-branded biodegradable twin credit cards?
questions.explanation: Punjab National Bank (PNB), in partnership with Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Ltd., launched India's first co-branded biodegradable twin credit cards in June 2026. Manufactured using biodegradable materials, these cards promote sustainability while offering users access to both Visa and RuPay networks through a twin-card proposition. Customers benefit from global travel privileges, UPI-enabled payments, discounts on jewellery purchases, fuel surcharge waivers, complimentary airport and railway lounge access, OTT subscriptions, fitness memberships, and insurance coverage. The initiative combines environmentally friendly innovation with digital convenience, as card applications and management are handled through the Zagg. money mobile application.

questions.question: Which city has been sanctioned for defence land for the Gandhi Sarovar Project?
questions.explanation: The President of India sanctioned the use of 83.814 acres of defence land in Hyderabad for the Gandhi Sarovar Project as part of the larger Musi Riverfront Development Project. Developed by the Musi Riverfront Development Corporation Limited (MRDCL), the initiative aims to restore and rejuvenate the Musi River while creating a major cultural and ecological landmark. The project includes the construction of a Statue of Peace, a Gandhi Museum, a National Museum, an Education Hub, a Handloom Training Centre, a Relics and Research Centre, and a riverfront viewing platform. It also commemorates the historic Gandhi Sarovar site, where Mahatma Gandhi's ashes were immersed in 1948.

questions.question: Which supercomputer became the world's fastest according to the TOP500 list announced in June 2026?
questions.explanation: LineShine, based at the National Supercomputing Centre in Shenzhen, China, became the world's fastest supercomputer according to the TOP500 list announced in June 2026. It achieved a remarkable performance of 2.198 exaflops, capable of performing more than two quintillion calculations per second. LineShine is the first CPU-only supercomputer to surpass the 2-exaflop milestone and the first Chinese system to top the global rankings since Sunway TaihuLight in 2017. Its achievement highlights China's growing capabilities in high-performance computing and the increasing global focus on technological advancement and digital sovereignty.

questions.question: In which city was the second Pax Silica Summit held on 25–26 June 2026?
questions.explanation: The second Pax Silica Summit was held in Washington, D.C., on 25–26 June 2026, bringing together representatives from 35 countries, including India, to strengthen global cooperation in artificial intelligence (AI). The summit resulted in the adoption of the Joint Statement on AI Opportunity, promoting trusted AI governance, resilient supply chains, innovation-friendly policies, and industrial collaboration. Major announcements included the launch of the Pax Pass platform for AI-related supply chains and the Stanford-led Foundry School, supported by a US$50 million commitment from the United States to strengthen AI manufacturing and workforce development.

questions.question: On which date is the International Day Against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking observed every year?
questions.explanation: The International Day Against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking is observed every year on June 26 to strengthen global action against drug abuse and illegal drug trafficking. Established by the United Nations General Assembly through Resolution 42/112 in 1987, the first observance took place in 1988. The day is coordinated by the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) and focuses on raising awareness about the harmful effects of drug abuse, promoting prevention and rehabilitation, encouraging international cooperation, and supporting evidence-based policies to combat the growing global drug problem.

questions.question: In which Indian state was the newly discovered tiger moth genus Antaram found on June 24, 2026?
questions.explanation: The newly discovered tiger moth genus Antaram idukki was identified in the Idukki district of Kerala, located in the biodiversity-rich Western Ghats. The genus belongs to the subfamily Arctiinae under the family Erebidae and represents a previously unknown evolutionary lineage. The species was discovered by researchers from the Zoological Survey of India and the Natural History Museum, London. Its habitat in the Western Ghats highlights the ecological importance of the region, as the moth serves as both a pollinator and a food source for various animals, making it an important indicator of ecosystem health.

questions.question: In which Union Territory is the Hemis Festival celebrated annually at the famous Hemis Monastery?
questions.explanation: The Hemis Festival is celebrated every year in Ladakh at the historic Hemis Monastery in the Leh district. Dedicated to Guru Padmasambhava, also known as Guru Rinpoche or the Second Buddha, the festival commemorates his birth anniversary and his contribution to spreading Buddhism in the Himalayan region. The two-day celebration features the famous Cham masked dance, traditional Tibetan music, sacred rituals, prayers, and cultural performances. It is one of India's largest Buddhist festivals and attracts thousands of devotees and tourists, helping preserve Ladakh's rich cultural heritage while promoting tourism and spiritual awareness.

questions.question: On which date is the United Nations International Day in Support of Victims of Torture observed every year?
questions.explanation: The United Nations International Day in Support of Victims of Torture is observed every year on June 26 to reaffirm the global commitment to eliminating torture and supporting its victims. The United Nations General Assembly proclaimed the observance through Resolution 52/149 in 1997, and it was first observed in 1998. The date marks the entry into force of the UN Convention Against Torture (CAT) in 1987. The observance promotes human dignity, justice, rehabilitation for survivors, accountability for perpetrators, and stronger international cooperation to prevent torture and uphold human rights worldwide.

questions.question: Which country's Supreme Audit Institution (SAI) signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India on June 24, 2026, to strengthen cooperation in public sector auditing?
questions.explanation: The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Supreme Audit Institution (SAI) of Israel to enhance bilateral cooperation in public sector auditing. The agreement focuses on exchanging professional knowledge, technical expertise, and best practices while promoting training opportunities and bilateral seminars. It also emphasises the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and data analytics to improve auditing processes and performance oversight. The collaboration reflects the commitment of both countries to modernise public sector auditing through innovation, technology, and institutional cooperation.

questions.question: Who was conferred with the Global Prestige Award at the House of Lords, UK Parliament, on June 20, 2026?
questions.explanation: Harsh Vardhan, President of the Bihar Cricket Association (BCA), received the Global Prestige Award at the House of Lords in the UK Parliament on June 20, 2026. The award recognised global leaders contributing to peace, justice, and development in line with the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047. Harsh Vardhan also became the youngest President in the history of the Bihar Cricket Association after being elected unopposed in September 2025. Under his leadership, Bihar cricket has witnessed significant progress, including the emergence of promising talents such as Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Akshara Gupta.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Director of the Intelligence Bureau (IB) by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet?
questions.explanation: Mahesh Dixit, a 1993-batch IPS officer of the Andhra Pradesh cadre, has been appointed as the new Director of the Intelligence Bureau (IB). He succeeds Tapan Kumar Deka and will assume office on June 30 for a two-year tenure. Before this appointment, he served as the Special Director of the IB and handled several critical intelligence operations across Northeast India, Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, and anti-Naxal regions. A qualified medical doctor, Mahesh Dixit, brings extensive experience in internal security, counter-terrorism, and intelligence operations to one of India's most important security positions.

They recognise outstanding contributions in fields such as art, literature, science, social work, sports, public affairs, and education.

Its focus on indigenous manufacturing, advanced aviation technology, and collaboration with NVIDIA reflects India's growing capabilities in next-generation aerospace innovation.
