questions.question: To which country did India complete its first commercial sea shipment of Banganapalle mangoes?
questions.explanation: India completed its first commercial sea shipment of Banganapalle mangoes to Singapore, marking an important milestone in expanding agricultural exports through cost-effective and sustainable logistics. The 5-metric-tonne consignment was coordinated by APEDA under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry in collaboration with the ICAR–Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture (CISH). Dispatched on June 11, 2026, and delivered on June 24, 2026, the shipment demonstrated the feasibility of sea freight for exporting premium fruits. This initiative is expected to improve global market access for Indian mangoes while reducing transportation costs and environmental impact.

questions.question: Which state launched the GO-EAST policy to accelerate industrial growth and attract investments?
questions.explanation: The GO-EAST (Government of Odisha Eastern Investment Accelerator and Special Task Force) policy was launched by Odisha to promote industrial growth, attract fresh investments, and speed up project implementation. The initiative includes a dedicated investment facilitation platform, faster approvals, real-time project tracking, and a specialised GO-EAST Cell supported by the Go SWIFT digital monitoring module. The policy also focuses on developing backward districts by providing additional incentives for non-mineral-based industries. Through this initiative, Odisha aims to become Eastern India's leading manufacturing hub while supporting balanced regional development and enhancing investor confidence.

questions.question: In which city was the 5th India-Tajikistan Joint Working Group on Counter-Terrorism held?
questions.explanation: The 5th India-Tajikistan Joint Working Group (JWG) on Counter-Terrorism was held in Dushanbe, the capital of Tajikistan, on June 24, 2026. The meeting focused on enhancing bilateral cooperation in combating terrorism, violent extremism, radicalisation, terrorist financing, and drug trafficking. Both countries also emphasised preventing the misuse of technology for terrorist activities and strengthening collaboration through international platforms such as the United Nations, SCO-RATS, and the Eurasian Group. The dialogue reaffirmed the shared commitment of India and Tajikistan to addressing regional and global security challenges through coordinated efforts.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Executive Advisor to Air India Chairman N. Chandrasekaran on June 24, 2026?
questions.explanation: Pradeep Singh Kharola, a 1985-batch IAS officer and former Civil Aviation Secretary, was appointed as the Executive Advisor to Air India Chairman N. Chandrasekaran. He was also inducted as a full member of the airline's management committee. His appointment is intended to support the leadership transition as CEO Campbell Wilson prepares to step down. Kharola played a significant role in the privatisation of Air India during his tenure as Civil Aviation Secretary and has previously served as the Chairman of Air India, bringing extensive administrative and aviation sector experience to the organisation.

questions.question: Which country was visited by INS Udaygiri and INS Kavaratti during their port call in June 2026?
questions.explanation: INS Udaygiri and INS Kavaratti concluded their port call in Vietnam as part of India's operational deployment in the Southeast Asia region. During the visit, the Indian Navy engaged in professional interactions and bilateral maritime exercises with the Vietnam People's Navy. The deployment, led by the Flag Officer Commanding Eastern Fleet, was conducted under India's Act East Policy and the MAHASAGAR vision, focusing on maritime security, operational cooperation, and strengthening defence ties. The visit highlighted the growing strategic partnership between India and Vietnam and reinforced India's commitment to ensuring a secure and stable Indo-Pacific region.

questions.question: What is the name of India's humanitarian relief mission launched to assist Venezuela after the devastating earthquake?
questions.explanation: Operation Amistad is India's humanitarian relief mission launched to assist Venezuela following a devastating earthquake. Conducted under India's Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR) framework, the mission includes relief supplies, medical equipment, portable hospitals, and rescue teams to support affected communities. The Indian Air Force deployed C-17 Globemaster aircraft to transport aid and personnel. The operation reflects India's commitment to providing timely humanitarian assistance during international disasters and reinforces its role as a responsible global partner that supports friendly nations during times of crisis.

questions.question: In which year were the Drugs Rules formulated under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act?
questions.explanation: The Drugs Rules, 1945, were formulated under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940, to regulate the manufacture, distribution, and sale of drugs and cosmetics in India. These rules provide the legal framework for ensuring the quality, safety, and efficacy of medicines available in the country. Recent amendments have expanded the QR code-based traceability system to include vaccines, antimicrobials, anti-cancer drugs, and narcotic and psychotropic medicines. This initiative aims to curb counterfeit drugs, improve supply chain transparency, combat antimicrobial resistance, and strengthen public health through better monitoring and authentication of high-risk medicines.

questions.question: Which country hosted India's first-ever mango promotion events to boost exports?
questions.explanation: India organised its first-ever mango promotion events in Iceland to expand the global reach of its premium mango varieties and strengthen agricultural exports to Northern Europe. The initiative was organised by the Embassy of India in Reykjavik and APEDA, showcasing renowned varieties such as Dasheri, Chausa, Langra, and Kesar. The events also highlighted opportunities under the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA), which is expected to improve market access and trade cooperation. Iceland represents a promising premium market for imported fruits, making it an important destination for India's export diversification strategy.

questions.question: On which date is World MSME Day observed every year?
questions.explanation: World MSME Day is observed annually on June 27 to recognise the vital role of Micro-, Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MSMEs) in promoting economic growth, generating employment, encouraging innovation, and supporting sustainable development. The observance also raises awareness about the challenges faced by MSMEs, such as limited access to finance, infrastructure, and technology. It encourages governments, financial institutions, and development organisations to create a supportive environment that enables these enterprises to thrive. Celebrating the day highlights the importance of entrepreneurship and the contribution of MSMEs to inclusive and resilient economies worldwide.

questions.question: What type of project is the Rajolibanda Diversion Scheme (RDS)?
questions.explanation: The Rajolibanda Diversion Scheme (RDS) is an interstate irrigation project constructed across the Tungabhadra River, a major tributary of the Krishna River. Over the years, it has become an important component of water resource management in the Krishna River basin and continues to play a vital role in ensuring water security and sustainable agricultural development.

questions.question: Which state approved the Policy on Reuse of Treated Used Water, 2026, to strengthen water security and climate resilience?
questions.explanation: Andhra Pradesh approved the Policy on Reuse of Treated Used Water, 2026, with the objective of improving water security, promoting climate resilience, and supporting sustainable urban development. Aligned with the Swarna Andhra Vision 2047, the policy aims to meet at least 20% of urban water demand through treated wastewater reuse. It also mandates the use of treated water in sectors such as thermal power plants, construction, and urban services while encouraging industrial reuse. The policy includes phased implementation across all Urban Local Bodies and promotes efficient water management through modern infrastructure and monitoring systems.

questions.question: Which port celebrated its 154th Foundation Day with the announcement of projects worth ₹5,028.17 crore?
questions.explanation: Mumbai Port celebrated its 154th Foundation Day by announcing 63 infrastructure projects worth ₹5,028.17 crore aimed at modernising port facilities and strengthening India's maritime sector. The event included the inauguration of new projects, foundation stone laying for major initiatives, and the signing of strategic agreements to improve port operations and waterfront development. Held under the theme "Together We Can," the celebrations emphasised promoting cruise tourism, enhancing coastal shipping, and improving logistics efficiency. These initiatives support the broader vision of developing world-class maritime infrastructure in line with the goals of Viksit Bharat 2047.

questions.question: Which state police deployed India's first sovereign AI platform, C-SIGHT, for digital investigations?
questions.explanation: Telangana Police deployed C-SIGHT, India's first sovereign artificial intelligence platform, to strengthen digital investigations related to child sexual abuse cases. Developed by the Telangana Cyber Security Bureau (TGCSB) in collaboration with Vatins Systems, the platform operates entirely within the police network, ensuring sensitive data remains secure and offline. C-SIGHT significantly reduces investigation time, achieves high accuracy in identifying child sexual exploitation and abuse material, and automates the analysis of digital evidence. The initiative demonstrates Telangana's leadership in adopting advanced AI technologies to enhance cybercrime investigation and child protection efforts.

questions.question: How many Sukhoi Su-30MKI fighter jets have been equipped with BrahMos supersonic cruise missiles by the Indian Air Force?
questions.explanation: The Indian Air Force has equipped 40 Sukhoi Su-30MKI fighter jets with the air-launched BrahMos supersonic cruise missile, significantly enhancing India's long-range precision strike capability. This integration enables the aircraft to carry out stand-off attacks on strategic land and maritime targets while remaining outside the reach of enemy air defence systems. The BrahMos missile, jointly developed by India and Russia, offers a strike range of about 450 km and travels at speeds of up to Mach 3. The development strengthens India's indigenous defence capabilities and improves the operational effectiveness of its frontline fighter fleet.

questions.question: Which state integrated tea and plantation class landholdings into the farmers’ registry portal to provide Small Tea Growers with a unique Farmer ID?
questions.explanation: Assam integrated tea and plantation class landholdings into its farmers’ registry portal on June 26, 2026, to improve access to government services for Small Tea Growers (STGs). The initiative provides each eligible grower with a unique Farmer ID linked to Aadhaar, land records, and personal details. This digital integration simplifies access to fertilisers, institutional credit, subsidies, crop insurance, and other government schemes while reducing repetitive paperwork. The programme officially covers over 1.33 lakh registered small tea growers and is expected to benefit more than 1.5 lakh growers and around six lakh individuals across the state.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Managing Director for India by OpenAI to lead its strategy and operations in the country?
questions.explanation: Prabhjeet Singh has been appointed as the Managing Director for India by OpenAI, reflecting the company's commitment to expanding its presence in one of the world's fastest-growing artificial intelligence markets. Before joining OpenAI, he served as the President of Uber India and South Asia, where he played a significant role in business growth and market expansion. His extensive experience in scaling technology-driven businesses is expected to help OpenAI strengthen its operations in India. The appointment also highlights India's growing importance due to its large digital user base, thriving startup ecosystem, increasing enterprise adoption of AI, and strong government focus on artificial intelligence.

questions.question: On which date is Statistics Day observed every year in India to commemorate the birth anniversary of Prof. Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis?
questions.explanation: Statistics Day is observed every year on June 29 to honour the birth anniversary of Prof. Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis, who is regarded as the father of modern statistics in India. The Government of India instituted this observance in 2007 to promote awareness about the importance of statistics, encourage evidence-based policymaking, inspire students and researchers to pursue careers in statistics and data science, and recognise the contribution of official statistics to governance and national development. The celebration is coordinated by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) and the National Statistical Office (NSO).

questions.question: Which university developed an AI-powered Transformer Model for accurate crop yield prediction using climate data and satellite imagery?
questions.explanation: Chandigarh University developed a lightweight AI-powered Transformer Model designed to improve crop yield prediction through precision farming. The model uses imagery from the European Space Agency's Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 satellites along with climate variables such as rainfall, temperature, and soil moisture. It requires 40% fewer parameters than conventional AI models, enabling faster predictions with lower computational costs. The system was successfully evaluated on paddy, maize, moong, and sugarcane, outperforming traditional Random Forest and LSTM models. This innovation can support better farm management, agricultural planning, and efficient resource utilisation for farmers.

questions.question: In which state was the National Workshop on Tiger Re-introduction inaugurated on June 28, 2026?
questions.explanation: The National Workshop on Tiger Re-introduction was inaugurated in Rajasthan, specifically in Alwar, on June 28, 2026, marking the 18th anniversary of tiger restoration in the region. The workshop was organised by the National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) in collaboration with the Government of Rajasthan to develop future conservation strategies. During the event, important publications related to tiger management, tiger recovery, and Project Cheetah were released. The workshop also highlighted India's success in increasing the number of tiger reserves, achieving global tiger conservation targets, and restoring the tiger population in Sariska from local extinction to a thriving population.

questions.question: In which Indian state was Bharat Taxi officially launched by Union Home Minister Amit Shah on 27 June 2026?
questions.explanation: Bharat Taxi was officially launched in Gujarat as a cooperative-based mobility platform under the Ministry of Cooperation. The initiative aims to empower vehicle operators, known as "Sarathis," by making them shareholders instead of contract workers. Unlike conventional ride-hailing platforms, it emphasises cooperative ownership, transparent earnings, financial security, and welfare for drivers. The launch took place at the Mahatma Mandir Convention and Exhibition Centre in Gandhinagar, with participation from senior government leaders and cooperative institutions. The platform has already attracted more than seven lakh Sarathis and plans to expand its services to over 500 cities across India within the next two years.

questions.question: Which England captain announced his retirement from international cricket after the Third Test against New Zealand at Trent Bridge?
questions.explanation: Ben Stokes announced that he would retire from international cricket after the Third Test against New Zealand at Trent Bridge, bringing to a close an outstanding international career spanning nearly 15 years. He established himself as one of England’s greatest all-rounders through his exceptional performances with both bat and ball. His achievements include playing a decisive role in England’s 2019 ICC Cricket World Cup victory, producing the unforgettable Headingley Ashes innings, leading the Test team with an aggressive approach, and inspiring teammates through his resilience, leadership, and ability to perform under pressure.

questions.question: Which country signed 19 major initiatives with India during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's three-day visit to strengthen maritime security, defence, and strategic cooperation?
questions.explanation: Seychelles and India announced 19 major initiatives aimed at strengthening their strategic partnership across key sectors such as maritime security, defence, healthcare, digital payments, education, infrastructure, space cooperation, and climate resilience. The agreements were unveiled during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit and discussions with President Patrick Herminie in Victoria. The partnership also reinforces India's MAHASAGAR vision for promoting security, sustainable development, and regional cooperation in the Indian Ocean. Additional measures included defence assistance, humanitarian aid, financial support, and technology collaboration, highlighting the growing importance of India–Seychelles relations in the Indo-Pacific region.

questions.question: Which state launched the Go East initiative to accelerate industrial investment and boost industrial growth?
questions.explanation: Odisha launched the Go East initiative on June 26, 2026, under the leadership of Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi to promote industrial investment and accelerate project implementation. The initiative establishes a high-level Special Task Force and a dedicated Go East Cell within IPICOL to facilitate inter-state investments. It also includes revisions to the Industrial Policy Resolution-2022, prioritizes non-mineral industries, and aims to reduce industrial setup time from 160 days to less than 100 days through deregulation reforms. The programme is expected to strengthen investment, generate employment, and develop future-ready industrial hubs in the state.

questions.question: How many UNESCO World Heritage Sites does Italy have, making it the country with the highest number of such protected sites in the world?
questions.explanation: Italy has become the UNESCO World Heritage Capital with 61 protected sites, the highest number recorded by any country. These include 55 Cultural Heritage Sites and 6 Natural Heritage Sites, reflecting the nation’s extraordinary historical, artistic, architectural, and natural wealth. Italy’s rich legacy, spanning the Roman Empire, the Renaissance, medieval towns, archaeological treasures, and diverse landscapes, has earned it global recognition. The UNESCO designation helps preserve sites of Outstanding Universal Value, promotes sustainable tourism, supports conservation efforts, encourages international cooperation, and strengthens cultural awareness while contributing significantly to Italy’s tourism-driven economy.

questions.question: At which airport did the DGCA successfully conduct India's first GAGAN satellite-based landing system approach on a jet engine aircraft?
questions.explanation: India's first Satellite-Based Landing System (SLS) approach on a jet engine aircraft using the indigenous GAGAN system was successfully conducted by the DGCA on June 28, 2026, at Udaipur Airport. The precision landing was performed by an IndiGo Airbus A320 using the Localiser Performance with Vertical Guidance (LPV) approach. Developed jointly by ISRO and the Airports Authority of India (AAI), GAGAN enables highly accurate satellite-based navigation and reduces dependence on conventional Instrument Landing Systems (ILS). This achievement marks a significant advancement in India's aviation technology and strengthens its indigenous Satellite-Based Augmentation System (SBAS) capabilities.

questions.question: Which two states signed the historic agreement for the Yamuna Water Project on June 29, 2026?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan and Haryana signed the historic Yamuna Water Project agreement on June 29, 2026, in New Delhi to resolve a nearly three-decade-old water dispute and improve drinking water availability in water-scarce regions. The project will transport Rajasthan's allocated share of Yamuna River water from the Western Yamuna Canal through a network of underground pipelines. It establishes a comprehensive framework covering water allocation, infrastructure development, cost sharing, monitoring, and dispute resolution. The initiative is expected to benefit several districts in both states by ensuring a reliable water supply, promoting groundwater recharge, reducing water wastage, and strengthening long-term water security through scientific water management practices.

questions.question: What was India's industrial output growth in May 2026, marking a five-month high?
questions.explanation: India's industrial output grew by 5.1% in May 2026, the highest growth rate recorded in the previous five months. The increase was driven primarily by strong performance in the electricity and gas supply sector, robust manufacturing activity, and higher capital goods production. The data, released by the National Statistics Office (NSO), also reflected the adoption of the new 2022–23 base year for the Index of Industrial Production (IIP). A key methodological change was the replacement of the Wholesale Price Index (WPI) with the Output Producer Price Index (Output PPI), improving the accuracy of industrial output estimation and providing a better measure of real industrial growth.

questions.question: At which location did ISRO successfully conduct the eighth hot test of the 175-tonne Semi-Cryogenic Engine Power Head Test Article (PHTA)?
questions.explanation: ISRO successfully conducted the eighth hot test of the Semi-Cryogenic Engine Power Head Test Article (PHTA) on June 24, 2026, at the ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC) in Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu. During the test, the engine achieved an 88% thrust level of 175 tonnes, exceeding the performance of earlier tests. The engine uses Liquid Oxygen (LOX) and Isrosene as cleaner and more efficient propellants. The test is an important milestone in the development of the indigenous SE2000 semi-cryogenic engine, which is intended to replace the L110 core stage of the LVM3 launch vehicle, thereby enhancing payload capacity and mission efficiency.

questions.question: Where is the world's first Copper–Chlorine (Cu–Cl) thermochemical hydrogen production facility based on the Cu–Cl cycle located?
questions.explanation: The world's first hydrogen production facility based on the Copper–Chlorine (Cu–Cl) thermochemical cycle was inaugurated by the Department of Atomic Energy on June 26, 2026, at the Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research (IGCAR) in Kalpakkam, Tamil Nadu. The facility utilises heat from the Fast Breeder Test Reactor (FBTR) to produce carbon-free hydrogen with improved thermodynamic efficiency at lower operating temperatures. The technology was indigenously developed by the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC), Mumbai, and supports India's three-stage nuclear programme by extending the use of nuclear energy beyond electricity generation into clean hydrogen production.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the part-time chairman of HDFC Bank for a three-year term, subject to RBI approval?
questions.explanation: HDFC Bank has appointed former Chief Election Commissioner Rajiv Kumar as its part-time chairman for a three-year term, subject to approval from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). He has also been appointed as an Additional Director (Independent Director) for a four-year term beginning on June 30, 2026, subject to shareholder approval. Rajiv Kumar is a 1984-batch IAS officer with extensive experience in finance and public administration. He previously served as Secretary of the Department of Financial Services and played a significant role in banking reforms, including public sector bank consolidation, capital infusion, and increasing deposit insurance coverage.

questions.question: Who announced that he will step down as the Managing Director and CEO of Kotak Mahindra Bank upon the completion of his term on December 31, 2026?
questions.explanation: Ashok Vaswani announced on June 27, 2026, that he would step down as the Managing Director and CEO of Kotak Mahindra Bank after completing his term on December 31, 2026. Before joining Kotak Mahindra Bank, he served as the CEO of Barclays UK and held several senior leadership roles at Citigroup and Barclays, particularly in global consumer banking and payments. Kotak Mahindra Bank is India's fourth-largest private sector bank by market capitalisation and assets. Established in 2003, it was the first non-banking financial company (NBFC) in India to be converted into a commercial bank after receiving a banking license from the Reserve Bank of India.

questions.question: Which state has received in-principle approval for India's first offshore airport project?
questions.explanation: Maharashtra has received in-principle approval for India's first offshore airport project, marking a significant milestone in the country's aviation infrastructure. The proposed airport will be developed off the coast of Palghar district to improve air connectivity in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region while addressing land scarcity. The project was approved by Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis following a proposal from the Maharashtra Airport Development Company (MADC). Designed using advanced offshore engineering techniques, the airport is expected to enhance passenger and cargo handling capacity, reduce noise pollution over urban areas, strengthen regional connectivity, and support long-term economic growth and infrastructure development in the state.

questions.question: On which date is International Asteroid Day observed every year?
questions.explanation: International Asteroid Day is observed annually on June 30 to raise global awareness about asteroid impact hazards and the importance of planetary defence. The date commemorates the Tunguska Event of June 30, 1908, the largest recorded asteroid impact event in modern history, which devastated nearly 2,000 square kilometres of forest in Siberia. The United Nations General Assembly officially proclaimed the observance in 2016 to encourage international cooperation in asteroid detection, scientific research, emergency preparedness, and public education. The day also highlights the need to monitor Near-Earth Objects (NEOs) and strengthen global efforts to protect Earth from potential asteroid threats.

questions.question: In which city was the AVC Men's Volleyball Cup 2026 held, where India won its maiden bronze medal?
questions.explanation: India achieved a historic milestone by winning its first-ever medal at the AVC Men's Volleyball Cup 2026, which was held in Gandhinagar. The Indian men's volleyball team secured the bronze medal after defeating Bahrain 3–1 in the third-place playoff on June 29, 2026. This remarkable performance also resulted in a significant improvement in India's position in the FIVB World Rankings, with the team moving up 18 places from 60th to 42nd. Led by captain Jerome Vinith Charles and coached by Serbia's Dragan Mihailović, the 14-member squad delivered an outstanding performance on the continental stage.

questions.question: Which company signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Ministry of Tourism to strengthen the digital promotion of Indian tourism?
questions.explanation: The Ministry of Tourism signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Google India Pvt. Ltd. to enhance the digital visibility of India's tourism destinations through advanced technologies. The partnership focuses on using artificial intelligence (AI), digital marketing, data-driven insights, and capacity building to improve visitor engagement and promote the Incredible India campaign. The agreement is non-commercial, non-binding, and has no financial implications for either party. By leveraging Google's digital ecosystem, the collaboration aims to showcase India's cultural, historical, spiritual, and natural attractions more effectively, strengthen global tourism outreach, and support the country's broader goals of digital transformation and sustainable tourism development.

questions.question: In which country is the Unified Payments Interface (UPI) expected to become operational by the end of 2026?
questions.explanation: The Unified Payments Interface (UPI) is expected to become operational in the Seychelles by the end of 2026, as announced by Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri. The initiative reflects the growing strategic and economic partnership between India and Seychelles. Besides digital payment integration, the two countries cooperate in areas such as health, education, renewable energy, and social infrastructure. Maritime security remains a major focus to address challenges like illegal fishing, piracy, and drug trafficking in the Indian Ocean Region. Both nations are also exploring a Comprehensive Economic Partnership to strengthen bilateral trade and reviewing development projects supported under India's Special Economic Package.

questions.question: On which date is CA Day (Chartered Accountants Day) celebrated every year in India?
questions.explanation: CA Day, also known as Chartered Accountants Day, is celebrated every year on July 01 to commemorate the establishment of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) in 1949 under the Chartered Accountants Act, 1949. In 2026, ICAI celebrates its 77th Foundation Day, recognising the invaluable contributions of Chartered Accountants to India's financial governance, transparency, and economic development. The occasion is marked by seminars, conferences, award ceremonies, and professional development programmes across the country. It also highlights ICAI's role in regulating the accounting profession, setting auditing standards, and promoting ethical financial practices.

questions.question: In which river was the new pollution-eating bacteria Brachybacterium netajii discovered by researchers?
questions.explanation: Researchers discovered a new species of pollution-eating bacteria, Brachybacterium netajii, in the Hooghly River, West Bengal, on June 26, 2026. The discovery was made through a collaborative effort involving Netaji Mahavidyalaya, the University of Burdwan, IIT (BHU), and Hiroshima University, Japan. The bacterium can degrade p-nitrophenol (PNP), a toxic industrial pollutant, by using it as a source of carbon and energy. It also shows remarkable resistance to heavy metals such as arsenic, cadmium, lead, and mercury and can tolerate high salinity. The species was named in honour of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose for his contributions to scientific and technological advancement.

questions.question: On which date was the Goods and Services Tax (GST) launched in India, commemorated annually as GST Day?
questions.explanation: GST Day is observed every year on July 01 to mark the implementation of the Goods and Services Tax (GST) in 2017. Introduced under the vision of "One Nation, One Tax," GST replaced multiple central and state indirect taxes with a unified tax system, simplifying taxation and creating a common national market. Over the years, GST has strengthened cooperative federalism, improved tax compliance through digital governance, and enhanced transparency. Recent GST 2.0 reforms have further simplified tax rates, eased compliance for businesses, especially MSMEs, and promoted economic growth through technology-driven tax administration and improved ease of doing business.

questions.question: Who assumed charge as India's 31st Chief of the Army Staff (COAS) on July 1, 2026?
questions.explanation: General Dhiraj Seth assumed charge as India's 31st Chief of the Army Staff (COAS) on July 1, 2026, succeeding General Upendra Dwivedi. Upon taking office, he unveiled the "VIJAY" vision, a comprehensive roadmap focused on building a technology-driven, future-ready, and self-reliant Indian Army. The vision emphasises Vigilance and Readiness, Innovation and Transformation, Jointness and Integration, Aatmanirbharta, and Yoddha First. A 1986-batch Armoured Corps officer with nearly four decades of distinguished service, General Seth has commanded several key formations, including the South Western Command and Southern Command, contributing significantly to India's defence preparedness and military modernisation.

questions.question: What was the year-on-year growth rate of India's gross GST collections in June 2026?
questions.explanation: India's gross GST collections recorded a year-on-year growth of 13.9% in June 2026, reaching ₹1,94,812 crore compared to ₹1,71,105 crore in June 2025. After accounting for refunds, net GST collections stood at ₹1,62,377 crore, reflecting an annual growth of 11.2%. The increase was driven mainly by strong import-related GST revenue, which surged by 34.6%, while domestic GST collections grew by 6.5%. The robust revenue performance highlights improved tax compliance, effective digital tax administration, and sustained economic activity despite global uncertainties, reinforcing the strength of India's GST framework.

questions.question: Who has been reappointed as the Chairman of the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) for a six-month term effective from July 1, 2026?
questions.explanation: Ravi Agrawal has been reappointed as the Chairman of the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) for a further six-month term from July 1, 2026, to December 31, 2026. A 1988-batch Indian Revenue Service (IRS) officer, his extension was approved by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) after his scheduled retirement. The CBDT is the apex policymaking body for direct taxes in India and functions under the Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance. It is responsible for formulating direct tax policies, improving tax administration, combating tax evasion, issuing income tax guidelines, and enhancing transparency and taxpayer services across the country.

questions.question: Which banking partner collaborated with NPCI to enable real-time foreign exchange (FX) settlement for international UPI payments?
questions.explanation: HSBC India partnered with the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) and JP Morgan Payments to introduce real-time foreign exchange (FX) settlement for cross-border UPI transactions. This initiative enables instant currency conversion, faster payment confirmation, and real-time settlement between participating financial institutions. It also reduces settlement risks and improves transparency by providing customers with immediate exchange rates and transaction values. The partnership is a significant step in strengthening UPI's global reach, making international digital payments quicker, more efficient, and more reliable while supporting India's vision of expanding its digital payment ecosystem worldwide.

questions.question: Which state launched the second phase of the 'School Chalo Abhiyan' to achieve 100% school enrolment for the 2026–27 academic session?
questions.explanation: Uttar Pradesh launched the second phase of the 'School Chalo Abhiyan' under the leadership of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath to achieve 100% enrolment of eligible children in government schools for the 2026–27 academic session. The campaign focuses on identifying out-of-school children, re-enrolling school dropouts, and ensuring their integration into the formal education system. It also encourages active participation from parents, School Management Committees (SMCs), local communities, and public representatives. The initiative aligns with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 and supports the implementation of the Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009.

questions.question: Who was honoured with the 2026 USISPF Leadership Award for strengthening India-US economic ties and transforming India's telecommunications sector?
questions.explanation: Sunil Bharti Mittal, Founder and Chairman of Bharti Enterprises, received the 2026 USISPF Leadership Award at the IX US-India Strategic Partnership Forum (USISPF) Annual Leadership Summit held in Washington, D.C. He was recognised for his outstanding leadership in transforming India's telecommunications sector and strengthening economic and commercial ties between India and the United States. Under his leadership, Bharti Enterprises expanded into telecommunications, digital services, infrastructure, financial services, and other sectors. His efforts have promoted digital connectivity, innovation, international investment, and stronger business collaboration between India and North America.

questions.question: Who assumed charge as the General Officer Commanding-in-Chief (GOC-in-C) of the Indian Army's Southern Command on 1st July 2026?
questions.explanation: Lt Gen Rajesh Pushkar assumed charge as the General Officer Commanding-in-Chief (GOC-in-C) of the Indian Army's Southern Command on 1st July 2026, succeeding Lt Gen Sandeep Jain, who became the Vice Chief of the Army Staff. A senior Armoured Corps officer commissioned into the 74 Armoured Regiment in 1988, Lt Gen Pushkar has nearly four decades of distinguished military service. He has commanded several important formations, served in instructional and staff appointments, and represented India internationally in Bhutan and Russia. He is also a recipient of the Ati Vishisht Seva Medal (AVSM) and Vishisht Seva Medal (VSM) for his exceptional service to the nation.

questions.question: Which Indian private aerospace company signed an MoU with Finnish firm ICEYE to build, launch, and operate Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) Earth observation systems from India?
questions.explanation: Agnikul signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Finnish space technology company ICEYE on 1st July 2026 to develop, launch, and operate Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) Earth observation systems from India. The partnership aims to establish an end-to-end sovereign space capability, reducing dependence on foreign launch providers while strengthening India's space ecosystem. SAR technology enables high-resolution imaging regardless of weather conditions or time of day, making it valuable for disaster management, border surveillance, defence, and environmental monitoring. The collaboration also seeks to position India as a major satellite manufacturing and launch hub for the Asia-Pacific region.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief (AOC-in-C) of the Indian Air Force's Southern Air Command on 1st July 2026?
questions.explanation: Air Marshal Jasvir Singh Mann assumed charge as the Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief (AOC-in-C) of the Southern Air Command on 1st July 2026, succeeding Air Marshal Manish Khanna after his retirement. Commissioned into the fighter stream of the Indian Air Force in 1989, he has accumulated over 3,000 flying hours on aircraft including the Apache, MiG-21, Jaguar, MiG-29, Su-30, and Rafale. He has held several key operational and leadership appointments and is a recipient of the Ati Vishisht Seva Medal (AVSM) and Vayu Sena Medal (VSM) for his distinguished service.

questions.question: In which city were four advanced R&D facilities inaugurated at the CSIR-Indian Institute of Chemical Technology (CSIR-IICT) on 30th June 2026?
questions.explanation: Four advanced research and development facilities were inaugurated at the CSIR-Indian Institute of Chemical Technology (CSIR-IICT) in Hyderabad by Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh on 30th June 2026. The initiatives included an Advanced R&D Facility for Fluorochemicals, a Sustainable Engineering Complex, a Continuous Processing Platform for industrial chemicals, and a Decentralised Effluent Treatment Plant. The foundation stone for a new hostel complex was also laid to support young researchers. These projects aim to strengthen indigenous technologies, promote sustainable industrial development, improve waste management, and transform scientific research into a driver of economic growth and innovation.

questions.question: Who was reappointed as the Chairman of the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) for a period of six months with effect from 1st July 2026?
questions.explanation: Ravi Agrawal was reappointed as the Chairman of the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) for six months, from 1st July 2026 to 31st December 2026, or until further orders. The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) approved his extension on a contract basis by relaxing the Recruitment Rules, as he was due to retire on 30th June 2026. A 1988-batch Indian Revenue Service (IRS) officer, Ravi Agrawal, has been heading the CBDT since July 2024. The CBDT is the apex authority responsible for administering direct tax laws under the Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance.

questions.question: Which institution signed an MoU with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs to implement the Corporate Mitra Scheme aimed at supporting MSMEs with regulatory compliance?
questions.explanation: IIT Madras signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs and several professional institutes to implement the Corporate Mitra Scheme. The initiative aims to create a pool of trained para-professionals who can assist Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) in managing business operations and regulatory compliance. The programme includes 150 hours of online learning through the SWAYAM Plus portal, followed by six months of practical training with professional firms. It also offers fee concessions for women and candidates from specified regions, supporting skill development and ease of doing business in India.

questions.explanation: IIT Bombay signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with SBI Life Insurance on 1st July 2026 to establish the Bharat AI & Cyber Innovation Hub for Insurance. The initiative aims to develop indigenous AI-based cybersecurity solutions tailored to the Indian insurance sector, enhancing the protection of customer data and digital systems. Additionally, the partnership supports SBI Life's strategic transformation into an AI-native insurance company, promoting advanced technological innovation and strengthening India's cybersecurity capabilities in the financial services sector.

questions.question: Which state approved the ₹2,000 crore Deep Sea Fishing Mission to boost marine fish production and exports?
questions.explanation: Odisha approved the Deep Sea Fishing Mission with an estimated outlay of ₹2,295.45 crore for implementation over the period 2026–2036. The mission aims to increase annual marine fish production by 2 lakh metric tonnes, raise marine exports to ₹5,000 crore per year by 2036, and generate more than 50,000 employment opportunities. A dedicated Blue Economy Hub (B-Hub) will serve as the central knowledge, innovation, and coordination centre for the mission. The Odisha Cabinet, chaired by Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi, also approved the Mukhyamantri Poshan Yojana to strengthen nutrition support for secondary school students.

questions.question: Where was the 12th India-Malaysia Sub Committee Meeting on Military Cooperation (SCMC) conducted on 1st July 2026?
questions.explanation: The 12th India-Malaysia Sub Committee Meeting on Military Cooperation (SCMC) was held in New Delhi on 1st July 2026. The meeting was co-chaired by Amitabh Prasad from India's Ministry of Defence and Major General Amer Mahmud Bin Abdul Rahman of the Malaysian Armed Forces. Discussions focused on cyber security, defence technology, humanitarian assistance and disaster relief (HADR), capacity building, and enhanced military training cooperation. The SCMC serves as the principal military-to-military consultative mechanism between India and Malaysia and plays a key role in strengthening bilateral defence cooperation and regional security collaboration under the ADMM-Plus framework.

questions.question: Which bank celebrated its 119th Foundation Day by launching new digital banking initiatives, including CBDC services and a Digital Gold Loan facility?
questions.explanation: Punjab & Sind Bank celebrated its 119th Foundation Day on 30th June 2026 in New Delhi by introducing several digital banking initiatives aimed at enhancing customer services and operational efficiency. These included the launch of the Navjyoti mobile application for human resource management, Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) services, and a Digital Gold Loan facility. The bank also introduced the PSB Bharat Connect account, specially designed for central and state government employees. Established in 1908 and headquartered in New Delhi, Punjab & Sind Bank is one of India's leading public sector banks with the tagline, "Where Service is a Way of Life."

questions.question: Who assumed the appointment of General Officer Commanding-in-Chief (GOC-in-C) of the Jaipur-based South Western Command?
questions.explanation: Lieutenant General Mohit Malhotra assumed the appointment of General Officer Commanding-in-Chief (GOC-in-C) of the Jaipur-based South Western Command after serving as the Chief of Staff at Headquarters Eastern Command. Commissioned into the 47 Armoured Regiment in June 1989, he has held several key command assignments, including service in the Siachen Glacier, command of an Armoured Division, and the Desert Corps. He has extensive expertise in operational planning, military intelligence, and technology absorption. For his distinguished service to the nation, he has been awarded the Ati Vishisht Seva Medal (AVSM) and the Sena Medal (SM).

questions.question: Which state launched the Digi Rover Special Land Survey Campaign to modernise land demarcation using GNSS technology?
questions.explanation: Uttar Pradesh launched the Digi Rover Special Land Survey Campaign on 1st July 2026 from Saharanpur to modernise land demarcation across the state. The campaign uses Digi Rover based on Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) technology, replacing traditional land measurement methods with more accurate and transparent digital techniques. It aims to resolve over 79,000 pending land survey and demarcation cases by 15th August 2026. The Board of Revenue is supervising the initiative, while district-level officials, including District Magistrates, Tehsildars, Revenue Inspectors, and Lekhpals, are responsible for its implementation to reduce land disputes and improve public services.

questions.question: Which country signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with India to enhance cooperation in water resources and sustainable management during the Saudi Water Week?
questions.explanation: India and Saudi Arabia signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on 30th June 2026 to strengthen cooperation in water resources management and sustainable development during the Saudi Water Week held in Jeddah. The agreement focuses on sharing best practices in water resource planning, enhancing technical cooperation, building institutional capacity, and improving sustainable water management and irrigation systems. The MoU was signed by India's Ambassador to Saudi Arabia, Suhel Khan, and Saudi Arabia's Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture, Abdulrahman Abdulmohsen AlFadley. The partnership reflects the growing strategic relationship between the two countries in addressing water security and sustainable resource management.

questions.question: Which state is home to the Borjuli site that was notified as a Biodiversity Heritage Site to conserve wild rice genetic resources?
questions.explanation: The Borjuli site in the Sonitpur district of Assam was notified as a Biodiversity Heritage Site on 2nd July 2026 to conserve Oryza rufipogon, a wild rice species that is vital for developing climate-resilient and high-yielding rice varieties. The project, titled "In-situ Conservation and Management of Wild Rice," is funded by the National Rainfed Area Authority (NRAA) and implemented in collaboration with the Assam State Biodiversity Board and ICAR–National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources (ICAR-NBPGR). The initiative supports biodiversity conservation, sustainable agriculture, and the preservation of valuable plant genetic resources for future food security.

questions.question: When did the Reserve Bank of India implement the revamped Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS, 2026)?
questions.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) implemented the revamped Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS, 2026) with effect from July 1, 2026. The scheme replaced the 2021 framework while continuing the "One Nation, One Ombudsman" approach to provide jurisdiction-neutral grievance redressal. It covers banks, eligible NBFCs, non-bank prepaid payment instrument issuers, and credit information companies. The revised framework also specifies compensation limits, complaint timelines, and streamlined filing through the Centralised Receipt and Processing Centre (CRPC), the CMS portal, and a 24×7 multilingual contact centre to improve customer grievance resolution.

questions.question: What is the toll-free number of the 24×7 Women Helpline launched by the National Commission for Women (NCW)?
questions.explanation: The National Commission for Women (NCW) launched the 24×7 Women Helpline 14490 to provide immediate support, complaint registration, psychological counselling, and guidance for women facing violence, harassment, workplace exploitation, and other forms of abuse. The helpline is available round the clock and serves as a single point of contact for women aged 18 years and above. It also offers referral services, information about government welfare schemes, and grievance redressal support. As part of the Digital India initiative, the service aims to make assistance more accessible, improve complaint handling, and strengthen institutional support for women's safety and empowerment.

questions.question: Which Aadhaar details can residents now update free of charge through the official Aadhaar App?
questions.explanation: UIDAI has introduced a new digital service that allows Aadhaar holders to update their Email ID directly through the official Aadhaar App without visiting an Aadhaar Seva Kendra. The service became available on July 1, 2026, and is offered free of charge for six months. This initiative aims to make Aadhaar services more accessible, convenient, and citizen-friendly by enabling users to update their details from anywhere. The feature received a strong response, with over 2.5 lakh email updates completed within the first two days, reflecting the growing adoption of digital government services.

questions.question: On which date will the International Day of Cooperatives 2026 be observed?
questions.explanation: The International Day of Cooperatives 2026 will be observed on July 04, 2026, which falls on the first Saturday of July. The annual observance recognizes the significant contributions of cooperatives to economic and social development across the world. Governments, cooperative organizations, businesses, and communities participate in various events to raise awareness about the cooperative movement. The theme for 2026 is "Cooperatives for a Peaceful World!", highlighting the role of cooperatives in promoting social justice, democratic participation, inclusion, shared ownership, solidarity, and resilient communities for sustainable peace and development.

questions.question: Which country partnered with India to launch the first Forum for the Promotion of Exports in Bamako?
questions.explanation: India and Mali jointly launched the first India–Mali Forum for the Promotion of Exports in Bamako to strengthen bilateral trade, investment, and commercial cooperation. The two-day forum marked the institutionalisation of trade relations between the two countries and brought together government officials and business leaders to explore opportunities in manufacturing, infrastructure, mining, pharmaceuticals, textiles, and agriculture. Bilateral trade reached US$326.61 million in FY 2025–26, registering a 55% year-on-year growth. The initiative also supports future investments, trade facilitation, and stronger economic ties while promoting long-term strategic partnerships between India and Mali.

questions.question: Who assumed charge as the Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL) on July 1, 2026?
questions.explanation: Anupam Misra assumed charge as the Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL) on July 1, 2026. Before this appointment, he served as Director (Marketing) at Fertilisers and Chemicals Travancore Limited (FACT) from July 2020 to June 2026 and also held the additional charge of CMD of FACT. Hindustan Copper Limited, functioning under the Ministry of Mines, is a Miniratna Category-I Central Public Sector Enterprise headquartered in Kolkata. It is India's only vertically integrated copper producer, carrying out activities from mining and beneficiation to smelting, refining, and manufacturing copper products.

questions.question: Which bank announced the acquisition of Deutsche Bank’s India retail, private banking, and wealth management operations on June 30, 2026?
questions.explanation: Kotak Mahindra Bank announced the acquisition of Deutsche Bank India’s retail, private banking, and wealth management businesses on June 30, 2026, in a deal valued at ₹282 crore. The acquisition includes a loan portfolio of ₹29,000 crore, deposits worth ₹16,000 crore, and assets under management (AUM) totalling ₹10,500 crore. This strategic move is expected to strengthen Kotak Mahindra Bank’s retail banking and wealth management presence while expanding its customer base and enhancing its market position in India's competitive banking sector.

questions.question: Which country signed a nearly $1 billion green methanol agreement with ACME Group?
questions.explanation: ACME Group signed a long-term agreement worth nearly $1 billion with Japan's Mitsubishi Gas Chemical (MGC) to supply 100,000 tonnes of green methanol annually from its upcoming production facility in Paradip, Odisha. The green methanol will mainly be used as a cleaner marine fuel to help reduce greenhouse gas emissions in the shipping sector. This partnership strengthens India–Japan cooperation in clean energy, supports India's National Green Hydrogen Mission, promotes sustainable industrial development, and creates a reliable international market for Indian-produced green fuels, contributing to global decarbonization efforts.

questions.question: Who became India's youngest international cricketer by making his debut at the age of 15 years and 99 days?
questions.explanation: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi created history by becoming India's youngest international cricketer at the age of 15 years and 99 days. He achieved this milestone on July 4, 2026, when he received his T20I cap before the match against England at Old Trafford, Manchester. With this debut, he surpassed the long-standing record held by Sachin Tendulkar, who made his international debut at 16 years and 205 days in 1989. Vaibhav also became the youngest Indian men's T20I debutant and set a new benchmark among players representing full ICC member nations in men's T20 internationals.

questions.question: Which Indian state's Jalbhara Sandesh, Janai’s Manohara, and Balagarh’s traditional wooden boats recently received Geographical Indication (GI) tags?
questions.explanation: The GI tags were awarded to three traditional products from West Bengal—Chandannagar’s Jalbhara Sandesh, Janai’s Manohara, and Balagarh’s traditional wooden boats. These products are deeply connected with the cultural heritage, craftsmanship, and culinary traditions of the Hooghly district. A GI tag provides legal protection to products that have unique qualities or a reputation linked to a specific geographical region. This recognition helps preserve traditional knowledge, prevents counterfeiting, enhances market value, creates export opportunities, and supports the livelihoods of local artisans and producers while promoting the state's rich cultural identity.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Part-time Chairman and Additional Independent Director of HDFC Bank?
questions.explanation: Rajiv Kumar was appointed as the Part-time Chairman and Additional Independent Director of HDFC Bank on June 30, 2026, for a three-year term, subject to approval from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). A former Finance Secretary of India, he played a key role in the consolidation of 10 Public Sector Banks into four entities and later served as the Chief Election Commissioner during the 2024 General Election. He succeeded Atanu Chakraborty after the interim tenure of Keki Mistry. His appointment reflects HDFC Bank's focus on experienced leadership and strong corporate governance.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Chairman of the Tamil Nadu Curriculum Design Committee on June 30, 2026?
questions.explanation: Mayilsamy Annadurai was appointed as the Chairman of the Tamil Nadu Curriculum Design Committee by the School Education Department on June 30, 2026. He replaced Sultan Ahmed Ismail (Retd.), who resigned from the position, and will lead the existing 16-member panel while the remaining members continue in their roles. A distinguished ISRO scientist, Annadurai served as the Project Director of Chandrayaan-1 and played key leadership roles in Chandrayaan-2 and the Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan). His appointment is expected to strengthen curriculum development by bringing scientific expertise and innovation to school education.

questions.question: Which Indian bank partnered with Japan's Mizuho Bank to enhance collaboration in Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) financing and related services?
questions.explanation: Bank of Baroda entered into a strategic partnership with Japan's Mizuho Bank on June 30, 2026, to strengthen cooperation in Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) financing and related financial services. The collaboration focuses on joint origination, structuring, and syndication of acquisition financing, along with co-underwriting and selected M&A advisory deals. It also aims to develop preferred-partner channels for secondary risk distribution and sub-participation. By combining Mizuho Bank's global expertise with Bank of Baroda's strong domestic presence, the partnership is expected to support cross-border investment opportunities and corporate financing in India.

questions.question: Which continent will benefit from the WHO-approved first molecular diagnostic test for the Bundibugyo Ebola virus to accelerate outbreak response?
questions.explanation: The World Health Organisation (WHO) approved the first molecular diagnostic test for the Bundibugyo Ebola virus under its Emergency Use Listing (EUL) on July 2, 2026, to strengthen outbreak response efforts in Africa. The test detects the virus's genetic material directly from blood samples, allowing faster and more accurate diagnosis. It is specifically designed for the Bundibugyo strain, which is different from the Zaire strain and requires separate diagnostic tools. The approval supports timely detection, better disease surveillance, and improved public health measures, particularly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where the outbreak is ongoing.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the new Chairperson of the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) on July 3, 2026?
questions.explanation: Lokhande Prashant Sitaram, an IAS officer, was appointed as the Chairperson of the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) on July 3, 2026. Before assuming this role, he served as the Additional Secretary in the Ministry of Home Affairs, a position he held from April 1, 2026. CBSE is a premier national-level education board functioning under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. It is responsible for conducting the Class 10 (AISSE) and Class 12 (AISSCE) examinations and oversees thousands of affiliated public and private schools across the country.

questions.question: Who achieved the World No. 1 ranking in the men's Shot Put F57 category on July 02, 2026?
questions.explanation: Hokato Hotozhe Sema achieved the World No. 1 ranking in the men's Shot Put F57 category on July 02, 2026, marking a significant milestone for Indian para athletics. Hailing from Nagaland, he serves as a Subedar in the 9 Assam Rifles and has earned recognition for his outstanding achievements in sports. He won a bronze medal in the men's Shot Put F57 event at the Paris Paralympics 2024 and became the first Paralympian to receive the Ati Vishisht Seva Medal (AVSM). He is also a recipient of the Arjuna Award for excellence in sports.

questions.question: In which Indian state was the world's oldest accurately dated banyan tree scientifically identified?
questions.explanation: Bihar is home to the world's oldest accurately dated banyan tree, located in Munger and estimated to be around 700 years old. Scientists from the Birbal Sahni Institute of Palaeosciences (BSIP), Lucknow, determined its age using radiocarbon dating of wood samples analysed through Accelerator Mass Spectrometry. The research confirmed that the tree predates nearby historical structures and is a surviving remnant of an ancient natural forest. The findings, published in the international journal Quaternary Research, represent a significant achievement in botanical and environmental research, as banyan trees lack annual growth rings, making age determination particularly challenging.

questions.question: On which date is World Zoonoses Day observed annually?
questions.explanation: World Zoonoses Day is observed every year on July 6 to raise global awareness about zoonotic diseases, which are infections that transmit between animals and humans. This specific date holds historical significance because it commemorates the successful administration of the first rabies vaccine by French microbiologist Louis Pasteur on July 6, 1885. Pasteur's groundbreaking vaccination saved the life of a young boy bitten by a rabid dog and marked a monumental milestone in medical science, laying the foundation for modern vaccine development against infectious diseases. The day emphasises the importance of prevention, early detection, and coordinated action through the One Health approach, which recognises the interconnected health of humans, animals, and the environment.

questions.question: Which team won the ICC Women’s T20 World Cup 2026 by defeating England in the final at Lord’s Cricket Ground?
questions.explanation: Australia won the ICC Women’s T20 World Cup 2026 by defeating England by seven wickets in the final at Lord’s Cricket Ground. England scored 150/4 in their allotted 20 overs, with Nat Sciver-Brunt remaining unbeaten on 58. Australia successfully chased the target in just 17.1 overs, led by Beth Mooney’s unbeaten 64 runs and Phoebe Litchfield’s aggressive innings, which provided an excellent start. This victory earned Australia a record seventh ICC Women’s T20 World Cup title, further strengthening their position as the most successful team in the history of the tournament.

questions.question: What is the new name of the International Booker Prize after its renaming in 2026?
questions.explanation: The Bukhman International Booker Prize is the new name of the International Booker Prize following a decade-long funding commitment by Bukhman Philanthropies. Along with the renaming, the winner's prize money was doubled from £50,000 to £100,000, while each shortlisted title now receives £5,000. The award continues to recognise the collaborative efforts of authors and translators by sharing the prize equally between them. The first winner under the new name will be announced in May 2027, and the prize remains dedicated to fiction translated into English and published in the United Kingdom or Ireland.

questions.question: Which Indian Naval sail training ship represented India at the United States International Naval Review 250 and Sail4th 250 celebrations in New York?
questions.explanation: INS Sudarshini represented India at the United States International Naval Review 250 and the Sail4th 250 celebrations held in New York. The ship arrived at New York Port as part of its Lokayan 2026 transoceanic expedition, which aims to strengthen international maritime cooperation and goodwill. Commissioned into the Indian Navy in 2012 and built by Goa Shipyard Limited, INS Sudarshini serves as a sail training vessel based at the Southern Naval Command in Kochi. It also plays a key role in preserving traditional seafaring skills while promoting friendly relations with navies around the world.

questions.question: Which country will chair the Ninth Session of UNCTAD's Intergovernmental Group of Experts on Consumer Protection Law and Policy in Geneva from July 6–8, 2026?
questions.explanation: India will chair the Ninth Session of the UNCTAD Intergovernmental Group of Experts on Consumer Protection Law and Policy, held in Geneva from July 6–8, 2026. The meeting brings together policymakers, regulators, and consumer protection authorities from various countries to discuss emerging consumer issues and strengthen international cooperation. India’s delegation is led by Nidhi Khare, Secretary of the Department of Consumer Affairs. During the session, India will oversee key discussions, including the launch of the UN Principles for Consumer Product Safety, while highlighting its achievements in digital consumer grievance redressal through initiatives such as the National Consumer Helpline and the AI-powered e-Jagriti platform.

questions.question: Which West African country launched the first-ever India–Country Forum for the Promotion of Exports in Bamako to strengthen bilateral trade?
questions.explanation: Mali partnered with India to launch the inaugural India–Mali Forum for the Promotion of Exports in Bamako, marking a significant step in strengthening economic and trade relations between the two countries. The forum was organised under the theme "Reinforcing Trade and Strategic Partnerships" and highlighted the rapid growth in bilateral commerce, which reached $326.61 million in FY 2025–26. Discussions focused on expanding trade through the Duty-Free Tariff Preference (DFTP) Scheme, increasing market access, promoting investment opportunities, and unlocking Mali's export potential in the Indian market while supporting long-term economic cooperation.

questions.question: What was India's rank in the Global Passport Index 2026?
questions.explanation: India was ranked 125th out of 197 countries in the Global Passport Index 2026. Although the country's overall score improved to 45.1, its highest in the past five years, it slipped one place from the previous year's ranking due to stronger improvements made by other countries. The index evaluates passports using three key factors: enhanced mobility, quality of living, and investment opportunities. India showed progress in quality of life and investment potential, but limited visa-free travel access to major destinations affected its mobility score, preventing a higher overall ranking despite the improved performance.

questions.question: In which industrial hub is the CG Semi Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) facility located as part of India's growing semiconductor ecosystem?
questions.explanation: The CG Semi OSAT facility is located in Sanand, Gujarat, which has emerged as one of India's leading semiconductor and electronics manufacturing hubs. The region hosts major semiconductor companies and integrated facilities, including testing laboratories, design centres, and specialised chemical producers. The facility supports the Semicon India Programme and aligns with the "Design in India" and "Make in India" initiatives. Developed through a partnership involving India, Japan, and Thailand, it aims to strengthen domestic semiconductor capabilities, increase production capacity, and enhance India's position in the global semiconductor supply chain.

questions.question: Which Brazilian footballer announced his retirement from international football after Brazil’s FIFA World Cup 2026 Round of 16 exit?
questions.explanation: Neymar announced his retirement from international football after Brazil’s 2-1 defeat to Norway in the Round of 16 of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. His international career spanned 16 years, from 2010 to 2026, during which he played 130 matches, scored 80 goals, and provided 59 assists. He became Brazil’s all-time leading male goal scorer, surpassing Pelé’s record. Fittingly, his final international match took place at MetLife Stadium, the same venue where he scored his first goal for Brazil in 2010, making his farewell especially memorable and symbolic.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as India's new Ambassador to North Korea?
questions.explanation: Sanjeev Jain, a 2008-batch Indian Foreign Service (IFS) officer, has been appointed as India's new Ambassador to North Korea by the Ministry of External Affairs. Before this appointment, he served as India's Ambassador to the Republic of Cabo Verde, an island nation off the western coast of Africa. With extensive diplomatic experience, he has contributed to strengthening India's bilateral relations with several countries. He is expected to assume his new responsibilities after completing the required diplomatic formalities, further enhancing India's diplomatic engagement with the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK).

questions.question: Which state is constructing India's first air-filled rubber dams using South Korean technology?
questions.explanation: Gujarat is constructing its first air-filled rubber dams using advanced technology from South Korea to modernise water resource management. The two projects are being developed on the Heran River in Chhota Udepur district and the Ambika River in Tapi district. These innovative dams are designed to improve irrigation, enhance groundwater recharge, store water efficiently, and help in flood management. Equipped with automated SCADA systems, the projects are expected to provide reliable irrigation to thousands of hectares of agricultural land while ensuring sustainable and efficient use of water resources.

questions.question: Which state is home to India's first greenfield integrated refinery-cum-petrochemical complex?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan is home to India's first greenfield integrated refinery-cum-petrochemical complex, the Pachpadra Refinery, developed as a joint venture between Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) and the Rajasthan government in Balotra. Built at a cost of over ₹79,450 crore, the refinery has a capacity of 9 MMTPA for refining and 2.4 MMTPA for petrochemicals. The project is a major milestone in India's energy and petrochemical sector and is expected to strengthen industrial development, employment generation, and economic growth in the region.

questions.question: Which state approved the ₹313.3 crore PM Cha Shramik Protsahan Yojana package for tea garden workers?
questions.explanation: West Bengal approved the implementation strategy for the Pradhan Mantri Cha Shramik Protsahan Yojana (PMCSPY) with a special assistance package of ₹313.3 crore to improve the lives of tea garden workers and their families. The scheme focuses on enhancing education, healthcare, and worker welfare infrastructure in the tea-growing regions of North Bengal. It is expected to benefit more than three lakh tea plantation workers. The funds have been allocated for educational improvements, strengthening healthcare facilities, and constructing worker rest sheds, ensuring comprehensive social and economic development in the tea garden communities.

questions.question: Who was officially declared the winner of Peru's presidential runoff election?
questions.explanation: Keiko Fujimori was officially declared the winner of Peru's presidential runoff election by the country's electoral authority after defeating Roberto Sanchez, the leftist candidate and former Foreign Trade and Tourism Minister. She secured the presidency, with the official swearing-in ceremony scheduled for July 28, 2026. Peru is a country located in western South America, with Lima as its capital and the Sol as its national currency. It is also renowned for Machu Picchu, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.

questions.question: Which country conferred its highest civilian honour, Bintang Adipurna, on Prime Minister Narendra Modi?
questions.explanation: Indonesia conferred its highest civilian honour, Bintang Adipurna, on Prime Minister Narendra Modi in recognition of his contribution to strengthening bilateral relations and promoting international cooperation between the two countries. The honour was presented by Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto during the Prime Minister's official visit to Jakarta. The award reflects the deep and growing Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between India and Indonesia, covering areas such as trade, investment, digital cooperation, maritime security, critical minerals, and cultural ties. It also symbolises the strong friendship and mutual respect shared by the two nations.

questions.question: What is the new name of Jalalabad town in Uttar Pradesh?
questions.explanation: Parashurampuri is the new name approved for Jalalabad town in Uttar Pradesh by the state Cabinet led by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. The renaming was carried out after the Central Government raised no objections to the proposal. The decision was taken in response to the demand of local residents and aims to recognise the town's historical, religious, and cultural significance. The government considers the town to be associated with Lord Parashuram, who is regarded as the sixth incarnation of Lord Vishnu, and the new name reflects this traditional identity.

questions.question: Which state opened the online application window for the Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Caste students for the 2026–27 academic session?
questions.explanation: Punjab opened the online application process for the Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Caste (SC) students for the 2026–27 academic session. The scheme is managed by the Punjab Department of Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities and aims to provide financial assistance for higher education to students from economically weaker SC families. Applications are processed through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) to ensure transparency and direct benefit transfer. The initiative also includes awareness camps and inter-departmental coordination to improve access to educational opportunities and encourage local career development.

questions.question: Where did India host the BRICS Heads of Anti-Drug Agencies meeting in 2026?
questions.explanation: Guwahati, Assam, hosted the high-level BRICS Heads of Anti-Drug Agencies meeting, organised by the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) under the Ministry of Home Affairs. The meeting focused on strengthening cooperation among BRICS nations to combat transnational drug trafficking, synthetic drugs, precursor diversion, and emerging New Psychoactive Substances (NPS). Discussions also emphasised intelligence sharing, operational coordination, and the use of digital technologies to tackle darknet and cryptocurrency-based drug trafficking. The meeting aligned with India's Vision Document on Narcotics Control (2026–2029) and concluded with the adoption of a Joint Declaration to enhance collective action.

questions.explanation: Haryana became the first state to have Sirsa Kinnow recognised as its first fruit with a Geographical Indication (GI) tag. The GI registration was granted by the Geographical Indications Registry in Chennai, recognising the unique quality and characteristics of kinnow grown in the Sirsa district. The region's favourable climatic and geographical conditions produce kinnow with a sweet taste, high juice content, large size, and attractive colour. The GI tag provides legal protection against imitation, enhances market value, promotes exports, and improves income opportunities for farmers while strengthening Haryana's horticultural brand identity.
