questions.question: Which major port became India's second port with an 18-metre operational draft after completing the Capital Dredging Phase VI project?
questions.explanation: Kamarajar Port became India's second major port to achieve an 18-metre operational draft after the successful completion of the ₹440 crore Capital Dredging Phase VI project. The upgraded infrastructure allows the port to handle fully laden Capesize vessels carrying up to 1,70,000 DWT, significantly improving cargo handling efficiency. The project included deepening approach channels, entrance channels, berths, and navigational areas, transforming the port into a Cape Compliant Port. This achievement is expected to reduce logistics costs, improve turnaround time, enhance India's global maritime competitiveness, and strengthen the country's export-import (EXIM) trade.

questions.question: Which state's Natural History Museum was designated as India's 21st Designated Repository under the Biological Diversity Act, 2002?
questions.explanation: The Natural History Museum of Mizoram University, located in Aizawl, was designated as India's 21st Designated Repository under Section 39 of the Biological Diversity Act, 2002. The recognition strengthens India's biodiversity conservation framework by enabling the museum to preserve authenticated biological specimens, including voucher and type specimens. Situated in the Indo-Burma Biodiversity Hotspot, the museum plays a significant role in documenting rich flora and fauna, supporting scientific research, species identification, long-term preservation of biological resources, and collaboration with biodiversity institutions across the country.

questions.question: Which city will host the Commonwealth Games 2026, where the Indian contingent will wear sustainable jute-viscose blended apparel?
questions.explanation: Glasgow, Scotland, will host the Commonwealth Games 2026 from 23 July to 2 August 2026. During the event, the Indian contingent will wear sustainable jute-viscose blended apparel developed by the National Jute Board under the Ministry of Textiles. The biodegradable apparel highlights India's commitment to sustainable textiles, natural fibre innovation, and the Make in India initiative. This will also mark the first time a national contingent wears jute-based apparel at an international multi-sport event, promoting environmentally friendly manufacturing practices and showcasing Indian craftsmanship on a global stage.

questions.question: Who is leading the Indian delegation at the inaugural Global Dialogue on AI Governance in Geneva, Switzerland?
questions.explanation: Kirti Vardhan Singh, Minister of State, is leading the Indian delegation at the inaugural Global Dialogue on AI Governance held in Geneva, Switzerland. The dialogue is the first session of a universal, multi-stakeholder forum established under the United Nations General Assembly Resolution 79/325. It focuses on key issues such as the social and economic impact of artificial intelligence, bridging AI divides, ensuring safe and trustworthy AI, protecting human rights, and supporting sustainable development. The event also includes the presentation of the first annual report by the Independent International Scientific Panel on AI (IISPA), highlighting AI capabilities and associated risks.

questions.question: Which state introduced millet-based chikki into the Dokka Seethamma Mid-Day Meal Scheme to improve student nutrition?
questions.explanation: Andhra Pradesh introduced a millet-based chikki under the Dokka Seethamma Mid-Day Meal Scheme to enhance the nutritional intake of students in government schools. The snack is prepared using peanuts, jaggery, and nutritious millets such as ragi, jowar, and bajra. It is distributed three times a week and is monitored through barcode-based tracking to ensure transparency and quality. The initiative aims to improve the intake of calcium, iron, protein, and dietary fibre among children while promoting the consumption of millets, which are nutrient-rich, environmentally sustainable, and widely encouraged across India.

questions.question: Which country is scheduled to launch its fourth next-generation medium-sized Earth observation satellite via a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket?
questions.explanation: South Korea is set to launch its fourth next-generation medium-sized Earth observation satellite aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California, USA. The approximately 500-kg satellite is equipped with indigenous high-resolution observation cameras and will orbit at an altitude of 888 km. It is designed to capture images of the entire Korean Peninsula every three days. After four months of in-orbit testing, the satellite is expected to become fully operational in the first half of 2027, supporting agriculture, forest management, disaster response, climate change analysis, and public safety.

questions.question: Where will South Asia’s largest private sector integrated missile manufacturing plant be established by Adani Defence and Aerospace?
questions.explanation: Adani Defence and Aerospace is establishing South Asia’s largest private sector integrated missile manufacturing facility in Shivpuri, Madhya Pradesh, with an investment of ₹2,500 crore. The plant will manufacture precision-guided munitions, ammunition, and mission-ready missiles while integrating advanced materials and production systems at a single location. Equipped with automated manufacturing technology and globally benchmarked safety standards, the facility is expected to strengthen India's indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities. The project will also boost employment, enhance the regional industrial ecosystem, and support the country's goal of achieving greater self-reliance in the defence sector.

questions.question: What is the name of India's first dedicated digital learning platform for tribal arts, culture, languages, and traditional knowledge launched by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs?
questions.explanation: TribeX is India's first dedicated digital learning platform focused on preserving, documenting, and promoting tribal arts, culture, languages, and traditional knowledge. Launched by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, the platform integrates online learning, digital documentation, research support, and skill development. It offers free certificate courses on tribal heritage and UGC-recognised postgraduate diploma programmes in collaboration with academic institutions. TribeX aims to preserve indigenous knowledge, promote tribal traditions globally, support researchers and learners, and create employment-oriented educational opportunities while making authentic tribal knowledge accessible to people across India and the world.

questions.question: Which country signed 14 strategic agreements with India, including deals to procure BrahMos and Astra missile systems?
questions.explanation: India and Indonesia strengthened their Comprehensive Strategic Partnership by signing 14 agreements covering defence, maritime security, trade, digital payments, education, space, critical minerals, and other strategic sectors. As part of the defence cooperation, Indonesia decided to procure India's BrahMos supersonic cruise missile systems and Astra Beyond-Visual-Range Air-to-Air Missiles (BVRAAMs). These agreements were announced during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to Jakarta in July 2026. The partnership also reinforces cooperation in the Indo-Pacific region, promotes regional stability, and expands India's growing defence exports and strategic engagement with Southeast Asia.

questions.question: How many states signed the Narmada Project Payment Pact to resolve the long-standing cost-sharing dispute?
questions.explanation: Four states Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Maharashtra—signed the Narmada Project Payment Pact to settle long-pending financial issues related to the implementation of the Narmada Water Disputes Tribunal (NWDT) Award. The agreement covers cost-sharing for the Sardar Sarovar and Indira Sagar projects, including rehabilitation expenses, compensation for submerged land, construction costs, interest on borrowings, and settlement of outstanding dues. The pact represents an important step toward cooperative federalism, improved inter-state coordination, and efficient management of the Narmada River basin and its major water resource projects.

Located about 25 light-years from Earth, the rocky exoplanet orbits a red dwarf star within the habitable "Goldilocks" zone, where conditions may allow liquid water to exist. The planet has an estimated mass of 2.3 times that of Earth and was identified using advanced instruments, including the Habitable-zone Planet Finder and the NEID spectrometer. Future NASA missions are expected to study its atmosphere for possible biosignatures and signs of habitability.

As a leading NBFC and insurance distributor, Bajaj Finance is expected to benefit from enhanced data accuracy, faster operations, and better collaboration across the insurance and lending ecosystem.

Working alongside Green Worms, the initiative aims to improve waste management systems across the coastal regions of Kerala and Mahe, contributing to cleaner coastlines and enhanced environmental conservation.

questions.question: Which country launched the pilot phase of the Tourist Package Visa service that combines flight bookings, hotel reservations, and e-visa processing into a single transaction?

In the initial phase, the service is available to travellers from several countries, including India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Egypt, Jordan, and Mexico. The initiative supports Saudi Arabia's efforts to promote tourism and enhance the overall visitor experience.

questions.question: By what percentage did global Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) increase in 2025, according to UNCTAD?
questions.explanation: According to the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD), global Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) increased by 6% in 2025, reaching a total of $1.6 trillion. This marked the end of a two-year decline in global investment flows. Developed economies recorded stronger growth in FDI inflows than developing economies, while a significant share of global investments remained concentrated in the top recipient countries. The report also highlighted increasing investment in strategic greenfield projects, reflecting growing interest in sectors that support long-term economic growth, innovation, and sustainable development.

questions.question: Which city hosted the BRICS Women Ministerial Meeting organised under India’s BRICS Chairship in July 2026?
questions.explanation: Kochi, Kerala, hosted the BRICS Women Ministerial Meeting on 8–9 July 2026 under India’s BRICS Chairship. The meeting focused on the theme "Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability," reflecting the four pillars of India's chairship. Discussions covered women's leadership, entrepreneurship, financial inclusion, digital empowerment, climate action, food security, and nutrition. The programme also featured plenary sessions, thematic panel discussions, and exhibitions highlighting women-led initiatives in STEM, education, and rural development, reinforcing collaboration among BRICS member countries on gender-inclusive growth and sustainable development.

questions.question: Which country officially terminated the interim peace agreement with Iran and revoked the oil licenses in July 2026?
questions.explanation: The United States officially terminated the interim peace agreement with Iran and revoked the general license that had allowed Iran to sell crude oil and petrochemical products. The decision followed military escalations, including attacks on U.S. military bases in the Gulf and retaliatory operations by U.S. Central Command. The move also imposed a deadline for winding down existing oil transactions, leading to increased geopolitical tensions. Following the announcement, global oil prices rose sharply, and shipping activity around the strategically important Strait of Hormuz was significantly affected due to heightened security concerns.

questions.question: Which Indian Institute of Management announced the establishment of its first overseas campus in Malang, Indonesia?
questions.explanation: IIM Bangalore announced the establishment of its first overseas campus in Malang, Indonesia, marking a significant milestone in the international expansion of Indian higher education. The campus will be set up in the Singhasari Special Economic Zone through a Memorandum of Understanding with PT Intelegensia Grahatama (PT IGT). The project will begin with executive education programmes for senior professionals before expanding to full-fledged degree courses. The curriculum will emphasise areas such as artificial intelligence, digital transformation, global supply chains, healthcare management, climate, and sustainability, in line with the objectives of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020.

questions.question: By what percentage did electric passenger vehicle retail sales surge year-on-year in June 2026, according to FADA?
questions.explanation: According to the Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations (FADA), electric passenger vehicle retail sales recorded an approximate year-on-year growth of 108% in June 2026, increasing from 15,318 units in June 2025 to 31,823 units in June 2026. This remarkable rise also boosted the segment's market share to 7.7% of total passenger vehicle sales. The strong performance reflects the increasing adoption of electric mobility in India, supported by growing consumer demand, improved charging infrastructure, wider model availability, and continued emphasis on clean and sustainable transportation solutions.

questions.question: In which city was the foundation stone laid for the Dr Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Smart Industrial Park in 2026?
questions.explanation: The foundation stone for the Dr Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Smart Industrial Park was laid in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, by Chief Minister Dr Mohan Yadav. Spread across approximately 173 acres, the industrial park is designed to promote advanced manufacturing through modern IT and AI-based infrastructure. Developed under the ‘work-live-grow’ model, it will support sectors such as garments, toys, information technology, and artificial intelligence. The project is expected to generate more than 15,000 direct and indirect jobs and includes a large convention centre to host investor summits and industrial exhibitions, strengthening Bhopal's industrial ecosystem.

questions.question: In which Indian city was the AUSTRAHIND 2024 joint military exercise between India and Australia conducted?
questions.explanation: The AUSTRAHIND 2024 joint military exercise between India and Australia was conducted in Pune from November 8 to 21, 2024. The exercise forms an important part of the growing defence cooperation under the India-Australia Comprehensive Strategic Partnership. It aims to strengthen interoperability, improve operational coordination, and enhance mutual understanding between the armed forces of both countries. Along with other bilateral and multilateral exercises such as AUSINDEX, Tarang Shakti, Pitch Black, and Talisman Sabre, AUSTRAHIND reflects the commitment of India and Australia to deepen defence collaboration and promote security and stability in the Indo-Pacific region.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Chief Economist and Director of the Research Department of the International Monetary Fund (IMF)?
questions.explanation: Silvana Tenreyro has been appointed as the new Chief Economist and Director of the Research Department of the International Monetary Fund (IMF). She will also serve as the IMF's Economic Counsellor, leading the preparation of key global economic assessments and providing guidance on the global economic outlook. She succeeds Pierre-Olivier Gourinchas, who is returning to academia. Tenreyro brings extensive experience from her tenure on the Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee and her work at the Federal Reserve Bank of Boston, making her well-qualified for this important international leadership role.

questions.question: Which Indian city was ranked among the world's top 10 happiest cities in the Happy City Index 2026?
questions.explanation: Jaipur secured the 6th position globally in the Happy City Index 2026, making it the only Indian city to feature in the world's top 10 happiest cities. The city earned this recognition for its high quality of life, effective governance, rich cultural heritage, strong tourism sector, and continuous urban development. Improvements in infrastructure, public services, smart city initiatives, sustainability, and citizen engagement have further enhanced the living standards of residents. Jaipur's successful balance between preserving its historical identity and embracing modern development played a key role in achieving this prestigious global ranking.

questions.question: Which country's space agency operates the Hayabusa2 spacecraft that performed a high-precision flyby of asteroid Torifune?
questions.explanation: JAXA (Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency) is Japan's national space agency and the organisation responsible for the Hayabusa2 mission. The spacecraft successfully carried out a high-precision flyby of the near-Earth asteroid Torifune as part of efforts to test planetary defence technologies. Hayabusa2 was originally launched in 2014, successfully collected samples from asteroid Ryugu, and returned them to Earth in 2020. The agency continues to play a significant role in space exploration, asteroid research, and the development of technologies to better understand and respond to potential threats from near-Earth objects.

questions.question: Which country partnered with India to launch the PACTS framework for cyber and critical technologies?
questions.explanation: India and Australia elevated their bilateral strategic partnership by launching the Australia-India Partnership on Cyber, Critical Technologies and Supply Chains (PACTS), which officially replaces the 2020 Framework Arrangement on Cyber and Cyber-Enabled Critical Technology Cooperation. This comprehensive framework focuses on five pillars: supply chain resilience, critical technology research, cybersecurity cooperation, digital resilience through India's Digital Public Infrastructure, and defence research collaboration between DRDO and Australia's Defence Science and Technology Group. The partnership is chaired by the Indian Deputy National Security Advisor and the Australian Deputy Secretary, with nodal lead agencies including the National Security Council Secretariat, Ministry of External Affairs, and Ministry of Defence overseeing specific pillars.

questions.question: What is the name of the world's first once-weekly basal insulin launched in India for the treatment of adult diabetes?
questions.explanation: Awiqli, developed by Novo Nordisk, is the world's first once-weekly basal insulin introduced in India for the treatment of adult diabetes. The medicine is designed to reduce the burden of daily insulin injections by requiring only one injection every week, reducing the annual number of injections from 365 to 52. It is administered through a pre-filled pen device and works by binding to the blood protein albumin, which creates a reservoir that releases insulin steadily over seven days. This helps maintain stable blood glucose levels and improves treatment convenience. Awiqli can be used by eligible patients with Type 2 diabetes either alone or with other medicines, while patients with Type 1 diabetes must use it together with short-acting insulin during mealtimes.

questions.question: Which city will host the Global AI Summit scheduled alongside the ITU AI for Good Global Summit?
questions.explanation: Geneva has been selected as the host city for the Global AI Summit, which will be held alongside the ITU AI for Good Global Summit. The event aims to bring together world leaders, policymakers, researchers, technology companies, and international organisations to discuss artificial intelligence governance, innovation, ethics, and responsible development. Geneva was chosen because of its long-standing role as a global diplomatic hub and its concentration of United Nations agencies, humanitarian organisations, research institutions, and international conferences. The summit is expected to strengthen global cooperation and promote the responsible use of AI technologies worldwide.

questions.question: According to the IMF's revised World Economic Outlook, what is India's projected GDP growth rate for FY27?
questions.explanation: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) revised India's GDP growth forecast for FY27 to 6.4%, lowering it from the earlier estimate of 6.5%. The revision reflects concerns over rising global energy prices, including higher crude oil, natural gas, and fertilizer costs, which are expected to increase inflationary pressures and impact economic growth. Despite the downgrade, India's economy continues to be supported by strong domestic consumption and a resilient services sector. The IMF also expects growth to improve in FY28 as energy-related pressures ease, keeping India among the world's fastest-growing major economies.

questions.question: Within how many working days will eligible online PF advance claims be processed under the new EPFO 3.0 rules?
questions.explanation: Under the new EPFO 3.0 reforms, eligible online PF advance claims linked with Aadhaar and verified KYC are processed much faster than before. The claim settlement period has been reduced from the earlier 7–20 working days to just 3 working days, making the withdrawal process quicker and more efficient. This digital initiative also includes a higher auto-settlement limit of ₹5 lakh, simplified withdrawal categories, and mandatory retention of 25% of the EPF balance while an employee remains in service. The reforms aim to improve convenience while protecting long-term retirement savings.

questions.question: Who has been approved by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) as the Managing Director and CEO of South Indian Bank?
questions.explanation: Mahesh Pai has been approved by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) as the Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer (MD & CEO) of South Indian Bank for a three-year term. He is currently serving as the Chief General Manager at Canara Bank, where he leads the Digital Banking and Innovation vertical. With nearly three decades of banking experience, he has worked across digital banking, treasury, corporate strategy, retail banking, MSME credit, and overseas banking operations. He will succeed P. R. Seshadri as the head of South Indian Bank after completing the required approval process.

questions.question: In which country did the Embassy of India launch a dedicated online appointment portal for Passport, Visa & Attestation services?
questions.explanation: The Embassy of India launched a dedicated online appointment portal to simplify access to Passport, Visa, and Attestation services for applicants across the UAE. The portal enables users to book appointments for services provided at the Embassy of India in Abu Dhabi and the Consulate General of India in Dubai. This initiative improves the efficiency, accessibility, and convenience of consular services for applicants.

questions.explanation: NOT AVAILABLE

questions.question: Which former Indian captain became the 12th Indian cricketer to be inducted into the ICC Hall of Fame in 2026?
questions.explanation: Sourav Ganguly was inducted into the ICC Hall of Fame on 8 July 2026, becoming the 12th Indian cricketer to receive this prestigious recognition. Widely known as "Dada," Ganguly is celebrated for transforming Indian cricket through his fearless leadership and aggressive approach. Under his captaincy, India reached the 2003 ICC Cricket World Cup final, achieved memorable overseas Test victories, and developed future stars such as MS Dhoni, Virender Sehwag, Yuvraj Singh, Harbhajan Singh, and Zaheer Khan. His achievements as both a captain and batter earned him a place among cricket's greatest legends.

questions.question: Which country launched the new Letter of Authorisation (LoA) regime for sustainable high-seas fishing to strengthen its Blue Economy?
questions.explanation: India introduced the new Letter of Authorisation (LoA) regime to promote sustainable high-seas fishing, improve fishermen’s incomes, and strengthen the country’s Blue Economy. The initiative enables Indian fishing vessels to operate in the Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) and beyond while ensuring responsible exploitation of marine resources. It also aims to reduce pressure on coastal fisheries, increase seafood exports, create employment opportunities, and support fishing cooperatives and Fish Farmer Producer Organisations. With a coastline exceeding 11,000 km and a vast EEZ of nearly 24 lakh square kilometres, the initiative seeks to unlock India's untapped deep-sea fishing potential and enhance its position in the global seafood market.

questions.question: Which state unveiled the AI Policy 2026–31 roadmap to attract over ₹10,000 crore in private investment and create more than one lakh AI-enabled jobs?
questions.explanation: Jharkhand launched the AI Policy 2026–31 with the objective of transforming the state into a leading hub for artificial intelligence, digital governance, and technology-driven innovation. The roadmap aims to attract more than ₹10,000 crore in private investment, establish over 50 Global Capability Centres (GCCs), support more than 1,000 AI startups, and generate over one lakh AI-enabled jobs within five years. The policy also emphasises AI-powered governance through initiatives such as the Chief Minister’s Data Intelligence Platform, Health and Nutrition Vigilance System, and Critical Minerals Administration System, while strengthening the state's IT infrastructure, startup ecosystem, and digital economy.

questions.question: Which stealth frigate was commissioned into the Indian Navy's Eastern Fleet as the sixth and final vessel of Project 17A?
questions.explanation: INS Mahendragiri is the sixth and final stealth frigate built under the Indian Navy’s Project 17A and was commissioned into the Eastern Fleet on 11 July 2026. Designed by the Indian Navy’s Warship Design Bureau and constructed by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited, the warship has over 75% indigenous content, reflecting India's commitment to self-reliance under the Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative. Equipped with advanced stealth technology, modern automation, and capabilities for anti-air, anti-surface, anti-submarine, and electronic warfare, INS Mahendragiri also supports search and rescue, humanitarian assistance, maritime security, and long-range operational missions.

questions.question: Which bank received the inaugural BBB-/Stable investment-grade issuer credit rating from S&P Global Ratings?
questions.explanation: Federal Bank received its first-ever international issuer credit rating of BBB-/Stable for the long term and A-3 for the short term from S&P Global Ratings. This investment-grade rating reflects the bank’s strong financial fundamentals, disciplined risk management, healthy capitalisation, diversified funding profile, and consistent financial performance. A BBB- rating is the lowest level within the investment-grade category, indicating adequate financial strength, stable operating performance, and a strong ability to meet long-term financial commitments. The rating also enhances global investor confidence, improves access to capital, strengthens stakeholder trust, and reinforces the bank’s international credibility.

questions.question: Which organisation signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with TRAI to conduct India's largest village-level telecom network performance survey?
questions.explanation: The Department of Posts partnered with the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) to conduct the largest-ever telecom network performance survey covering more than 5.68 lakh villages across the country. The survey aims to assess the quality and availability of mobile services provided by operators such as Bharti Airtel, Reliance Jio, Vodafone Idea, and BSNL. Using the extensive rural postal network, Gramin Dak Sevaks, and an Android-based mobile application, the initiative will identify connectivity gaps, support evidence-based policymaking, improve rural telecom infrastructure, and strengthen the Digital India mission by enhancing mobile connectivity in remote and underserved regions.

questions.question: Which country partnered with India to inaugurate the International Centre for Civilizational Studies “Manas and Mahabharata” in Bishkek?
questions.explanation: India and Kyrgyzstan jointly inaugurated the International Centre for Civilizational Studies “Manas and Mahabharata” in Bishkek to strengthen cultural and academic cooperation. The centre aims to promote comparative research on the Mahabharata and the Kyrgyz epic Manas while encouraging collaboration in history, literature, philosophy, and international relations. The initiative also supports faculty exchanges, joint research, and cultural dialogue between the two countries. Another significant achievement announced during the event was the release of the first Hindi translation of the Kyrgyz epic Manas, further enhancing mutual understanding and preserving the rich literary heritage of both nations.

questions.question: When is World Population Day observed every year to raise awareness about population-related issues and sustainable development?
questions.explanation: World Population Day is observed every year on July 11 to increase awareness about global population issues, including reproductive health, family planning, gender equality, youth empowerment, and sustainable development. Established by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) in 1989, the observance was inspired by the "Five Billion Day" milestone on July 11, 1987, when the world's population was estimated to have reached five billion. The day encourages governments, organisations, and individuals to promote informed decision-making, improve quality of life, ensure equitable access to resources, and support policies that contribute to balanced population growth and long-term sustainability.

questions.question: Which city will make the Pink Saheli Smart Card mandatory for women to avail free bus travel from August 1, 2026?
questions.explanation: The Delhi government has made the Pink Saheli Smart Card mandatory for women to continue enjoying free travel on Delhi Transport Corporation (DTC) and DIMTS (Cluster) buses from 1 August 2026. The initiative replaces the existing paper-based pink ticket system with a digital smart card to improve transparency, reduce paper usage, simplify ticket verification, and prevent misuse of the scheme. Eligible women must apply for the card, carry it while travelling, and tap it on the card reader when boarding the bus. The government has also established multiple registration centres and launched awareness campaigns to ensure smooth implementation of the new digital system.

questions.question: What was the global rank of the Indian Air Force in the WDMMA 2026 Global Air Power Rankings?
questions.explanation: The Indian Air Force (IAF) secured the 3rd position in the WDMMA 2026 Global Air Power Rankings for the fifth consecutive year, ranking ahead of China's People's Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF). The rankings are based on the True Value Rating (TVR) system, which evaluates factors such as fleet composition, modernisation, operational readiness, logistics, mission capability, and domestic aerospace production rather than only the number of aircraft. With a balanced fleet of fighter jets, helicopters, transport aircraft, trainers, and special mission aircraft, along with ongoing modernisation under the Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative, the IAF continues to strengthen its global standing.

questions.question: Which state launched the ‘Mee Bhoomi-Mee Hakku’ programme to streamline land records and ownership in 2026?
questions.explanation: Andhra Pradesh launched the ‘Mee Bhoomi-Mee Hakku’ programme under the leadership of Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu to improve land record management and ownership transparency. The initiative aims to distribute 29.04 lakh new Pattadar Passbooks across 6,887 villages by the end of July 2026. It also includes the removal of 2,074 acres of land from the prohibited list under Section 22-A, benefiting hundreds of farmers. Additionally, 101 acres were removed from the ‘dotted lands’ category to resolve ownership issues, making the programme a significant step toward efficient land administration and farmer welfare.

questions.question: What was the rank of New Delhi in the Global Liveability Index 2026 released by the Economist Intelligence Unit (EIU)?
questions.explanation: New Delhi secured the 120th position in the Global Liveability Index 2026 published by the Economist Intelligence Unit (EIU), which assessed 173 cities worldwide. The rankings were based on five key parameters: stability, healthcare, culture and environment, education, and infrastructure. Copenhagen was ranked as the world's most liveable city, followed by Vienna and Melbourne. Among Indian cities, Mumbai ranked 121st, Chennai 123rd, and Bengaluru 127th. The index provides a comprehensive assessment of urban living conditions and helps compare the quality of life across cities around the world.

questions.question: Which city is hosting the 3rd BRICS Transport Ministers’ Meeting under India’s 2026 BRICS Chairship?
questions.explanation: Nagpur, Maharashtra, is hosting the 3rd BRICS Transport Ministers’ Meeting on July 11–12, 2026, under India’s BRICS Chairship. Chaired by Union Transport Minister Nitin Gadkari, the meeting follows the Transport Working Group session and focuses on the theme “Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability (BRICS).” Key discussions include the adoption of Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), transport decarbonisation, AI-based technologies, resilient logistics and supply chains, urban mobility, circular economy practices, and the development of multi-modal infrastructure. The meeting marks the third edition of the BRICS Transport Ministers’ forum after previous sessions hosted by Russia and Brazil.

questions.question: Which country announced the repatriation of three stolen ancient antiquities to Tamil Nadu in 2026?
questions.explanation: Australia announced the return of three stolen 11th and 12th-century antiquities to India, marking an important step in preserving India's cultural heritage. The artefacts include a ceremonial Bronze Trident of Goddess Bhadrakali, a Granite Nandi idol, and a Basalt sculpture of the six-headed Karthikeya (Shanmukha). These objects originated from historic temples built during the reign of Rajendra Chola I under the Chola dynasty and had been illegally trafficked before being housed in the National Gallery of Australia. Their repatriation reflects international cooperation in combating the illegal trade of cultural property and protecting historical artefacts.

questions.question: Where was the foundation stone laid for the ICMR Centre for High Altitude Medicine and Public Health Research?
questions.explanation: The foundation stone for the ICMR Centre for High Altitude Medicine and Public Health Research was laid in Keylong, Himachal Pradesh, by Union Health Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda. The project will upgrade the existing ICMR field station into a multidisciplinary research hub focused on high-altitude physiology, acclimatisation, maternal and child health, disaster medicine, and tribal health. The centre will also integrate telemedicine, digital health platforms, and drone-enabled healthcare logistics to improve medical services in remote Himalayan regions. It will work in collaboration with the Armed Forces Medical Services (AFMS), DRDO, and the Himachal Pradesh Government to advance high-altitude public health research.

questions.question: Which state became India's 6th fully literate state under the ULLAS (New India Literacy Programme) 2026?
questions.explanation: Uttarakhand became India's sixth fully literate state on 8 July 2026 after fulfilling the literacy benchmarks under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 and the ULLAS (Understanding of Lifelong Learning for All in Society) – New India Literacy Programme. The centrally sponsored scheme focuses on improving adult literacy, digital literacy, financial literacy, and critical life skills among non-literate citizens aged 15 years and above. Implemented through volunteer participation and the ULLAS Mobile App, the programme aims to promote lifelong learning and inclusive education. Uttarakhand joined Mizoram, Goa, Tripura, Himachal Pradesh, and Sikkim in achieving this milestone.

questions.question: Which international financial institution approved a USD 890 million funding package to support India's national residential solar rooftop programme?
questions.explanation: The World Bank Group approved a USD 890 million financing package on 10 July 2026 to accelerate India's national residential solar rooftop programme under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana. The package includes a USD 820 million IBRD loan, a USD 60 million concessional loan from the Clean Technology Fund, and a USD 10 million grant from the IBRD’s Livable Planet Fund. The initiative is expected to mobilise USD 4.2 billion in private investment, support solar installations for 10 million households, create around 1.7 million jobs, and contribute to India's goals of achieving 60% non-fossil-fuel-based electricity capacity by 2035 and Net Zero emissions by 2070.

questions.question: On which date is NAMASTE Day observed every year to honour India's sanitation workers and mark the anniversary of the NAMASTE Scheme?
questions.explanation: NAMASTE Day is observed annually on July 14 to recognise the invaluable contribution of sanitation workers, including sewer workers, septic tank workers, waste pickers, and former manual scavengers. The observance also marks the anniversary of the National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE) Scheme, launched during the 2023–24 financial year. The initiative promotes mechanised sanitation, occupational safety, social inclusion, and improved livelihoods for sanitation workers. Across the country, awareness programmes, health camps, safety training, demonstrations of mechanised equipment, and welfare activities are organised to honour their service and encourage dignified and safe sanitation practices.

questions.question: Which city was the venue for the unveiling of the Mannathu Padmanabhan statue and the inauguration of the Mannam Smrithi Mandapam on July 12, 2026?
questions.explanation: The unveiling of the statue of renowned social reformer Mannathu Padmanabhan and the inauguration of the Mannam Smrithi Mandapam took place in New Delhi at the Mannam International Centre in Dwarka. The event was organised by the Nair Service Society (NSS), Delhi, and attended by Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan, along with other dignitaries. The memorial honours Padmanabhan's lifelong efforts toward social justice, equality, and reform. The ceremony also included a tree plantation drive under the 'Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam' campaign, highlighting the importance of environmental conservation alongside commemorating his legacy.

questions.question: How many major qualification tests did ISRO successfully complete for the Gaganyaan Crew Module on July 12, 2026?
questions.explanation: ISRO successfully completed three major qualification tests for the Gaganyaan Crew Module as part of preparations for India's first human spaceflight mission. The tests validated the Crew Module Uprighting System (CMUS), the Crew-Service Umbilical Unit (CSU-2) separation mechanism, and the Apex Cover Separation System. These systems are essential for ensuring astronaut safety during splashdown, atmospheric re-entry, parachute deployment, and post-landing recovery. The successful completion of these tests significantly improves mission readiness, reduces operational risks, and brings India closer to achieving its goal of independently sending astronauts into low Earth orbit and safely returning them to Earth.

questions.question: How many nations, along with the United States and the United Kingdom, rejected China's South China Sea claims in the joint statement issued on July 12, 2026?
questions.explanation: A total of 12 nations, together with the United States and the United Kingdom, joined in issuing a joint statement reaffirming the 2016 Hague Arbitration ruling on the South China Sea. Altogether, the declaration was supported by 14 countries, which emphasised that China's expansive maritime claims have no legal basis under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS). The statement marked the tenth anniversary of the landmark arbitral award, reaffirmed the importance of international law, freedom of navigation, and peaceful dispute resolution, and expressed concern over actions that could undermine regional stability in the Indo-Pacific.

questions.question: Which state has the Employees' State Insurance (ESI) Scheme implemented across all 33 districts under the ESIC 2.0 reforms?
questions.explanation: Under the ESIC 2.0 reforms, the Employees' State Insurance (ESI) Scheme has been implemented across all 33 districts of Telangana, expanding access to social security and healthcare services for insured workers and their families. Telangana has played a significant role in the ESI Scheme since it was first introduced in the Twin Cities of Hyderabad and Secunderabad on 30 March 1975. Today, the state provides social security benefits to more than 19 lakh insured persons, demonstrating the extensive coverage and importance of the scheme in supporting the welfare of employees.

questions.question: Which state became the first in the country to collaborate with the Union Ministry for hosting the 6th Lok Samvardhan Parv under the PM VIKAS Scheme?
questions.explanation: Uttarakhand became the first state in India to collaborate with the Union Ministry of Minority Affairs for organising the 6th Lok Samvardhan Parv under the PM VIKAS Scheme. Held at the Parade Ground in Dehradun, the festival showcased traditional handicrafts, textiles, and indigenous products through 150 exhibition stalls. Around 90 women artisans participated, highlighting the theme of Nari Shakti, while 40% of the stalls were dedicated to the state's crafts and arts. The event also promoted entrepreneurship, facilitated buyer-seller interactions, and supported artisans through digital marketing initiatives, contributing to cultural preservation and sustainable livelihoods.

questions.question: Which country signed agreements with India on maritime hydrography, mutual logistics support, and disaster management while elevating bilateral ties to a Strategic Partnership?
questions.explanation: India and New Zealand elevated their bilateral relationship to a Strategic Partnership and signed several agreements covering maritime security, defence cooperation, trade, agriculture, disaster management, tourism, and cultural collaboration. The two countries adopted a Roadmap to 2030 with the goal of doubling bilateral trade to NZ$7 billion by 2030. Key agreements included mutual logistics support between their naval forces, hydrography and nautical cartography cooperation, and disaster resilience initiatives. New Zealand also joined the Maritime Security pillar of the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative and the Global Biofuels Alliance, strengthening cooperation across strategic, economic, and environmental sectors.

questions.question: Which space agency successfully conducted the first lift-off and vertical landing test of its reusable prototype rocket in Akita prefecture in 2026?
questions.explanation: JAXA successfully conducted Japan's first lift-off and vertical landing test of a reusable prototype rocket at its test facility in Noshiro, Akita Prefecture. During the test, the rocket reached an altitude of about 10 metres and completed a safe landing after a 40-second flight. The reusable launch technology is intended to recover the first-stage booster, the most expensive part of a rocket, thereby reducing the cost of future space missions. This achievement marks a significant milestone for Japan's space programme and strengthens its capabilities in developing cost-effective and sustainable space transportation systems.

questions.question: Which city will host the 16th edition of Aero India from February 8–12, 2027?
questions.explanation: The 16th edition of Aero India, Asia's largest airshow and aviation exhibition, will be held in Bengaluru from February 8 to 12, 2027, at the Yelahanka Air Force Station. The event is organised with Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) as the nodal agency, supported by Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL). Aero India is a biennial event that showcases India's defence and aerospace capabilities while providing a platform for domestic and international companies to display advanced technologies. The event also supports the government's vision of increasing indigenous defence manufacturing and strengthening India's position in the global aerospace sector.

questions.question: Which state's Unjha cumin (Jeera) and Unjha fennel (Saunf) were recently granted the Geographical Indication (GI) tag?
questions.explanation: Unjha cumin and Unjha fennel were awarded the Geographical Indication (GI) tag to recognise their unique qualities and strong connection with the Unjha region. Gujarat is home to Unjha, one of Asia's largest spice trading centres, where these premium spices are cultivated and traded extensively. The GI certification protects the products from imitation, strengthens their regional identity, improves export opportunities, and enhances consumer confidence in their authenticity. It is also expected to help farmers secure better prices, promote value addition in the spice supply chain, and further strengthen the agricultural economy of Gujarat.

questions.question: Which smartphone company entered into a joint venture with Dixon Technologies for electronic device manufacturing, approved by the Government of India, in 2026?
questions.explanation: Vivo entered into a joint venture with Dixon Technologies (India) Limited for manufacturing smartphones and other electronic devices in India. The venture has an equity structure of 51% held by Dixon Technologies and 49% by Vivo Mobile India, ensuring majority Indian ownership in compliance with Press Note 3 regulations. Approved by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, the partnership is expected to strengthen domestic electronics manufacturing, promote local production, and support India's growing mobile device manufacturing ecosystem.

questions.question: By what percentage did India's merchandise trade deficit increase year-on-year in June 2026?
questions.explanation: India's merchandise trade deficit reached $30.43 billion in June 2026, compared to $19.10 billion in June 2025, reflecting a year-on-year increase of 59%. During the month, merchandise exports stood at $40.41 billion, while imports were significantly higher at $70.84 billion, resulting in a wider trade gap. The increase was driven by elevated import costs, weaker export momentum compared to the previous month, and challenging global economic conditions. A persistently high trade deficit can put pressure on the current account, currency stability, and inflation, making trade policy and export growth key priorities.

questions.question: In which Indian state did Spain's Submer Group announce a $2 billion investment in the semiconductor and data centre industry?
questions.explanation: Spain's Submer Group announced a $2 billion investment to strengthen the semiconductor and data centre ecosystem in Madhya Pradesh. The project is expected to create around 5,000 direct employment opportunities and includes the development of Global Capability Centres along with advanced technological infrastructure. About 15 acres of land have been allotted in the Acharpura industrial area for the data centre project, with the approval and land allotment completed in a record six days. The investment is expected to boost industrial growth, technology development, and employment in the region.

questions.question: In which country was the 56th International Physics Olympiad (IPhO) 2026 held?
questions.explanation: The 56th International Physics Olympiad (IPhO) 2026 was organised in Bucaramanga, Colombia. The event witnessed participation from 381 students representing 87 countries, making it one of the world's leading physics competitions for school students. India achieved an outstanding milestone by winning five gold medals, with every member of its team earning a gold medal. This performance helped India secure a joint first position alongside China, Kazakhstan, Russia, South Korea, and Taiwan, reflecting the country's consistent excellence in international science Olympiads.

questions.question: Which state enforced new legal provisions authorising preventive detention without trial and the attachment of properties belonging to rioters in 2026?
questions.explanation: West Bengal introduced new legal provisions that authorise preventive detention without trial and permit the attachment of properties belonging to individuals identified as rioters. Under these provisions, detention orders must receive approval from the State Government within 15 days, while every case is to be reviewed by an Advisory Board within three weeks. The board must be chaired by a serving or retired High Court judge. These measures operate within the constitutional framework of preventive detention provided under Article 22 of the Constitution of India, which also lays down safeguards regarding the duration and review of detention.

questions.question: What was India's Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation rate in June 2026?
questions.explanation: India's Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation increased to 9.87% in June 2026, up from 9.68% in May 2026. The rise was primarily driven by higher prices of food products, mineral oils, basic metals, and chemicals, reflecting continued cost pressures across multiple sectors. During the same period, the Wholesale Price Index increased from 109.9 to 110.2. While fuel and power inflation moderated compared to the previous month, elevated food and manufacturing-related prices continued to keep wholesale inflation at a high level, indicating persistent inflationary trends in the economy.

questions.question: At which location was the 84,000 m³ RCC Water Reservoir inaugurated at the IISCO Steel Plant in 2026?

questions.question: Which company was ranked India's most valuable and strongest tyre brand in the Brand Finance India 100 – 2026 report?
questions.explanation: MRF was recognised as India's most valuable and strongest tyre brand in the Brand Finance India 100 – 2026 report. The rankings reflect MRF's strong market presence, customer trust, financial performance, and effective brand management. Established in 1946 and headquartered in Chennai, MRF manufactures tyres for a wide range of vehicles, including cars, trucks, buses, motorcycles, agricultural machinery, and aircraft, making it one of India's leading tyre manufacturers.

questions.question: Which state has announced India's first government-driven Artificial Intelligence (AI) University?
questions.explanation: Karnataka has announced the establishment of India's first government-driven Artificial Intelligence (AI) University as part of its vision to become an "AI-native State." The proposed university will focus on developing world-class AI talent, promoting advanced research, encouraging innovation, and strengthening collaboration among academia, industry, and government. Along with the university, the state will also establish an AI Hub to support startups, research, and commercialization of AI technologies. These initiatives aim to enhance Karnataka's leadership in artificial intelligence while contributing to India's growing digital economy and future-ready workforce.

questions.question: By what percentage did India’s net direct tax collections increase year-on-year as of July 13?
questions.explanation: As of July 13, India’s net direct tax collections reached ₹6.51 lakh crore, compared to ₹5.59 lakh crore during the same period in the previous financial year. This represents a year-on-year growth of 16.4%. The increase was driven by higher corporate tax collections and improved non-corporate tax receipts, reflecting stronger corporate profitability, better tax compliance, rising incomes, and a healthy equity market. This growth was achieved despite the government issuing significantly higher tax refunds, highlighting the strength of overall tax revenue performance and the country's improving fiscal position.

questions.question: On which date is World Youth Skills Day 2026 celebrated worldwide?
questions.explanation: World Youth Skills Day 2026 will be observed on July 15, 2026, to highlight the importance of equipping young people with vocational, technical, digital, and life skills needed for the future workforce. The day promotes continuous learning, innovation, and collaboration among governments, industries, and educational institutions. It also emphasises preparing youth for AI-driven workplaces, green economies, entrepreneurship, and lifelong learning. Established by the United Nations General Assembly in 2014, the observance aims to improve employability, reduce unemployment, support sustainable development, and encourage inclusive economic growth through quality skill development.

questions.question: Who was conferred the 60th Jnanpith Award for 2025 for outstanding contributions to Tamil literature?
questions.explanation: R. Vairamuthu was conferred the 60th Jnanpith Award for 2025 in recognition of his outstanding lifetime contribution to Tamil literature. A celebrated poet, lyricist, and writer, he became the third Tamil author from Tamil Nadu to receive this prestigious honour, following Akilan and Jayakanthan. The award includes a cash prize of ₹11 lakh, a bronze statue of Goddess Vagdevi, and a citation. Vairamuthu is widely known for his poetry, novels, essays, and film lyrics, with notable works such as Kallikattu Ithikasam, which earned him the Sahitya Akademi Award in 2003.

questions.question: In which city was the All India Water Secretaries’ Conference organised by the Department of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation?
questions.explanation: New Delhi hosted the All India Water Secretaries’ Conference organised by the Department of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation under the Ministry of Jal Shakti. questions.question: India strengthened its partnership with which organisation during the third Trade and Technology Council (TTC) meeting held in Brussels?
questions.explanation: India strengthened its partnership with the European Union during the third Trade and Technology Council (TTC) meeting in Brussels. The discussions focused on expanding cooperation in areas such as artificial intelligence, electric vehicles, semiconductors, renewable energy technologies, secure digital infrastructure, and resilient supply chains. Both sides emphasised the importance of trusted partnerships to address global trade disruptions and technological challenges. The collaboration also aims to promote sustainable economic growth, enhance digital transformation, strengthen trade and investment ties, support clean energy initiatives, and encourage innovation through joint efforts between governments, industries, startups, and research institutions.

questions.question: Which Indian state approved the new agricultural marketing law replacing the 1956 OAPM Act to establish a competitive farmer-centric system?
questions.explanation: Odisha approved a new agricultural marketing law to replace the Odisha Agricultural Produce Markets (OAPM) Act, 1956, with the objective of creating a more competitive, transparent, and farmer-centric agricultural marketing system. The new legislation aligns the state's framework with the Centre's Model Agricultural Produce and Livestock Marketing Act, 2017. It promotes electronic trading, e-auctions, a unified statewide market, inter-state trade, and a single trading licence. The reforms also recognise warehouses, cold storages, and silos as market sub-yards while encouraging the participation of Farmer Producer Organisations, cooperatives, and self-help groups to improve market access for farmers.

questions.question: Which state increased the subsidy under the Pink E-Rickshaw Scheme from 20% to 40% for women beneficiaries?
questions.explanation: Maharashtra increased the subsidy under the Pink E-Rickshaw Scheme from 20% to 40% to promote women's economic empowerment and self-employment. The revised subsidy also provides retrospective benefits to eligible women who had already purchased e-rickshaws under the scheme. Beneficiaries are required to contribute at least 10% of the vehicle cost, while the remaining amount can be financed through bank loans or interest-free deferred payment facilities offered by suppliers. The scheme is implemented through the Office of the Commissioner, Women and Child Development, Pune, with the state government empowered to reallocate beneficiary targets across districts.

questions.question: Which Indian city is set to launch driverless metro train operations on the Green and Purple Lines?
questions.explanation: Kolkata is set to introduce driverless metro train operations on its Green and Purple Lines, making it one of the few Indian cities with Grade of Automation 4 (GoA-4) metro services. These trains use advanced Communication-Based Train Control (CBTC) technology, enabling automatic acceleration, braking, station stops, and door operations under continuous supervision from a central control room. The project also includes advanced safety features such as platform screen doors, smart signalling systems, emergency braking, and obstacle detection. The initiative is expected to improve operational efficiency, passenger safety, and the overall public transport experience in the city.

questions.question: Which initiative was approved by the Union Cabinet with a budget of ₹1.27 lakh crore to strengthen India's semiconductor ecosystem?
questions.explanation: Semicon 2.0 is a major government initiative approved by the Union Cabinet to strengthen India's semiconductor ecosystem with an allocated budget of ₹1.27 lakh crore. The programme aims to promote semiconductor design, manufacturing, research and development, advanced packaging, materials, and workforce development. It seeks to reduce dependence on imports, attract global semiconductor companies, and create a resilient domestic supply chain. Built upon the achievements of Semicon 1.0, the initiative also focuses on technological self-reliance, innovation, and positioning India as a trusted global hub for semiconductor manufacturing and advanced chip design.

questions.question: Which state officially adopted the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 and the PM-SHRI scheme to enable the release of central education funds?
questions.explanation: West Bengal officially adopted the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 and the PM-SHRI scheme to facilitate the release of central education funds for the current financial year. Along with this decision, the state announced several education reforms, including an increase in PM POSHAN cooking costs, the introduction of gas-based cooking in schools, installation of solar panels and other infrastructure improvements, provision of safe drinking water in affected districts, and the recruitment of 12,000 teachers. The move also includes governance reforms and aligns the state's education system with national initiatives aimed at improving the quality, accessibility, and sustainability of school education.

questions.question: In which Indian state were two new species of solitary bees discovered during a biodiversity documentation expedition?
questions.explanation: Arunachal Pradesh is the state where researchers discovered two new species of solitary bees during a biodiversity documentation expedition in the Siang Valley. The newly identified species, Elaphropoda triangulata and Habropoda adi, belong to the Anthophorinae subfamily, which consists of ground-nesting solitary bees that play a crucial role as pollinators. The discovery was made by researchers from the Ashoka Trust for Research in Ecology and the Environment (ATREE) and Felis Creations. Located in the Eastern Himalayas, Arunachal Pradesh is a globally recognised biodiversity hotspot and continues to contribute significantly to India's newly discovered plant and animal species.

questions.question: Under which operation did the Central Bureau of Narcotics dismantle a high-tech Mephedrone manufacturing laboratory in Pune?
questions.explanation: Operation Vajra was a special operation under which the Central Bureau of Narcotics (CBN) dismantled a high-tech Mephedrone manufacturing laboratory in Pune and arrested the key conspirators. The operation was carried out by the Preventive Branch of the Office of the Deputy Narcotics Commissioner, CBN, Neemuch. The illicit laboratory was seized in Maharashtra, while the accused were apprehended in Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan. All actions were taken under the provisions of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985. The operation reflects the government's continued efforts to combat illegal drug production and strengthen narcotics law enforcement across the country.

questions.question: Which bank launched the national-level cybersecurity hackathon FinSpark'26 to address technology-driven security challenges in the banking sector?
questions.explanation: Bank of Maharashtra launched FinSpark'26, a national-level cybersecurity hackathon, to encourage innovative solutions for emerging cyber threats in the banking sector. The event is centred on the theme "Securing the Future of Banking" and aims to strengthen cyber resilience while enhancing customer trust. The hackathon offers a prize pool of more than ₹10 lakh and features problem statements related to insider threat detection and AI-driven cybersecurity analytics. The grand finale is scheduled to be held at COEP Technological University, Pune. The initiative reflects the bank's commitment to promoting innovation and improving cybersecurity in financial services.

questions.question: On which date is World Snake Day celebrated every year?
questions.explanation: World Snake Day is celebrated annually on July 16 to raise awareness about snakes and their importance in maintaining ecological balance. The observance highlights the need to conserve snake species, protect their natural habitats, and educate people about their ecological role. Snakes help control rodent populations, support biodiversity, and maintain healthy food chains. The day also aims to dispel common myths and fears associated with snakes through educational programs and conservation initiatives. Since its recognition in 2009, World Snake Day has encouraged wildlife experts, conservationists, and environmental organisations worldwide to promote snake conservation and foster a better understanding of these important reptiles.

questions.question: Which insurance company launched the Smart Retirement Income with Sustained Earnings (Smart RISE) retirement income plan in July, 2026?
options: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Ltd.
questions.explanation: Axis Max Life Insurance Ltd. launched the Smart Retirement Income with Sustained Earnings (Smart RISE) retirement plan on July 16, 2026. The product combines a guaranteed annuity with a NIFTY 50 index-linked variable annuity, offering customers both stable income and growth potential. It allows policyholders to choose a deferment period before receiving regular pension payouts and provides a Return of Purchase Price to nominees upon the annuitant's demise. Formerly known as Max Life Insurance Company Ltd., the company is headquartered in New Delhi and introduced this plan to support long-term retirement planning while addressing market volatility and financial security needs.

questions.question: Which Indian-origin NASA astronaut launched his first mission to the International Space Station (ISS) in July 2026?
questions.explanation: Anil Menon, an Indian-origin NASA astronaut, launched his first mission to the International Space Station (ISS) on July 15, 2026, aboard Russia's Soyuz MS-29 spacecraft from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan. The mission is scheduled to last for eight months, with his return planned for April 2027. During his stay aboard the ISS, he will conduct scientific research and technology demonstrations alongside Roscosmos cosmonauts Pyotr Dubrov and Anna Kikina. His successful launch marks an important milestone in his career and highlights continued international cooperation in space exploration and scientific research.

questions.question: Which private aerospace company developed the Vikram-1 rocket, India's first privately built orbital launch vehicle?
questions.explanation: Skyroot Aerospace developed the Vikram-1 rocket, India's first privately built orbital launch vehicle, marking a significant milestone in the country's private space sector. Scheduled under Mission Aagaman, the rocket is designed to carry small satellites into low Earth orbit and demonstrates advanced indigenous technologies, including an all-carbon composite structure and 3D-printed engines. The mission builds on the success of the Vikram-S suborbital launch in 2022 and aims to validate the rocket's systems for future commercial operations. Vikram-1 is expected to strengthen India's position in the global small satellite launch market while encouraging greater private participation in the nation's growing space ecosystem.

questions.question: Which organisation has partnered with the Gates Medical Research Institute to manufacture the M72/AS01E tuberculosis vaccine candidate, subject to successful Phase III trials and regulatory approvals?
questions.explanation: Serum Institute of India has entered into a partnership with the Gates Medical Research Institute to establish the manufacturing capacity for the M72/AS01E tuberculosis vaccine candidate. The collaboration aims to produce the vaccine at a large scale if Phase III clinical trials are successful and regulatory approvals are obtained. The initiative seeks to improve vaccine affordability and accessibility, particularly for countries with a high burden of tuberculosis and for lower- and middle-income nations. The partnership also reinforces India's position as a global vaccine manufacturing hub and supports international efforts to combat one of the world's deadliest infectious diseases.

questions.question: Which country held a bilateral meeting with India in July 2026 to strengthen cooperation in the MSME sector?
questions.explanation: India and Poland held a bilateral meeting on July 15, 2026, at Kartavya Bhawan, New Delhi, to strengthen cooperation in the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) sector. The discussions focused on expanding institutional partnerships, promoting sustainable manufacturing through the Zero Defect Zero Effect (ZED) initiative, improving access to credit for small businesses, and enhancing multilingual information dissemination. Poland is India's largest trading partner in Central and Eastern Europe, with bilateral trade increasing threefold between 2013 and 2025. The meeting also reinforced ongoing collaboration between India's National Small Industries Corporation (NSIC) and the Polish Agency for Enterprise Development (PARP).

questions.question: Which bank signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Digital India BHASHINI Division (DIBD) in July, 2026 to promote multilingual AI solutions for inclusive banking?
questions.explanation: Punjab National Bank (PNB) signed an MoU with the Digital India BHASHINI Division (DIBD) to integrate AI-powered multilingual language technologies into banking services. The collaboration aims to enable voice-first banking through the BHASHINI for Seva/Sanchalan initiative, making digital banking more accessible in multiple Indian languages. The partnership covers key BHASHINI components such as Udyat, Mitra, AppMitra, Pravakta, and Bhashadaan. This initiative is expected to reduce language barriers in Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), improve customer accessibility, and promote inclusive banking services for people across diverse linguistic backgrounds in India.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Secretary of the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES) by the Government of India?
questions.explanation: Dr Srinivasa Kumar Tummala has been appointed as the Secretary of the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES) by the Government of India with the approval of the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC). He has over 30 years of experience in satellite oceanography, tsunami warning systems, climate services, disaster risk reduction, and coastal hazard management. Before assuming this role, he headed the Indian Ocean Tsunami Warning and Mitigation System (IOTWMS) Secretariat under UNESCO-IOC in Perth, Australia. He also played a key role in establishing India's Tsunami Early Warning Centre at INCOIS, significantly strengthening the country's disaster preparedness and ocean science capabilities.

questions.question: Which country signed the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) with India to strengthen bilateral trade and professional mobility?
questions.explanation: The Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) became operational between India and the United Kingdom to strengthen bilateral trade, investment, and professional mobility. The agreement provides zero-duty access for 99% of India's export tariff lines, benefiting sectors such as processed foods, textiles, engineering goods, leather, chemicals, and pharmaceuticals. Along with CETA, the Double Contribution Convention (DCC) exempts Indian professionals from dual social security contributions and extends the exemption period for temporary workers from three to five years. These measures are expected to boost trade, support businesses, facilitate skilled professionals, and help achieve the bilateral trade target of USD 100 billion by 2030.

questions.question: On which date is INS Malvan, the second Mahe-class Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft, scheduled to be commissioned into the Indian Navy?
questions.explanation: INS Malvan, the second Mahe-class Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft (ASW-SWC), is scheduled to be commissioned into the Indian Navy on July 22, 2026. Built by Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL), Kochi, the vessel is a significant achievement under the Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative, with more than 80% indigenous content. Designed for anti-submarine warfare, coastal surveillance, and maritime security, INS Malvan will strengthen India's naval capabilities in shallow coastal waters. The induction of this advanced warship reflects India's continued focus on enhancing indigenous defence manufacturing and securing its extensive maritime boundaries.

questions.question: Where did Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurate the Advanced Mother and Child Centre and the Advanced Neurosciences Centre at PGIMER?
questions.explanation: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Advanced Mother and Child Centre and the Advanced Neurosciences Centre at the Post Graduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER) in Chandigarh. During the event, he also laid the foundation stone for a 150-bed Critical Care Block under the Pradhan Mantri Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission (PM-ABHIM). These projects are aimed at improving access to advanced healthcare services, strengthening emergency and critical care infrastructure, supporting medical education and research, and providing better maternal, child, and neurological healthcare for people in Chandigarh and the surrounding regions.

questions.question: Which state emerged as the top-performing large state in NITI Aayog’s first Investment Friendliness Index (IFI)?
questions.explanation: Gujarat secured the top position among India's large states in the first Investment Friendliness Index (IFI) released by NITI Aayog, achieving a score of 56.6 out of 100. The state performed exceptionally well due to its strong infrastructure, efficient ports, and reliable power supply, making it an attractive destination for investments. The index evaluates states and Union Territories across eight pillars, including infrastructure, business climate, regulatory ease, and government policy. It is intended to help governments identify strengths and areas for improvement to create a more investment-friendly environment and support economic growth across the country.

questions.question: Which state is moving towards the implementation of the National e-Vidhan Application (NeVA) under the Digital India Programme?
questions.explanation: Maharashtra is implementing the National e-Vidhan Application (NeVA), a Mission Mode Project of the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs under the Digital India Programme. The initiative follows the vision of “One Nation One Application” and aims to digitise the functioning of the Maharashtra Legislative Assembly and Legislative Council. With an estimated implementation cost of around ₹48 crore in the state, NeVA is expected to make legislative proceedings paperless, improve efficiency, enhance transparency, encourage public participation, and modernise legislative processes through the use of digital technology.

questions.question: Which airline launched the first-ever direct flight connecting NAMO Airport, Daman, to Delhi in July 2026?
questions.explanation: Alliance Air launched the first direct flight connecting NAMO Airport in Daman with Delhi, significantly reducing travel time from 8–10 hours by road to about 2.5 hours by air. As a government-owned regional airline operating under the UDAN scheme, Alliance Air plays a key role in improving regional connectivity across India. The new route benefits the industrial corridor extending from Palghar in Maharashtra to Valsad in Gujarat. The initiative also supports the government's objective of expanding regional aviation infrastructure by developing new airports and improving air connectivity to underserved regions.

questions.question: Who has been confirmed as the UK Labour Party leader and is set to become the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom?
questions.explanation: Andy Burnham has been confirmed as the leader of the UK Labour Party and is set to assume the office of Prime Minister. He succeeds Sir Keir Starmer, who resigned from the party leadership. Burnham became the Labour leader unopposed and is expected to focus on restoring public trust, strengthening public services, promoting regional economic development, and encouraging greater local government autonomy. Having served as a Member of Parliament since 2001 and held several ministerial positions, Burnham brings extensive political experience and is expected to lead the Labour government through a new phase of governance and economic recovery.

questions.question: In which state did the ICMR i-DRONE study significantly reduce tuberculosis diagnosis time and patient costs?
questions.explanation: The ICMR i-DRONE study was conducted in Telangana's Yadadri-Bhuvanagiri district in collaboration with AIIMS Bibinagar and the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP). The initiative evaluated drone-assisted transport of sputum samples for tuberculosis diagnosis among 840 participants. It reduced the median diagnosis time from 15 days to just 5 days while significantly lowering patients' out-of-pocket expenditure from ₹9,451 to ₹91. The project also established a hub-and-spoke healthcare network connecting Primary Health Centres, sub-centres, and TB units, demonstrating how drone technology can improve healthcare delivery and strengthen medical supply chains.

questions.question: Which business group retained the top position in the Brand Finance India 100 Most Valuable Brands 2026 report for the 10th consecutive year?
questions.explanation: Tata Group retained its position as India's most valuable brand in the Brand Finance India 100 Most Valuable Brands 2026 report, marking its 10th consecutive year at the top. The group achieved a brand value of $33.6 billion, reflecting its strong market presence and diversified business portfolio. The report also highlighted Infosys as the second most valuable brand and LIC Group as the third. India's top 100 brands were collectively valued at $252.8 billion, registering a 7% annual increase, demonstrating the continued strength and growth of Indian businesses across multiple sectors.

questions.question: Which country launched its first Strategic Dialogue with India?
questions.explanation: India and Belgium launched their inaugural Strategic Dialogue on July 15, 2026, at the Egmont Palace in Brussels, establishing the first formal mechanism for regular high-level strategic engagement between the two countries. India was represented by External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar, while Belgium was represented by Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Affairs Minister Maxime Prévot. The dialogue focused on strengthening cooperation in clean energy, digital technologies, life sciences, chemicals, logistics, semiconductor supply chains, and defence and security. The initiative reflects the commitment of both nations to deepen bilateral ties and address emerging global and geopolitical challenges through closer collaboration.

questions.question: Which two states are covered under the railway multitracking projects approved by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) in July, 2026?
questions.explanation: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved two railway multitracking projects covering the states of Odisha and Jharkhand to strengthen logistics, rail connectivity, and freight movement. The projects include the Paradeep–Haridaspur doubling and the Rajkharsawan–Dangoaposi fourth line, with a total investment of ₹3,907 crore and a completion target of 2030–31. Together, they will add about 145 km to the Indian Railways network, improve connectivity for around 1,526 villages and 14 lakh people, boost the transportation of key minerals, and support the PM-Gati Shakti National Master Plan through integrated infrastructure development.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the new Prime Minister of Ukraine in July, 2026, following parliamentary approval?
questions.explanation: Serhii Koretskyi was appointed as the Prime Minister of Ukraine on July 16, 2026, after receiving approval from the Verkhovna Rada with 289 votes in favour. He was nominated by President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and succeeded Yulia Svyrydenko as part of a significant wartime government reshuffle. Before becoming Prime Minister, Koretskyi served as the Chief Executive Officer of Naftogaz, Ukraine’s largest state-owned oil and gas company. His appointment is expected to strengthen governance and support the country's administration during ongoing national and geopolitical challenges.
