questions.question: When is Nagasaki Day observed every year to commemorate the atomic bombing of Nagasaki?
questions.explanation: August 9 is observed every year as Nagasaki Day to commemorate the atomic bombing of Nagasaki in 1945 during the final stages of World War II. On August 9, 1945, the United States dropped an atomic bomb code-named “Fat Man” on Nagasaki. The bomb was carried by the B-29 Bockscar, piloted by Major Charles W. Sweeney, and exploded at approximately 11:02 a.m. The bombing caused widespread destruction, deaths, injuries and long-term radiation effects. Nagasaki Day honours the victims, recognises the suffering of survivors, and promotes awareness about the devastating humanitarian consequences of nuclear weapons and the importance of nuclear disarmament.

questions.question: When is the International Day of the World’s Indigenous Peoples observed annually?
questions.explanation: August 9 is observed annually as the International Day of the World’s Indigenous Peoples. The United Nations General Assembly declared the day in December 1994 to recognise the rights, cultures, traditions and contributions of Indigenous Peoples worldwide. The date also commemorates the first session of the UN Working Group on Indigenous Populations, held on August 9, 1982. In 2026, the theme is “Honouring Indigenous Midwives: Safeguarding Life and Well-being,” highlighting the important role of Indigenous midwives and traditional knowledge. The day promotes awareness of issues such as land rights, cultural preservation, equality, healthcare, education and protection of traditional knowledge.

questions.question: Which state approved the Private Business Park Development Scheme 2025 to attract global investments?
questions.explanation: Uttar Pradesh approved the Uttar Pradesh Private Business Park Development Scheme 2025 on March 23, 2026, with the objective of attracting global investments and reducing project implementation delays. The scheme follows a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model based on the Design, Build, Finance, Operate and Transfer (DBFOT) framework. Developers must have a minimum land requirement of 10 acres, while 50% of the business park must be reserved for IT and knowledge-based industries. The initiative aims to provide plug-and-play infrastructure for Global Capability Centres, research and development units, and MSMEs. Land ownership will remain with the state’s Industrial Development Authorities.

questions.question: Where was the 9th India Medical Device 2026 conference organised?
questions.explanation: The 9th India Medical Device 2026 conference was organised at Vigyan Bhawan in New Delhi on August 7 and 8, 2026. The event was organised by the Department of Pharmaceuticals in collaboration with the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI). Its theme was “Towards Viksit Bharat: Advancing India as a Global Hub for Quality Medical Devices”. Key technical sessions focused on Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), Artificial Intelligence in healthcare, localisation of component manufacturing and reimbursement mechanisms for innovative therapies. The conference aimed to strengthen India’s medical device sector and support the country’s goal of becoming a global hub for quality healthcare technologies.

questions.question: Which state announced a ₹9.3 lakh crore investment target through the VER project?
questions.explanation: Andhra Pradesh announced a development plan on August 6, 2026, to attract ₹9.3 lakh crore in total investment through the Visakhapatnam Economic Region (VER) project. The state government is expected to contribute ₹3.5 lakh crore to ₹4 lakh crore, while the private sector target is ₹5.3 lakh crore. The ‘Bay City’ project will serve as the primary anchor for regional development. The project extends from Mulapeta Port to the Akhanda Godavari project in Rajahmundry and focuses on AI data centres, hydrogen, clean technology, renewable energy, port-related industries and tourism. The initiative aims to accelerate economic growth across the region.

questions.question: Which state will host the Asian Rafting Championships 2026?
questions.explanation: Arunachal Pradesh will host the Asian Rafting Championships 2026 in Boleng from October 5 to 9, 2026. The five-day championship will be held on the Simang River, a major tributary of the Siang River, and will feature leading paddlers from across Asia. The event is intended to showcase Arunachal Pradesh’s potential for white-water sports and adventure tourism. The Siang is a major river of the state and is known as the Yarlung Tsangpo in Tibet. Arunachal Pradesh, known as the “Land of the Rising Sun,” became a full-fledged state on February 20, 1987, and its capital is Itanagar.

questions.question: Which states were covered by the NJORT deployment to manage the Chandipura Virus outbreak?
questions.explanation: Gujarat and Rajasthan were covered by the deployment of the National Joint Outbreak Response Team (NJORT) on August 5, 2026, to manage the Chandipura Virus (CHPV) outbreak. The multidisciplinary team includes experts from the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), and Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD). Investigations are focusing on possible vectors, the clinical spectrum of the disease, animal reservoirs and genetic variations of the virus. Whole-genome sequencing of samples is being conducted at the Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre in Gandhinagar to identify genetic changes in the circulating virus.

questions.question: Which institute is associated with Karthikeyan Lanka, recipient of the NASI Young Scientist Platinum Jubilee Award 2026 in Earth Sciences?
questions.explanation: IIT Bombay Associate Professor Karthikeyan Lanka was selected for the National Academy of Sciences, India (NASI) Young Scientist Platinum Jubilee Award 2026 in the Earth Sciences category. His research focuses on ecohydrology, satellite remote sensing and land-atmosphere interactions. He has used data from NASA’s Soil Moisture Active Passive (SMAP) mission to study soil moisture and its influence on the Indian monsoon. Lanka also developed India’s first operational subseasonal agricultural drought forecasting system in collaboration with the Mahalanobis National Crop Forecast Centre. The system provides weekly drought forecasts at a 9-kilometre spatial resolution with lead times of up to four weeks.

questions.question: Which state launched the Vetri Vaanmagal Scheme to train women drone pilots for precision farming?
questions.explanation: Tamil Nadu launched the Vetri Vaanmagal Scheme on August 6, 2026, as part of its 2026-27 agriculture budget to promote women’s participation in modern agricultural technology. The scheme aims to train 500 eligible candidates, including 100 women drone operators, through the Remote Pilot Training Organisation of Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU). The government allocated ₹1.50 crore for operator training and pilot licences. Additionally, 50 women will receive financial assistance covering 50% of the cost of agricultural drones, supported by a ₹2.50 crore allocation. The initiative focuses on precision farming and strengthening women’s role in agricultural mechanisation.

questions.question: Which country became the first to complete a full life-cycle harvest of rice in a space environment aboard the Tiangong Space Station?
questions.explanation: China became the first country to complete a full life-cycle, or seed-to-seed, harvest of rice in a microgravity environment aboard the Tiangong Space Station. The achievement was completed by astronauts of the Shenzhou-23 mission on August 5, 2026, at an orbital altitude of about 400 kilometres above Earth. The experiment used specialised plant growth chambers to regulate light, temperature, humidity and nutrient delivery. The research aims to support sustainable food production during future long-duration human missions to the Moon and Mars, while also studying the genetic stability and regeneration capabilities of crops grown in microgravity.

The Korea Masters is part of the professional badminton circuit held in South Korea. The Badminton World Federation (BWF), established in 1934, is the international governing body for badminton.

questions.question: Where did Astrobase Space Technologies unveil India’s first privately-built 800kN reusable rocket engine, Everest?
questions.explanation: Bengaluru was the location where Astrobase Space Technologies unveiled India’s first privately-built 800kN Full-Flow Staged Combustion (FFSC) liquid oxygen-methane rocket engine, named Everest, on August 7, 2026. The engine produces 800 kN of thrust and has a specific impulse of 340 seconds. It is designed for reusable medium-lift launch vehicles and features a throttle range of 50% to 110%. Astrobase plans to manufacture 50 engines annually and aims to support launch-on-demand missions. The company, headquartered in Bengaluru, was established in 2024 and specialises in propulsion systems, test infrastructure, and reusable space technologies.

questions.question: Where was India’s first-of-its-kind Eco-Educational Hub, ‘Prakriti Gyan Dham’, inaugurated?
questions.explanation: Lucknow is the location where India’s first-of-its-kind Eco-Educational Hub, ‘Prakriti Gyan Dham’, was inaugurated at the Banthra campus of CSIR-NBRI on August 8, 2026. The hub was dedicated to the nation by Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh. It includes the PAaVan Path interpretive heritage trail, Indian Heritage Garden, Vibhav Enclave for rare and threatened plants, Bhairav Enclave featuring State Plants, and Bamboosteum with 43 bamboo species. The initiative promotes experiential environmental education, biodiversity awareness, and conservation. CSIR-NBRI, headquartered in Lucknow, is a constituent laboratory of the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research.

questions.question: Which country is the location of the Sampur Solar Power Project?
questions.explanation: Sri Lanka is the location of the Sampur Solar Power Project, which is situated in the Trincomalee district. The project is being developed as a joint venture between India’s NTPC Limited and the Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB). It aims to increase the share of renewable energy in Sri Lanka’s national electricity grid. India and Sri Lanka are also working on an HVDC interconnection project to link their power grids and facilitate the transfer of surplus renewable energy. These initiatives are intended to strengthen bilateral energy cooperation, regional energy security, and the clean energy transition.

questions.question: Which organisation signed an MoU with the Karnataka Digital Economy Mission to attract ₹5,000 crore in GCC investments to Karnataka?
questions.explanation: GoodWorks Group signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Karnataka Digital Economy Mission (KDEM) on August 09, 2026, to attract ₹5,000 crore in Global Capability Centre (GCC) investments to Karnataka over the next five years. The partnership aims to establish 50 new GCCs and expand existing centres, creating more than 62,500 direct and indirect jobs. It is also expected to generate an annual salary inflow of around ₹2,250 crore and increase demand for 1.25 million sq. ft of commercial real estate. Target markets include North America, Europe, Japan, South Korea, and West Asia.

questions.question: Which airport became the first in India to operationalise a satellite-guided helicopter approach procedure?
questions.explanation: HAL Airport in Bengaluru became the first airport in India to operationalise a satellite-guided helicopter approach procedure on August 7, 2026. The procedure uses Required Navigation Performance Category H (RNP CAT H), a specialised satellite-based navigation system designed specifically for helicopters. Developed by the Airports Authority of India (AAI), it was validated by HAL test pilots and approved by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA). The system reduces helicopter approach time from around 12 minutes to approximately 4 minutes and enables accurate flight paths around terrain and urban obstacles. It is particularly useful for air ambulance and search-and-rescue operations.

questions.question: In which state was the daily Itarsi–Madan Mahal passenger train introduced?
questions.explanation: Madhya Pradesh was the state where the Ministry of Railways introduced the daily Train No. 51673/51674 connecting Itarsi and Madan Mahal. The service was approved on August 8, 2026, covering a distance of 242 km in approximately 5 hours and 5 minutes. It connects the important railway nodes of Itarsi and Jabalpur and benefits commuters in the Jabalpur–Narmadapuram belt. Major stoppages include Pipariya, Narsinghpur, Gadarwara, Sridham, Bagra Tawa, Sohagpur, Bankhedi, Salichauka Road, and Kareli. Itarsi Junction is located in Narmadapuram district and comes under the West Central Railway zone.

questions.question: On which date is World Lion Day observed annually?
questions.explanation: August 10 is observed annually as World Lion Day to raise awareness about lion conservation and the threats faced by lions worldwide. The day highlights issues such as habitat loss, human-wildlife conflict, poaching, depletion of prey, diseases, and climate change. Lions are apex predators and play an important role in maintaining ecosystem balance by controlling prey populations and influencing herbivore grazing patterns. The day also highlights conservation initiatives, including India’s efforts to protect the Asiatic lion population mainly found in Gujarat’s Gir landscape. India’s Project Lion, habitat expansion and the development of Barda Wildlife Sanctuary are important conservation measures.

questions.question: What real GDP growth rate for FY27 was projected by the RBI’s 101st Survey of Professional Forecasters?
questions.explanation: The RBI’s 101st Survey of Professional Forecasters, conducted in July 2026, projected India’s real GDP growth for FY27 at 6.6%. This was an upward revision from the earlier estimate of 6.5%, reflecting expectations of continued support from domestic demand, manufacturing, services, and exports. The survey also projected FY27 retail inflation at 5%, merchandise export growth at 7%, and a current account deficit of 1.4% of GDP. The RBI itself later raised its FY27 GDP growth forecast to 6.7%, which was 0.1 percentage point higher than the SPF estimate.

questions.question: Which country donated five peacocks to the United Nations Office at Geneva (UNOG) in August 2026?
questions.explanation: India donated five Indian peacocks to the United Nations Office at Geneva (UNOG) on August 7, 2026, reviving a diplomatic tradition that began in 1981. The donation included four blue peafowl and one rare white-feathered male, symbolising the blue and white colours associated with the United Nations. The birds were formally handed over by India’s Permanent Representative to the UN in Geneva, Arindam Bagchi, and received by UNOG Director-General Tatiana Valovaya. The peacocks will be housed in Ariana Park and cared for by Geneva Bioparc zoo staff. India’s first such donation was made by former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi in 1981.

questions.question: Who has assumed charge as the Secretary of the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES)?
questions.explanation: Dr Srinivasa Kumar Tummala has assumed charge as the Secretary of the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES), Government of India. He is a noted oceanographer and distinguished scientist with more than three decades of experience in remote sensing, satellite oceanography, coastal hazard mitigation, and disaster management. He played a key role as Project Manager of India’s Tsunami Early Warning System at INCOIS following the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami. He has also served as Director of ESSO-INCOIS, Hyderabad, since August 2020, and has contributed significantly to ocean information services and disaster preparedness.

questions.question: Which insurance company entered into a strategic corporate agency partnership with J&K Bank to distribute life insurance products?
questions.explanation: SBI Life entered into a strategic corporate agency partnership with J&K Bank on August 6, 2026, to distribute life insurance products through the bank’s extensive network. More than 1,000 branches of J&K Bank will offer SBI Life’s insurance solutions across Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, and other parts of India. The product portfolio includes protection, savings, retirement, and child plans. The partnership aims to improve insurance penetration and financial awareness while supporting the IRDAI’s vision of “Insurance for All by 2047.” SBI Life Insurance was established in 2001 and is a joint venture between the State Bank of India and BNP Paribas Cardif.

questions.question: How many new international ports has India added for entry by e-Visa holders?
questions.explanation: India has added 11 new international ports that allow foreign citizens with valid Indian e-Visas to enter the country. The new additions comprise 9 land ports and 2 airports, taking the total number of designated international ports for e-Visa entry to 88. These include 37 airports, 38 seaports and 13 land ports. The move is aimed at making international travel to India more convenient, supporting tourism, improving regional connectivity and expanding visa infrastructure. The newly added airports are Bhopal and Tirupati, while the nine land ports include Agartala, Darranga, Gede, Ghojadanga, Haridaspur, Jaigaon, Dawki, Moreh and Attari (Road).

questions.question: Which country has announced the dates for Exercise Talisman Sabre 2027?
questions.explanation: Australia has announced that Exercise Talisman Sabre 2027 will be conducted from August 9 to 22, 2027. The exercise is hosted jointly by Australia and the United States and will involve 24 additional partner nations. India is also confirmed to participate in the 2027 edition, following discussions during the second India-Australia Defence Ministers' Dialogue held in June. Talisman Sabre is the largest military exercise conducted by the Australian Department of Defence. Originally established as a bilateral Australia-US exercise, it focuses on strengthening military interoperability and supporting a free and open Indo-Pacific region.

questions.question: Who received a one-year extension as the Director of the Enforcement Directorate (ED) in August 2026?
questions.explanation: Rahul Navin received a one-year extension as the Director of the Enforcement Directorate (ED), following approval by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) on August 9, 2026. His extended tenure is effective beyond August 13, 2026, and continues until August 13, 2027, or until further orders, whichever is earlier. The extension was formally processed through an order issued by the Department of Personnel & Training (DoPT). The Enforcement Directorate operates under the Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, and is responsible for enforcing important laws such as the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 and the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999.

questions.question: Which city launched the Maitri Sanskar Value Education Programme as a three-year pilot initiative in government schools?
questions.explanation: Ludhiana launched the Maitri Sanskar Value Education Programme on August 10, 2026, as a three-year pilot initiative in 12 government schools. The programme is being implemented through a partnership between the District Administration and the MaitriBodh Parivaar Charitable Trust. It aims to develop values such as integrity, compassion, responsibility, and respect among students. The initiative uses workbooks, storytelling, experiential activities, teacher training, and continuous assessment to strengthen emotional well-being and life skills. Ludhiana is located in Punjab and is a major industrial centre, popularly known as the “Manchester of India.”

questions.question: Which state has approached the Supreme Court challenging the High Court ruling allowing motorcycles to operate as bike taxis?
questions.explanation: Karnataka has approached the Supreme Court challenging a Karnataka High Court ruling concerning the registration of motorcycles as transport vehicles and their operation as bike taxis. The state has raised concerns about passenger safety, insurance coverage, traffic congestion, pollution and the absence of a specific regulatory framework for bike-taxi services. Karnataka has also argued that the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 does not expressly provide for motorcycles to be used as taxis. The Supreme Court’s decision could have wider implications for bike-taxi operators, mobility companies, insurance providers and state transport authorities across India.

questions.question: What was the Government of India’s debt-to-GDP ratio in FY26?
questions.explanation: The Government of India’s debt-to-GDP ratio stood at 58.2% in FY26, according to data presented in Parliament. This was 210 basis points higher than the government’s target of 56.1% for the year. The Union government’s outstanding liabilities had declined from 61.5% of GDP in FY21 to 58.2% in FY26. For FY27, the government has set a lower debt-to-GDP target of 55.6%, requiring a reduction of around 260 basis points. The ratio is an important indicator of fiscal sustainability, as a lower debt burden provides greater flexibility for government borrowing during economic downturns or emergencies.

questions.question: Who won the Saint Louis Rapid & Blitz championship in August 2026?
questions.explanation: R Praggnanandhaa won his maiden Saint Louis Rapid & Blitz championship on August 7, 2026, finishing with 23.5 points. The Indian Grandmaster secured the title with one round remaining and scored 11.5 points out of a possible 18 in the blitz section. He lost only one game during the entire blitz segment. Uzbekistan’s Javokhir Sindarov finished second with 22 points, while Wesley So of the United States secured third place with 20.5 points. The victory also helped Praggnanandhaa move to second place in the overall Grand Chess Tour standings. He became a Grandmaster in 2018 at the age of 12.

questions.question: Who was announced as the co-recipient of the ICTP 2026 Dirac Medal?
questions.explanation: Deepak Dhar was announced as the co-recipient of the 2026 Dirac Medal, conferred by the Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP) in Italy. He is recognised for his major contributions to statistical mechanics and the study of complex systems, including phenomena such as earthquakes, traffic congestion and financial market fluctuations. Dhar became the first Indian recipient of the Boltzmann Medal in 2022 and is among only ten physicists worldwide to have received both the Boltzmann Medal and Dirac Medal. He currently serves as an INSA distinguished professor at ICTS, Bengaluru.

questions.question: On which date is World Elephant Day observed every year?
questions.explanation: August 12 is observed annually as World Elephant Day to promote the conservation, protection and welfare of elephants worldwide. The observance focuses on threats faced by African and Asian elephants, including habitat loss, poaching, illegal ivory trade, human-elephant conflicts and exploitation in captivity. The official celebration of World Elephant Day began on August 12, 2012, following an initiative launched in 2011 by the Elephant Reintroduction Foundation and filmmakers Patricia Sims and Michael Clark. In 2026, the day falls on Wednesday and carries the message “Bringing the world together to help elephants,” emphasising global cooperation for elephant conservation.

questions.question: Who announced that he would step down as Tata Sons chairman after his current term ends in February 2027?
questions.explanation: N Chandrasekaran announced that he would not seek reappointment as chairman of Tata Sons after his current term ends in February 2027. He requested the Tata Sons board to begin the succession process early to ensure a smooth transition. Chandrasekaran joined the Tata Group in 1987 and served as CEO and Managing Director of Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) from 2009 before becoming chairman of Tata Sons in 2017. During his tenure, the Tata Group expanded across technology, automobiles, steel, aviation, defence, electronics and semiconductors. His decision followed the lack of unanimous board support for extending his tenure beyond February 2027.

questions.question: Which country declared a national emergency following a magnitude 7.4 earthquake in August 2026?
questions.explanation: Colombia declared a national state of emergency after a magnitude 7.4 earthquake struck the western part of the country in August 2026. The epicenter was located near San José del Palmar in the department of Chocó, at a depth of about 107 kilometres, classifying it as an intermediate-focus earthquake. Colombia is highly vulnerable to seismic activity because of the interaction of the Nazca, South American and Caribbean tectonic plates. It is also part of the Pacific Ring of Fire, a region known for frequent earthquakes and volcanic activity. The event highlighted Colombia’s complex tectonic setting and earthquake risks.

questions.question: Who won India’s first-ever gold medal at the Aerobic Gymnastics Asian Championships?
questions.explanation: Ariha Pangambam created history by winning India’s first-ever gold medal at the Aerobic Gymnastics Asian Championships. She secured the gold medal in the senior women’s individual event held in the Philippines from August 4 to 7, 2026. Pangambam finished at the top with an overall score of 19.100, comprising 8.650 in artistry, 7.600 in execution and 2.850 in difficulty. Her achievement marked a significant milestone for Indian aerobic gymnastics at the Asian level. The Gymnastics Federation of India (GFI), established in 1951 and headquartered in New Delhi, is the national governing body for gymnastics in India.

questions.question: Which bank partnered with EazyDiner to launch the EazyDiner Platinum RuPay Credit Card?
questions.explanation: IndusInd Bank partnered with EazyDiner to launch the EazyDiner IndusInd Bank Platinum RuPay Credit Card on August 11, 2026. The lifetime-free card has no joining or annual fees and is issued on the RuPay network, allowing customers to link it with UPI apps for QR-based payments. Cardholders can receive dining discounts through the EazyDiner app, a complimentary three-month EazyDiner Prime membership, and monthly Buy One Get One movie ticket benefits through BookMyShow. The card also offers EazyPoints that can be redeemed for dining experiences and lifestyle benefits. IndusInd Bank began operations in 1994 and is headquartered in Mumbai.

questions.question: Which state dispatched its first-ever international consignment of mustard honey to Dubai?
questions.explanation: Tripura dispatched its first-ever international consignment of mustard honey to Dubai on August 10, 2026. The one-metric-tonne shipment was produced and aggregated by the Dergang Farmer Producer Organisation (FPO) in Tripura. The export was facilitated by the Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA), which operates under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry and promotes exports of scheduled agricultural and processed food products. The initiative highlights Tripura’s growing apiculture and agricultural potential and provides international market opportunities for local farmers and producers. Agartala is the capital of Tripura, which shares international borders with Bangladesh on three sides.

questions.question: Which state is the largest milk-producing state in India?
questions.explanation: Uttar Pradesh is the largest milk-producing state in India, contributing 15.66% of the country’s total milk production in 2024–25, according to the Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics (BAHS) 2025. The state produced approximately 19.01 million tonnes of milk during the year. Rajasthan ranked second with a 14.82% share, followed by Madhya Pradesh at 9.12%. Uttar Pradesh’s strong dairy sector is supported by its large livestock population, rural dairy farming base, availability of feed and fodder, expanding dairy cooperatives, and improving milk-processing infrastructure. India is also the world’s largest milk-producing country.

questions.question: On which date is International Youth Day celebrated every year?
questions.explanation: August 12 is observed annually as International Youth Day by the United Nations. The day focuses on raising global awareness about issues affecting young people and recognising their contributions to social, economic and sustainable development. International Youth Day was first celebrated on August 12, 2000, following the adoption of UN General Assembly Resolution 54/120 in December 1999. In 2026, the observance falls on Wednesday, August 12, under the theme “Different Contexts, Common Aspirations,” highlighting diverse youth experiences while emphasising their shared aspirations for education, employment, healthcare, inclusion and participation in decision-making.

questions.question: Who became the first Indian athlete to win a high jump medal at the World Athletics U20 Championships?
questions.explanation: Basant Meghwal created history by becoming the first Indian athlete to win a high jump medal at the World Athletics U20 Championships. At the 2026 championships in Eugene, Oregon, he secured the silver medal by clearing a personal-best height of 2.21 metres. The top three athletes all cleared 2.21 metres, with the final rankings decided through countback rules. Algeria’s Younes Ayachi won gold, while Great Britain’s Otis Poole took bronze. Meghwal, who represents the Indian Navy through the sports quota, had earlier won gold at the Asian U20 Athletics Championships in Hong Kong in 2026.

questions.question: Which state government launched the Tathyakosh.in portal for public data discovery?
questions.explanation: Karnataka launched Tathyakosh.in, a centralised digital public good platform designed to simplify the discovery of fragmented public data across India. Developed by the ACSEL Technology Forum, Karnataka’s Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence, in collaboration with the IIT Alumni Centre Bengaluru, the platform integrates more than 1.5 million datasets from 458 data sources. Tathyakosh functions as a discovery tool rather than storing datasets directly, redirecting users to original sources to preserve data ownership and provenance. It is particularly useful for startups and researchers working in healthcare, agriculture, climate research, and financial inclusion.

questions.question: Which number series was launched by TRAI for utility and courier service calls?
questions.explanation: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) initiated the rollout of the 1601 number series on August 10, 2026, for service and transactional voice calls made by utility and logistics companies. The initiative aims to help consumers identify legitimate business communications and reduce impersonation fraud involving standard 10-digit mobile numbers. In its first phase, the series covers electricity, water, city gas and LPG providers, along with courier, express logistics and freight companies. Eligible entities must use the numbers exclusively for service and transactional calls, while promotional calls through the 1601 series are prohibited.

questions.question: In which city will Amgen establish its new Science and Innovation Centre?
questions.explanation: Hyderabad will host Amgen’s new Science and Innovation Centre at Genome Valley, with the facility scheduled to become operational in 2027. The centre will focus on discovery chemistry, drug metabolism, pharmacokinetics, precision medicine, and the integration of experimental science with data technology. The project is expected to create employment opportunities for around 200 highly skilled professionals. Amgen had earlier established its Global Capability Centre in Hyderabad in February 2025. Genome Valley is India’s first systematically developed life sciences research and development cluster and has become an important hub for biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies.

questions.question: On which date is World Organ Donation Day observed every year?
questions.explanation: August 13 is observed every year as World Organ Donation Day to raise awareness about the importance of organ donation and encourage people to become donors. The day also aims to dispel myths and misconceptions related to organ transplantation. Organ donation can provide a second chance at life to patients suffering from organ failure. Organs such as the kidneys, heart, liver, lungs, pancreas, and intestines can be donated under appropriate medical and legal conditions. Awareness campaigns help bridge the gap between the growing demand for organs and the availability of donated organs.

questions.question: Which major port became India’s first Scope-2 emission-free major port in August 2026?
questions.explanation: VOC Port, officially known as V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority, became India’s first major port to be recognised as Scope-2 emission-free on August 10, 2026. Located in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, the port achieved this milestone with renewable energy accounting for 93.89% of its total electricity consumption during 2025-26. It also received ISO 50001:2018 certification for its Energy Management System from Bureau Veritas. The port operates solar and wind power facilities and is developing green hydrogen and green methanol infrastructure as part of its broader clean-energy initiatives.

questions.question: Which Indian institution was ranked highest in the QS World University Rankings 2027?
questions.explanation: IIT Delhi was the highest-ranked Indian institution in the QS World University Rankings 2027, securing the 118th position globally after climbing five places. It was followed by IIT Bombay at 134th, IIT Madras at 170th, IIT Kharagpur at 205th and IISc Bengaluru at 221st. India’s representation in the rankings has expanded significantly, with 52 institutions featured in 2027 compared with just 11 in 2015. The growth reflects improvements in higher education, research, innovation and institutional development, supported by policy initiatives including the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020.

questions.question: Which Union Territory approved ₹10 crore for the restoration of Rattan Garh Fort in Bhaderwah?
questions.explanation: Jammu & Kashmir approved ₹10 crore on August 11, 2026, for the repair and renovation of the historic Rattan Garh Fort in Bhaderwah, Doda district. The project focuses on preserving the fort’s architectural and historical character while developing it as a major heritage and tourism attraction. Rattan Garh Fort is associated with the cultural heritage of the Chenab Valley. The restoration is also expected to integrate the fort into Bhaderwah’s tourism circuit, improve visitor facilities and contribute to local economic activity through increased tourism.

questions.question: What was India’s retail inflation rate in July 2026?
questions.explanation: India’s retail inflation rose marginally to 4.45% in July 2026, compared with 4.38% in June 2026. The increase was mainly driven by higher food prices, with Consumer Food Price Index (CFPI) inflation rising to 5.52% from 5.32% in June. The July figures were based on the revised Consumer Price Index (CPI), which uses 2024 as its base year. Rural retail inflation stood higher at 4.84%, while urban inflation was 3.96%. Among major states, Telangana recorded the highest inflation at 6.32% in July.

The Department of Higher Education functions under the Ministry of Education and is responsible for university education, technical education and scholarships. It also oversees major regulatory bodies such as the University Grants Commission (UGC) and the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).

The J&K team earned the opportunity after becoming the 2025-26 Ranji Trophy champions. The match is historically significant as it will be the first major cricket event in Kashmir in four decades. The Irani Cup is an annual first-class match between the reigning Ranji Trophy champions and the Rest of India team. J&K will be led by 41-year-old batter Paras Dogra. Fast bowler Auqib Nabi Dar was the leading wicket-taker in the 2025-26 Ranji Trophy with 60 wickets.

questions.explanation: Indian para-cyclists secured a total of 12 Medals at the UCI Para Sport Denmark Grand Prix held in Odense, Denmark, from August 7 to 9, 2026. India’s medal tally consisted of 2 Gold, 5 Silver, and 5 Bronze medals. Arshad Shaikh of the MC2 category was the leading Indian performer, winning 6 medals, including 2 Gold, 3 Silver, and 1 Bronze. Vishwa Vasani, competing in the WC3 category, won 4 Bronze medals, while 16-year-old Anshuman of the MC1 category contributed 2 Silver medals. The Indian team was trained under Chief Coach Aditya Mehta.

questions.question: Which state implemented a Widow and Orphan Cess on the sale of petrol and diesel at 60 paise per litre?
questions.explanation: Himachal Pradesh implemented a Widow and Orphan Cess on the sale of petrol and high-speed diesel from August 11, 2026. The cess is levied at 60 paise per litre and is collected at the first point of sale within the state. The measure was introduced under Section 6-A of the Himachal Pradesh Value Added Tax Act, 2005, following the passage of the Himachal Pradesh Value Added Tax (Amendment) Bill, 2026. The revenue generated through the cess is specifically earmarked for the welfare of widows and orphaned children. Himachal Pradesh became the 18th state of India on January 25, 1971.

questions.question: Which company partnered with ITI Limited to accelerate digital transformation and modernisation of legacy systems for Indian enterprises?
questions.explanation: Airtel Business partnered with ITI Limited on August 12, 2026, to accelerate digital transformation and modernisation of legacy systems for Indian enterprises. The collaboration aims to provide future-ready digital solutions focused on operational efficiency, security, and business resilience. Its service portfolio includes LEO satellite services, IoT connectivity, sovereign cloud services, AI-powered solutions, cybersecurity frameworks, and data centre services. The partnership combines the communication infrastructure of Airtel Business with the engineering capabilities of ITI Limited. ITI Limited, established in 1948, is headquartered in Bengaluru and functions under the Department of Telecommunications, Ministry of Communications.

questions.question: Which state approved the establishment of four Centres of Excellence to promote natural farming?
questions.explanation: Gujarat approved the establishment of four Centres of Excellence to promote and expand natural farming across the state on August 11, 2026. The centres will be developed in Navsari, Morbi, Bhavnagar, and Chhota Udepur, with an allocation of ₹20 crore for the financial year 2026-27. The Gujarat Prakrutik Krishi Vikas Board will serve as the nodal agency for implementing and managing the scheme. Each centre will have the capacity to train 100 farmers at a time. The facilities will focus on bio-input production, natural farming demonstrations, soil and quality testing, and post-harvest processing.

questions.question: On which date is Partition Horrors Remembrance Day observed in India?
questions.explanation: August 14 is observed as Partition Horrors Remembrance Day, also known as Vibhajan Vibhishika Smriti Diwas. The Government of India declared August 14 as the day of remembrance in 2021 to honour the victims and survivors of the Partition of India in 1947. The observance recalls the immense human suffering caused by displacement, communal violence, loss of property, family separation, and destruction of livelihoods. The date precedes India’s Independence Day and highlights the sacrifices and hardships associated with Partition. Various exhibitions, memorial programmes, educational sessions, and discussions are held to preserve historical memories and promote communal harmony.

questions.question: Which company signed a multi-launch agreement with HEX20 for three dedicated Vikram-series space missions?
questions.explanation: Skyroot Aerospace signed a multi-launch agreement with Kerala-based HEX20 on August 10, 2026, for three dedicated Vikram-series space missions. The missions are scheduled to begin in Q4 of 2027 and will support HEX20’s Earth-observation constellation, in-orbit payload demonstrations, and rideshare services for third-party spacecraft. The agreement follows Skyroot’s successful July 18, 2026, launch of Vikram-1, described as India’s first privately developed orbital-class rocket. Headquartered in Hyderabad, Skyroot Aerospace aims to increase its launch capacity to 12 missions annually. Vikram-1 uses in-house propulsion and composite structures designed for small-satellite launches.

questions.question: Which country became the first Arab country to formally abolish the death penalty?
questions.explanation: Lebanon became the first Arab country and the first nation in the Middle East to formally abolish the death penalty on August 11, 2026. The Lebanese Parliament replaced all existing death sentences with life imprisonment. The country had maintained a de facto moratorium on executions since 2004, although dozens of people remained technically on death row. The abolition applies to crimes that were previously punishable by death, including murder and treason. The move provides lasting legal protection for the right to life and aligns Lebanon with international human rights trends. Lebanon’s capital is Beirut, and its official currency is the Lebanese Pound.

questions.question: In which city did Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers launch the Indian Navy’s first Next-Generation Offshore Patrol Vessel, Shruti?
questions.explanation: Kolkata was the location where the Indian Navy’s first Next-Generation Offshore Patrol Vessel (NGOPV), Shruti (Yard 3037), was launched at the Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers (GRSE) facility on August 11, 2026. The vessel has been indigenously designed and built by GRSE. The NGOPV programme is being executed concurrently by GRSE in Kolkata and Goa Shipyard Limited in Goa. Shruti is designed for maritime surveillance, anti-piracy operations, humanitarian assistance and disaster relief, offshore asset protection, and search and rescue missions. GRSE is a premier warship-building company under the Ministry of Defence and is headquartered in Kolkata.

questions.question: Who was elected as the new President of Hungary by the Hungarian Parliament?
questions.explanation: Andras Baka was elected as the new President of Hungary by the Hungarian Parliament on August 13, 2026. He secured 140 votes in favour and 6 votes against through a secret ballot, with no abstentions recorded. Baka was nominated and elected by the governing Tisza party, while members of the far-right Fidesz party boycotted the voting process. The Hungarian presidency is primarily ceremonial, although the president has powers such as returning bills to lawmakers or referring them to the Constitutional Court for review. Hungary’s capital is Budapest, and its currency is the Hungarian Forint.

questions.question: What real GDP growth did SBI Research project for India in Q1 FY27?
questions.explanation: SBI Research projected India’s real GDP growth at 8% for the April-June quarter (Q1 FY27), exceeding the Reserve Bank of India’s projection of 7%. The forecast was based on a Nowcasting Model using 54 high-frequency indicators covering agriculture, industry, and services. Economic activity showed broad improvement, with 86% of 50 leading indicators recording growth. IIP growth accelerated to 7.3% in June, while services exports and airport cargo traffic also recorded strong growth. The report highlighted robust industrial activity, credit growth, and government capital expenditure as key factors supporting the growth outlook.

questions.question: Who assumed charge as the Secretary of the Department of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation?
questions.explanation: Archana Varma assumed charge as the Secretary of the Department of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation under the Ministry of Jal Shakti. She is a 1995-batch IAS officer of the Assam cadre and had served as the Mission Director of the National Water Mission since September 2022. During her tenure, she worked to expand the mission’s scope beyond the Jal Shakti Abhiyan: Catch the Rain programme. She has also served as Additional Secretary in the Central Vigilance Commission and handled vigilance matters related to the Government of NCT of Delhi.

questions.question: Which state prohibited the sale, distribution, and manufacture of tobacco and nicotine products for one year?
questions.explanation: Karnataka prohibited the sale, distribution, and manufacture of tobacco and nicotine products across the state for a period of one year from August 10, 2026. The ban specifically covers gutkha and pan masala containing tobacco and nicotine, and also prohibits their manufacture, storage, transportation, distribution, and sale. The Department of Food Safety and Drugs Administration is responsible for enforcing the notification. The measure aims to protect public health and promote an addiction-free state. Karnataka was formed as Mysore State in 1956 and was renamed Karnataka in 1973, with Bengaluru as its capital.

questions.question: Who authored the autobiography titled 'Triumph of the Indian Republic: My Life, My Struggles'?
questions.explanation: Ram Nath Kovind authored the autobiography titled 'Triumph of the Indian Republic: My Life, My Struggles', which was released by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on August 12, 2026. The book documents Kovind’s life journey, personal struggles, and contributions to India, while highlighting the country’s democratic values and institutions. Ram Nath Kovind served as the 14th President of India from 2017 to 2022. Before becoming President, he served as the Governor of Bihar from 2015 to 2017. He was also the second Dalit President of India, after K.R. Narayanan.

questions.question: Which institute transferred the technology for an IND-ready phytopharmaceutical to treat diabetic foot ulcers to Viridis Biopharma?
questions.explanation: IICT, or the CSIR-Indian Institute of Chemical Technology, Hyderabad, signed a technology transfer agreement with Viridis Biopharma for an IND-ready phytopharmaceutical aimed at treating diabetic foot ulcers. The treatment was developed from Gymnema sylvestre and focuses on wound management. The project was developed by the Department of Applied Biology under the CSIR Phytopharmaceutical Mission Phase-III. It has completed pre-clinical development, botanical standardisation, and GLP-compliant safety studies and is now moving toward clinical trials and commercial development. Regulatory submissions are planned for India’s CDSCO and the US FDA.

questions.question: Where was the first national conclave of the Indian Institutes of Handloom Technology, IIHT SUTRA 2026, held?
questions.explanation: New Delhi hosted IIHT SUTRA 2026, the first national conclave of the Indian Institutes of Handloom Technology. The event was inaugurated by Union Textiles Minister Giriraj Singh on August 14, 2026, at the Dr Ambedkar International Centre. Organised under the theme “IIHTs: Weaving the Future of the Indian Handloom Sector – Educate. Innovate. Transform,” the conclave aimed to strengthen IIHTs as centres of excellence in technical education, research, and technological innovation. Several strategic MoUs were also signed with organisations including Grasim Industries, Northern India Textile Research Association, and IIM Sambalpur.

questions.question: Which organisation partnered with the Digital India BHASHINI Division to advance multilingual, voice-first AI solutions for inclusive governance?
options: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
questions.explanation: NITI Aayog partnered with the Digital India BHASHINI Division through a Statement of Intent to advance multilingual, voice-first AI solutions for inclusive governance. The collaboration, titled BHASHINI for Seva/Sanchalan, aims to integrate AI-powered language technologies across NITI Aayog’s digital platforms. Key initiatives include BHASHINI Sahayogi for linguistic data collection and BHASHINI Pravakta for expanding awareness and adoption of AI tools. The ecosystem supports 36 Indian text languages, 23 Indian voice languages, and 35 international languages. Governance tools such as NITI TARA and SMRITI further support data-driven decision-making and multilingual meeting documentation.

questions.question: Which Union Territories were the first to implement CBDC-based food subsidy transfers under the Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana?
questions.explanation: Chandigarh and Dadra Nagar Haveli became the first Union Territories to implement CBDC-based food subsidy transfers under the Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana. The initiative uses programmable Digital Rupee tokens to transfer food subsidies directly into beneficiaries’ CBDC wallets instead of traditional bank accounts. Beneficiaries can use these tokens to purchase foodgrains from empanelled merchants through real-time digital payments. The rollout aims to reduce leakages, diversion, and cash-handling issues in subsidy delivery. It follows earlier pilot implementations in Puducherry and Gujarat and represents a major step toward fully digital welfare delivery.

questions.question: In which state was the 8th BRICS Working Group on Oceanic and Polar Science and Technology meeting held?
questions.explanation: Goa hosted the 8th meeting of the BRICS Working Group on Oceanic and Polar Science and Technology on August 12, 2026, under India’s BRICS Presidency. The meeting was organised by the National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research in South Goa, under the Ministry of Earth Sciences. Delegations from eight BRICS member countries participated, including India, Brazil, Russia, China, South Africa, Egypt, Indonesia, and the UAE. The BRICS OPST Working Group was established in 2018 to promote scientific cooperation among member states. India had previously hosted its 3rd meeting in 2020.

questions.question: Which company partnered with CHRIST (Deemed to be University) to establish the Innovation Centre for Artificial Intelligence?
questions.explanation: IBM partnered with CHRIST (Deemed to be University) to establish the IBM Innovation Centre for Artificial Intelligence. The centre aims to promote AI-driven education, research, and innovation by providing students, faculty members, researchers, and PhD scholars access to enterprise technologies and real-world use cases. Its specialised research areas include Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Intelligent Automation, and Responsible AI. The initiative also provides access to IBM technologies such as watsonx.ai, watsonx Orchestrate, and IBM Bob for developing and scaling enterprise AI applications.

questions.question: In which country was the bilateral air exercise Udara Shakti 2026 conducted?
questions.explanation: Malaysia hosted the bilateral air exercise Udara Shakti 2026, which commenced on August 13, 2026, at Subang Air Base. The exercise involves the Indian Air Force and the Royal Malaysian Air Force, focusing on joint field training and Subject Matter Expert exchanges. It aims to enhance operational learning, share best practices, and improve interoperability between the two air forces. The exercise strengthens defence cooperation and professional engagement between India and Malaysia. It is distinct from Exercise Pitch Black 2026, a multinational air exercise hosted by the Royal Australian Air Force in Northern Australia, involving personnel and aircraft from several countries.

questions.question: Which institute developed a nutrient-assisted two-stage cultivation process for enhanced CO2 capture and bioenergy production?
questions.explanation: IIT Guwahati developed a nutrient-assisted two-stage cultivation process designed to enhance carbon dioxide capture and bioenergy production using microalgae. In the first stage, microalgal cultures are grown under 15% CO2 to support rapid growth and carbon availability. In the second stage, the CO2 concentration is reduced to 5%, while calcium and phosphorus are added to stabilise pH and improve biomass aggregation. The process achieved 25.7% higher biomass production and 35.4% higher CO2 fixation. Calcium also enabled auto-sedimentation, resulting in 98.46% biomass recovery efficiency and reducing energy requirements for downstream separation.

questions.question: Where was the Gramin Gyan Setu app launched to integrate rural libraries?
questions.explanation: Gandhinagar was the location associated with the launch of the Gramin Gyan Setu app, an initiative aimed at integrating rural libraries in Gujarat. Union Home Minister Amit Shah launched the app through video conferencing on August 12, 2026. The project seeks to interconnect 752 libraries within the Gandhinagar Lok Sabha constituency and provide rural children and youth access to a collective pool of around 2.80 lakh books. It covers villages across the Gandhinagar, Kalol, and Sanand assembly constituencies and uses a hub-and-spoke model. Specialised vans funded through MPLAD funds will visit villages every fortnight to facilitate book distribution and collection.

questions.question: Which Indian shipbuilding company delivered the MS Maria vessel to the German firm HS Schiffahrts UG?
questions.explanation: Cochin Shipyard Ltd delivered MS Maria, the second of eight multi-purpose vessels in the HS EcoFreighter series, to German firm HS Schiffahrts UG on August 12, 2026. The vessel has a 7,000 DWT capacity and is classified as an Ice-class vessel. It features the “Groot Cross-Bow” design and a transom stern for improved speed and fuel efficiency. Designed by Groot Ship Design of the Netherlands, the vessel was constructed at Cochin Shipyard Ltd according to Det Norske Veritas classification rules. CSL is India’s largest shipbuilding and maintenance facility and is headquartered in Kochi, Kerala.

questions.question: Which country strengthened its bilateral relations with India through high-level parliamentary engagement?
questions.explanation: Kenya strengthened its bilateral relations with India through high-level parliamentary engagement between Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla and Kenyan Speaker Rt. Hon. Dr Moses M. Wetang'ula on August 13, 2026. The discussions focused on parliamentary cooperation, inclusive development, democracy, and human-centric progress. Both countries emphasised regular exchanges of parliamentary delegations and the formation of Parliamentary Friendship Groups. Kenya also recognised Persons of Indian Origin as an indigenous community and supported India’s candidature for permanent membership of the United Nations Security Council. The countries further discussed sharing India’s experience in using Artificial Intelligence for greater transparency and efficiency in parliamentary functioning.

questions.question: By which year does India aim to achieve 100 GWe of nuclear energy capacity?
questions.explanation: India aims to scale its nuclear energy capacity to 100 GWe by 2047 under the Nuclear Energy Mission announced in the Union Budget 2025-26. The roadmap focuses on developing a self-reliant nuclear energy ecosystem and encouraging private sector participation. India also plans to develop and operationalise at least five indigenous Small Modular Reactors by 2033, including the 220 MWe Bharat Small Modular Reactor and the 55 MWe SMR-55. The SHANTI Act, 2025, provides a legislative framework for private participation while strengthening nuclear safety regulation. The long-term strategy also follows India’s three-stage nuclear programme and promotes nuclear medicine infrastructure.

questions.question: Which company secured an order worth up to ₹15,000 crore to host an AI data centre using NVIDIA’s high-performance chips?
questions.explanation: Larsen and Toubro secured an order worth up to ₹15,000 crore from U.S.-based cloud platform Together AI to host an AI data centre using NVIDIA’s high-performance chips. The order was secured by L&T’s AI infrastructure subsidiary, LTN Compute, and is valued between ₹10,000 crore and ₹15,000 crore. The data centre is being hosted at the Vyoma.AI unit on its Chennai campus and will feature 10,000 NVIDIA B300 chips, making it the largest such deployment in India. The facility will support AI inference, fine-tuning, and training for Together AI’s cloud platform.

questions.question: What percentage stake did Bank of America agree to acquire in Jio Credit?
questions.explanation: Bank of America agreed to acquire a 49.9% stake in Jio Credit, the lending arm of Jio Financial Services, for ₹18,268 crore. Under the transaction structure, the American banking major will initially acquire a 26.5% equity interest through preferential allotment. Its stake is expected to eventually increase to 49.9% through the exercise of warrants, subject to regulatory and statutory approvals. The transaction reflects growing foreign investment in India’s financial sector. Jio Financial Services was established as a separate entity in 2023 following its demerger from Reliance Industries and operates across digital lending, insurance broking, and payments.

questions.question: In which state will the Indian Army establish specialised training centres for youth across various district headquarters?
questions.explanation: Telangana will have specialised training centres established by the Indian Army across various district headquarters to prepare local youth for nationwide Army recruitment drives. The announcement was made on August 12, 2026, by Lieutenant General C Rajesh Pushkar, GOC-in-C of the Southern Command, following a meeting with state leadership at the MCRHRD Institute in Hyderabad. The centres will also create awareness about career opportunities in the armed forces. In addition, the Army will support Telangana’s disaster response framework by assisting with rescue, evacuation, and rehabilitation during floods and other natural calamities.

questions.question: In which Indian state is the 140-year-old Parichha Dam located?
questions.explanation: Uttar Pradesh is the state where the historic Parichha Dam is located in Jhansi. Built across the Betwa River, the dam was constructed between 1881 and 1886 and became an important component of the Betwa Canal System. On August 14, 2026, it was recognised as a World Heritage Irrigation Structure (WHIS) by the International Commission on Irrigation and Drainage (ICID). The dam is 1,174 metres long and 16.8 metres high, featuring 318 steel falling shutters. Its irrigation network extends across Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh, covering thousands of kilometres and irrigating large areas of farmland.

questions.question: Who was conferred the UT Ladakh State Award 2025 for exemplary service to Sowa-Rigpa medicine?
questions.explanation: Dr Padma Gurmet, Director of the National Institute of Sowa-Rigpa in Leh, was conferred the UT Ladakh State Award 2025 on 13 August 2026. The award recognised his exemplary contribution to the preservation, promotion, and development of Sowa-Rigpa, a traditional system of medicine practised in the Himalayan region. The honour was presented by Ladakh Lieutenant Governor Vinai Kumar Saxena during the UT State Awards ceremony covering the years 2022–2025. A total of 36 distinguished individuals were honoured for exceptional contributions across various fields and for their efforts toward the development of society and the Union Territory of Ladakh.

questions.question: Which country reached an agreement with Iran on the shipping route map for vessels in the Strait of Hormuz?
questions.explanation: Oman reached an agreement with Iran on the shipping route map for vessels navigating the Strait of Hormuz. The agreement followed several weeks of technical negotiations aimed at ensuring safe maritime navigation through this strategically important waterway. Both Iran and Oman border the Strait of Hormuz, making their coordination important for the safe movement of ships and international trade. The agreement focuses specifically on navigation and does not alter either country’s sovereignty over the waterway. However, Iran indicated that the complete restoration of normal commercial shipping remains conditional on broader developments involving the United States.

questions.question: Which country is partnering with India to map cross-border land occupation using UAVs within a three-year target?
questions.explanation: Nepal is partnering with India to conduct a joint mapping exercise of cross-border land occupation using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). The initiative aims to generate reliable technical information about areas where people cultivate or occupy land across the international boundary. The survey is expected to begin after the 2026 monsoon and be completed within three years. India and Nepal agreed on an annual plan and budget during the 13th meeting of the Survey Officers’ Committee in Lucknow. The aerial images will be jointly analysed to understand the nature and extent of cross-border occupation, particularly in areas affected by changing river courses.

questions.question: Which telecom company launched several digital initiatives and infrastructure projects on August 15, 2026, to mark India's 80th Independence Day?
questions.explanation: BSNL (Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited) launched several customer-centric digital initiatives and infrastructure projects on August 15, 2026, to commemorate India’s 80th Independence Day. The company ordered 26,300 additional 4G BTS sites for deployment in rural and remote areas. It also introduced the Re 1 Freedom 2.0 offer, extended the validity of its ₹2,399 annual prepaid plan, and launched the BSNL Selfcare New app with AI chatbot and voice-search features. BSNL also partnered with Polycab to manufacture telecom hardware under the Hardware-as-a-Service model. BSNL is a Central Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Communications.

questions.question: Which Indian company is set to partner with Rolls-Royce to develop and manufacture engines for the AMCA programme?
questions.explanation: Reliance is set to partner with UK-based Rolls-Royce to explore the establishment of a dedicated aerospace gas turbine complex in India. The proposed collaboration aims to support the joint development and manufacturing of aero-engines for India’s Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme. The partnership combines Rolls-Royce’s expertise in advanced propulsion technology with Reliance’s manufacturing and execution capabilities. The initiative is expected to strengthen India’s indigenous aerospace ecosystem, reduce dependence on foreign-made defence equipment, and enhance domestic capabilities in fighter-engine production. The AMCA is a twin-engine stealth fighter being developed for India’s future air-combat requirements.

questions.question: Who won the Esports World Cup chess title for the second consecutive year in 2026?
questions.explanation: Magnus Carlsen won the Esports World Cup chess title for the second consecutive year on August 16, 2026, in Paris, France. Representing Team Liquid, the Norwegian World No. 1 defeated Belarusian Grandmaster Denis Lazavik by a score of 2-0 in the final. Carlsen remained undefeated throughout the competition, demonstrating his continued dominance in competitive chess. He is a five-time World Chess Champion and holds the record for the highest peak FIDE rating in history, at 2882. Hikaru Nakamura finished third after defeating Alireza Firouzja 4-1 in the third-place match.

questions.question: In which Union Territory was the CBDC-based Direct Benefit Transfer system for the Public Distribution System launched?
questions.explanation: Chandigarh was the Union Territory where the Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC)-based Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system for the Public Distribution System (PDS) was launched on August 16, 2026. Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan launched the pilot project, which uses e-RUPI digital vouchers to ensure transparent and leak-proof delivery of food subsidies. Developed in collaboration with the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution and the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), the initiative uses blockchain-based CBDC technology for real-time transaction settlement. Similar CBDC-linked models are also being explored for agricultural and fertiliser subsidy distribution.

questions.question: Which country is scheduled to host the BRICS Environment Working Group meetings on 17-18 August 2026?
questions.explanation: India is scheduled to host the BRICS Environment Working Group meetings on 17-18 August 2026 at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi. The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change is the nodal ministry coordinating the event. Representatives and environment ministers from BRICS member countries are expected to participate and discuss areas of environmental cooperation. India has previously hosted the BRICS Summit in 2012, 2016, and 2021. Bharat Mandapam, located at Pragati Maidan, is a major international convention and exhibition venue and also hosted the 18th G20 Summit in September 2023.

questions.question: Which company signed agreements with BEML and Adani Defence to manufacture fuselage structures for the LCH Prachand?
questions.explanation: HAL (Hindustan Aeronautics Limited) signed agreements with BEML and Adani Defence Systems and Technologies Limited on August 14, 2026, for manufacturing fuselage structures of the Light Combat Helicopter (LCH) Prachand. BEML will manufacture 48 fuselage structures under an order worth ₹184 crore, while Adani Defence will produce 42 structures. The initiative marks the first integration of private industry into helicopter fuselage production and aims to increase industrial participation in India’s aerospace sector. The production supports the manufacturing of 156 Prachand helicopters ordered for the Indian Armed Forces and is being carried out at HAL’s new facility in Tumakuru, Karnataka.

questions.question: Which state is set to get Asia’s first desert-themed night safari at Juna Deesa?
questions.explanation: Gujarat is set to host Asia’s first desert-themed night safari at Juna Deesa in Banaskantha district. The project received approval from the Central Zoo Authority (CZA) on August 12, 2026, and will be implemented by the Gujarat Forest Department. Spread across approximately 103 hectares, the Desert Zoological Park and Night Safari is estimated to cost ₹542.14 crore. It will feature five night safari enclosures along with a day zoo and is expected to house around 2,700 animals and birds belonging to nearly 83 species, highlighting desert and arid ecosystems.

questions.question: Which state signed MoUs with CSIR-NGRI and IIT (ISM) Dhanbad to explore lithium and gallium reserves?
questions.explanation: Andhra Pradesh signed two strategic Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) on August 13, 2026, with CSIR-NGRI and IIT (ISM) Dhanbad to strengthen mineral exploration and mining research. CSIR-NGRI will undertake extensive exploration in the Vempalle area of the Kadapa Basin, where preliminary studies at Thummalapalle have indicated significant concentrations of lithium and gallium. Lithium levels are estimated at up to 1,000 ppm, while gallium levels may reach 250 ppm. The ₹140 crore exploration project will be funded by the National Mineral Exploration Trust (NMET), while another MoU aims to establish a Centre of Excellence for Mining in the state.

questions.question: Where was India’s first virtual zoo and 14-D cinema facility inaugurated?
questions.explanation: Indore was the location where India’s first virtual zoo and 14-D cinema facility were inaugurated on August 16, 2026, by Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Dr Mohan Yadav. The facility has been developed within the existing Indore Zoo under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model, with an investment of approximately ₹4.5 crore. It features the country’s first virtual jungle safari and a 14-D cinema theatre, using advanced digital technology to provide immersive experiences of forests and wildlife. The initiative aims to promote wildlife education among children and tourists while offering an innovative way to experience nature and biodiversity.

questions.question: Which company signed a Shareholders’ Agreement for the joint development of the 920 MW Punatsangchhu-III Hydroelectric Project in Bhutan?
questions.explanation: JSW Energy signed a Shareholders’ Agreement with Bhutan’s Druk Green Power Corporation (DGPC) on August 17, 2026, for the joint development of the 920 MW Punatsangchhu-III Hydroelectric Project. The project is located in Wangdue Phodrang District of Bhutan and will utilise the country’s Himalayan river systems to generate clean hydropower. DGPC will hold a 51% equity stake, while JSW Neo Energy, a subsidiary of JSW Energy, will hold 49%. This project is particularly significant because it marks JSW Energy’s first power generation venture outside India and supports Bhutan’s continued expansion of renewable energy.

questions.question: Which country participates with India in Exercise MAITREE-XV 2026?
questions.explanation: Thailand participates with India in Exercise MAITREE-XV 2026, which is the 15th joint military exercise between the two countries. The exercise is being conducted from August 18 to 31, 2026, at Vibhavadi Rangsit Camp in Surat Thani, Thailand. The Indian Army and Royal Thai Army are taking part with 85 personnel each. The exercise focuses on joint counter-insurgency and counter-terrorist operations in difficult jungle and semi-urban environments, while also enhancing interoperability, operational coordination, and defence cooperation between the two armies.

questions.question: Who will succeed Sunil Bharti Mittal as the chairperson of Airtel Payments Bank from October 1, 2026?
questions.explanation: Shabnam Sinha will succeed Sunil Bharti Mittal as the chairperson of Airtel Payments Bank from October 1, 2026, for a three-year term. Her appointment was approved by the company’s Board and the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). Sinha is currently an independent director on the bank’s board and chairs the Special Committee of the Board for Monitoring Frauds. She brings nearly four decades of leadership experience across development finance, financial services, public policy and institutional transformation. Her experience with the World Bank and expertise in financial inclusion and digital transformation are expected to support the bank’s continued growth.

questions.question: Where were the PMIS Industry Awards organised by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs held in August, 2026?
questions.explanation: New Delhi hosted the PMIS Industry Awards organised by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs on August 16, 2026. The event recognised companies that made significant contributions by providing internship opportunities under the Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS). The scheme aims to enhance skill development and employability among Indian youth through industry-linked training and hands-on experience in leading companies. Mahindra & Mahindra Limited was recognised as the Overall Industry Champion, while several PSUs and private companies received awards in different categories. The Ministry of Corporate Affairs, headquartered in New Delhi, administers the Companies Act, 2013 and the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC).

questions.question: Who received Nepal’s honorary General rank during the official visit to Kathmandu in August 2026?
questions.explanation: Dhiraj Seth, the Indian Army Chief, received the honorary General rank of the Nepali Army on August 17, 2026, during his official visit to Kathmandu. The honour was conferred by Nepal President Ram Chandra Paudel. This recognition follows the long-standing tradition between the Indian Army and the Nepali Army that dates back to 1950, reflecting the cordial and close military relationship between India and Nepal. During his visit, General Seth also received a Guard of Honour at the Nepali Army Headquarters and paid homage at the Army Pavilion in Tundikhel.

questions.question: Where in India was the 8th edition of the India-USN EOD Exercise 2026 concluded?
questions.explanation: Kochi was the location in India where the 8th edition of the India-USN EOD Exercise 2026 concluded on August 14, 2026. The joint naval exercise was conducted at the Southern Naval Command and involved personnel from the Indian and US Navies. The training focused on explosive ordnance disposal, including improvised explosive devices, mine neutralisation, render-safe operations, diving and underwater activities. The exercise also covered the use of unmanned underwater systems, specialised diving equipment, wreck location and salvage. It strengthened the professional capabilities, interoperability and maritime cooperation between the two navies.

questions.question: Which Indian company partnered with Norway’s Hystar AS for the phased indigenisation and local manufacturing of PEM electrolyser systems?
questions.explanation: BHEL partnered with Norway-based Hystar AS on August 17, 2026, to promote the phased indigenisation and local manufacturing of Proton Exchange Membrane (PEM) electrolyser systems in India. The collaboration aims to support the country’s growing green hydrogen market and strengthen project execution capabilities under the National Green Hydrogen Mission and Make in India initiative. With this partnership, BHEL becomes one of the few Indian companies capable of offering both alkaline and PEM electrolyser solutions. BHEL, established in 1964 and headquartered in New Delhi, is India’s largest engineering and manufacturing enterprise in the energy and infrastructure sector.
