questions.question: Which state announced 365 days of maternity leave for government women employees having a third child?
questions.explanation: Tamil Nadu announced an extension of maternity leave to 365 days for women government employees having a third child, replacing the earlier entitlement of 12 weeks for employees with two or more surviving children. The decision is aimed at promoting women’s empowerment and social welfare. Tamil Nadu has progressively increased maternity leave benefits over the years, from 90 days in 2011 to six months, then nine months in 2016, and 365 days in 2021 for employees with fewer than two surviving children. A government order will provide detailed implementation guidelines and eligibility conditions for the new third-child provision.

questions.question: How many Indian peacekeepers serving with UNMISS in South Sudan received UN Medals for their outstanding service?
questions.explanation: 210 Indian peacekeepers serving with the United Nations Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS) received UN Medals for their exceptional service. The ceremony was held in Juba and recognised their contributions during crises, medical emergencies, and lifesaving missions. Among the recipients were six women peacekeepers and seven staff officers. India has a long-standing role in UN peacekeeping operations and is one of the largest providers of military and police personnel to UN missions. As of April 2026, India was also the top troop contributor to UNMISS, with 1,775 Indian military personnel deployed in South Sudan.

questions.question: Which deep-tech startup launched the indigenous iron-air battery pilot project at NTPC Simhadri Thermal Power Station?
questions.explanation: Meine Electric launched a utility-scale pilot of its indigenous iron-air battery technology at the NTPC Simhadri Thermal Power Station on August 17, 2026. The project is being executed by the Atal Incubation Centre–Anna University, with Meine Electric serving as the technology partner. The battery features a six-hour charging cycle followed by an 18-hour discharge cycle and is designed for long-duration energy storage. The pilot aims to evaluate technical performance and operational reliability under real-world utility conditions while supporting 24x7 clean power and greater grid flexibility. Iron-air batteries use iron, oxygen, and water through a reversible rusting process.

questions.question: Which fintech company launched India’s first transformer-based AI foundation model for payments, named Vulcan?
questions.explanation: Razorpay launched Vulcan, India’s first transformer-based AI foundation model specifically designed for payments, on August 18, 2026. The model was developed in collaboration with NVIDIA and Amazon Web Services (AWS) using the Amazon SageMaker platform. Vulcan is designed to improve payment reliability, fraud detection, and transaction routing across India’s digital payments ecosystem. It increased payment success rates by up to 10% and detected eight times more international card fraud. The model was tested and deployed across approximately 3 trillion data points on Razorpay’s payments network, demonstrating the growing role of artificial intelligence in strengthening digital payment security and efficiency.

questions.question: What GDP growth rate has Ind-Ra projected for India for FY27?
questions.explanation: Ind-Ra has raised its forecast for India’s GDP growth in FY27 to 6.8%, up from its earlier estimate of 6.7%. The revision is mainly attributed to lower crude oil prices, with the agency reducing its baseline crude oil price assumption from $95 to $85 per barrel. However, Ind-Ra highlighted several risks, including El Niño conditions, high inflation, geopolitical tensions in West Asia, weak global trade, and unfavourable agricultural conditions. The projected growth remains below the 7.6% growth rate given in the provisional FY26 estimates by the National Statistical Office.

questions.question: In which city will India host the BRICS ICT Track 2026?
questions.explanation: Pune will host the BRICS ICT Track 2026 from August 17 to 21, organised by the Department of Telecommunications (DoT) as part of India’s BRICS Chairship. The event will be conducted under the theme “Innovate, Cooperate and Transform (ICT) for a Resilient Future.” Major events include the 7th BRICS Working Group Meeting for Cooperation in ICTs, the Digital BRICS Forum and Expo, and the 12th BRICS Communications Ministers Meeting. Key discussions will focus on artificial intelligence, digital public infrastructure, next-generation communications, cybersecurity, and child online protection among the participating BRICS nations.

questions.question: Where will Semicon India 2026 be held?
questions.explanation: Semicon India 2026, the fifth edition of India’s major semiconductor industry event, will be held at Yashoobhoomi (IICC), Dwarka, New Delhi, from September 17 to 19, 2026. The event will showcase India’s expanding semiconductor ecosystem and is expected to feature more than 500 exhibitors, over 290 international companies, more than 150 speakers, and delegations from over 40 countries. The theme of the event is “Silicon to Systems: Building the Ecosystem.” Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the three-day event on September 17, highlighting India’s growing ambitions in semiconductor manufacturing and technology.

questions.question: Which Indian state declared snakebite a notifiable disease in August 2026?
questions.explanation: Maharashtra declared snakebite a notifiable disease, effective from August 18, 2026, making the reporting of suspected and confirmed snakebite cases and related deaths compulsory. Healthcare institutions and professionals are required to report cases to the concerned district health authorities through systems such as the Health Management Information System (HMIS) and Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme (IDSP). The measure aims to strengthen disease surveillance, ensure timely treatment, and improve planning for anti-snake venom (ASV) availability. The state has also emphasised the importance of receiving treatment within the “golden hour” of 60 minutes after a snakebite.

questions.question: Who became the world’s youngest male Chartered Accountant at the age of 16 years and 141 days?

His interest in accounting developed during the COVID-19 pandemic after completing his Class 10 examinations. Inspired by his mother, an ACCA-qualified professional, he pursued the ACCA qualification and completed it in about one year. He later obtained the CFA charter and began pursuing an MSc in Finance. He also works as a Senior Research Analyst at Century Financial in Dubai, focusing on investment research and financial analysis.

It provides cashless treatment of up to ₹5 lakh per year on a family floater basis at empanelled hospitals. The scheme is implemented under Ayushman Bharat-Arogya Karnataka regulations and managed by the Suvarna Arogya Suraksha Trust.

questions.question: Where will the 31st Southern Zonal Council meeting be held on August 20, 2026?
questions.explanation: Mahabalipuram in Tamil Nadu will host the 31st Southern Zonal Council meeting on August 20, 2026. The meeting will be chaired by Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Amit Shah and organised by the Inter-State Council Secretariat under the Ministry of Home Affairs. Representatives from southern states and Union Territories are expected to participate and discuss issues concerning regional coordination and development. The Southern Zonal Council is one of India’s five Zonal Councils, established under Sections 15 to 22 of the States Reorganisation Act, 1956. These councils provide a platform for strengthening coordination between states and the Centre and promoting cooperative federalism.

questions.question: Which postal organisation partnered with India Post to launch the PosTransfer UPI remittance service for direct money transfers to UPI-enabled accounts in India?
questions.explanation: Qatar Post partnered with India Post to launch the PosTransfer remittance service on August 15, 2026, enabling customers in Qatar to transfer money directly to UPI-enabled accounts in India. The service operates through Qatar Post outlets and uses the recipient’s UPI ID. The initiative involves the Universal Postal Union’s Interconnection Platform and NPCI International Payments Limited (NIPL). Transactions can range from QAR 10 to QAR 4,000, with a maximum equivalent of ₹1 lakh per transaction and a flat service fee of QAR 15. The service creates a digital remittance corridor for the Indian diaspora in Qatar.

questions.question: In which city did the 65th Subroto Cup International Football Tournament 2026 begin?
questions.explanation: New Delhi hosted the opening of the 65th Subroto Cup International Football Tournament 2026, which began on August 18, 2026. The opening ceremony was held at Dr B.R. Ambedkar Stadium and featured Air Marshal S Sivakumar as the Chief Guest and weightlifter Lovepreet Singh as the Guest of Honour. A total of 108 teams are participating across three categories: Junior Girls Under-17, Junior Boys Under-17, and Sub-Junior Boys Under-15. The tournament is an important grassroots football competition in India, providing young players with national-level exposure and opportunities to develop and showcase their footballing skills.

questions.question: In which city was the maiden flight of India’s first indigenous jet-powered loitering munition, Divyastra Mk3, successfully conducted?
questions.explanation: Lucknow was the city where Kawa UAV Pvt. Ltd. (HoverIt) successfully conducted the maiden flight of Divyastra Mk3 on August 11, 2026. Developed as India’s first indigenous jet-powered loitering munition, Divyastra Mk3 uses a jet engine developed by DG Propulsion and contains no imported foreign engines or critical subsystems. Kawa UAV, an indigenous defence technology firm based in Lucknow, specialises in high-speed precision strike systems and UAVs The successful flight demonstrates India’s growing capabilities in developing advanced, self-reliant defence technologies under the broader objective of Atmanirbhar Bharat.

questions.question: In which state was the Centre of Excellence for Eri Weaving inaugurated on August 18, 2026?
questions.explanation: Meghalaya was the location of the Centre of Excellence for Eri Weaving, inaugurated by Chief Minister Conrad K. Sangma on August 18, 2026. The centre was established at Ri Sai, Nongpoh, as part of the Integrated Textile Tourism Complex. Its primary objective is to preserve and promote traditional Eri weaving skills while creating sustainable opportunities for weavers, spinners, and silkworm rearers. Eri silk, also known as Ahimsa Silk or Peace Silk, is produced without killing the silkworm. Meghalaya is a major producer of Eri silk in North East India.

questions.question: By what percentage did Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) increase their gross loans during FY 2025-26?
questions.explanation: 10.3% was the increase in gross loans of Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) during FY 2025-26. Their gross loans outstanding rose from ₹5.24 lakh crore in the previous financial year to ₹5.78 lakh crore. The growth reflects increased financing support for rural entrepreneurship, micro enterprises, agriculture, MSMEs, and weaker sections. RRBs also achieved an average of 91.7% against the Priority Sector Lending target, which is statutorily fixed at 75% of Adjusted Net Bank Credit. The expansion highlights the important role of RRBs in strengthening rural credit availability and supporting economic development in rural areas.

questions.question: On which date is Indian Akshay Urja Day celebrated annually in India?
questions.explanation: August 20 is observed annually as Indian Akshay Urja Day, also known as Renewable Energy Day, in India. The day aims to raise awareness about renewable and sustainable energy sources such as solar, wind, hydroelectric, biomass, and geothermal energy. It also emphasises energy conservation, advancements in renewable-energy technologies, and greater public participation in India’s transition toward clean energy. The date is additionally significant because it marks the birth anniversary of former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi, who was associated with efforts to promote modernisation, science, and technology in India. The observance highlights the importance of clean energy for sustainable development and addressing climate change.

questions.question: Who was re-elected as the President of Zambia for a second consecutive five-year term in August 2026?
questions.explanation: Hakainde Hichilema was re-elected as the President of Zambia for a second consecutive five-year term on August 13, 2026. Representing the United Party for National Development (UPND), he secured 2,965,326 votes, accounting for approximately 61.4% of the total votes cast. The election was conducted under Zambia’s constitutional 50% + 1 majority rule, requiring a candidate to obtain more than half of the votes to avoid a second-round run-off. Hichilema’s new presidential term will span from 2026 to 2031. Zambia’s capital is Lusaka, and its currency is the Zambian Kwacha.

questions.question: On which date is World Mosquito Day observed annually?
questions.explanation: August 20 is observed annually as World Mosquito Day to raise awareness about mosquito-borne diseases and their prevention. The day commemorates the important discovery made by British-Indian physician and scientist Sir Ronald Ross in 1897, when he demonstrated that malaria is transmitted through the bite of infected female Anopheles mosquitoes. World Mosquito Day highlights the health risks associated with diseases such as malaria, dengue, chikungunya, Japanese encephalitis, and Zika virus. It also encourages communities to eliminate mosquito breeding sites, avoid stagnant water, use protective measures, and cooperate with public health agencies to reduce mosquito-borne disease transmission.

questions.explanation: August 19 is observed globally as World Humanitarian Day (WHD) to honour humanitarian workers and promote the protection of aid personnel under International Humanitarian Law (IHL). The 2026 campaign uses the official slogan #ActForHumanity.

Alamgir, a senior Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) leader and former Secretary General, transitioned from party politics to the country’s highest constitutional position. questions.question: Which state signed an agreement with Digital Bharat Nidhi (DBN) to implement the Amended BharatNet Program under a State-led model?
questions.explanation: Chhattisgarh signed an agreement with Digital Bharat Nidhi (DBN) on August 19, 2026, to implement the Amended BharatNet Program (ABP) under a State-led model. The project will be executed through Chhattisgarh State BharatNet Infrastructure Limited (CSBIL), with ₹3,942 crore in financial support approved by the Government of India. The program aims to cover 11,682 Gram Panchayats and provide connectivity to 8,328 villages on a demand basis. It also targets more than three lakh rural home fibre connections, supporting telemedicine, e-Governance, online education, and digital payments in remote areas.

questions.question: What is the name of the smart cancer drug developed by Indian scientists to selectively target tumour cells?
questions.explanation: RK-251 is a smart cancer drug developed through collaborative research led by the Institute of Advanced Study in Science and Technology (IASST), Guwahati, and IIT-Guwahati. The drug is designed to selectively activate inside cancer cells by responding to high levels of Reactive Oxygen Species (ROS), which are more abundant in such cells. Once activated, RK-251 releases the anticancer compound NBDHEX. The drug demonstrated high efficacy against triple-negative breast cancer, an aggressive form of the disease. Preclinical testing using zebrafish embryos showed zero toxicity, while fluorescence helped monitor drug activation in ROS-rich environments.

questions.question: Which state increased the annual health insurance coverage under its Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme from ₹5 lakh to ₹25 lakh?
questions.explanation: Tamil Nadu increased the annual health insurance coverage under the Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme from ₹5 lakh to ₹25 lakh on August 19, 2026. The five-fold increase is aimed at strengthening the state’s healthcare system and improving access to quality medical treatment for people across different income groups and geographical locations. The state also announced an extension of maternity leave for women employees for the third child from 12 weeks to 365 days, matching the duration available for the first two children. Additionally, official vehicles and monthly allowances were proposed for MLAs to help them address public grievances and monitor development projects.

questions.question: Which institute partnered with Tata Power to develop and commercialise next-generation clean energy solutions?
questions.explanation: IIT Bombay partnered with Tata Power through a Master Research Agreement (MRA) signed on August 17, 2026. The collaboration focuses on developing and commercialising next-generation clean energy technologies. Key research areas include smart grids, power electronics, energy storage, electric mobility, AI for power systems, digital grid technologies, cybersecurity, carbon capture, and the circular economy. The partnership aims to bridge the gap between laboratory research and large-scale commercial deployment while developing indigenous and scalable solutions to strengthen India’s energy security and support national decarbonization efforts.

questions.question: Which state hosted its first-ever Kaushal Mahotsav in Balurghat in August 2026?
questions.explanation: West Bengal hosted its first-ever Kaushal Mahotsav in Balurghat on August 19, 2026, organised by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) in collaboration with the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) and the state government. The event aimed to provide employment opportunities to the youth of Dakshin Dinajpur. More than 7,500 interviews were conducted, over 4,500 candidates were shortlisted, and more than 7,000 job opportunities were offered. Over 50 employers from manufacturing, retail, logistics, healthcare, hospitality, and banking participated in the recruitment drive.

questions.question: What was India’s unemployment rate for individuals aged 15 years and above in July 2026?
questions.explanation: India’s unemployment rate for individuals aged 15 years and above declined to 5.1% in July 2026, compared with 5.5% in June 2026, according to the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) Monthly Bulletin released by the National Statistics Office (NSO). The decline was accompanied by improvements in labour market indicators. The overall Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) increased to 55.4%, while the Worker Population Ratio (WPR) rose to 52.5%. Rural unemployment also decreased to 4.5%. The survey used the Current Weekly Status (CWS) approach for estimating employment and unemployment conditions.

questions.question: Which bank launched the women-focused YES Essence Credit Card in August 2026?
questions.explanation: YES Bank launched the YES Essence Credit Card on August 19, 2026, as a lifestyle and health-oriented financial product specifically designed for women. The card targets young professionals, salaried customers, and digitally active women. It offers accelerated reward points on dining, grocery, shopping, beauty, and travel, along with milestone rewards of up to 10,000 YES Rewardz points. Healthcare benefits include an annual preventive health check-up and specialised cancer marker screening. The card also provides lifestyle benefits such as BOGO movie tickets, complimentary coffee, welcome vouchers, and birthday vouchers.

questions.question: In which city did QpiAI inaugurate its 8-inch quantum foundry in August 2026?
questions.explanation: Bengaluru is the city where QpiAI inaugurated its 8-inch quantum foundry on August 19, 2026. The facility is located within a newly opened 70,000 sq ft R&D centre and is designed for semiconductor-scale manufacturing of advanced quantum processors. It aims to produce processors containing up to 10,000 physical qubits, a major increase from QpiAI’s existing 128-qubit capability. The facility will support the mass production of quantum processors for high-performance computing and the development of specialised quantum-AI solutions. Bengaluru, Karnataka, is also the headquarters of QpiAI, a full-stack quantum computing startup.

questions.question: Which country signed a Memorandum of Arrangement with India for Maritime Security Cooperation in August 2026?
questions.explanation: Japan signed a Memorandum of Arrangement with India on August 20, 2026, to strengthen Maritime Security Cooperation. Indian Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and Japanese Defence Minister Shinjiro Koizumi held a bilateral meeting in New Delhi for the agreement. The cooperation covers Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA), Search and Rescue (SAR), and Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR). The UNICORN integrated communications antenna system was also finalised as the first defence equipment transfer project between the two countries. India and Japan also conduct exercises such as Veer Guardian, Dharma Guardian, and JAIMEX to enhance military interoperability and strategic cooperation.

Always Here.’ initiative on August 21, 2026, to expand access to routine and planned healthcare services across all seven days of the week. The initiative extends outpatient consultations, diagnostic services, preventive health checks, and scheduled procedures to Sundays. Apollo also highlighted its AI-powered Apollo Prohealth platform for early health risk prediction and the Zen Health Program for detecting early signs of disease before symptoms appear. The initiative aims to provide timely healthcare access to Indian and international patients, supporting Apollo’s broader focus on preventive and technology-enabled healthcare.

questions.question: Which organisation transferred the technology for the development of the Submarine-Fired Decoy (SFD) to Bharat Dynamics Limited?
questions.explanation: DRDO transferred the technology for the development of the Submarine-Fired Decoy (SFD) to Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL) for indigenous production. The technology transfer agreement was signed by the Naval Science and Technological Laboratory (NSTL), a DRDO laboratory specialising in naval warfare and underwater defence technologies. The SFD is designed as a countermeasure system to protect submarines from incoming torpedoes by generating false signals and signatures that can mislead hostile torpedoes. The initiative strengthens India’s underwater defence capabilities, reduces dependence on foreign manufacturers, and supports the Aatmanirbhar Bharat vision in defence manufacturing.

questions.question: In which state will Reliance Industries Limited develop India’s first integrated Underground Coal Gasification complex?
questions.explanation: Andhra Pradesh will host Reliance Industries Limited’s proposed integrated Underground Coal Gasification (UCG) complex, described as India’s first of its kind. The project will be established in Eluru district, covering the Chintalapudi and Recherla coal blocks. RIL has proposed an investment of ₹2.73 lakh crore, to be implemented in exploration, development, and production phases. The project will use UCG technology to convert deep-seated coal into synthesis gas (syngas) directly underground. With substantial estimated coal reserves, the initiative is aligned with the National Coal Gasification Mission’s target of gasifying 100 million tonnes of coal by 2030.

questions.question: Which country co-chaired the 2nd India-Malaysia Joint Working Group Meeting on Public Administration and Governance Reforms?
questions.explanation: Malaysia co-chaired the 2nd India-Malaysia Joint Working Group Meeting on cooperation in Public Administration and Governance Reforms, held on August 18, 2026. The meeting was co-chaired by Shri Puneet Yadav from India’s Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) and Mr Datuk Dr Mohd Bakhari bin Ismail, Deputy Director General of Public Service, Malaysia. Discussions covered the Malaysia-India Governance Partnership Strategic Roadmap, digital governance tools, capacity building, artificial intelligence, blockchain, cloud services, and cybersecurity. India and Malaysia elevated their bilateral relationship to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership in August 2024.

questions.question: Which state launched four toll-free helplines to report extortion, syndicate activities, illegal road and toll tax collections, and illegal liquor activities?
questions.explanation: West Bengal launched four dedicated toll-free helplines to enable citizens to directly report various illegal activities. The helplines cover complaints related to extortion, syndicate activities, illegal road and toll tax collections, and illegal liquor. The numbers introduced are 155334 for extortion, 155335 for syndicate activities, 155337 for illegal road and toll tax collections, and 155339 for illegal liquor. Union Home Minister Amit Shah reviewed the functioning of these helplines during his visit to the state and assured that complaints received through the numbers would be acted upon promptly.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Honorary Advisor to the BRICS Chamber of Commerce & Industry (BRICS CCI) in August 2026?
questions.explanation: Dr. Eluri Sreedhar was appointed as the Honorary Advisor to the BRICS Chamber of Commerce & Industry (BRICS CCI) on August 17, 2026. His responsibilities include advising on economic collaboration and strategic partnerships, while supporting initiatives focused on inclusive development and social empowerment. He will also contribute to the development of sustainable opportunities in self-employment and livelihood creation and promote entrepreneurship and community empowerment at national and international levels. The appointment letter was formally presented by Sameep Shastri, Chairman of BRICS CCI. Established in 2012, BRICS CCI is a non-profit organisation headquartered in New Delhi that promotes trade, commerce, and industry among BRICS countries and emerging economies.

questions.question: On which date is National Space Day 2026 observed to commemorate the historic Chandrayaan-3 Moon landing?
questions.explanation: August 23 is observed as National Space Day in India to commemorate the historic soft landing of Chandrayaan-3 on the Moon on August 23, 2023. The Vikram lander successfully landed near the lunar south polar region, making India the first country to achieve a successful landing in that region and the fourth country to accomplish a soft landing on the Moon. National Space Day celebrates India’s achievements in space science and aims to inspire students, researchers, innovators, startups, and young entrepreneurs to contribute to the country’s growing space sector. The 2026 theme focuses on innovation, collaboration, and global space leadership.

questions.question: Which state became the first inland state in India to initiate the export of value-added Tilapia products?
questions.explanation: Chhattisgarh became the first inland state in India to initiate the export of value-added Tilapia products, with 382 tonnes exported to the United States. The achievement was highlighted during a review of the Tilapia Cluster under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) in Raipur. The state has received significant investment under PMMSY, with nearly ₹900 crore allocated to develop its fisheries sector. Modern technologies such as IoT, Biofloc, and Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems are being promoted to improve production and processing. The initiative aims to strengthen fisheries infrastructure, create employment, and enhance India’s seafood export competitiveness.

questions.question: Which state became the fifth state in India to ban the manufacture, storage, and sale of synthetic or analogue paneer?
questions.explanation: Himachal Pradesh became the fifth state in India to implement a ban on the manufacture, storage, and sale of synthetic or non-dairy analogue paneer being sold as genuine dairy products. The ban was imposed on August 21, 2026, under Section 30(2)(a) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. It applies to all Food Business Operators, including restaurants, hotels, cloud kitchens, and caterers. Businesses are prohibited from using analogue paneer in dishes marketed as paneer. The order is effective immediately for one year and also requires compliance with food labelling and traceability regulations to protect consumers.

questions.question: Who was appointed as a part-time Non-official Director on the Central Board of the Reserve Bank of India in August 2026?
questions.explanation: Somanath Sreedhara Panicker was appointed as a part-time Non-official Director on the Central Board of the Reserve Bank of India on August 20, 2026. The Central Government appointed him for a four-year tenure beginning from the date of appointment. Somanath Panicker is a former Chairman of ISRO and played a significant leadership role in the Chandrayaan-3 mission. The mission achieved a historic milestone by making India the first country to land near the Moon’s south polar region and the fourth country to achieve a soft landing on the Moon. Anand Mahindra was simultaneously reappointed to the RBI Central Board.

questions.question: What is the maximum shareholding that LIC is permitted to acquire in HDFC Bank after receiving approval from the RBI?
questions.explanation: 9.99% is the maximum shareholding that the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) is permitted to acquire in HDFC Bank following approval from the Reserve Bank of India on August 19, 2026. LIC’s holding was 4.11% as of August 14, 2026, and the RBI allowed it to increase its stake up to 9.99% of HDFC Bank’s paid-up share capital or voting rights. The acquisition must comply with RBI’s Master Directions on share acquisition in private banks and relevant SEBI regulations. The move is intended to strengthen LIC’s investment exposure to the financial services sector.

questions.question: In which city was the Yashoda AI initiative launched by the National Commission for Women in August 2026?
questions.explanation: Jalandhar was the city where the National Commission for Women (NCW) Chairperson Vijaya Rahatkar launched the Yashoda AI initiative on August 18, 2026. The initiative is an Artificial Intelligence literacy programme aimed at promoting digital empowerment and increasing women’s participation in emerging technologies. It provides training in areas such as cybersecurity, digital privacy, and safe online practices. The programme was originally initiated by the NCW in 2025. During the visit, the NCW also launched the She Serves programme at a women’s college to encourage young women to consider careers in the Armed Forces.

questions.question: Which company is the target entity in the equity shareholding acquisition approved by the Competition Commission of India?
questions.explanation: Bharti Life Insurance is the target entity in the equity shareholding acquisition approved by the Competition Commission of India (CCI) on August 19, 2026. Prudential Corporation of India is the acquirer in the transaction, which involves the acquisition of a specific equity shareholding in Bharti Life Insurance. The CCI is responsible for enforcing the Competition Act, 2002, and preventing anti-competitive practices in India. It functions under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs and is headquartered in New Delhi. The approval demonstrates the role of competition authorities in reviewing significant corporate transactions to ensure fair competition in the market.

questions.question: Which payments bank partnered with Paramotor Digital Technology Ltd to launch co-branded prepaid cards across India?
questions.explanation: NSDL Payments Bank entered into a co-branded partnership with Paramotor Digital Technology Ltd on August 21, 2026, to launch industry-specific prepaid cards across India. The partnership will support prepaid card solutions for both enterprises and consumers across various payment networks. Paramotor Digital will use the banking infrastructure of NSDL Payments Bank for card issuance. The collaboration will cover platforms such as SpendPro for consumer spending management, Yayyy.shop for digital gifting, and RewardOn for rewards and loyalty services. All payment solutions developed under the partnership will comply with RBI regulations and be integrated with secure existing payment networks.

questions.question: Which Indian women’s doubles pair won a bronze medal at the 2026 BWF World Championships?
options: Tan Ning and Liu Sheng Shu
Jia Yi Fan and Zhang Shu Xian
questions.explanation: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand won the bronze medal in women’s doubles at the 2026 BWF World Championships, ending India’s 15-year wait for a medal in the event. They became only the second Indian women’s doubles pair to achieve this feat after Jwala Gutta and Ashwini Ponnappa, who won bronze in 2011. Treesa and Gayatri reached the semifinals by defeating China’s Jia Yi Fan and Zhang Shu Xian in the quarterfinals. They eventually lost to top-seeded Chinese pair Tan Ning and Liu Sheng Shu in the semifinal after a 70-minute contest.

questions.question: Who became the leading wicket-taker in ICC World Test Championship history with 234 wickets?
questions.explanation: Mitchell Starc became the leading wicket-taker in ICC World Test Championship history after reaching 234 wickets. The Australian left-arm fast bowler surpassed teammates Pat Cummins and Nathan Lyon, who had 228 wickets each. Starc achieved the milestone during the second Test against Bangladesh at Mackay, where he produced a remarkable 10-wicket match haul. His performance also took his overall Test wicket tally to 445, allowing him to surpass South African great Dale Steyn and enter the top 10 wicket-takers in Test cricket history.

questions.question: Which institution will host the physical hub of the Jindal Steel Centre of Excellence for advanced steel research?
questions.explanation: IIT Hyderabad will host the physical hub of the Jindal Steel Centre of Excellence (CoE), established through an MoU signed with Jindal Steel on August 21, 2026. The centre aims to promote advanced research and innovation in high-strength, value-added, and value-engineered steels. Its applications will cover infrastructure, defence, power plants, refineries, transportation, and heavy engineering. The collaboration will also provide opportunities for student internships, placements, academic modules, workshops, and technical demonstrations. The CoE is expected to strengthen industry-academia collaboration and support the wider adoption of advanced steel technologies in strategic and infrastructure sectors.

questions.question: Which bank raised $500 million through its first-ever international bond issuance in August 2026?
questions.explanation: IDFC First Bank raised $500 million through its maiden overseas bond issuance on August 19, 2026, marking its entry into global debt markets. The bank issued three-year fixed-rate senior notes carrying a coupon rate of 5.625%, with the bonds scheduled to mature in 2029. The issuance was conducted through the bank’s International Financial Services Centre (IFSC) Banking Unit at GIFT City in Gandhinagar. S&P Global Ratings assigned the bonds a BBB- long-term issuer credit rating with a stable outlook. The funds are intended to diversify the bank’s funding base and support its long-term expansion plans.

questions.question: Which state approved a ₹31,387-crore green AI data centre project?
questions.explanation: Andhra Pradesh approved a major ₹31,387-crore green AI data centre project in Visakhapatnam. AM AI Factory (Vizag) Pvt Ltd will establish a 512 MW Green Integrated AI Data Centre Facility at Amanam village in Bheemunipatnam mandal. The facility is expected to be developed within two years and four months and could create employment opportunities for around 1,000 people. The state government has also approved several incentives, including support for power infrastructure and water supply, along with exemptions from stamp duty and electricity duty. The project is aimed at attracting large-scale technology investments to Andhra Pradesh.

questions.question: Which state approved 180 days of maternity leave twice during the service period for eligible female state government employees, without a mandatory two-year gap?
questions.explanation: Uttar Pradesh approved a revised maternity leave provision allowing eligible female state government employees to avail themselves of 180 days, or six months, of maternity leave twice during their service period. A major change is the removal of the earlier mandatory two-year gap between two maternity leaves. The amendment concerns Rule 153(1) of the Uttar Pradesh Financial Handbook. The revised provision is intended to support working mothers by providing adequate time for pregnancy, childbirth, recovery, and childcare. The benefit has also been extended to adoptive mothers under the revised provisions.

questions.question: By which year does India plan to establish the Bharatiya Antariksha Station (BAS)?
questions.explanation: India plans to establish the Bharatiya Antariksha Station (BAS) by 2035, as announced by ISRO Chairman V. Narayanan during the third National Space Day celebrations in Ahmedabad on August 23, 2026. The first module of the proposed space station has already been approved. The BAS is expected to support India’s long-term human spaceflight activities, building upon capabilities developed through the Gaganyaan programme. It will provide opportunities for scientific research, technology testing, and gaining experience in extended human missions in space, marking a significant advancement in India’s space exploration ambitions.

questions.question: In which Indian state was the first 100% indigenous AK-203 ‘Sher’ rifle manufactured and test-fired?
questions.explanation: Uttar Pradesh is the state where India’s first fully indigenous AK-203 ‘Sher’ rifle was manufactured and successfully test-fired. The rifle was produced at the Korwa factory of Indo-Russian Rifles Private Limited (IRRPL) in Amethi. The prototype uses 100% Indian components and raw materials, marking a major achievement in defence indigenisation under the Make in India and Atmanirbhar Bharat initiatives. The AK-203 is a 7.62×39 mm gas-operated assault rifle based on the Kalashnikov platform. Indian Army trials for the indigenous rifle are planned for September 2026.

questions.question: Which airline partnered with Wizzmoni Financial Services Ltd to launch the Wizz Voyager co-branded multi-currency travel card?
questions.explanation: Oman Air partnered with Wizzmoni Financial Services Ltd to launch the Wizz Voyager, an AI-powered co-branded multi-currency travel card for international travellers. The card supports more than 35 global currencies and is issued in partnership with VISA for worldwide acceptance. It offers features such as real-time transaction tracking, smart financial controls, and milestone-based rewards, including Oman Air flight vouchers and cabin upgrades. The card is aimed at frequent international travelers, tourists, students, and professionals. Oman Air is a member of the oneworld Alliance and began international flight operations in 1993.

questions.question: Who won the Kanizsa Open 2026 Group A chess title in Hungary?
questions.explanation: Pranesh M won the Kanizsa Open 2026 Group A title held in Nagykanizsa, Hungary. The 19-year-old Indian Grandmaster from Karaikudi, Tamil Nadu, finished with 7 points from 9 rounds. He secured the championship on superior tiebreak scores after four players finished tied on 7 points. Pranesh sealed his victory by defeating German Grandmaster Vadim Petrovskiy with the white pieces in the ninth and final round. His success adds another notable international achievement to his growing chess career and highlights the strong representation of young Indian players in international chess tournaments.

questions.question: Where was the National Conclave on Tribal Languages and Museums launched on August 24, 2026?
questions.explanation: Mysuru hosted the National Conclave on Tribal Languages and Museums on August 24, 2026, in Karnataka. Organised by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs in association with the Karnataka State Tribal Research Institute and the Central Institute of Indian Languages, the three-day conclave focused on conserving tribal languages and culture. Major initiatives included the revamped Adi Vaani platform with an iOS app and five new languages, along with the launch of the Jago AI bot. The event also featured discussions on multilingual education, language documentation, technology, and community-led revival of endangered tribal languages.

questions.question: Where was the 25th India–UK Defence Consultative Group meeting held in August, 2026?
questions.explanation: New Delhi hosted the 25th India–UK Defence Consultative Group (DCG) meeting on August 21, 2026. The meeting focused on strengthening bilateral defence industrial cooperation between India and the United Kingdom. It was co-chaired by Indian Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh and UK Permanent Under Secretary for Defence Jeremy Pocklington. Discussions included reviewing the India–UK Vision 2035 and advancing research and development under the Ten-year Defence Industrial Roadmap. Both sides also agreed to expand military cooperation through joint exercises, training, and capacity building. The UK delegation additionally visited the National War Memorial, Gandhi Smriti Museum, and National Defence College.

questions.question: In which state was the NSG’s first Mahila Commando Conversion Course inaugurated?
questions.explanation: Haryana hosted the inauguration of the National Security Guard’s (NSG) first-ever Mahila Commando Conversion Course (MCCC) at the NSG Training Academy in Manesar. The 12-week specialised programme is designed for selected women personnel from State Police Forces and Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs). Participants receive rigorous training in physical fitness, endurance, weapon handling, marksmanship, tactical intervention, hostage rescue, and counter-terrorism operations. After completing the course, the women commandos will return to their respective forces and contribute their specialised skills. The initiative aims to increase women’s operational capabilities and strengthen coordination among India’s security forces.

questions.question: Which country signed an MoU with India to strengthen bilateral cooperation in telecommunications and ICTs?
questions.explanation: Brazil signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with India on August 21, 2026, to strengthen bilateral cooperation in telecommunications and Information and Communication Technologies (ICTs). The agreement was signed on the sidelines of the 12th BRICS Communications Ministers Meeting in Pune, Maharashtra. It promotes cooperation in emerging technologies such as 5G, 6G, Artificial Intelligence, and the Internet of Things. The two countries will also collaborate on Open RAN, Direct-to-Device connectivity, Non-Terrestrial Networks, Low Earth Orbit satellites, cybersecurity, spectrum management, and Digital Public Infrastructure. The framework is based on equality, mutual benefit, and mutual respect.

questions.question: Who became the first French woman to perform a spacewalk at the International Space Station?
questions.explanation: Sophie Adenot became the first French woman to perform a spacewalk during a maintenance mission at the International Space Station (ISS). She conducted the spacewalk alongside NASA astronaut Anil Menon, with the primary objective of replacing a space-to-ground antenna that supports the station’s communication network. The work was carried out around the Z1 truss above the Unity module. The initial spacewalk lasted approximately six and a half hours, but the antenna installation could not be completed due to time constraints. A second spacewalk was scheduled for August 25, 2026, to finish the installation, with Jack Hathaway assisting through the Canadarm2 robotic arm.

questions.question: Which Indian city debuted in the IWG 2026 Work From Anywhere Index with a score of 77?
questions.explanation: Mumbai debuted in the IWG 2026 Work From Anywhere Index with a score of 77, becoming the only Indian city included in the global ranking. The index evaluates destinations based on factors such as weather, broadband connectivity, accommodation, transportation, culture, food, and flexible workspaces. Mumbai performed particularly well in transport, accommodation, flexible workspace availability, and weather. Its score was higher than those of cities such as London and Miami. However, Mumbai faced comparatively weaker scores in broadband speed, events, and happiness. Bangkok topped the 2026 index with 106.5 points, followed by Tokyo and Barcelona.

questions.question: Which state sanctioned ₹18 lakh for the construction of a new Government Primary School building?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan sanctioned ₹18 lakh on August 23, 2026, for constructing a new building for the Government Primary School in Rampura (Kanwarpura), Jaipur. The project is located in the Sanganer block, with construction scheduled to begin on September 1, 2026. Of the total amount, ₹12 lakh will come from the District Mineral Foundation Trust (DMFT), while ₹6 lakh will be provided through the MLA fund. The original school building had been declared dilapidated after a technical survey in September 2025. The initiative forms part of Rajasthan’s broader efforts to improve school infrastructure across the state.

questions.question: Where was the first Steering Committee meeting for the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) held on August, 2026?
questions.explanation: New Delhi hosted the first Steering Committee meeting for the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) on August 21, 2026. The meeting reviewed preparations for the festival, which is scheduled to take place in Goa from November 20 to 28, 2026. Ashutosh Gowariker has been appointed Festival Director, while Dr L. Murugan, Minister of State for Information and Broadcasting, is the Chairman of the Steering Committee. The meeting focused on providing opportunities for young students and emerging filmmakers, promoting India’s Orange Economy, strengthening international cinema outreach, and implementing masterclasses and mentorship programmes.

questions.question: Which country launched Operation Economic Outcast to target Iran’s revenues, oil networks, and global trade links?
questions.explanation: The United States launched Operation Economic Outcast, a new global campaign aimed at increasing economic pressure on Iran. The operation seeks to disrupt Iranian revenue sources and economic supply lines, with major targets including digital assets, technology, gold, aviation, and shipping. Iranian oil revenues and the networks involved in converting oil earnings into funds are also key areas of focus. The US Treasury Department imposed fresh sanctions on 60 entities, ships, and individuals across several countries. The campaign also threatens secondary sanctions against foreign businesses or nations that engage with Iran’s targeted economic networks, potentially creating wider global economic repercussions.

questions.question: Who won the 2026 Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort?
questions.explanation: Lando Norris won the 2026 Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix at Circuit Zandvoort on August 24, 2026, securing his second consecutive victory of the 2026 F1 season. Representing McLaren, Norris finished ahead of Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli, who was the runner-up, trailing by 11.536 seconds. George Russell, also driving for Mercedes, completed the podium in third place. Ferrari drivers Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc finished fourth and fifth, respectively. The Dutch Grand Prix is held at Circuit Zandvoort in the Netherlands and returned to the Formula 1 calendar in 2021 after a 36-year absence.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as Officer on Special Duty (OSD) in the Directorate of Home Guards of Delhi and is set to become its Director General from October 1, 2026?
questions.explanation: Satish Golcha, a senior IPS officer of the AGMUT cadre, has been appointed as Officer on Special Duty (OSD) in the Directorate of Home Guards, Delhi. His OSD tenure will continue until the retirement of the current Director General, Virender Singh, on September 30, 2026. From October 1, 2026, Golcha is expected to take charge as the Director General of Home Guards. Earlier, he served as Commissioner of Police, Delhi, and Director General (Prisons), Delhi, along with holding other senior positions in the Delhi Police.

questions.question: Where will the SCO Summit 2026 be held from August 31 to September 1?
questions.explanation: Bishkek, the capital of Kyrgyzstan, will host the SCO Summit 2026 from August 31 to September 1. The summit is particularly significant as the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) marks its 25th anniversary. The meeting will focus on regional security, counterterrorism, transport connectivity, trade and energy cooperation. Discussions are also expected to address emerging threats such as cybercrime and organised crime, along with major connectivity projects in Central Asia. The summit will bring together representatives of the SCO’s 10 member states, including India, China, Russia, Pakistan, Iran and Belarus, highlighting the organisation’s growing regional importance.

questions.question: Which country announced the discovery of over 7.5 trillion cubic feet of natural gas reserves in its southern Fars province in August, 2026?
questions.explanation: Iran announced the discovery of more than 7.5 trillion cubic feet (TCF) of natural gas reserves in Fars province in southern Iran on August 23, 2026. Approximately 5.7 tcf of the discovered reserves are considered recoverable. The discovery also includes valuable gas condensates worth tens of billions of dollars and could provide production equivalent to around 15 years of output from a single phase of the South Pars field. The new reserves are particularly significant for Iran’s energy security following a 25% reduction in daily gas production capacity caused by infrastructure attacks in February 2026.

questions.question: Which company launched the Multi-Currency EEFC Account solution for exporters on August 24, 2026?
questions.explanation: Razorpay launched its Multi-Currency EEFC Account solution on August 24, 2026, to help exporters receive international payments directly in foreign currencies. The solution allows earnings to be credited to Exchange Earners’ Foreign Currency (EEFC) accounts in the original transaction currency, including USD, EUR, GBP, AED and SGD. It helps businesses reduce foreign exchange conversion cycles, minimise FX leakage and lower associated costs. The service is integrated into Razorpay’s existing dashboard and settlement engine, so merchants do not need separate onboarding or additional setup. Razorpay, established in 2014 and headquartered in Bengaluru, operates as an omnichannel payments platform for businesses.

questions.question: Which vessel is set to be commissioned as the second Nistar-class Diving Support Vessel of the Indian Navy on 31st August 2026?
questions.explanation: Nipun is the second Nistar-class Diving Support Vessel (DSV) of the Indian Navy and is scheduled to be commissioned on 31st August 2026 at the Naval Dockyard, Mumbai. The vessel was indigenously designed and built by Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL), Visakhapatnam. Nipun is equipped for specialised diving, underwater interventions, medical support and submarine rescue operations. Its commissioning will strengthen the Navy’s capabilities in deep-sea diving and underwater missions while also highlighting India’s growing expertise in indigenous defence shipbuilding and supporting the broader objective of achieving self-reliance in defence manufacturing.

questions.question: Which organisation unveiled the indigenous NJ-05, NJ-50 and NJ-100 micro and small gas turbine engines for defence applications?
questions.explanation: CSIR unveiled three Indian-made micro and small gas turbine engines—NJ-05, NJ-50 and NJ-100—on 25th August 2026. Developed by CSIR-National Aerospace Laboratories (CSIR-NAL), these engines generate thrusts of 5 kg, 50 kg and 100 kg respectively. They are designed for tactical UAVs, drone interceptors and compact missile systems. The development strengthens India’s indigenous propulsion capabilities and supports the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative. It is also expected to reduce dependence on imported propulsion systems while creating opportunities for Indian aerospace industries and start-ups to manufacture specialised engines.

questions.question: By what percentage did India’s finished steel consumption increase during April-July 2026?
questions.explanation: India’s finished steel consumption increased by 7.9% during April-July 2026, reaching 56 million tonnes (MT), compared with 52 MT during the corresponding period of the previous year. The growth in consumption was higher than the 4.7% increase in finished steel production, which reached 54.7 MT. This stronger rise in consumption indicates robust domestic demand, particularly from infrastructure and construction-related industries. During the same period, India’s crude steel production also increased by 2.4% to 56.2 MT, reflecting continued growth in the country’s steel sector.

questions.question: Which institution conferred the Nina Saxena Excellence in Technology Award 2026 on Dr Nishanth Dongari?
questions.explanation: IIT Kharagpur conferred the Nina Saxena Excellence in Technology Award 2026 on Dr Nishanth Dongari on August 18, 2026, during its Platinum Jubilee foundation day. Dr Dongari, an Associate Professor at IIT Hyderabad and founder of PURE Energy, was recognised for developing PuREPower, India’s first all-in-one integrated Battery Energy Storage System (BESS). The system combines solar charging with lithium-ion storage and features an automatic switchover in under 10 milliseconds, along with AI-driven battery management. The Nina Saxena Award is presented annually by IIT Kharagpur to recognise outstanding technical innovation and commercialisation.

questions.question: Which country signed an MoU with India to strengthen bilateral cooperation in telecommunications and Information and Communication Technologies (ICTs) on August 21, 2026?

It promotes cooperation in emerging technologies such as 5G, 6G, Artificial Intelligence and the Internet of Things. questions.question: Which bank extended Ketan Merchant’s tenure as Interim Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer for another three months from August 27, 2026?
questions.explanation: Fino Payments Bank extended Ketan Merchant’s tenure as Interim Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer for another three months, beginning August 27, 2026. The extension was recommended by the Nomination & Remuneration Committee and approved by the bank’s board. It remains subject to approval from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). Merchant assumed the interim leadership role on May 27, 2026, following the resignation of Rishi Gupta. Before becoming interim CEO, Merchant served as the bank’s Chief Financial Officer. The extension ensures continuity in leadership during the transition period.

questions.question: Which village was declared Maharashtra’s first 100% LPG-free PNG village by Mahanagar Gas Limited?
questions.explanation: Ashiv village in Latur district was officially declared Maharashtra’s first 100% LPG-free PNG village by Mahanagar Gas Limited (MGL) on August 20, 2026. The village successfully transitioned from Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) to Piped Natural Gas (PNG), with MGL providing direct pipeline connections to 1,050 households. The initiative ensures an uninterrupted cooking fuel supply directly to homes and supports the government’s objective of increasing the share of natural gas in India’s energy mix. The project was implemented in coordination with the Ashiv Gram Panchayat and local district authorities, marking an important milestone in village-level clean energy adoption.
