questions.question: How many African nations did the WHO confirm had officially ended poliovirus type 2 outbreaks in August 2026?
questions.explanation: Five African nations, Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, the Republic of Congo, and Uganda were confirmed by the World Health Organisation (WHO) to have officially ended their poliovirus type 2 outbreaks on August 21, 2026. The declaration specifically concerned circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 2 (cVDPV2), which can emerge in populations with insufficient immunity. The assessment followed an Independent Outbreak Response Assessment conducted between January and June 2026. The WHO’s efforts focus on closing immunity gaps through high-quality vaccination campaigns, stronger routine immunisation, improved surveillance, and modernised laboratory networks across the African Region.

questions.question: Which state government ordered the suspension of food licences of Amazon, Swiggy Instamart, and BigBasket over the sale of toxic Dhatura seeds?
questions.explanation: Karnataka ordered the immediate suspension of food licences for Amazon, Swiggy Instamart, and BigBasket on August 25, 2026, after the platforms were found listing toxic Dhatura fruits and seeds for food use or human consumption. The action was taken by the Food Safety and Drug Administration under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. Authorities also suspended registrations of third-party sellers supplying the products and directed the removal of related listings, advertisements, and promotional materials. Dhatura is a poisonous plant containing tropane alkaloids that can cause serious adverse health effects, making its sale as food strictly prohibited.

questions.question: Which French aerospace company signed a deal with HAL to co-develop the Aravalli helicopter engine?
questions.explanation: Safran, a French aerospace company, signed a deal with Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) to jointly develop the Aravalli helicopter engine for India’s future multirole military helicopters. The engine will belong to the 3,500–4,000 shaft horsepower class and is intended to power the 13-tonne Indian Multi-Role Helicopter (IMRH) and the 12.5-tonne Deck-Based Multi-Role Helicopter (DBMRH). The project will be undertaken through SAFHAL Helicopter Engines Pvt Ltd, a 50:50 joint venture between HAL and Safran, with production planned at HAL’s facility in Tumakuru, Karnataka.

questions.question: Which football club won the 2026 Durand Cup by defeating Mohun Bagan 4-1 in the final?
questions.explanation: East Bengal won the 2026 Durand Cup by defeating Mohun Bagan 4-1 in the final held in Kolkata, West Bengal, on August 25, 2026. The victory earned East Bengal its record-equalling 17th Durand Cup title, matching Mohun Bagan’s previous record. The triumph also ended East Bengal’s 22-year wait for the prestigious trophy, with their previous title coming in 2004. Edmund Lalrindika was the star performer, scoring a hat-trick, while Bipin Singh also found the net. East Bengal was coached by Antonio Lopez Habas and captained by Mohammed Rashid.

questions.question: Which state Legislative Assembly passed a resolution rejecting the exploration and mining of uranium?
questions.explanation: Meghalaya passed a resolution rejecting uranium exploration and mining in the state. The resolution was introduced by Chief Minister Conrad K Sangma and received unanimous support from all 60 MLAs of the Meghalaya Legislative Assembly. It urged the Government of India, the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE), and Uranium Corporation of India Ltd (UCIL) not to permit, conduct, or undertake uranium mining operations in the state. Concerns over environmental impacts, public health risks, and opposition from local communities were key reasons behind the resolution.

questions.question: Which bank signed an MoU with the Indian Army to launch specialised credit cards for Army personnel?
questions.explanation: Punjab National Bank (PNB) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Indian Army on August 21, 2026, to introduce specialised credit cards tailored for Army personnel. The PNB LUXURA Metal Credit Card is designed for Army officers, while the PNB Parakram Credit Card is intended for Junior Commissioned Officers (JCOs) and other ranks. Benefits include 3% cashback at CSD outlets, zero forex markup on international transactions, airport lounge access, golf lessons, and BOGO movie ticket offers. The Parakram card also features a biodegradable design, supporting environmental sustainability.

questions.question: Who won the FIDE-rated rapid chess tournament with 8.5 points from nine rounds?
questions.explanation: Apoorv Kamble won the FIDE-rated rapid chess tournament by scoring an impressive 8.5 points from nine rounds. The 17-year-old chess player secured the top position ahead of Sammed Jaykumar Shete, who finished second, and Vaidyanathan Kannan, who took third place. More than 700 players participated in the tournament, which followed the Swiss System and used a time control of 10 minutes plus a 5-second increment. Kamble had recently returned from the Asian Junior Championship in Mumbai and said that the victory significantly boosted his confidence.

questions.question: Which Indian state signed an MoU with Germany’s Hessen to strengthen cooperation in investment, innovation, and skill development?
questions.explanation: Maharashtra signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the German state of Hessen on August 21, 2026, to enhance cooperation in investment, innovation, and skill development. The agreement was signed in Mumbai by Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis and Hessen’s Minister President Boris Rhein. It covers industry and services, information technology, skilled manpower and cross-border mobility. The partnership also promotes AI and R&D collaborations and expands opportunities in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, engineering, automotive, logistics, and the digital economy. Hessen will serve as the “Gateway to Europe” for Maharashtra, while Maharashtra will act as the “Gateway to India and the Indo-Pacific” for Hessen.

questions.question: Which bank signed an MoU with VinFast India to provide inventory financing solutions for its authorised dealer network?
questions.explanation: Federal Bank signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with VinFast India on August 25, 2026, to provide tailored inventory financing solutions for VinFast’s authorised dealers. The arrangement is designed to give dealers greater financial flexibility, optimise working capital, and maintain healthy vehicle inventories. It is also expected to improve operational efficiency across VinFast’s nationwide distribution network. The partnership aims to strengthen the company’s retail foundation and support its long-term growth in India’s electric vehicle market. Federal Bank, established in 1931 as Travancore Federal Bank, is headquartered in Aluva, Kerala, and is one of India’s leading private sector banks.

questions.question: On which date is World Lake Day observed annually?
questions.explanation: August 27 is observed annually as World Lake Day to raise awareness about the importance of lakes and the need for their conservation, restoration, and sustainable management. The date commemorates the first World Lake Conference held on August 27, 1984, in Shiga Prefecture, Japan. The United Nations General Assembly established World Lake Day through Resolution 79/142, adopted by consensus on December 12, 2024. The first global observance took place on August 27, 2025, making August 27, 2026, the second United Nations observance. The day highlights freshwater security, biodiversity, livelihoods, and environmental protection.

questions.question: In which Union Territory was DRDO’s indigenous Military Combat Parachute System successfully tested at an altitude of 22,000 feet?
questions.explanation: Ladakh was the location of the first successful high-altitude test of DRDO’s indigenous Military Combat Parachute System (MCPS). The trial was conducted at the Nyoma-Mudh drop zone, one of the world’s highest drop zones. The jump took place from 22,000 feet above mean sea level in temperatures of around minus 15 degrees Celsius. The parachute system demonstrated its efficiency, reliability, and tactical usability under extreme conditions. Developed by DRDO’s ADRDE and DEBEL, the MCPS includes features such as improved guidance, reduced descent rate, and NavIC compatibility, strengthening India’s indigenous defence capabilities.

questions.question: Which state launched the Vidya Sathi app to provide free 24-hour live academic support to students in Classes 9–12?
questions.explanation: Bihar launched the Vidya Sathi app to provide continuous academic assistance to nearly 3 lakh students studying in Classes 9 to 12 across around 700 Saraswati Vidya Niketan model schools in all 38 districts of the state. The app offers live interaction with teachers, personalised academic guidance, and digital study materials beyond regular classroom hours. It also supports preparation for Bihar Board examinations and competitive entrance exams such as JEE and NEET. Around 75,000 teachers are expected to provide academic assistance through the programme, strengthening digital education and personalised learning opportunities for students.

questions.question: Which company acquired Porsche subsidiary MHP Management for an enterprise value of €320 million?
questions.explanation: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) acquired 100 per cent of the shares of MHP Management- und IT-Beratung GmbH, a subsidiary of German automaker Porsche, for an enterprise value of €320 million. The acquisition, announced on August 24, 2026, is part of a broader strategic partnership between TCS, MHP, and Porsche. Porsche also signed a five-year partnership valued at €1.25 billion. The collaboration includes establishing a dedicated AI Mobility Centre of Excellence for Porsche and focuses on next-generation manufacturing technologies, software-defined mobility, and digital transformation. TCS is headquartered in Mumbai and was founded in 1968.

questions.question: Which country is partnering with India to mobilise 10 trillion yen of private investment over the next 10 years?
questions.explanation: Japan is partnering with India to mobilise 10 trillion yen of Japanese private investment into India over the next 10 years, with a strong focus on semiconductors and artificial intelligence. The partnership also covers green hydrogen, data centres, digital infrastructure, and cybersecurity. Japanese financial institutions such as MUFG and Mizuho are already expanding their presence in India. The initiative supports India’s broader economic vision of becoming a USD 30 trillion economy by 2047. GIFT City in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, is also being promoted as a key gateway for international investment and financial activities.

questions.question: Which bank partnered with Citigroup to finance NRI foreign-currency deposits?
questions.explanation: Axis Bank partnered with Citigroup Inc. on August 24, 2026, to finance Non-Resident Indian (NRI) foreign-currency deposits and support India’s foreign exchange reserves. Under the arrangement, Axis Bank provides standby letters of credit that support offshore financing extended by Citigroup to NRI investors. This mechanism enables leveraged investment in foreign-currency deposits and allows offshore lenders to provide financing without maintaining a retail presence in India. Axis Bank also offers FCNR (B) deposits with interest rates of up to 6.40%. The partnership strengthens financial linkages with NRIs while supporting foreign-currency inflows into India.

questions.question: Which Indian state launched the Startup Mission portal and Startup Policy 2026?
questions.explanation: Uttar Pradesh launched the UP Startup Mission portal along with the Startup Policy 2026 to strengthen its startup ecosystem. The initiative aims to provide startups and entrepreneurs with easier access to government services, funding, incubation, and other resources. Uttar Pradesh currently has more than 24,000 startups, including eight unicorns, compared with around 120 startups before 2017. The policy also focuses on supporting Centres of Excellence in areas such as MedTech, drones, quantum computing, space technology, robotics, and green hydrogen, while promoting employment, innovation, entrepreneurship, and economic growth.

questions.question: In which Indian state was India’s first non-GMO, high-expansion popcorn maize hybrid seed launched?
questions.explanation: Andhra Pradesh was the state where India’s first non-GMO, high-expansion popcorn maize hybrid seed was launched on August 24, 2026. Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan launched the indigenous hybrid at Musunuru in Eluru district. Developed by Gourmet Popcornica, the initiative aims to reduce dependence on imported hybrid technology, conserve foreign exchange, and improve India’s competitiveness in the global popcorn maize sector. The project involves more than 17,500 farmers across eight states and covers around 40,000 acres. It also integrates maize processing, quality control, and cold storage to improve market access and increase farmers’ incomes.

questions.question: Which sanctuary has been identified as a critical breeding stronghold for the Black-necked Stork?
questions.explanation: Khijadiya Sanctuary in Gujarat has been identified as a critical breeding stronghold for the Black-necked Stork. A scientific study conducted by the Gujarat Ecological Education and Research (GEER) Foundation confirmed four active nests, with each breeding pair successfully producing two fledglings. The sanctuary recorded a peak seasonal population of 21 Black-necked Storks, including eight juveniles and five non-breeding adults. Located in Jamnagar district, Khijadiya is a Ramsar Site designated in 2022 and is notable for its combination of freshwater and saltwater wetland habitats, making it an important site for bird conservation.

questions.question: Which country unveiled the AIM-424 Malice long-range air-to-air missile?
questions.explanation: The United States unveiled the AIM-424 Malice long-range air-to-air missile in August 2026 following a fit test on an F-35 aircraft. The missile was developed and built by Raytheon for high-end aerial combat and has an operational range exceeding 250 nautical miles (463 kilometres). It is designed to maintain manoeuvrability against fighter-sized targets and incorporates specialised aerodynamic features and a dedicated datalink infrastructure. The AIM-424 Malice is planned for deployment on platforms including the F-47, F-35C, F/A-18, and developmental F/A-XX, representing a significant advancement in long-range aerial warfare capabilities.

questions.question: In which state did the National Security Guard inaugurate its first-ever Mahila Commando Conversion Course?
questions.explanation: Haryana hosted the inauguration of the National Security Guard’s (NSG) first-ever Mahila Commando Conversion Course (MCCC) on August 26, 2026. The 12-week specialised program is being conducted at the NSG training centre in Manesar. It is designed for women personnel selected from various State Police Forces and Central Armed Police Forces. The training covers counter-terror operations, tactical intervention, marksmanship, hostage rescue, physical conditioning, and weapons handling. The initiative aims to establish uniform professional standards among participating personnel and strengthen coordination between India’s security agencies in responding to complex security and counter-terrorism situations.

questions.question: On which date is World Sanskrit Day 2026 observed?
questions.explanation: August 28 is observed as World Sanskrit Day 2026, also known as Sanskrit Diwas or Vishva Sanskrit Diwas. The day falls on Shravana Purnima, the full moon day of the Shravana month. It aims to promote awareness of Sanskrit and highlight its contributions to Indian literature, philosophy, science, religion, and linguistics. Sanskrit Day has been officially observed in India since 1969 following notifications issued by the Union Ministry of Education. Celebrations commonly include shloka recitations, essay competitions, debates, seminars, and other activities that encourage students and the younger generation to learn about Sanskrit and its rich heritage.

questions.question: Who became the first Indian player to win the Grand Chess Tour title?
questions.explanation: R Praggnanandhaa became the first Indian player to win the Grand Chess Tour title after defeating American Grandmaster Fabiano Caruana 15-13 in a thrilling final at the Saint Louis Chess Club. He made a remarkable comeback after trailing by six points at the start of the decisive day. Praggnanandhaa won both rapid games and held his nerve during the blitz phase to secure the title. The victory earned him USD 200,000 in prize money and added another major achievement to his successful year, following his Norway Chess triumph.

questions.question: In which state was the redeveloped Hutatma Smruti Smarak at Patradevi inaugurated?
questions.explanation: Goa was the location where Defence Minister Rajnath Singh inaugurated the newly re-developed Hutatma Smruti Smarak at Patradevi on August 26, 2026. The memorial honours the satyagrahis who participated in the Goa liberation struggle, particularly those involved in the peaceful August 15, 1955 satyagraha against Portuguese rule. The ₹9.50 crore project was developed by the Goa State Infrastructure Development Corporation and features a redesigned central monument, sculptures, information hubs, and murals. Goa was liberated from Portuguese rule through Operation Vijay in December 1961 and later became India’s 25th state on May 30, 1987.

questions.question: On which date is National Sports Day celebrated annually in India?
questions.explanation: August 29 is celebrated annually as National Sports Day in India to honour Major Dhyan Chand, the legendary hockey player, on his birth anniversary. Born in 1905, Dhyan Chand played a major role in India’s Olympic hockey success and was part of the gold medal-winning teams in 1928, 1932, and 1936. National Sports Day also promotes physical fitness, sports participation, and healthy living. The Fit India Movement was launched on August 29, 2019, to encourage fitness as a regular part of daily life. The day is also associated with India’s National Sports Awards.

questions.question: Which Indian state launched the Bidesh Sikhyabruti scholarship scheme for SC and ST students pursuing higher education abroad?
questions.explanation: Odisha launched the Bidesh Sikhyabruti scholarship scheme on August 23, 2026, to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe communities who pursue higher education abroad. Each year, 50 students will be selected, provided they secure admission to international institutions ranked among the Top 200 in the QS World University Rankings. Each beneficiary can receive up to ₹25 lakh per annum, covering tuition, accommodation, living expenses, international travel, medical insurance, and incidental costs. Odisha also became the first Indian state to implement a universal free education policy from Kindergarten to Post-Graduation in July 2026.

questions.question: Which country partnered with India to establish a strategic roadmap for cooperation in fisheries, aquaculture, and the Blue Economy?
questions.explanation: Seychelles partnered with India on August 25, 2026, to establish a strategic roadmap for cooperation in fisheries, aquaculture, and the Blue Economy. The bilateral meeting focused on areas such as marine aquaculture, modern hatcheries, tuna fisheries, marine conservation, and Monitoring, Control, and Surveillance infrastructure. The two sides also discussed using Artificial Intelligence in harvest management, strengthening fisheries data systems, and developing the tuna-processing value chain. A proposed bilateral Memorandum of Understanding and annual work plan would support joint scientific research and regular institutional engagement. Seychelles is an archipelago nation in the Indian Ocean, with Victoria as its capital.

questions.question: Which state notified three elephant corridors in the Hosur Forest Division to strengthen elephant habitat connectivity?
questions.explanation: Tamil Nadu notified three elephant corridors in the Hosur Forest Division, covering more than 10,300 hectares, to safeguard critical elephant movement routes between Tamil Nadu and Karnataka. The designated corridors are Jawalagiri-Ulibanda-Thaggatti, Jawalagiri-Panai-Anchetty, and Billikkal Jawalagiri. The longest is the Jawalagiri-Panai-Anchetty corridor, covering 6,881.47 hectares and extending for 20.90 km. These corridors are located within the Cauvery North Wildlife Sanctuary and adjoining reserved forests. The notification aims to maintain forest connectivity, support elephant migration, and reduce habitat fragmentation and human-elephant conflict. It followed directions from the Madras High Court and recommendations from expert committees.

questions.question: What was the record level of India’s foreign exchange reserves in the week ended August 21?
questions.explanation: $729.3 billion was the record level reached by India’s foreign exchange reserves in the week ended August 21. The reserves increased by $12.4 billion, surpassing the previous record of $728.5 billion recorded in February. The rise was supported by strong capital inflows following the RBI’s concessional swap window and revaluation gains. Foreign Currency Assets increased to $591.33 billion, while gold reserves rose to $114.22 billion. The RBI’s swap window had brought in around $72.8 billion by August 21. At the new record level, India’s forex reserves were sufficient to cover more than 11 months of goods imports.

questions.question: Which Indian state launched the country’s first state-level Sports Genomics Programme?
questions.explanation: Gujarat launched India’s first state-level Sports Genomics Programme to integrate genomics with sports science, physiology, and nutrition for scientific athlete identification and high-performance training. The programme is supervised by the Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre (GBRC) and aims to collect around 2,000 athlete samples in its first year, with a target of 10,000 samples over five years. It studies genetic variations linked to endurance, muscle composition, power, metabolism, exercise response, and injury susceptibility. The initiative will also create the Gujarat Athlete Genome Database (G-AGD) to support personalised training, recovery, nutrition, and injury-risk assessment.

questions.question: Which company partnered with the Indian Institute of Creative Technologies to provide scholarships for 100 AVGC-XR students?
questions.explanation: Netflix partnered with the Indian Institute of Creative Technologies (IICT) to provide scholarships for 100 students and strengthen India’s AVGC-XR talent pipeline. Announced on August 26, 2026, the scholarship covers up to 80 per cent of the fees for professional, industry-ready programs. The curriculum includes diploma and certificate courses in areas such as Visual Effects Mastery, Interactive Comics, Media Tech Workflow, and E-Sports & Gaming Management. Netflix provided direct input for designing specialised courses to align them with global industry standards. The initiative supports India’s growing creative sector and contributes to the development of the country’s Orange Economy.

questions.question: What position did India secure in the FIH World Cup after losing to Belgium in the shootout?
questions.explanation: 8th was the position secured by the Indian men’s hockey team at the FIH World Cup after losing to Belgium in the shootout. The match ended 3-3 in regular time, with Abhishek scoring once and captain Harmanpreet Singh scoring twice for India, including a dramatic late equaliser. Belgium then won the shootout 4-3, with India scoring through Shilanand Lakra, Dilpreet Singh, and Abhishek. As a result, Belgium finished seventh while India finished eighth in the tournament. Harmanpreet Singh’s two-goal performance was one of the key individual highlights of India’s final World Cup match.

questions.question: What was Delhi’s own revenue share as a proportion of total revenue collections in the FY25 Budget Estimates?
questions.explanation: 93.2% was Delhi’s own revenue share as a proportion of total revenue collections in the FY25 Budget Estimates, making it the highest among the comparable states and Union Territories with available data. Haryana ranked second with 80.4%, followed by Telangana at 78.4%, Karnataka at 77.3%, and Tamil Nadu at 75.5%. Own revenue consists of own tax revenue and own non-tax revenue, including sources such as fees, royalties, dividends, and user charges. The indicator helps compare the extent to which states generate revenue from their own sources rather than relying on central tax transfers and grants.

questions.question: Which company handed over the Fast Patrol Vessel ICGS Ajit to the Indian Coast Guard?
questions.explanation: Goa Shipyard Limited (GSL) handed over the Fast Patrol Vessel ICGS Ajit (Yard 1277) to the Indian Coast Guard on August 25, 2026. The vessel was built with more than 65% indigenous content, supporting the Make in India and Atmanirbhar Bharat initiatives. It is equipped with twin marine diesel engines driving Controllable Pitch Propellers, a first-of-its-kind feature for this class of vessel. ICGS Ajit can exceed 27 knots and has an operational endurance of 1,500 nautical miles. The vessel will undertake coastal patrol, EEZ surveillance, anti-smuggling, search, and rescue missions.

questions.question: Which company partnered with UNDP India to support 50,000 Safai Mitras and strengthen waste management across 50 cities?
questions.explanation: Hindustan Unilever Limited (HUL) partnered with UNDP India on August 27, 2026, to support 50,000 Safai Mitras and strengthen waste management across 50 cities by 2028. The initiative focuses on formalising livelihoods, improving occupational safety and social security, and promoting the inclusion of women waste workers. HUL’s Project Circular Bharat promotes plastic circularity through financially viable recycling models, while Project Utthaan focuses on social inclusion and dignity for waste workers. The programme also emphasises source-level waste segregation, recovery value chains, and open-source toolkits for government bodies, in coordination with relevant Union ministries.

questions.question: Which Indian company signed an MoU with Japan’s Resona Bank for business matching and strategic investment collaboration?
questions.explanation: Tata Capital signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Japan’s Resona Bank on August 24, 2026, to promote business matching and strategic investment collaboration. As part of the partnership, Resona Bank committed US$20 million as a limited partner in the Tata Capital Growth Fund III LP. The fund is managed by Tata Capital and is registered as a Category II Alternative Investment Fund with SEBI. The collaboration aims to facilitate business opportunities and client introductions by leveraging Tata Capital’s network in the Indian market. Tata Capital is a diversified, systemically important non-deposit-taking NBFC and a subsidiary of Tata Sons Private Limited.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Director General of Home Guards, Delhi?
questions.explanation: Satish Golcha has been appointed as the Director General (DG) of Home Guards, Delhi, and is scheduled to assume charge on October 1, 2026. He is a 1992-batch IPS officer of the AGMUT cadre. Golcha previously served as the Delhi Police Commissioner from August 22, 2025, to July 17, 2026. He has also served as DGP of Arunachal Pradesh, DG of Tihar Prisons, and Special Commissioner of Police (Intelligence). He will succeed Virender Singh, a 1991-batch IPS officer, who is due to retire on September 30, 2026. The Home Guards assist civil administration in law and order, traffic management, and disaster response.

questions.question: Which drug was approved by the FDA for treating adults with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma?
questions.explanation: Rasonque (daraxonrasib) was approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) on August 26, 2026, for adults with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma. Developed by Revolution Medicines, Inc., Rasonque is a RAS inhibitor that targets multiple forms of the RAS protein, a key driver of tumour growth. It is administered as a once-daily tablet and is intended for patients who have received at least one prior systemic therapy and are not candidates for multiagent systemic therapy. In a randomised clinical trial involving 500 adults, the treatment improved median overall survival to 13.2 months compared with 6.7 months with standard chemotherapy.

questions.question: Which Indian water technology and engineering company joined the United Nations Global Compact Network India?
questions.explanation: WAE joined the United Nations Global Compact Network India on August 25, 2026, to align its operations with global sustainability standards. The company committed to the UN Global Compact’s Ten Principles covering human rights, labour, environment, and anti-corruption. Its sustainability efforts are aligned with five SDGs, including Clean Water and Sanitation, Industry and Innovation, Responsible Consumption, Climate Action, and Partnerships. WAE focuses on circular water systems, atmospheric water generation, and IoT-enabled monitoring to develop decentralised and digitally intelligent water ecosystems. The company will also report its sustainability progress through the Communication on Progress (CoP) framework, promoting transparency and accountability.

questions.question: Which company received India’s first compliance certificate for a 15-metre multi-axle sleeper bus?
questions.explanation: Synaty Automotive Pvt. Ltd. received India’s first compliance certificate for a 15-metre multi-axle sleeper bus from the International Centre for Automotive Technology (ICAT) on August 27, 2026. The certification was granted under AIS-119 and AIS-153 standards in accordance with the Central Motor Vehicles Rules. The bus features a 15-metre multi-axle configuration and offers 42 sleeper berths in its full-sleeper version, while the hybrid variant combines 21 berths with 42 seats. The certification involved specialised testing for structural strength, emergency and fire safety, and passenger comfort, supporting the development of advanced long-distance passenger vehicles in India.

questions.question: In which city was the 7th High-Level Meeting between the Indian Coast Guard and Vietnam Coast Guard held?
questions.explanation: Chennai hosted the 7th High-Level Meeting between the Indian Coast Guard (ICG) and Vietnam Coast Guard (VCG) on August 25, 2026. The meeting aimed to strengthen maritime cooperation and security between India and Vietnam under the 2015 Memorandum of Understanding on Coast Guard Cooperation. Discussions covered Maritime Search and Rescue, maritime law enforcement, marine pollution response, capacity building, professional exchanges, and previous ship visits. The two sides also planned the bilateral maritime exercise SAHYOG-HOPTAC, scheduled to be conducted at sea on August 27, 2026. Chennai’s strategic location on India’s eastern coast makes it an important centre for maritime cooperation.

questions.question: When was World Water Week 2026 observed?
questions.explanation: August 23 to 27 was the period during which World Water Week 2026 was observed. The annual event focused on the theme “Water for People and Progress” and addressed major global challenges related to water management, sanitation, freshwater resources, and climate resilience. Discussions also covered future international cooperation on water and implementation of the UNECE/WHO Protocol on Water and Health. World Water Week has been organised annually since 1991 by the Stockholm International Water Institute and was originally launched as the Stockholm Water Symposium. The event also served as a precursor to the UN Water Conference scheduled in Abu Dhabi in December 2026.

questions.question: Which country won the 2026 FIH Men’s Hockey World Cup by defeating Spain 1-0 in the final?
questions.explanation: Germany won the 2026 FIH Men’s Hockey World Cup after defeating Spain 1-0 in a closely contested final at the Belfius Hockey Arena. Michel Struthoff scored the decisive goal in the 44th minute, and Germany successfully defended its lead until the final whistle. This victory marked Germany’s second consecutive Hockey World Cup title and its fourth overall, following earlier triumphs in 2002, 2006, and 2023. With four titles, Germany equalled Pakistan as the joint-most successful team in Men’s Hockey World Cup history. Argentina secured the bronze medal by defeating the Netherlands 2-1.

questions.question: Which country lost the hosting rights for the 2027 Women’s Champions Trophy due to concerns over cricket governance?
questions.explanation: Sri Lanka lost the hosting rights for the inaugural ICC Women’s Champions Trophy 2027 following concerns over the autonomy and governance of Sri Lanka Cricket. The tournament was originally scheduled to be held from February 14 to 28, 2027, with six teams participating. The ICC had previously suspended Sri Lanka Cricket in 2023-24 over alleged political interference. In April 2026, the Sri Lankan government temporarily took charge of the cricket body and established a Transformation Committee. The ICC has emphasised the need for a democratically elected cricket board operating independently of government interference.

questions.question: Which country holds the world’s largest proven oil reserves and was involved in the historic 65 billion barrel oil deal with the United States?
questions.explanation: Venezuela holds the world’s largest proven oil reserves, estimated at more than 300 billion barrels. On August 29, 2026, the United States secured majority control over 65 billion barrels of proven Venezuelan oil reserves through a historic agreement. The deal aims to provide US refineries with stable, low-cost crude supplies while enabling long-term access for American companies to Venezuelan oilfields. It is expected to generate around $209 billion for Venezuela’s state treasury and attract nearly $100 billion in private energy-sector investment. Venezuela’s capital is Caracas, and the country is also one of the five founding members of OPEC, established in 1960.

questions.question: Which state unveiled its first ozone-based drinking water treatment project in Dehra?
questions.explanation: Himachal Pradesh unveiled its first ozone-based drinking water treatment project in Dehra, located in Kangra district. Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu announced ₹46 crore for the project, which uses ozone gas to disinfect water and improve its taste. The initiative aims to strengthen drinking water infrastructure and is expected to be extended to other parts of the state after its implementation in Dehra. The project is part of the government’s broader efforts to improve public services and local development. Other announcements included welfare schemes, forest conservation initiatives, new CBSE schools, and a veterinary hospital in Baddal Thor.

questions.question: Which institution launched the Phiball three-team basketball variant on the eve of National Sports Day in 2026?
questions.explanation: IIT Madras launched Phiball, an innovative three-team variant of basketball, on August 29, 2026, coinciding with the eve of National Sports Day. Designed by Prof. Sathyanarayana N. Gummadi, Dean of Students at IIT Madras, Phiball combines elements of basketball and netball and is played on a circular 26-metre-diameter court with three goal posts. The game has unique rules, including a 24-second shot clock, a maximum of three dribbles per possession, and a restricted no-offence zone beneath the rim. The name Phiball is inspired by the Golden Ratio, approximately 1.618. The sport is also designed to be affordable and accessible for grassroots participation.

questions.question: Which country declared a nationwide red alert on August 29, 2026, due to the El Nino phenomenon?
questions.explanation: Ecuador declared a nationwide red alert on August 29, 2026, due to the increasing risks associated with the ongoing El Nino phenomenon. The country’s Ministry of Risk Management issued the alert as authorities prepared for possible droughts, wildfires, and other climate-related disruptions. Particular concern was raised over drought and wildfire risks in the Amazon region. The emergency declaration enables authorities to take precautionary measures, including preventive evacuations if necessary. El Nino can cause abnormal weather patterns worldwide by altering atmospheric circulation, resulting in droughts in some regions and heavy rainfall in others.

questions.question: What shape of warning label has FSSAI proposed for HFSS packaged foods exceeding specified nutrient thresholds?
questions.explanation: Red Hexagonal is the proposed warning label shape for HFSS (High Fat, Sugar, and Salt) packaged foods under the FSSAI’s compliance proposal submitted to the Supreme Court on August 28, 2026. The warning would apply when a product is high in at least two of three specified nutrients: added sugar, added salt, or added saturated fat. The proposed label would be one point larger than the back-of-pack nutrition information and displayed in both Hindi and English. The framework is aligned with the ICMR-NIN Dietary Guidelines 2024 and uses the HFSS definition from earlier regulatory proposals and parliamentary discussions.

questions.question: Which country awarded Prime Minister Narendra Modi its highest honour, the Oliy Darajali Do‘stlik Order?
questions.explanation: Uzbekistan awarded Prime Minister Narendra Modi its highest honour, the Oliy Darajali Do‘stlik Order, during his visit to Tashkent on August 30, 2026. The honour, meaning “Order of Supreme Friendship,” recognises friendship and international cooperation. Modi dedicated the award to the people of India, India’s rich heritage, and the historic friendship between India and Uzbekistan. During the visit, the two countries also upgraded their bilateral relationship to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership and agreed on long-term uranium supplies to India. Cooperation was further strengthened in areas such as trade, investment, defence, energy, digital connectivity, and nuclear collaboration.

questions.question: On which date is National Small Industry Day observed in India?
questions.explanation: August 30 is observed as National Small Industry Day in India to recognise the important contribution of small-scale enterprises to manufacturing, employment, industrial development, and economic growth. The observance commemorates the launch of a comprehensive policy package for the small-scale sector on August 30, 2000. Small industries contribute over 30% of the country’s total national output and play a significant role in promoting the vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat. The National Small Industries Corporation (NSIC), established in 1955 under the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, supports the sector through training, capacity building, and other specialised programs.

questions.question: Which state notified three new elephant corridors in the Cauvery North Wildlife Sanctuary on August 28, 2026?
questions.explanation: Tamil Nadu notified three new elephant corridors in the Cauvery North Wildlife Sanctuary on August 28, 2026, to facilitate elephant movement between Tamil Nadu and Karnataka. The corridors are located in the Hosur Forest Division and support trans-Cauvery migration. The three corridors are Jawalagiri-Ulibanda-Thaggatti, Jawalagiri-Panai-Anchetty, and Bilikkal-Jawalagiri. All three are situated entirely within Reserved Forest boundaries, meaning no revenue villages or private lands are affected. Elephant corridors are important for connecting habitats, maintaining genetic diversity, and reducing human-wildlife conflict. The Cauvery North Wildlife Sanctuary also serves as a vital link between Karnataka’s Bannerghatta National Park and the Cauvery Wildlife Sanctuary.

questions.question: Which two states signed an agreement for sharing water from the Sone River?
questions.explanation: Bihar and Jharkhand signed an agreement to share water from the Sone River, resolving a longstanding interstate water dispute. The agreement aims to improve irrigation and drinking water availability across several districts in both states. In Bihar, regions such as Bhojpur, Buxar, Rohtas, Kaimur, Aurangabad, Arwal, Gaya, and Patna are expected to benefit. In Jharkhand, Palamu and Garhwa will receive water for irrigation and drinking purposes. The agreement is also considered an example of cooperative federalism, with dialogue between states being used to address water-resource and rural development needs.

questions.question: Who is set to succeed Tim Cook as the CEO of Apple from September 1, 2026?
questions.explanation: John Ternus is set to become Apple’s CEO from September 1, 2026, succeeding Tim Cook after Cook’s 15-year tenure. Ternus joined Apple in 2001 and rose to become senior vice president of hardware engineering, overseeing teams responsible for major products including the iPhone. As CEO, he is expected to focus on hardware innovation, artificial intelligence, product development, and Apple’s geopolitical and manufacturing challenges. Tim Cook will remain with Apple as executive chairman of the board, focusing on engagement with policymakers worldwide while Ternus concentrates on engineering, technology, and product strategy.

questions.question: When is ISRO scheduled to launch the GSLV-F17 carrying the EOS-05 Earth observation satellite?
questions.explanation: September 4 is the scheduled launch date for ISRO’s GSLV-F17 mission carrying the EOS-05 Earth observation satellite. The launch is planned for 2:55 AM IST from the Second Launch Pad of the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh. EOS-05 is significant because it is planned to become India’s first imaging satellite to operate from a geosynchronous orbit. The mission will demonstrate the GSLV’s capability to place advanced satellites into high-altitude orbits and strengthen India’s space-based Earth observation capabilities for environmental research, resource management, and monitoring changes on Earth’s surface.

questions.question: Which city became the first in India to achieve Zero Legacy Waste status under the Swachh Shehar Jodi initiative?
questions.explanation: Depalpur became the first city in India to achieve Zero Legacy Waste status under the Swachh Shehar Jodi initiative on August 31, 2026. The city successfully remediated 1,250 metric tonnes of accumulated waste that had built up over five years. Depalpur worked as a mentee city, with Indore serving as its mentor under the initiative’s Each One Teach One model. The effort also recovered recyclable materials, directed Refuse Derived Fuel to cement factories, and introduced a four-bin waste segregation system. The dumpsite was subsequently transformed into a green space and community hub, supporting cleaner and more sustainable urban development.

questions.question: What was India's real GDP growth rate in Q1 FY27?
questions.explanation: India’s real GDP grew by 7.8% year-on-year in the first quarter of FY27, covering the period from April to June 2026. This growth exceeded the Reserve Bank of India’s forecast of 7%, as well as estimates from the Moneycontrol poll and Reuters survey. The strong performance reflected the resilience of the Indian economy despite uncertainty in the global economic environment. Growth was supported by strong domestic demand, higher private and government consumption, robust investment, and positive performance in sectors such as services and manufacturing.

questions.question: Where is the 4th Indo-German Environmental Forum scheduled to be held on September 1, 2026?
questions.explanation: New Delhi is the venue for the 4th Indo-German Environmental Forum, scheduled for September 1, 2026. The forum aims to strengthen cooperation between India and Germany on climate and environmental policy. It is co-chaired by Union Minister Bhupender Yadav and German Minister Carsten Schneider and is organised under the theme “Together For More Resilience.” Key areas of discussion include low-carbon industries, biodiversity conservation, resource efficiency, circular economy models, sustainable finance, green skills, and investment mobilisation. The event is jointly organised by India’s Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change and Germany’s BMUKN.

questions.question: Which country signed a Letter of Offer and Acceptance with India for the procurement of Javelin anti-tank guided missile systems?
questions.explanation: The United States signed a Letter of Offer and Acceptance with India on August 29, 2026, for the procurement of Javelin anti-tank guided missile systems for the Indian Army. The agreement establishes a direct government-to-government procurement route and marks India’s formal entry as a customer for the shoulder-fired Javelin system. India and the US are also working toward eventual joint production of the missile system in India. The Javelin is a man-portable, fire-and-forget anti-tank missile featuring a top-attack flight profile designed to target the weaker roof armor of tanks and armored vehicles.

questions.question: Which state is set to establish its first university exclusively managed and staffed by women?
questions.explanation: Bihar is set to establish the state’s first women’s university, as announced by Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary on August 27, 2026. The university will have women serving as the Vice-Chancellor, professors, and other staff members, making it a dedicated institution for women’s education, leadership, and professional development. The announcement was made during the Viksit Bharat-Samridh Bihar program, alongside welfare initiatives worth ₹600 crore. Other measures included financial assistance to women through Direct Benefit Transfer, loans under the Jeevika Nidhi fund, rural market construction, and reforms to recruitment examinations and student grievance mechanisms.

questions.question: Who announced his retirement from playing for the Argentinian national football team after an illustrious international career?
questions.explanation: Lionel Messi announced his retirement from international football after an extraordinary 20-year career with Argentina. He made 207 international appearances and scored 125 goals, becoming Argentina’s most-capped player and all-time leading scorer. Messi played a key role in Argentina’s major recent successes, including the 2021 and 2024 Copa América titles, the 2022 Finalissima, and the 2022 FIFA World Cup. He also scored seven goals during Argentina’s victorious 2022 World Cup campaign in Qatar. His retirement marks the conclusion of one of the most celebrated international careers in football history.

questions.question: Which country announced the commencement of a Two-Plus-Two Dialogue with China on August 30, 2026?
questions.explanation: Bangladesh announced the commencement of a Two-Plus-Two (2+2) Dialogue with China on August 30, 2026, aimed at strengthening bilateral cooperation in diplomacy and defence. The initial discussions will be conducted at the Minister of State level, with subsequent meetings expected to move to the Foreign Minister level. The two countries are also focusing on strategic and economic cooperation, including the modernisation of Mongla Port, a proposed Mongla Export Processing Zone, the Teesta River Comprehensive Management and Restoration Project, and the China-Myanmar-Bangladesh corridor. The dialogue represents an effort to deepen Bangladesh-China strategic relations across multiple sectors.

questions.question: Who was appointed as an Executive Director of the Reserve Bank of India effective September 1, 2026?
questions.explanation: Suman Ray was appointed as an Executive Director (ED) of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) effective September 1, 2026. Before this appointment, he served as the Regional Director of the RBI for Maharashtra. As Executive Director, he will oversee the Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC) and the Premises Department. Ray has more than three decades of experience with the RBI and has worked across areas such as currency management, financial inclusion, payments and settlements, consumer education and protection, and human resources. He has also served as secretary to the Western Area Local Board.

questions.question: Who became the first non-medical woman officer in the Indian Defence Forces to be promoted to the rank of Air Vice Marshal?
questions.explanation: Shakti Sharma created history by becoming the first woman officer from the non-medical cadre in the Indian Defence Forces to be promoted to the rank of Air Vice Marshal, a two-star rank. Commissioned into the Indian Air Force Education Branch on June 18, 1994, she has served for more than three decades across training institutions, field units, command headquarters and Air Headquarters. From September 1, 2026, she took charge as Assistant Chief of the Air Staff (Education) at Air Headquarters. Her career also includes serving as Principal of Sainik School, Kapurthala, and establishing academic-defence partnerships with institutions such as IIT Kanpur and Pune University.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the first Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust in Ayodhya?
questions.explanation: Jeetendra Mishra, a retired Air Marshal of the Indian Air Force, was appointed as the first Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust in Ayodhya. He brings more than three decades of experience in the Indian Air Force and was commissioned as a fighter pilot on December 6, 1986. Mishra is a fighter combat leader and experimental test pilot with over 3,000 hours of flying experience. He has studied at prestigious institutions including the National Defence Academy, Air Force Test Pilots School, Air Command & Staff College in the USA, and Royal College of Defence Studies in the UK.

questions.question: Which country became the 71st signatory to the Artemis Accords in August 2026?
questions.explanation: Turkey became the 71st signatory to the Artemis Accords on August 31, 2026. The agreement was signed by Turkiye’s Minister for Industry and Technology, Mehmet Fatih Kacır, at NASA headquarters in Washington, D.C. The Artemis Accords establish principles for peaceful, transparent, and cooperative exploration of the Moon, Mars, and beyond. Turkiye’s participation reflects its growing interest in space exploration and international cooperation. The country is developing its national space program and preparing its first lunar mission, AYAP-1. Turkiye’s first astronaut, Alper Gezeravcı, travelled to the International Space Station in 2024 and conducted scientific research.

questions.question: When will World Coconut Day be observed in 2026?
questions.explanation: September 2 is observed as World Coconut Day, and in 2026 it will be celebrated on Wednesday, September 2. The day highlights the importance of coconut in agriculture, food production, trade, and the economy. It also recognises the livelihoods of communities involved in coconut cultivation and promotes sustainable agricultural practices. World Coconut Day was first celebrated in 2009 in association with the International Coconut Community (ICC), formerly known as the Asian and Pacific Coconut Community (APCC). The coconut is often called the “tree of life” because its water, meat, milk, oil, husk, shell, and leaves have numerous uses.

questions.question: Who became the youngest player to score a half-century in the history of the Duleep Trophy?
questions.explanation: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi became the youngest player to score a half-century in Duleep Trophy history at the age of 15 years and 157 days. He achieved this milestone during the 2026 semifinal between East Zone and Central Zone at the BCCI Centre of Excellence Ground 1 in Bengaluru. Sooryavanshi scored 92 runs from 81 balls and reached his fifty in just 42 balls. He surpassed Laxman Singh’s 57-year-old record, who had scored a Duleep Trophy fifty at 16 years and 23 days in the 1969 edition.

questions.question: Which country was involved in the Bhashini Shilpi session aimed at strengthening cooperation in multilingual AI technology and digital inclusion with India?
questions.explanation: Nepal was the country involved in the Bhashini Shilpi session organised by the Digital India Bhashini Division on August 31, 2026. The initiative aimed to strengthen India-Nepal cooperation in multilingual artificial intelligence technology and digital inclusion. Bhashini serves as India’s national platform for AI-enabled translation and speech services, helping reduce language barriers in digital public infrastructure. It supports more than 800 government websites, processes over 9 billion AI-related information units, and handles more than 24 million AI inferences daily. The platform provides text-based support for 36 Indian languages, voice technology for 23 Indian languages, and multilingual capabilities across 35 international languages.

questions.question: By what percentage did India’s gross GST revenue increase year-on-year in August 2026?
questions.explanation: 14.8% was the year-on-year growth recorded in India’s gross Goods and Services Tax (GST) revenue in August 2026. The total gross GST collections reached ₹1,99,853 crore, reflecting strong revenue performance. Domestic transactions increased by 9.3% to ₹1,37,249 crore, while revenue from imports rose by 29% to ₹62,604 crore. After accounting for refunds, net GST revenue stood at ₹1,68,057 crore, registering an 8.3% increase. Total refunds increased significantly by 67.9% to ₹31,795 crore. The 57th GST Council meeting is scheduled for September 12, 2026.

questions.question: Where was the 4th India-Denmark MSME Joint Working Group meeting held?
questions.explanation: Copenhagen hosted the 4th India-Denmark MSME Joint Working Group meeting, which focused on strengthening bilateral cooperation in the MSME sector, innovation, and technology. The meeting brought together representatives from India’s Ministry of MSME and the Danish Patent and Trademark Office. Key areas of discussion included Intellectual Property-led growth, technology transfer, startup support, and innovation. The delegation also participated in TechBBQ, a major Nordic startup event, and visited Aarhus University Innovation Kitchen and Agro Food Park. The engagement reflects the growing economic and technological partnership between India and Denmark, including cooperation benefiting MSMEs and startups.

questions.question: In which country was the 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit held?
questions.explanation: Kyrgyzstan hosted the 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Summit at the Yrys Ordo Congress Hall in Bishkek under the chairmanship of President Sadyr Japarov. The summit brought together leaders from the SCO’s 10 member states, along with partner and observer countries. India, China, Russia, Pakistan, Iran, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, and Kyrgyzstan participated as member states. The 2026 summit also marked the 25th anniversary of the SCO. Discussions focused on strengthening mutual trust, regional peace and stability, security, connectivity, economic cooperation, and multilateral engagement. India’s Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted the priorities of Security, Connectivity, and Opportunity.

The increase was supported by rising international demand for value-added coconut products and the expansion of India’s export market to 155 countries. Coconut-based products have applications across several sectors, including food, pharmaceuticals, water purification, capacitors, and other industries. The strong export performance highlights the growing economic importance of the coconut sector and India’s expanding role in the global coconut market. World Coconut Day 2026 will be observed on September 2, with celebrations planned in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.

questions.question: Which state introduced the Business Facilitation (Amendment) Bill, 2026, proposing a 21-day limit for several business clearances?
questions.explanation: Tamil Nadu introduced the Tamil Nadu Business Facilitation (Amendment) Bill, 2026, proposing a 21-day limit for processing various business and regulatory clearances. The proposed timeline would apply where existing state legislation provides a period longer than 21 days or does not specify a processing period. Public and local holidays would be excluded when calculating the 21-day period, while timelines shorter than 21 days would remain unchanged. The Bill also proposes establishing the Tamil Nadu Investment Promotion Commission, headed by the Chief Secretary, to monitor major investments involving significant capital, employment generation, free trade agreements, and other specified categories.

questions.question: Which institution collaborated with DRDO in developing and securing a patent for the high-energy compound BAM-H24?
questions.explanation: The University of Hyderabad collaborated with the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) in the research and development of BAM-H24, a high-energy compound intended for potential use in next-generation solid rocket propulsion systems. Researchers from the University of Hyderabad, including Drs. Muddamarri Hanumantha Rao and Muralidharan Krishnamurthi, contributed to the development. BAM-H24 combines high energetic performance with safety features such as chemical and thermal stability and resistance to impact and friction. Its low moisture absorption and expected superior specific impulse and low ignition delay could make it useful for improving the efficiency, safety, and performance of solid rocket propulsion systems.

questions.question: Which airline did former IAF Group Captain Abhinandan Varthaman join as a commercial pilot in August 2026?
questions.explanation: FLY91 is the Goa-based regional airline that former Indian Air Force Group Captain Abhinandan Varthaman joined as a commercial pilot in August 2026. After nearly 22 years of service in the IAF, Varthaman resigned from military service on March 31, 2026, and transitioned to civilian aviation. He subsequently began type rating and other mandatory procedures required for regional commercial flying. FLY91 commenced commercial operations in March 2024 and operates ATR 72-600 aircraft, focusing on regional connectivity between smaller cities and markets. As of September 3, 2026, the airline had six ATR 72-600 aircraft in its fleet.

questions.question: What is the name of the rainfall-based weather futures contract launched by NCDEX to hedge Northeast Monsoon risks?
questions.explanation: RAINCHNNAI is a rainfall-based weather futures contract launched by the National Commodity & Derivatives Exchange (NCDEX) to help manage financial risks associated with the Northeast Monsoon. The contract covers rainfall variability from September to December and is based on Cumulative Deviation Rainfall from the Long Period Average. It uses rainfall data from the India Meteorological Department’s Meenambakkam and Nungambakkam stations. The contract is cash-settled based on the CDR spot value. RAINCHNNAI complements the RAINMUMBAI contract and is particularly significant because the Northeast Monsoon contributes approximately 70% of Chennai’s annual rainfall.

questions.question: Which company received a multi-year Airbus contract to manufacture and supply fuselage skins for the A320 aircraft family?
questions.explanation: Mahindra Aerostructures received a multi-year contract from Airbus to manufacture and supply fuselage skins for the A320 aircraft family. The contract covers components for the A320neo and A321XLR models, particularly the rear fuselage and tail sections. Production will take place at Mahindra Aerostructures’ facility in Bengaluru, India, with finished components supplied to Airbus’ manufacturing plant in Augsburg, Germany. Initial engineering and tooling design are underway, while deliveries are scheduled to begin in 2028. The project will also expand technological capabilities through advanced production lines for chemical milling, surface treatment, and stretch-forming, strengthening India’s role in the global aerospace supply chain.

questions.question: Where was India’s first “Green Forge” complex inaugurated?
questions.explanation: Mohali was the location where India’s first “Green Forge” complex was inaugurated at the National Agri-food & Biomanufacturing Institute (BRIC-NABI). The facility is designed for controlled simulation, cultivation, and experimentation involving genetically modified (GM) crops. It can recreate environmental conditions such as light, humidity, and temperature and uses Artificial Intelligence and advanced simulation technologies to assess crop suitability across different geographical regions. The complex is part of broader efforts to strengthen India’s biotechnology ecosystem. The initiative also connects with the National Bio-Foundry Network, space biotechnology research with ISRO, and sustainability projects supporting India’s Net Zero 2070 goals.

questions.question: Which country will host the inaugural ICC Women’s Champions Trophy in 2027?
questions.explanation: India will host the inaugural ICC Women’s Champions Trophy 2027 after the ICC transferred the hosting rights from Sri Lanka. The tournament is scheduled to be held from February 14 to February 28, 2027, with six teams competing. Matches will take place at the Cricket Club of India in Mumbai and the International Cricket Stadium in Vadodara. The participating teams are Australia, England, India, New Zealand, South Africa, and Sri Lanka. The tournament will follow a round-robin format, with the top two teams advancing to the final on February 28.

questions.question: Which state is set to establish a Coconut Park with the support of the Coconut Development Board?
questions.explanation: Kerala is set to establish a Coconut Park with support from the Coconut Development Board to strengthen the state’s coconut industry. The project aims to promote modern processing, value addition, packaging, branding, and marketing of coconut-based products. It is also expected to encourage entrepreneurship, attract investments, and support export-oriented production of high-quality coconut products. The Kerala government plans to provide the necessary land and support for the initiative while engaging with exporters and industry stakeholders. Discussions will also focus on developing export-oriented value addition projects and business-to-business linkages, helping processed coconut products reach international markets.

questions.question: When is World Skyscraper Day celebrated annually?
questions.explanation: September 3 is observed annually as World Skyscraper Day, celebrating the engineering, architecture, and ambition behind the construction of the world’s tallest buildings. The date is associated with the birth date of Louis H. Sullivan, an influential pioneer of early skyscraper design. Modern supertall skyscrapers are generally defined by the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat (CTBUH) as buildings measuring at least 300 metres in height. These structures demonstrate advances in foundation systems, wind engineering, elevators, fire safety, and vertical transportation while often combining residential, commercial, hospitality, and entertainment facilities.

questions.question: Which state has announced the establishment of an Olympic City?
questions.explanation: Tamil Nadu has announced plans to establish a world-class Olympic City in Chennai, aiming to strengthen sports infrastructure and athlete development in the state. The Tamil Nadu Sports Development Authority will be involved in developing the proposed integrated sports complex. The Olympic City is expected to feature world-class sports arenas, modern sporting equipment, a high-performance training centre, and dedicated sports science and sports medicine centres. These facilities are intended to support athletes through advanced training, performance analysis, conditioning, injury prevention, treatment, and rehabilitation, helping them prepare effectively for national and international sporting competitions.
